tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma nirti shwa rā ya/ye shes bskal pa'i me 'od kyis/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bsregs nas/khams gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa/
༄༅/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma nirti shwa rā ya/ye shes bskal pa'i me 'od kyis/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bsregs nas/khams gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru pad+ma nirti shwa rā ya/

ye shes bskal pa'i me 'od kyis/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor kun bsregs nas/ khams gsum dbang du sdud mdzad pa/ /dbang chen sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de'i sgrub thabs bshad bya ste/ /kun gyi rtsa ba phyag gnyis pa/ /sgrub 'dod mar me mdzad dpal gyi/ /man ngag bzhin du 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir rta mgrin zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā wa lan gsum gyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar raṃ ser po las nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥdamar po de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar 'bar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas seng ldeng gi dbyug tho rdo rjes mtshan pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo ljang khus rta skad 'byin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas klu pho mo mnan pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan sogs khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad rta mgrin gyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ dbang bskur rang gi spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum byin rlabs man chad bor yang rung ngo*/ / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla/ thun mtshams su dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor snod paṃ las pad+ma dmar po baṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma rā ga'i snod chen por gyur/ de'i nang gtor rdzas kyis gang ba/

nam mkhar hrīḥdakar dmar mthing gsum brtsegs pa/ rang gi snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros gsum la phog pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzags gtor snod gang*/ oṃ sarba ka ri zhes pa lan gsum dang*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sam+bha ra sam+bha ra hūṃ/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin spyan drangs/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsams/ slar yang hrīḥyig gi 'od zer gyis sems can thams cad khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin du byas pa dang*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma thams cad spyan drangs/ snying po'i sngags lan gsum gyis gtor ma gtso bo la phul/ oṃ āḥhrīḥhūṃ/ lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i srung ma dang*/ lan bdun gyis 'jig rten pa rnams la phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab nas/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes gshegs su gsol/ dge ba bsngo'o/ / 'a di'i rig gtad kyi dbang bskur ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi dbus su pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad re kha dkar pos bris/ gru bcad bzhi phyogs mdog tu btang*/ de'i dbus su mañji'i steng du bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bshams/ mdun du mchod gtor rgya cher bshams shing*/ spyir dgos pa'i yo byad rol mo sna tshogs dang*/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ brtsegs gtor/ glo gnyis su chang bu dang mtheb kyu re/ de la ril bu brgya brgyad spungs pa zhig bya/ phyogs gang yang rung ba zhig tu stegs bu la gtor ma dang*/ seng ldeng gi dbyug tho zhig kyang bzhagasngon 'gro gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags brgya rtsa gcig gis bsngos la/ ye dharma dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing sogs kyis chos bshad/ a pa ra s+tha naṃ gats+tsha/ zhes pas rang gnas su song bar bsam/

bgegs dang log 'dren la bden pa bdar zhing*/ sngags bzlas pas bskrad/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las maṇ+ḍal dang bum pa gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa'i dbus su/ raṃ ser po las zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan gyi bar gong bzhin/ dbang rdzas kyi gtor ma dang*/ phyag mtshan skad cig gis rta mgrin zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ ar+gha ཾ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ hrīḥ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsung*/ /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas rngam chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ dbang rdzas kyi rta mgṛn gnyis po zhu ba las gtor ma dang dbyug par gyur/ gzungs thag bzung zhing sngags bzlas pas/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po bdud rtsir spyan drangs/ bum nang gi lha'i thugs kar thim/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs bum pa gang bar gyur/ snying po brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ maṇ+ḍal gtor ma dbyug pa gsum la dmigs nas nyer gcig tsam re bzla'o/ /gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dung chos kyi chu bum par bluga.oṃ āḥhūṃ/ bum nang gi lha ye shes kyi bdud rtsir zhu bar gyur/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ sems can thams cad 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i phyir du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal rta mgrin yi dam du 'tshal gyi/

bdag la byin gyis brlabs pa stsal du gsol/ ces lan gsum/ de nas slob dpon gyis legs so'i spro ba bskyed cigaslar yang bzlas brjod la brtson par gdams/ de nas bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rgyas par 'bogs/ bsdu na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sangs rgyas chos dang mas chog bu tshur theg pa chen po yi/ / zhes sogs sngags kyi che ba brjod/ slob ma'i spyi bor rta mgrin dang*/ snying ga'i nang du hrīḥyig mar me 'bar ba lta bu gsal btab/ rta mgrin gyi gnas gsum nas 'od zer 'bar ba/ dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma'i lus gang*/ sdig sgrib bsregs/ bde ba skyes par mos/ sngags bzla zhing rol mo'i sgra bya/ des ye shes phebs par 'gyur/ mngon rtogs bzhin lha bskyed bstim/ sku'i gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byas nas/ dbang lha spyan drangs/ ji ltar bltams pa zhes sogs kyi dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan gyi bar spyi dang 'dra/ me tog spyi bor bzhagasnying po lan bdun tsam bzlas te brtan par bsam/ bzlas lung dang*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / sogs byin gyis brlab pa'i lung spyi dang mthun/ 'jig rten 'di na gdug can dregs pa che/ /'og gi klu dang steng gi tshangs pa sogs/ /'joms byed dbyug pa bzung zhing gdug pa thul/ / phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i dbang thob shog/ ces dang*/ snying po lan gsum gyis dbyug pa gtad de/ thugs kyi byin rlabs so/ /de nas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bskur/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog rnams spyi'i cho gas rigs 'gre'o/ khro rgyal kun gyi rigs sngags rgyal/ /gsang sngags 'chang kuna~X dga~X' bskyed pa/ /rta mgrin snyinga~X po~X'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /mdo tsam yi ge'i lam du byas/ /rta mgrin jo bo lugs lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

// ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ nyin byed 'bum gyi 'od zer gyis/ /gnod byed 'byung po kun bsregs te/ /'gro la gsung gi snang ba 'gyed/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag khyed la 'dud/ /thugs rje chen po drag por grags pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs chen mo dpal ldan ā ti sha'i bzhed pa bzhin bshad par bya'o/ / oṃ swa bhā wa bi shud+dha sarba dharmā swa bhā wa bi shud+dho3haṃ/ rang gi snying gar raṃ ser po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las nyi ma dang de la gnas pa'i hrīḥlas 'od zer lcags kyu dang zhags pa lta bu 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ / sogs dang*/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar sho lo ka gcig gis bstod cing phyag 'tshal/ snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ puṣ+pe nas nai wi te 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang yang bdag gis dus kun tu/ /sdig pa bgyis par gang gyur pa/ /skrag pas rmi ltar bshags bgyid cing*/ /deng nas brtsams te 'byung mi bgyid/ /dge ba rnams la rjes yi rang*/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung*/ /thams cad byang chub mchog tu bsngo/ /de thob lam la gnas bgyid cing*/ /dam pa'i skyabs gsum la skyabs mchi/ / zhes rgyun bshags dang*/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā sogs lan gsum/ stong pa'i ngang las raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje nag po hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ de'i nang du nyi ma la ¿bh+ruṃ dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ shar dngul/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā gabyang gser las grub pa'i/ yang na bh+rūṃ las thod rus 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang stong gsum gyi khyon dang mnyam pa/ sha rus kyi rgyan gyis brgyan par bsgom/

de'i dbus su raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin dbu gsum phyag drug pa/ sku mdog dmar po/ dbus dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon gnag pa'i zhal spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu gsum gyi steng du rta mgo ljang khu gsum yod pa/ zhal nas 'brug stong ldir ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gnyis pa na gser gyi zhags pa/ gsum pa na dbyug tho bsnams pa/ g.yon gyi dang po na dung chen dmar gyis bkang ba bsnams pa/ gnyis pa na ral gri/ tha ma sbar ba gdangs pa'i mthe bong las bya khyung dkar po/ mdzub mo las mthing kha/ gung mo las ser po/ srin lag las dmar po/ mthe'u chung las ljang khu rnams/ bye ba bye ba'i sprul pa 'gyed pa/ zhabs drug gis klu brgyad brdzis pa/ rdo rje gshog pa g.yas g.yon las bya khyung gi sprul pa 'gyed pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ thod rkam gyi dbu rgyan/ thod rlon gyi se ral kha/ sbrul dkar nag gis yan lag rnams brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /lce rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ oṃ sarba ka ri zhes pas mtshan/ snying ga g.yon par nyi ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa/ g.yas par zla ba la gnas pa'i rgya gram ljang khu/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snying ga'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrīḥ.a zhes dbang bskur/ rgya gram las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ hūṃ sku mdog chags med nub kha'i dmar thag 'dra/ /'bar ba'i dbu la ral pa gyen du brdzes/ /ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha/ / pad+ma rigs sngags rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ye shes ha ya gṛ wa rta mchog dpal/ /zhal nas hūṃ phaṭa 'brug stong di ri ri/ /zhal bgrad mche ba gtsigs pa'i tshems nang na/

/gdug pa 'dul ba'i me stag khrom khrom 'bar/ khro rgyal dbang gi rta skad tsher tsher 'tsher/ /rta mgrin rta skad 'tsher la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes rang dang gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla/ thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ ye shes sems dpa' rang gi mdun du bzhugs pa la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas te/ bdag la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / zhes brjod/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang yang rta mgrin lhan skyes su grags pa phyag gnyis pa'i skabs dang 'dra bas de nyid 'don pa spo/ khyad par phyag mtshan gser mdog gi zhags pa dang ral gri/ seng ldeng dbyug pa'i tshab tu 'jogathugs kyi rjes gnang skabs/ thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyi/ /zhags pa ral gri bu la sbyin/ /zhags pas chings la ral gris gtubs/ /stong nyid snying rje rtogs par shog/ ces brjod/ 'di lta ltar byed na/ de'i tshom bu bkod/ 'khor bzhi khyi gdong mi dgos/ gzhan shwa na bzhi bskor dang 'dra'o/ /mtshan yang rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs su spo'o/ mkhas pa kuna~X gyi gtsug gi rgyan/ /dī paṃ ka ras yol ston la/ /gnang bas dga~X' skyes dngos grub thob/ /de gsung snyinga~X po~X tsam du bsdus/ /rta mgrin jo lugs chen mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /na mo kro dha rā dzā ya/ ches zab mchog tu rmad byung ba/ /rta mchog dpal gyi sgrub thabs 'di/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bshad bya yi/ /yid la dga' ba bskyed de nyon/ /maṇ+ḍal dmar po legs par brgyan la/ tshom bu lnga bkram la/ mchod pa dang/ gtor ma gsum bshams/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma/ de las gnas pa'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ bla ma dang rta mgrin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bzang spyod nas 'byung pa ltar yan lag bdun pa bya/ rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni/ /bdag gi lus kun rtag tu dbul bar bgyi/ / zhes brjod/ yang na skyabs sems gong du ma byas par/ skabs 'dir byas kyang rung*/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ maṃ las nyi ma brtsegs pa'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa'i bsrung 'khor dang*/ rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa gzhal yas khang du gyur/ de'i dbus su rang sems rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid khro rgyal rta mchog rol pa pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar zhing*/ dmar sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum dbus ma'i steng du/ rta mgo ljang zhur gyen du bltas te rta skad 'byin pa/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis kyis mda' gzhu 'gengs pa/ zhabs bzhi'i g.yon brkyang pa'i brkyang bskum dang gar stabs kyis tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang po mahā de ba rnams mnan pa/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ stag lpags sbrul rgyan mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /shar du rdo rje las byed ma mthing skya/ lhor gshin rje las byed ma mthing naganub tu klu mo las byed ma dkar mo/ byang du gnod sbyin las byed ma ljang khu thams cad kyang khyi gdong zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa spyi dang mthun par bsgoms la/ oṃ ha ha hi hi hriṃ hriṃ hri hri hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/

ces rtsa ba'i sngags ci 'grub bzla zhing*/ badz+ra shwa na sa ma ya/ ya ma shwa na sa ma ya/ nā ga shwa na sa ma ya/ kha ra ka shwa na sa ma ya/ zhes btags pa bzla zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ ta kri ta tsa ti bi tsa ti hū ya hu ya/ hu lu hu lu/ pu ru te pu ru te swāhā/ zhes pa sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi sngags sam/ rtsa sngags dang nye ba'i snying po ste/ de dag kyang ci 'grub bzla'o/ /las sngags ni sgrub thabs rnams su shes par bya'o/ thun bsdu bar 'dod na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ dmar po las gtso 'khor lnga spros mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' lha lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ hūṃ chags med sogs kyis bstod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes gnyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ / sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing*/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las/ gtso bo la 'od dpag med gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ de nas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod gong bzhin bya ba'am gang 'grub bya'o/ /bar 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing*/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ gtso bo'i gtor snod bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i pad gzhong yangs shing rgya che bar gyur/ de'i nang du bcud yi ge 'bru gsum las byung ba'i lha'i bdud rtsi dkar dmar du gyur/ las byed ma bzhi'i gtor ma/ a las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod kyi nang du 'bru gsum las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkugagator ma'i bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pas phul/ slar yang mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs dang*/ khyed kyi sems can sogs/ badz+ra muḥzhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang gi snying gar thim/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba dang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ / rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis dge ba bsngos nas thun mtshams la 'jugamachod bstod lhag ma rnams gtsang sar dor ro/ /'di'i rjes gnang yang rta mgrin lhan skyes kyi de nyid 'don pa spos pas rung ba las tshom bu lnga 'god/ phyag mtshan rdo rje dang pad+ma nyid 'god/ thugs kyi rjes gnang skabs/ shes rab stong nyid rdo rje dang*/ /snying rje ma chags pad+ma dmar/ /thabs dang thabs byung zung du 'jug/ ye shes thugs kyi dbang thob shog/ ces brjod pa nyid khyad par ro/ /sgrub thabs kuna~X las zab po zhes/ /grags pa'i dga~X' bas yongs khyab pa/ /shwa na bzhi bskor sgom pa'i thabs/ snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bkod 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa 'di dpal rta mgrin shwa na bzhi bskor du grags pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rigs sngags rgyal po rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jig rten 'jigs byed phyag btsal nas/ /rta mgrin dpal gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus sgrub po'i don du bri/ /shū n+ya ta 'i sngags don bsam/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs sho lo ka gcig bya/ spyi bor zla ba la oṃ/ snying gar nyi ma la āḥ lte bar pad+ma la hūṃ/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis bdag dang khams gsum gyi lus ngag yid gsum dag par byas/ stong pa'i ngang las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi nyes brtsegs bsnol ma'i steng du ri rab de'i rtse mor nyi ma la hūṃ/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+rā ṇāṃ/

oṃ āḥhūṃ de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs te hūṃ la thim/ yang hūṃ zhes brjod pas/ 'og min nas rta mgrin spyan drangs te thim pa las/ rang nyid rta mgrin dmar po ches khros shing 'jigs pa'i sku can/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pas rdo rjes mtshan pas dbyug tho 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas srid rtse man gyi bgegs thams cad gnon pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo nag po can/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ sbrul dang*/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing*/ hi hi'i sgra sgrog pa/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin gyis brlabs shing*/ nor rgyas la sogs klu rnams bka' nod pa/ 'od zer sna lnga dang*/ me dpung 'phro ba'i sku khro bo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ / snying gar sngags 'khor gsal btab la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ya gṛ wa badz+ra kro dha hūṃ hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar/ ā ka ro btags la 'bul/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa gzhan rnams dang 'dra zhing*/ gtor dbang re mdzad pa'i phyag len gda'o/ /rta rtog pa bdun brgya ba zhes pa'i/ /rgyud las btus pa'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /kun ༵ tu dag ༵ 'a ba bskyed pa dang*/ /snyinga~X po~X'i don rtogs phan yon che/ /paṇa chen shākya shrī nas brgyud pa'i rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang khros pa'i sku/ /ye shes ha ya gṛ wa la/ /gus pa'i yid kyis btud byas nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs la/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la rang sems hrīḥdamar po las/

rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug/rtsa ba'i zhal dmar po/ g.yas ljang ba/ g.yon dkar ba/ dbu gsum gyi steng na rta mgo ljang nag gsum mngon par 'phags te skad 'tsher ba/ rngog ma'i gseb nas me stag 'phros pas tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas dmyal ba yan chad me'i dra gur gyis khebs par mdzad pa/ spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje/ gnyis pa na mdung rtse gsum pa/ tha ma na ral gri/ g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub/ bar ba na mdung thung*/ tha ma na rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs brgyad kyis pad nyi'i steng du sbrul brgyad mnan pa/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ mi pags kyi g.yang gzhi/ glang chen gyi ko rlon/ rus pa'i rgyan drug khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bu/ sbrul nag gi chun po rnams kyis brgyan pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung tsha ba rtsub pa'i klong dkyil na bzhugs pa/ mgrin pa man chad nas byin pa yan chad du rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa'i khro bo gdug pa can ma rung pa tshar gcod pa'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa/ khrab kyi byang bu ltar gtams pa/ dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi stod du nyi ma la hrīḥphyi nang thams cad du ye shes kyi me sprul pa'i pho nya dang bcas pas khyab par bsams la/ oṃ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṝ ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci mang bzla/ 'jug tu snying po'i mthar/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya dzaḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya bh+yoḥ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya bzlogakhaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya gtubs/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya byer/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbad/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbud/ khaṃ rak+ṣa sa mā ya rbad rbud phaṭa ya 'byung po mā ra ya dza dzaḥ zhes pa btags pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dun bh+yoḥtig nan dzaḥdzaḥ sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/

zhes pa'ang btags la lan lnga tsam bzla'o/ /'jug tu dge ba'i rtsa ba'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma bsngo bar 'dod na/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis dgra bgegs thams cad bkug rdo rje khro bo rnams kyis tshar bcad pa'i sha khrag gi phung po gtor ma dang gcig tu 'dres/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba ling kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhañja ho/ rak+ṣa pi wa to sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul/ oṃ ha ya gṛ wa sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ rgyal ba kun gyi chos sku pad+ma'i gsungs/ /chos rje 'od dpag med pa rdo rje chos/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang hrīḥlas dbang chen sku/ /rta mgrin rta skad bzhad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag sogs phrin las bcol/ rjes kyi cho ga gzhan spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed tshul ni/ stegs bu'i steng du/ chos 'byung dmar po gru gsum/ mtha' zlum bskor/ gru bcad ljang khu/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dmar po/ de'i steng du mañji la/ gtor ma dmar po nor gzugs rtse mor rta mgos mtshan pa zhig bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor sman dang rak+ta sogs bshams/ bgegs gtor btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa song nas/ oṃ sarba pañca a mṛ ta hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ zhes sman mchod byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ mahā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ zhes rak+ta byin gyis brlabs/ stong par sbyangs pa nas nyi ma la hrīḥ zhes pa yan chad gong bzhin mdun du bskyed/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ gtor ma gong ltar byin gyis brlabs/ ha ho hrīḥ gzhug tu/ oṃ mahā ba ling ta/ te dzo ba ling te/ ba la ba te/ gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūṃ hrīḥṭha/ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma byin rlabs 'di gong sman rag gi sngon du byas kyang rung*/ gong bzhin gtor ma dang phyi mchod phul/ nang mchod sman gtor ma la bran/ ban+dha snod bzang yangs pa ru/ /rang byung gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /a la la te bzhes su gsol/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod/ rak+ta nas bran la/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad dang*/ /he ru ka'i gnas bcu nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan 'dren gyis/ /sha khrag dmar gyi rgya mtsho bzhes/ /oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas bstod pa dang 'dod don gsol btab byas la/ bzlas pa'ang ci 'grub dang*/ slob ma'i bya ba rnams bdag 'jug gi tshul gyis blang ngo*/ /de nas slob ma'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ sogs brjod/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ spro na thun mong ma yin pa'i skyabs 'gro dang*/ gsol gdab kyang byed/ bsdu na ma byas kyang rung*/ de ltar sngon 'gro lnga'am gsum 'dam kha yin/ dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis/ slob ma'i sdig sgrib nad gdon bar chad thams cad bsregs/ stong nyid du sbyangs/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar mngon rtogs bzhin phog/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum gsal btab/ ye shes pa bstims la rol mo'i sgra bya/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las rta mgrin dkar po spros te/ slob ma'i dpral ba'i oṃ la bstim/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ bum dbang*/ de bzhin du/ mgrin pa nas/ dmar po bstim ste/ gsang dbang*/ snying ga nas mthing ga bstim ste/ sher dbang lte ba nas/ kha dog sna tshogs pa bstim/ dbang bzhi pa'o/

/de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin te/ sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /de nas gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par byas la/ mthar khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin 'od du zhu nas/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas zhugs te thim pas/ rang gi lus ngag yid gsum/ rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs su zhu lugs su blug par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ ces pa ni sku dngos kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam tshig gzung bar khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas sogs kyis yon 'bul/ dge ba bsngo/ tshogs la longs spyod/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod dang*/ gsol btab bya/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /rab mchog mkhan po rje btsun gyis/ /sgrub thabs kyis zhes bka' stsal nas/ /pad+ma dbang gi sgrub thabs 'di/ /tā ra nā thas byas pa yin/ /zhes pa'ang dpal stag lung thang dang nye ba'i rnam rgyal rab brtan du'o/ /sgrub thabs kuna~X nas dga~X' ba'i phul/ /rta mchog rol ba'i snyinga~X po~X'i don/ /shin tu zab pa pad+ma yis/ /skyer sgang pa la dngos su gnang*/ /rta mgrin skyer sgang lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ gdug pa'i klu sogs tshar gcod dang*/ /gang las dngos grub rab mchog kun/ /thob 'gyur rta mchog dpal gyi ni/ /sgrub thabs man ngag mdo tsam bshad/ /'dir rta mgrin lcags ral can du grags pa sgom par 'dod pas skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad du mdun du spyan drangs bar gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs sogs rgyun bshags dang*/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du/

hrīḥyig dmar nag gi 'od zer 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mgrin sku mdog mig sman ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ spyi bo nas rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'don pas khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me dpung 'bar ba/ klu rgyal rigs dkar pos dbu brgyan/ bram ze dmar pos mgul brgyan/ rje rigs ser pos phyag gdub/ gdol ba nag pos ga sha /dmangs rigs ser khras zhabs gdub byas pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu brgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ dpal gyi chas brgyad yongs su rdzogs pa/ ru tra pho mo bsnol ba'i steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs 。pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar hrīḥde las 'od 'phros ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha thams cad spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pas dbu brgyan/ spyi bor oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ gi stod du hrīḥ

'i mthar sngags kyis 'phreng bas bskor/ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba hu lu hu lu hūṃ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ hrīḥbadz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa sarba shi ta ka la me dpung gtubs/ ha ha nan/ rbad rbad gtubs/ shag ha ha nan/ rbad rbad gtubs/ gṛ ṇa rā dza ya rbad/ mā ra ya rbad/ ces drag sngags dang sbyar ba gang 'grub bzlas/ thun 'jog khar dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ 'bru gsum las dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rta mgrin 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ hūṃ gnyis med rang byung dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /brjod med chos dbyings don gsal ma g.yos kyang*/ /dgra bgegs gdug pa 'dul ba'i don slad du/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'jig rten rnam par dag pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /nyi zla pad+ma brtsegs pa'i khri yi steng*/ /ru tra zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan steng du/ /rngam brjid ngar dang bcas nas bzhugs su gsol/ /sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ a ti pu ho/ zhes bzhugs su gsol zhing phyag 'tshal/ hrīḥpad+ma ta kṛ ta badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ ba i daṃ ba ling ta/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa khā hi/ mahā tsit+ta khā hi/ mahā ba su ta khā hi/ mahā go ro tsa na khā hā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ gdug pa 'dul mdzad ye shes lha'i sku/ sku mdog mthing nag dbyar gyi char sprin 'dra/ khams gsum dbang du bsdud pa'i rta skad 'tsher/ /ye shes rol pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod do/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ / zhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/

/ sogs kyi mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ smon lam btab cing bkra shis bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal nag po gru gsum tshom bu dang bcas pa'i steng du/ mañji la gtor ma dmar nag nor gzugs ma zhig 'god/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar du song nas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar bdag bskyed bzhin la 'don pa spo/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ hūṃ gdug pa 'dul mdzad sogs kyis bstod/ bzlas pa gang 'grub bya/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs nas/ 'dod 'don gsol btab kyi bar gtor chog gong bzhin gyis phul/ slob ma'i maṇ+ḍal phul zhing*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa bya/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ bcom ldan 'das khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin yi dam du 'tshal gyis/ slob dpon gyis bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag ste swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs ba nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gis bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rta mgrin 'di la dbang bskur cig/dus 'di nas ni bzung gnas su/ /rta mchog go 'phang ma thob bar/ /rtag tu yi dam lha yin gyi/ /yi dam lha ru mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum brjod pas/ rta mgrin 'od du zhu/ slob ma la thim pas/ skad cig gis rta mgrin du gyur pa ni/ sku mdog nas/ bzhugs pa' ོ'i bar brjod/ ye shes pa bstim lugs spyi dang 'dra/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te tsa ka li spyi bor bzhagasku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /sngags byang lag tu gtad de bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa ni/

gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /phyag mtshan bstim pa ni/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /snying po lan gsum bzlas pa'i phur pa lag tu gtad de/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin gyi sku gsung thugs gsum dang*/ slob ma 'di'i lus ngag yid gsum nus pa mnyam par gyur cig/ces brjod/ 'phrin las kyis rjes gnang ngo*/ /gtor dbang spyi dang mthun par bya ste/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /rjes kyi bya ba sogs lhag ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ / bgegs kuna~X 'joms shing sgrub po la/ /dga~X' bde'i dngos grub ster ba'i phul/ /rta mgrin nag po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /zla rgyal dgongs don snyinga~X po~Xr dril/ /zhes pa'ang dpal rta mgrin lcags ral can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ rta mgrin gyi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te dgu pa'o/ /gcig zhus/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ na mo badz+ra dhā rā ya/ da ni khro bo'i rgyal po 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrubs thabs nyams su len bar 'dod pas/ 'dir 'chad par 'dod pa'i sgrub thabs rnams la nan tan tu sgrub par bya ste/ gang la gang mos pa de dang de yis bya'o/ /dpal ldan 'gro kun sgrol ba'i mgon/ /bla ma mchog dang mi g.yo ba/ /dbyer med de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rim pa rnams bshad bya/ /dang por mi g.yo sngon po pus btsugs bsgom par 'dod pa la de'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya'o/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgoms la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las lus 'od kyi phung po rang gi snying ga'i nang du paṃ las pad+ma/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ sngon po 'od 'bar ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ lus gang zhing sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid gtum po chen po'i skur gyur pa ni/

sku mdog zar ma'i me tog ltar sngo ba'am/ dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon rdo rje zhags pa sdigs mdzub la lan gnyis su dkris shing thugs kar gtod pa zhabs g.yon gyi pus mo dang*/ g.yas kyi mthil sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhengs stabs kyi tshul du bzhugs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gyi g.yas pa steng du gzigs pa/ lha'i bu'i bdud tshar gcod cing*/ g.yon pa 'og tu gzigs pas lha min dang klu'i gdon 'dul ba dang*/ dbus thad kar gzigs pas sa steng gi bgegs thams cad 'joms pa/ cher 'khrugs shing khros pas khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pas mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po thor tshugs su bcings shing zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan pa dar sna tshogs pa'i sham thabs dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ sbrul dkar po se ral khar byas pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa'i sku can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / 'di la dbu skra nag po byas kyang rung zhing*/ bye brag tu klu'i gdon 'dul bar 'dod na/ pus mo g.yas btsugs stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa byed ces gsung*/ de nas rang gi thugs kar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' tshon gang ba/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūṃ nas 'bru tsam/ spro na gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren pa dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams kyang bya la/ bsdu na lha'i rnal 'byor gyi bya ba ni/ de nyid kyis 'grub pa yin no/ / ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar sngags kyis bskor ba/ de'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ gdon bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul te/

byin rlabs 'od zer gyi rnam pas bdag la thim/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla'o/ /'bum phrag brgyad cu bzlas pas las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur zhing*/ byang chub sgrub pa la ni tshad med do/ /rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gtor ma dkar gtor legs par bshams la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod/ de'i nang du a las lha'i bdud rtsis gang ba/ de'i dbus su hūṃ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od zer gyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ snying po'i mthar/ ār+ya a tsa la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ badz+ra puṣ+pe nas nai wi te 'i bar gyis mchod/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos kyang*/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*/ /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad pa/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo thugs rje'i mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bcom ldan 'das mi g.yo ba 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ yi ge brgya bas lhag chad kha bskang*/ ma 'byor ba dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ / sogs kyis mthar/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar nyi ma la tshom bu sngon po zhig bkod/ ma 'grub na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod kyang rung*/

dkar gtor cha gnyis dang*/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed kyang stong par sbyangs ba nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar du byas nas/ gtor ma byin gyis brlabs te 'bul ba nas/ 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar du byas/ dkar gtor gnyis phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la bsngo/ rjes gnang dngos ni/ khrus bya chos bshad maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ /dus gsum zhes sogs gsol ba btab/ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ /dngos gzhi rjes gnang gzhi 'god dang*/ /lung gsum sbyin pa de rjes su/ /phyag mtshan bstim par mdzad pa yin/ /dam tshig khas blangs maṇ+ḍal dang*/ /deng nas zhes sogs yon 'bul lo/ / rjes chog mchod pa kha gsos nas/ /mchod bstod dngos grub blang ba dang*/ /yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol dang*/ /smon lam gdab cing bkra shis bya/ /zhes pa'i sdom tshig blo la nges par bya ste/ phyag mtshan bstim pa tsam ma gtogs lag len sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin yin no/ /'di'i khyad paragyi byin rlabs chu srung byed thabs ni/ tho rangs skar khongs gnyis gsum tsam la bum pa gtsang mar chu'i gting nas chu blangs te nam mkha' ma mthong bar bya/ sngar gyi rjes gnang dang 'brel bar byed na/ shin tu legs/ thog mtha' gang du byas kyang chogalogs su byed na maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bla ma'i lag pa g.yas kyis bum pa'i kha bcad/ na maḥtsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇā ya/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa/ k+ṣaṃ traṃ/ trā sa ya/ trā sa ya/ saṃ trā ya saṃ trā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ*/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /bla ma mi g.yo bar sgom du gzhugaslob mas me tog bzung la/ thal mo sbyar/ sngags de'i rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ bla mas lan bdun bzlas la/ slob ma'i lag pa g.yas par blug la 'thung du gzhugarjes zlos dang 'thung thengs lan gsum byas la/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi

nas/ 'jug par gyur cig gi bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par byas nas gtang rag gi yon 'bul ba sogs bya'o/ /de thob nas rang gis chu srung nyams su len na/ chu la sngags brgya rtsa bzlas/ de khrus bya/ lag pa g.yas par chu blug la g.yon pas de'i rgyab nas mnye/ sngags lan gsum bzlas nas 'thung*/ de 'dra lan gsum bya'o/ /kuna~X nas zab cing rnyed dka' ba/ /rab dga~X' khro bo gtum po yi/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X bsdus pa 'di/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal phyir yin/ /ces pa ni rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las nang gi bar chad sel ba mi g.yo ba sngon po phyag gnyis pa pus btsugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyal 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /a ti'i lugs kyi gtum po'i sgrub thabs so/ / na mo gu ru/ mtha' dag 'gro ba sgrol ba'i slad/ /mi g.yo mgon la rab btud nas/ /gtum po'i sgrub thabs bla med pa/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /mi g.yo sngon po bka' gdams lugs bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gsal zhing dag par byas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ 'od zer des sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs/ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ sarba bi shwa pū dza me gha sa mu dra āḥhūṃ swāhā/ rdo rje gur ram bzang spyod nas 'byung ba ltar yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams bsgom/ swa bhā wa dang*/ shū n+ya ta sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ raṃ las pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems hūṃ las rdo rje'i lte bar nyi ma la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta dz+nyā na kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ de las rang nyid khro bo rgyal po mi g.yo ba sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyis steng 'og tu yon por gzigs pa/ phyag g.yas ye shes kyi ral gri me 'bar ba nam mkhar 'phyar ba/

g.yon rdo rje zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas tshogs bdag glang sna dang dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa'i gdon bgegs thams cad brdzes pa/ sma ra dang smin ma dang dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing*/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ sprul pa'i khro bo nam mkha' gang ba 'phro ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar raṃ las nyi ma la hūṃ 'od 'bar ba/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ spro na gong ltar mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor bar bsgoms la/ pho nya spro ba dang me sbar ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla'o/ /'jug tu mi dmigs bsdus la/ yig brgya bzla/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub du bsngo/

oṃ āḥhūṃ muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor snod chu gtsang gis bkang ba bshams la/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān ta kṛ ta hūṃ gis bsangs/ oṃ gyi sgra dang 'od kyis gtor ma snod dang bcas pa stong bar sbyangs/ āḥrin po che'i snod zab cing rgya che ba bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba/ hūṃ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bkug ste thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems bla ma chos skyong sems can thams cad khro bo mi g.yo ba'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ snying por mthar bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyis yi dam dang*/ a kā ro lan bdun gyis gzhan rnams la phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra nī la'i mdog/zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku/ /ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams/ khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces brjod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab la/ oṃ muḥ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ thun mtshams su yang lha'i snang ba dang ma bral bar bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ thun mong ba bka' gdams lha bzhi gzhan rnams kyi bzlas lung 'bogs tshul de nyid 'dod pa spos pas chog pa yin zhing*/ khyad par can ni/ maṇ+ḍal grub bzhi/ gru bcad sngon po la dbus su sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang bcas pa/ lte ba nyi gdan la tshom bu sngon po/ me tog sngon po sil mar dgram/ mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed kyi 'dod pa spos la mdun bskyed bsgom/ mchod pa ci nus bya/ gzhi bdag gtor ma dang bgegs gtor btang*/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum bya/

skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyas pa 'bogs pa'am/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos dang ma bya/ bdag bskyed ltar mngon rtogs phogalha sku snang stong la mnyam par 'jog tu 'jugasngags kyi bzlas lung phogaslob dpon gyi bgrang 'phreng mgo thog tu bzhag la/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ man ngag ltar mi dmigs kyi spro bsdu'i dmigs pa phogachos thams cad sgyu ma ltar sgom du bcug oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ zhes brjod/ mi dmigs par bzhag la phaṭa ces brjod du bcuga'adir rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra ba las/ mchod pa gsang pa rgya cher bshams nas byin gyis brlabs/ dpon slob lhan cig tu 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa lan gsum yang bya/ dkar gsum gyi tsa ru'i ston mo bya'o/ khro rgyal kuna~X 'dus rab dga~X'i tog/bdud sde'i snyinga~X la 'jigs skyed pa/ /zab mo'i sgrub thabs gsong po~Xr smras/ /dge des gtum po'i gnas thob shog/a ti sha'i zhal gyi gdams pa khro bo gtum po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //zhus dang*/ dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rdo rje gtum po ni/ /blo 'phel dkar po'i tshul 'dzi na pa/ de la btud nas de sgrub thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /bcom ldan 'das gtum po dkar pos sgrub pa la/ 'jug pa dang sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa pos tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs skyabs sems lan gsum/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dkar po/ a las zla ba raṃ las nyi ma rnams brtsegs pa'i steng du/ rang gi rnam shes hūṃ dkar po las 'od 'phros/ mi shes pa'i mun pa bsal/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi byin rlabs bsdus/ slar 'dus pa las rang nyid gtum po dkar po sku mdog gangs la nyi ma shar ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yon pa'i pus mo'i lha nga dang*/ g.yas pa'i mthil nyi ma'i gdan la brten pa/

phyag g.yas ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar ba'i ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad de/ rdo rje zhags pa lan gnyis su dkris pa'i sne gnyis phrag gong du lding ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum steng 'og bar du gzigs shing bgrad pa/ mche ba ma mchu'i steng du gtsigs pa/ dbu skra sma ra smin ma dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis mdzes pa/ sbrul gyi ske rags bcings pa/ dar gyi sham thabs kyis sku smad mdzes par byas shing*/ spyi bor mi bskyod pa dkar po bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mdun du gru gang tsam la pad nyi'i steng du rang 'dra ba'i bcom ldan 'das bskyed/ spro na gnyis ka la ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab kyang bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ snying gar nyi dkyil steng du 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu pa/ lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa g.yas bskor du 'khor ba/ de'i lte bar hūṃ/ rtsibs bcu la/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa bsams te/ srog rtsol nas grangs bsnyen pa ci rigs bya'o/ /phyi bzlas so/ /nang bzlas ni/ bdag gi snying gar hūṃ yi ge bcu po zhal nas thon mdun bskyed kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'khor lo bzhin du bsam/ slar mdun gyi lha'i lte ba nas thon/ bdag gi lte bar zhugs/ snying ga'i 'khor lo la thim par bsams/ srog rtsol bsdams la bzla'o/ / oṃ ār+ya a tsa la ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa ni/ rab mdzes gangs kyi bu mo nyi gzhon gyis/ /'khyud pa'i sku brnyan 'dzum khro brjid pa'i gar/ /pad+ma gzhon nu nyin byed lta bu'i steng*/ khyod zhabs pus btsugs lcid kyis 'gying zhing brdzis/ /rab zlum spyan gsum steng 'og bar g.yo zhing*/ /mche gtsigs ma mchu'i steng na rjes rtsen pa/ /ral gris 'debs shing zhags pas 'ching ba'i tshul/ /bdud bzhi'i dgra dpung ma lus 'joms par mdzad/

/rab bkra'i stag lpags dar gyis dkris pa'i gos/ / smad g.yogs sbrul ljang sked chings brten pa'i tshul/ /rang 'od las byung me 'od 'khyil ba'i klong*/ /g.yas bskum zhabs mthil 'khor los mnan pa'i stabs/ /rab gus lus kyi ba spu'i bla gos g.yo/ /ngag tshig smra ba'i snyan ngag dbyangs su 'tsher/ /yid gnyis ma mchis snying nas skyabs mchis pas/ /deng nas byang chub bar du brtse bas skyongs*/ /rab brjid yid 'phrog lha khyod bdag bsgrub na/ /stong nyid blo dang rjes 'brel snying rje dang*/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i spobs pa dge ba can/ khyed kyis mthu las gegs med mngon gyur shog/ mdun gyi lha rten nam rang gi snying gar thim/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor chog ni mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ thun mong ba ni rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gsung la sngags 'khor bstims pa dang*/ thugs la phyag mtshan dkar po bstim pa nyid yin zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa zab mo'i lugs ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po zhig bri/ de'i dbus su lugs sku'am/ tsa ka li bzhugs su bcugagayas su me tog dkar po/ g.yon du dri bzang gi chu snod bzhagamatha' mchod gtor gtsang mas bskor/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ tshad med bzhi nas/ snying gar thim gyi bar bdag bskyed gong bzhin/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las sku gzugs/ me tog dri bzang gsum ka'i gnas su paṃ gsum las/ pad+ma dkar po gsum a gsum las zla ba gsum/ raṃ gsum las nyi ma gsum rnams so sor brtsegs pa'i steng du hūṃ dkar po re re/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa gsum du gyur pa ni/ gtum po dkar po zhes pa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gis bar gong bzhin/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes sems dpa'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rten gsum po la dmigs nas sngags brgya rtsa re re bzla'o/ / me tog dang dri bzang gi gnas su bzhugs pa'i mi g.yo ba 'od du zhu ste/ shes rab spel ba'i rdzas khyad par can du gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan mang du brjod/ gsum ka la dmigs nas yi ge brgya pa tshar res brtan par bya/ bar 'dir gtor ma 'bul/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod bstod bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol btab dang*/ rgyun bshags spyi dang mthun/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par grub pa'i rjes su sku gzugs spyi bor bzhag pa'i rjes su snying po brgya rtsa bzla/ mdun bskyed ye shes pa'i tshul du thim par mos/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par byin pa las/ slob dpon gyi 'phreng ba slob ma'i mgul dang lag tu gtod pa phyag len yin/ dam bca' ba'i lung dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung mi dgos/ de nas me tog dkar po spyi bor bzhag nas snying po brgya rtsa bzla/ slob dpon gyi mtheb srin gyis dri bzang gi chu de slob ma'i spyi bo nas brtsams te lus thams cad la cung zad 'thor bzhin du snying po brgya rtsa bzlas pa'i mthar dri bzang gi chu ma lus par 'thung du gzhug bdud rtsi bde ba chen pos lus thams cad la khyab pa la shes pa gtad nas mnyam par 'jog 'di thugs kyi rjes gnang yin/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ /bdun kuna~X 'joms pa'i lha mchog ni/ /dga~X' ba rgyas byed lhag pa'i lha/ khyod nyid brten pa'i mkhas mchog rnams/ /snyinga~X po~X'i don la shin tu mkhas/ /mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /mi g.yo phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs so/ /na mo gu ru/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal dpa' bo ni/ /gar dgu'i nyams kyi bzhad cing

rol/ /srid zhi'i rlung gis ma g.yos pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i mngon rtogs bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro dang tshad med bzhi sems bskyed rnams bsgoms la/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur/ phyi rol ral gri'i rwa ba me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i bsrung 'khor/ de'i nang du pad nyi dang bdud bzhi mnyam par 'gyel ba'i gdan la hūṃ las ral gri hūṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ gdug pa can rnams btul/ slar 'dus pa las bdag nyid rje btsun ma mi g.yo ba mthing kha zhal bzhi kar nag pa/ zhabs bzhi brkyang bskum sna tshogs pas bdud bzhi mnan pa'am/ g.yas brkyang du bya/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis kyis ral gri 'debs tshul dang*/ rdo rje gsor ba g.yon gnyis kyis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa dang*/ khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ skra ser po gyen tu brdzes pa/ mche ba rnon po gtsigs shing*/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ mi lpags kyi stod g.yogs can sbrul dang*/ rin po che dang*/ rus pas brgyan pa/ khro bo sprul pa'i sprin spro ba/ me ri 'bar ba'i bskor ba'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang*/ dbang bskur rnams spyi dang 'dra/ dbu rgyan mi bskyod pa'o/ /bkod pa'i bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇaṃ oṃ a tsa la ka na ka na tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ/ traṃ maṃ taṃ bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma sha trun a mu ka s+ya shi raṃ/ kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ a ti mu ka s+t+waṃ bhā ya hri daṃ kī la ya hūṃ phaṭa/ las la sbyar ba'i sngags so/ /rjes lha sku stong par bsdus te/ slar yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas dge ba bsngo/

gtor ma nang mchod kyis bran la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mi g.yo mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a tsa la te dza badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhe/ nai we te sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ saṃ trip+ta sarba sa ta nān i maṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis 'bul/ mchod bstod sogs rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang mthun/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung mthing kha dbus su ral gris mtshan pa zhig 'bri/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi skabs/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ / ye shes 'bar ba'i ral gri 'di/ /bzung zhig gdug pa kun choms la/ /srid pa gsum las rgyal bar mdzod/ / ces lag tu gtad/ mdun bskyed la mos gus byas pas thim par mos su 'jug pa ni khyad par ro/ /zab mo kuna~X gyi phul du gyur/ /thos pas dga~X' ba rab 'phel ba/ /bsgoms na dngos grub rnam gnyis kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X mngon du 'gyur 'di mtshar/ /zhes pa ni mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༈ mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs so/ / na mo gu ru/ dgra bgegs 'joms mdzad dpa' bo che/ /'jigs byed mi g.yo la btud nas/ /dud kha phyag gnyis zhabs bzhi pa'i/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /'di la skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag las 'phags pa mi g.yo ba sku mdog dud kha nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche btsigs/

skra dang kha spu ser po gyen du brdzais pa/ zhabs dang pos bsgrub bya'i kha/ gnyis pas snying ga/gsum pas pus btsugs kyi lte ba/ bzhi pa phyir brkyang bar rkang pa mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ rgyal ba mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ mthing nag la snying pos bskor ba/ me'i rje ngar gyi phur bu sor bzhi pa rgya mdud la hūṃ bris pa lag tu thogs/ phur bu stong pa'i ngang las rang dang 'dra bar bskyed/ gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis ka dang gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes mdun bskyed kyi sngags las dngos grub zhu ba'i tshul gyis gang nus bzlas/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe phur bu'i lha la gsol ba btab pas/ de'i thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng*/ rang gi snying ga'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ phur pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul te/ de'i cho ga ni gong du mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs kyi sgrub thabs su bshad zin pa nyid do/ /'on kyang khyad par ni/ gtor ma dmar gtor gru gsum du bya/

oṃ las byung ba'i gtor snod thod pa dkar po zhes 'don pa spo/ mthar badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes rang la thim/ phur pa mgul khug tu bcug go /dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ bsnyen tshad 'bum phrag bcu gnyis so/ /'di'i lung 'bogs pa ni/ rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar bris 'bur gyi sku spyi bor gtugs/ gsung gi mthar phur bur mgrin par gtugs/ thugs kyi mthar ral gri snying gar gtugs/ brtan byed thod pa rgun chang gis gang ba las 'thung du gzhugade bzhi re re la sngags gsum gsum bzla'o/ /snying rjes kuna~X tu rab 'khros pa/ /dga~X' ba'i thugs rjes bdud bzhi 'joms/ /snyinga~X nas mgon po~X khyod brten na/ /dngos grub bzang po ci yang thob/ /mi g.yo ba zhabs bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /pad+ma badz+ra/ kha che dge slong ya ma ri zhal gzigs/ dge tshul <sdang mig gis mi 'chi nus pa/ >mi g.yo zhal gzigs/ dharma shī <mnga' ris pa >la/ nu bo dharma dī bya/ dge byas gtso bo/ a skyabs/ dkar ba rnam gsum/ yar bsgom/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ yon tan khri/ seng ge rgyal/ <seng ge bzang po/ >'di dpa' bo chig sgrub las byung gsung*// // ༄༅/ /mi g.yo spre'u brgyad mar grags pa'i sgrub thabs so/ / na mo gu ru we/ dpal ldan ye shes me lce yis/ /ma rig mun pa drungs 'byin zhing*/ /bdud tshogs ma lus bsregs pa po/ /gtum po che la spyi bos 'dud/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /mtha' dag srid pa'i nad sel zhing*/ /ri lu la sogs grub stsol ba/ /de 'dra gang yin 'dir bshad bya/ /'dir mi g.yo spre'u brgyad mar grags pa/ gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud kyi man ngag las 'byung ba gtum po zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro byams snying rje sems bskyed dang 'brel ba sngon du 'gro bas/

shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i rang sems oṃ a tsa la zhes pa nas/ tshin+dha hūṃ zhes pa'i sngags 'phreng yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri sngags 'phreng gi mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mi g.yo ba spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid mi g.yo sku mdog nag/dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis pa/ /g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus mthing zhal/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje ral gri dang*/ /'khor lo bsnams shing g.yon dang po/ /thugs kar khro bo'i sdigs mdzub can/ /lhag ma dgra s+t+wa zhags pa bsnams/ /g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gom stabs kyis/ /nad brgyad rang bzhin spre'u brgyad gnon/ /stag lpags na bza' sbrul rgyan dang*/ /mi mgo'i dbu rgyan do shal can/ /spyan gsum mche gtsigs me dpung bzhugs/ /spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūṃ sngon po/ hūṃ de'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ las rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ raṃ las byung ba'i nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ las byung ba'i ral gri hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ ye shes spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur spyi dang mthun par sbyar yang rung ste/ spyi bo dpral bar ltag pa sna ltag g.yas g.yon rnams su rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa re res brgyan pa ste rigs bdag gi rgyan no/ /ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mthar yig 'bru bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a tsa la ka ṇa sarba ro gā na/ bhin+dha bhin+dha/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūṃ zhes bzlas pas/ yig 'bru las ral gri 'phros/ bshang lam nas thon/ spre'u brgyad gzir ba dang*/ gzhan yang gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ gsang ba nas zhugs ste snying gar thim par bsam/ thun 'jog khar lha sku stong pa nyid du bsdus la cung zad mnyam par bzhagaslar yang dbang bskur gsal btab la dge ba bsngo/

gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a las thod pa'i nang du a las zla ba/ de'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje gdengs pa rgya gram gyi lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/ snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad lha mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa can gyi rnam par spyan drangs te bstim/ zla ba dang rdo rje rgya gram yang 'od du zhu/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ gtor mgron spyan drangs pa man chad mi g.yo pus btsugs kyi skabs dang 'dra/ bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bru 'bum mo/ /rang gzhan gyi gnad gdon zhi ba la lhag par bsngags pa yin zhing*/ ril bu dang rmi lam brtag pa'i las tshogs rnams kyang ji skad bshad pa bzhin bsgrub par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /nad kuna~X 'joms pa'i dpa' bo ste/ /yid la dga~X' bde bskyed pa'i gnas/ /shin tu gsang ba snyinga~X po~X'i don/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam rnam par spel/ /zhes pa ni mi g.yo spre'u brgyad mar grags pa'i mngon rtogs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu pa'o/ /dze tā ri/ rdo rje gdan pa che chung*/ ba ri ba/ gong ma lnga/ lo mchogadapal ldan seng ge chos rje bla ma/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*/ /'chi med gnas la nyer sbyor ba/ /tshe dpag med la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ kha shar du phyogs te rang yi dam gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal la gnas pas rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar ser rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ na bza' chos gos ngur smrig rnam gsum gsol ba/ pad zla la rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i lhung bzed bsnams pa/

mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i skur gyur/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs tshar gcig oṃ badz+ra ā yu ṣe sa ra ha ka ra re sha ra re hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes nyer cig bzlas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag tu med pas bdag tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rlung phyir gsal bas lhung bzed khol/ nang du brngubs pa'i tshe bdud rtsi lud pa rnams sna sgo nas zhugs te lus thams cad dang*/ khyad par snying ga'i rtsa sbubs gang bar bsams te/ mchil ma re mid pa lan bdun bya/ de nas/ oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī bān+tī ye swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus dang*/ tshe gzungs oṃ gnyis ma nyer gcig tsam bzlas pas/ tshe dpag med 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas zhugs pas lus thams cad gang bar gyur/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di'i bsnyen pa bya bar 'dod na/ ra ba bzhi po gang rung gi yar tshes gza' skar bzang ba'i tho rangs shig nas 'go brtsams/ khrus byas/ kha shar phyogs su bltas la bzla'o/ /rgyun gyi nyams len la tho rangs snying po brgya rtsa re bya/ 'chi ltas byung na stong rtsa re bzlas pas kyang dus min gyi 'chi ba bzlog go zhes bshad do/ /'di'i slob ma rjes 'dzin la sgom lung tsam 'bogs pa'i srol yod pa ni spyi dang mthun/ bum chog byed na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu dang bcas pa'i dbus su/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bkod/ gu gul gyis bdug la bgegs gtor btang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las bum pa baṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i steng du/ tshe dpag med sngar ltar bskyed/ bzlas pa ci nus byas pa'i mthar mchod bstod bya/ gsol ba btab cing dngos grub blangs la/ lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul la/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs kyis gsol btab dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma tha mal gyi nga rgyal la/

mdun bskyed dang slob dpon dbyer med pa tshe dpag med kyi nga rgyal la dmigs pa las byin rlabs len pa sogs dmigs pa sgrub thabs dang 'dra bar phogakhyad par ni 'dir yan lag bdun pa mi dgos/ rlung brngubs pa'i tshe bum chu re sbyin/ bzlas pa dpon slob gnyis kar lhan du byed/ tshe dpag med spyi bor thim pa'i skabs spyi bor bum pa 'jog cing*/ bum chu gtor ba rnams lag len yin/ slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba dang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /grub pa'i rgyal mo gsung kuna~X nas/ /ras chung snyan du dga~X' bas brgyud/ /bur sgom zhal gdams stag lung pa'i/ /snyinga~X gi gdams pa gsal po ༵ ra bris/ /ras chung pa'i lugs tshe dpag med sprul sku'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba kun las ches lhag pa'i/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sel/ /tshe dpag med la gus btud nas/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag bri/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ pad zla'i gdan la rang sems bh+rūṃ las rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye mahā puṇ+ye a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ a pa ri mi ta puṇ+ye/ dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro bha tsi te ka ri ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mdun bskyed/ gtor chog rjes gnang rnams ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i cho ga nyid sbyor ba yin la/ bum chog byed na/ bum pa sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ bum pa gnyis 'cha'/ gcig tu rgyal ba tshe dpag med

dang*/ gnyis par rdo rje gnod sbyin g.yas rdo rje mche ba 'phyar zhing g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad pa/ g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa zhig bskyed/ de la sngags kyang oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha khā da khā da hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ slob ma'am/ nad pa la bum mchog gi byin rlabs byed na/ thog mar bgegs sbyangs pa dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba bya/ de nas rdo rje gnod sbyin bskyed pa'i bum pa des bkrus shing byabs srung kyang bya/ de nas bkra shis brjod cing*/ slar bum pa gnyis pa des dbang bskur zhing*/ lha dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa ltar bsgom du bcug sbyin pa'i stobs kyi sangs rgyas yang dag 'phags/ / sogs sho lo ka re re'i mthar/ snying po re brjod cing dbang bskur/ rgyal srid sna bdun dang*/ bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs kyis shes pa brjod/ rjes gnang dang sprags te byed na/ rgyun bshags song mtshams su 'di rnams byed pa yin/ 'di la yar klungs pa seng ge rgyal mtshan gyis slob rgyud 'ga' re'i yi ge na/ tshe dbang lha gcig bum gcig gi dmigs pa phal cher dkrugs te 'di la sbyar yod na'ang*/ bsre bslad kho na yin no/ /sgrub thabs 'di'i khungs ni ngan song sbyod rgyud yin zhes bla mas gsung*/ brgyud pa 'di'i mos zhen can/ /kuna~X la'ang rgya cher ma grags mod/ /'phags pas mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab dga~X' snyinga~X po~X'i rjes su 'brang*/ /tshe dpag med ba ri lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rjes chags dngos/ /rgyal ba tshe 'dzin dbang po'i skur/ /ston mdzad de la rab dang bas/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems sngon du song nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba de'i steng du oṃ gyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid rgyal ba tshe dpag med sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhi ba'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/

phyag g.yas dang po rdo rje dkar po/ g.yon dang po shel gyi 'phreng ba/ 'og ma gnyis yum la 'khyud tshul gyi mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na shel gyi bum pa bdud rtsi dkar pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum pad+ma kun dha li dmar mo phyag dang po gnyis kyis byi ru'i bgrang phreng dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis yab la 'khyud pas pad+ma rā ga'i bum pa bdud rtsi dmar pos gang ba 'dzin pa/ pad+ma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i spyi bor rnam snang*/ mgrin par snang mtha'/ snying gar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar rin 'byung*/ gsang bar don grub rnams rang snang gi yum dang bcas par gyur/ mi bskyod pa'i thugs kar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi dbus su oṃ/ klad skor gyi dbus su thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ nyi zla ā li kā li'i skud pas bcings pa/ ba spu'i sgo thams cad rta mgrin phyag gnyis pa'i go chas gtams pa/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang dbang bskur rgyas btab spyi dang 'dra ba las/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ de nas bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ tshe gzungs oṃ gnyis ma gang nus bzla'o/ / rjes mi dmigs par bsams la dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la bcud dang bcas pa me rlung gi sbyor bas sbyangs/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs la bstim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du rgyal ba tshe dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a kā ro lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ bcom ldan mgon po ye shes tshe yi bdag/rgyal ba kun gyis rtag tu dgongs gyur pa'i/ /'phags pa'i tshogs kyis skye shi gcod pa'o/ /skye dgu rnams kyi skyabs gyur bcom ldan 'das/ /dad pas bdag ni rtag tu bstod phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/

bgegs dang 'chi las rnam grol ba'i/ / 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho de/ /mkha' mnyam rnams dang lhan cig tu/ /myur du thob par mdzad du gsol/ zhais gsol ba btab/ yig brgyas kha bskang*/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni/ maṇ+ḍal dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi rnam pa can nam/ ma 'grub na pad+ma 'dab brgyad zhig bri/ der bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bskyed/ bum pa'i nang du lha bskyed pa ni/ bdag bskyed kyi 'don pa spos pas 'grub cing*/ mthar mchod bstod gtor ma phul la/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum gyis mchod yon phul bas zhu bar mos/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ byang chub rdo rje la sogs gsol gdab lan gsum/ dngos gzhi dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo nas gsang gnas kyi bar du rtsa a wa dhū tī dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zhig yod par mos la/ bum pa 'di nyid bcom ldan 'das tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med par gyur pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor byon par sgoms shig

ces brjod la bum pa spyi bor bzhag yab yum snyoms pa zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur pa/ spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang*/ gsang dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum dri ma bag chags dang bcas dag par mos mdzod/ ces brjod de bum chu sbyin/ de nas mngon rtogs kyi dmigs pa tshang bar 'bogs/ dbang bskur gyi skabs bum chu spyi bor gtor/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ spros pa la dga' bas tshe ril tshe chang ster ba'i lugs kyang gda'/ yig rnying na med pas ma byas kyang chog go /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di yang lo ro ras chung pa'i/ /gdams pa zab mor kuna~X du grags/ /ri bo che ba'i yig tshogs las/ /rab dga~X'i snyinga~X po~X byung ba yin/ /tshe dpag med dkar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang las 'chi med ye shes kyi/ /dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rab zab 'dir ni bri bar bya/ /skal ldan rnams kyis blang bar byos/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i seng khre'i steng du paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba la gnas pa'i rang sems 'chi med srog gi ngo bo a dkar po/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba tshe dang ye shes dpag tu med pa sku mdog zla ba chu shel ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ mtshan dpes spras shing 'od 'bar ba'o/ /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a dkar po/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ steng phyogs 'jig rten gyi khams yon tan dpag tu med pa nas/ rgyal ba tshe dpag med 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ a pa ra mi ta ā yur+dz+nyā na/ su bi nish+tsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te saṃmyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ puṇ+ye puṇ+ye mahā puṇ+ye/ a pa ra mi ta puṇ+ye dz+nyā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ skā ra pa ri shud+dha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅga te swa bhā wa bi shud+dhe mahā na ya pa ri wā ra ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā a pa ra mi ta ā yur dz+nyā na sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ zhes sogs chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa/ /yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku tshe dang*/ /ye shes dpag yas shin tu rnam nges pa/ /gzi brjid rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ mi rtog pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhagathun 'tshams su skad cig gis lhar bskyed la gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas dge ba bsngo'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra ba las/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad dkar po 'bri/ rdul tshon dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ gtor bsngo'i skabs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ gzungs ring gi mthar a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ rjes gnang dngos kyi skabs/ rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa la/ sku'i rjes gnang dang*/ lung gsum la gsung gi rjes gnang dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa la thugs kyi rjes gnang gi ming 'dogs bsgyur ba tsam mdzad do/

/'di'i bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs pa dang*/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gtor bsngo sogs byed pa ni/ rang 'dod kyi grub mtha'i rgyas bkab tsam yin gyi/ de'i rang lugs ma yin no/ /mi tra'i gdams pa kuna~X grags pa/ /rab byung dga~X' ba'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /snyinga~X nas nyams su len 'dod na/ /rang lugs drang po~Xr sgom par byos/ /tshe dpag med dkar bo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*/ /dus min 'chi ba nyer zhi zhing*/ /sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyong mdzad pa'i/ /gtsug tor rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ spro na tshogs zhing spyan 'dren dang*/ /yan lag bdun pa rgyas par bya/ mdor bsdu na tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten du gyur pa ni/ rin po che'i rang bzhin seng khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng du khri zlum po bang rim sum brtsegs/ de'i steng du zla ba la gnas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ steng du rin po che'i bre/ gdugs bcu gsum/ char khebs tog dang bcas pa/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi lda ldi sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i bum pa'i nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la bh+rūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing yid tsam khro ba/ zhal re re zhing zhi ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gnyis pas pad+ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa bsnams pa/

gsum pas mda'/ bzhi pas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon dang pos zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pas skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya/ bzhi pas ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i steng na bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang bcas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje sngon po g.yas rnga yab dang g.yon rdo rje sngon po 'dzin pa/ gtso 'khor gsum gyi phyogs bzhir khro bo bzhi gnas pa ni/ shar du mi g.yo ba g.yas ral gri 'phyar ba/ lhor 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ nub tu dbyug sngon g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ byang du stobs po che g.yas rdo rje rtse gsum 'phyar ba/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing kha rab tu khros pa/ phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod cing*/ spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs su byas pa/ stag lpags dang*/ sbrul gyi rgyan can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso mo'i steng gi nam mkha' la gnas gtsang ma'i rigs kyi lha'i bu gnyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ gtso mo la sku khrus gsol ba/ de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ dpral bar traṃ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ a ljang khu/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug gtor rnam par rgyal ma 'khor dang bcas pa/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin du sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dgachu'i lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las/ gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog/zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /snying gar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+rūṃ yig bsrung bya sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa 'khod par gyur/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hri aṃ aḥ bdag dang bsrung bya la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swāhā/ zhes cung zad bzlas nas/ gtso bor gzungs ring nyid bzla'o/ /bzlas pa tshar nas/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la mchod bstod/ yig brgya/ 'dod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams byas nas/ dge ba bsngos la/ thun mtshams la 'jug/gtor ma dkar gtor zhig oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūṃ gis bsangs/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañca ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa kyis sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā ṇāṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na twa ta gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor rnam rgyal lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ gzungs ring tshar gcig gi mthar/ uṣ+ṇi ṣa bi dza ya sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ oṃ a kā ro sogs lan bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la

sogs/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra ba las/ ming 'dogs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang gi tha snyad dang*/ slob ma 'ga' zhig gi don du 'gyur na/ bdag mdun gnyis kyi bar du bum pa sgrub cing rjes gnang gi thog mtha' gang rung du bkru byabs srung gsum byed pa ni khyad par ro/ /bum pa'i cho ga ni gzhan du 'bri bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs 'di'i sgrub thabs mang na yang*/ /kuna~X la 'di nyid grags che bas/ /gzhan la phan phyir dga~X' bas bris/ /'dus gsal snyinga~X po~X ngo mtshar rmad/ /rnam rgyal lha dgu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal lha mor bcas/ /de bzhin rtsa rgyud bla ma la/ /mchog tu gus pas btud byas nas/ /tshe sgrub kun gyi mchog gyur bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhin sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ hūṃ las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rwa gur bla bre mda' dra me dpung dang bcas pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba dkar po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba'i gdan la rang sems hūṃ dkar po'i 'phro 'du las phyir bzlog ma chen mo 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i skur gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dkar zhing na bza' dkar po can/ zhal brgyad rtsa zhal dkar po khro la 'dzum pa'i rnam pa can/ g.yas su sngo dmar ser ba'i zhal gsum drag tu bzhad pa/ g.yon du dmar ljang dud kha cher khros pa/ de drug ka'ang khro zhal/ steng zhal dkar po zhi ba/ zhal thams cad spyan gsum pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dril bu thugs kar bsnol ba/ lhag ma rnams kyis/ zhags pa ral gri dgra sta lcags kyu dang*/ /mda' dang tho ba 'khor lo g.yas pa na/ /sdigs mdzub bum pa mdung dang thod pa dang*/ /gzhu dang kha ṭ+wāṃ skyabs sbyin g.yon pas so/

/pad zla la g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bdud dang dbang phyug la sogs pa bgegs thams cad mnan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang*/ gtsug gi nor bu dang*/ thod skam dang mgo 'phreng dang*/ stag lpags la sogs pas brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thugs kar zla ba dmar skya la hūṃ dang*/ de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ye shes pa rang la thim/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga yum can gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ a mṛ ta san dza wa ni/ mahā a mṛ te sa mu khe dzi waṃ/ pra be sha ya/ pra be sha ya/ sarba badz+ra pad+ma sa ma yo gi ma na bo dhi tsit+ta/ pi pa tha mut+te hūṃ hūṃ/ a a oṃ āḥswāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla zhing*/ khri'am 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas na 'chi ba nges par bzlog pa ste/ a bhi dha na las/ 'di ni khri tsam bzlas byas na/ /'chi ba nges par 'tsho bar gyur/ /dus min 'chi ba zhi 'gyur zhing*/ /'chi ba las ni nges par slong*/ / zhes gsungs so/ 'jug tu ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ nang mchod bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs nas 'bru gsum gyis myang*/ he ru ka'i rigs byung ba/ /rdo rje gtsug gtor chen mo ni/ /'chi bdag bzlog mdzad bdud rtsi'i zhal/ /phyir bzlog chen mo khyod la 'dud/ / ces bstod/ 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya bzlas te phyag gnyis pa'i bar du bsdus la/ dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bde mchog ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar srung 'khor nas dbu brgyan gyis bar gong bzhin bskyed la/ sngags kyi mthar i di bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma ma ā yur sid+dhi pra yats+tshan+tu oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ lhag ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis bsngos/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab sogs spyi dang 'dra'o/
