/'di'i rjes gnang ni rten gzhi chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma dkar po la me tog dkar po'i tshom bu bkod/ bum pa bca'/ rjes gnang sgrub thabs spyi dang 'dra/ bum pa'i nang du sngags kyi yig 'brus gang bar mos la bum bzlas bya/ rjes gnang dngos ni/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags dang rigs lnga'i sdom bzung bya/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba'i rjes su bum chus dbang bskur zhing*/ mngon rtogs ltar dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa'ang 'bogs/ gsung gi rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la/ spyi bor haṃ nam mkhar zla ba la gnas pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'i dbyug pa'i sbom sar hūṃ/ des sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga nas brgyud nas/ slob ma'i lus gang ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/ gzhan spyi dang 'dra/ tshe sgrub kyi tshe yang sngags kyi 'khor lo snying gar bsgoms na shin tu zab par 'gyur mod kyi gsal thebs dka' ba'i phyir 'dir ma bshad do/ /rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /sngags 'chang kuna~X la'ang ches dkon na/ /gzhan la smos kyang ci dgos pas/ /thos la dga~X' bas snyinga~X po~X long*/ /bde mchog las/ 'byung ba 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las tshe sgrub kyi lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu gcig pa'o/ /dge'o// //

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang gi mtshan tsam thos pas kyang*/ /bdud rnams thams cad spa skong ba/ /gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs bshad/ / 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ / byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ / lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro/ shes rab snying rtse dang bcas pas/ /brtson pas sems can don du bdag/sangs rgyas mdun du gnas bcas te/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed bgyi/ / zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig/sdug bsngal kun dang bral bar shog/bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*/ /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog/ ces lan gsum gyis tshad med bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dkar la dwangs pa/ mtsho mtha' ne'u gsing me tog dang 'bras bu'i nags tshal du mas rnam par brgyan pa/ glang chen thal dkar gyi khyu tshogs nye bar rgyu ba/ lha dang drang srong rig 'dzin du ma gnas pa'i gzhi mtsho'i steng thams cad me tog sna tshogs pas rnam par bkra ba/ chu bya sna tshogs dregs pa'i skad snyan sgrog pa/ de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po rab tu rgyas pa/ yal ga gnya' shing tsam la gser gyi lo 'dab shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam gyis g.yogs pa/ rtse mor pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma stong ldan ze'u 'bru dmar ser du yod pa'i steng du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems a yig dkar po/ de las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi mi shes par mun pa bsal/ shes rab kyi snang ba la bkod/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sku mdog zla ba nor bu'i phung po ltar dkar ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i sdong bu'i rtsa ba thugs kar bzung bar rab tu rgyas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa'i glegs bam can/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ dar dkar po'i stod g.yogs dang sna tshogs pa'i dar gyi smad dkris gsol ba/ brgyad gnyis lon pa'i lang tsho can skyes bu chen po'i mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi snying rtse mo gyen bstan pad+ma 'dam ba brgyad kha 'bus kyi rnam par kha bye ba'i dbus su 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs drug pa'i rtse mo rno ba/ lte bar zla ba la a/ rtsibs drug la mdun nas g.yas skor gyi/ oṃ wā kyai daṃ na ma/ zhes pa'i gsang sngags yi ge drug pa ste/ yig 'bru rnams reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul du gnas pa/ de nyid 'khor lo g.yas skor dang yig 'bru g.yon skor du 'khor bas sdig sgrib mtha' dag dag par 'gyur/ oṃ wā kyai daṃ na ma/ zhes pa ci nus su bzla'o/ /mthar oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ār+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shap+ta rnams kyis mchod/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun ma bshams la phul/ bstod pa ni mtshan brjod dam paṇ+ḍi ta ma tis mdzad pa'i bstod pa yongs rdzogs kyis bstod/ shin tu bsdu na/ ngo bo ma nor chos nyid rab mkhyen zhing*/ /rnam pa ma lus 'ja' tshon lhang nger gzigs/ /thugs rje che dang thabs tshul dpag med kyis/ /srid mtsho mtha' yas skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jam dbyangs mgon khyod gus pas rjes dran zhing*/ /bsgoms bzlas legs mchod mngon par bstod pa yis/ /blo ngan ma rig 'thibs po'i tshogs rnams kun/ /sprin med nyi shar ji bzhin dwangs par mdzod/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag la shes rab phun sum tshogs pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo/ rgya ston gyi yi ge ltar na/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal bshams pa'i steng du/

bdag bskyed gyi lha byon par bsams nas/ rang tha mal ba'i nga rgyal gyis mchod pa man chad byed pa yin na'ang*/ bdag bskyed la ye shes pa spyan 'dren med pas mi legs so/ /de'i phyir gzhung gi dgongs pa bdag bskyed nyid la mchod pa yin no/ /bsnyen pa'i skabs gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na 'og nas 'chad pa bzhin 'bul/ phyis kyi yi ge 'ga' na/ zhing khams thugs kar bsdu ba dang*/ mchod bstod sogs maṇ+ḍal mchod chog tu byas gda' na'ang sgrub thabs gzhan 'ga' zhig gis rgyas bkab par zad la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi skabs/ 'dzam bu'i gling ngam glingagazhan dag ces sogs brjod pa'i tshe/ rgyal srid sna bdun kar 'bul ba'i dbang du byas 'dug na'ang*/ spyir mchod pa'i rnam grangs mang gin bzang ba yin mod/ 'di'i man ngag tu nges par dgos pa ni ma yin te/ rgya ston gshin rje gshed kyi phyogs la thugs bag chags brtas pa'i rnam 'gyur tsam mo/ / bsnyen pa'i skabs gtor chog kyang nges par dgos pa ma yin la/ thun mtshams su 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku brnyan la phyag mchod bstod pa sogs ci nus su byed pa ni gal che'o/ /de la 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ rdul tshon dkar pos pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris la/ de'i steng du 'jam dbyangs kyi sku dang 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi glegs bam bzhugs su gsol ba'i mtha' skor du/ byang shar du mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog gi snod bshom pa nas gzung ste/ mchod pa spyi 'gro ltar bsham/ shar du dkar gtor gcig bshams la/ de nas slob dpon gyis mdun gyi mchod pa rnams oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod ces sogs mchod pa spyi 'gro ltar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi sogs gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bdag bskyed sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba bzhin bsgoms nas bzlas pa ci nus bya/

de nas bdag bskyed la mchod bstod bya/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa ni bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ las zhes sogs bdag bskyed ltar bskyed la/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po sogs gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rjes btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dgug gzhug bya/ slar yang thugs ka'i sogs nas/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam mo/ /de nas phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga tā ar+ya mañju shrī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du shap+ta 'i bar du phul la/ bstod pa ci shes pas bstod/ de nas gtor ma la chab btang la bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma zag pa med pa'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams la/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ zhes sogs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya mañju shrī i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas lan gsum mam lnga'am bdun gyis phul la/ mchod bstod byas la/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad kyi ma rig pa'i mun pa bsal nas/ shes bya thams cad bde blag tu rtogs par mdzad du gsol/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang yon phul te gral la 'khod/

las kyi rdo rjes me tog bkye bsdu byas nas 'dug pa la/ slob dpon gyis chos bshad cung zad byas la/ 'dir slob dpon gyis las su gyur pa bdag bskyed sngon du btang nas mdun bskyed bsgrubs te/ mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul dgos pa rnams legs par grub pa yin/ gnyis pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal gcig phul mdzod/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas rdo rje gur las/ gang gi slob dpon gsol ba btab/ /de yi rigs su skye ba med/ ces dang*/ tshul ji lta bus gsol ba 'debs na/ mdun du dul bar 'dug pa dang*/ /gos sogs tshul ni sdom pa dang*/ /pus btsugs thal mo sbyar ba yis/ /nyan sogs 'dod pas gsol gsum gdab/ / ces gsungs pas na/ khyed rnams snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod cigadus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ / zhes dang*/ mdun bskyed rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi mtha' skor du brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sprin phung 'thibs pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsams nas/ khyed rang gis sngar byas pa'i sdig pa dran pa dang mi dran pa thams cad la 'gyod pa bskyed pa dang*/ phyin chad srog la bab kyang sdig pa mi byed do snyam du bsams pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kun gyi dus gsum du bsags pa'i dge ba la rjes su yi rang ngo*/ /snyam pa dang*/ stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid can gyi don dam pa byang chub kyi sems tshul bzhin du bsgom par bgyi'o snyam du yi dam 'cha' ba dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i dkon mchog gsum la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro'o snyam pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che ci nas kyang thob par byed do snyam pa'i smon pa'i sems bskyed pa dang*/

sangs rgyas de thob pa'i ched du rdo rje theg pa'i lam la bsgrub par bya'o snyam pa 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa dang*/ de ltar bgyis pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des bdag dang sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gyur cig gu snyam pa'i bsam pa dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigadakon mchog gsum la sogs lan gsum bya/ gsum pa gnyis ka'i bya ba la/ sku'i rjes gnang dang*/ gsung gi dang*/ thugs rnam par mi rtog pa'i dang*/ yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang dang bzhi yod pa las/ dang po sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba btab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigagang tshe lta bar 'dod pa'am zhes sho lo ka gcig lan gsum bya/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ khyed rang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ nged kyis oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi phung po dang khams dang skye mched thams cad mi dmigs par stong pa nyid du sangs te song ba'i rjes su baṃ las/ sogs bdag bskyed lhar gsal btab la bsgom du bcug la/ de ltar khyed rang 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i spyi gtsug tu rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gcig byon nas khyed rang la thim pa'i mos pa mdzod cig byas la/ 'jam dbyangs kyi sku slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sku yin te/ /sangs rgyas sku yis byin brlabs pas/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob shog/dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas khyed rang gi lus 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dang dbyer med du gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de ltar byas pa la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su nad med pa dang*/ 'gro ba gzhan gyis mthong ba tsam gyis dad par 'gyur ba dang*/ mthar thug tu mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gnyis pa gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

brtse ldan khyod kyis mkhyen rab 'od zer gyis/ / sogs sho lo ka gcig lan gsum/ de nas yang dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod cigabla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i thugs ka'i 'khor lo'i steng baṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa las sngags kyi 'phreng ba 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa bla ma'i zhal nas thon te/ khyed rang 'jam pa'i dbyangs su gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs nas/ snying ga'i baṃ yig sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim pa'i mos pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ciga'aphreng ba lag tu 'dzin du bcug la/ oṃ wā kyai daṃ na ma/ zhes tshar :kha cig [gca ིga ]'don/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyis nged la me tog gtor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigabacom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum/ de nas khyed rang gis slob dpon la me tog phul ba de sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas dngos grub kyis tshul du byin pa'i mos pa mdzod cig byas la me tog mgo thog tu bzhag nas/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /rtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams la/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis gsung gi byin gyis brlabs pa ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig/ ces brjod/ de ltar byas pa la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i bya ba la mkhas pa dang*/ mthar thug tu gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi gsung thob par 'gyur ba yin no/ /gsum pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigashes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ /snying rje zhi la mi gnas pas/ /mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas/ /'jam dbyangs thugs la gsol ba 'debs/ / zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas dpon slob gnyis kas lus gnad bca' ba ni/

rkang pa skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhagasgal tshigs bsrang*/ mig bar snang la bstad nas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar smin mtshams kyi thad tsam du yi ge a gcig gsal btab la/ de la sems rtse gcig tu bstad nas a a zhes nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ a de 'ja' yal ba bzhin du yal nas dmigs pa med pa'i stong pa nyid rtog pa thams cad dang bral ba la gsal le sing nge ye re bar sems ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag nas/ slob ma'i spyi bor me tog cig bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cigazhes kyang brjod de brtan par bsam mo/ /de ltar thugs kyi rjes gnang thob pa la phan yon gnyis te/ gnas skabs su chos la blo 'gro zhing mthar thug tu shes bya ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes rdo rje lta bu thob par 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa yon tan 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod cigadus 'di nas ni gzung nas su/ /phyi ma byang chub ma thob bar/ /bcom ldan 'jam dbyangs mgon gyis ni/ /bdag gis bla ma mdzad du gsol/ /

zhes pa lan gsum/ de nas slob ma'i lag tu mtshan brjod gtad la/ 'di ni 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rgyud mtshan yang dag par brjod pa zhes bya ba tshig nyung la don zab pa/ rgyud sde thams cad kyi yang rtse yin pas 'di la thos bsam dang*/ 'di nas bstan pa'i don nyams su blangs na/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur bas/ 'di la khyed rang rnams thos bsam gyis la nyams su long*/ gzhan la ston la bshad pa gyis la sems can gyi don du gang 'gyur gyis shigaces rjes su gnang ba sbyin pa yin no/ /de ltar byas pa la phan yon gnyis yod de/ gnas skabs su rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas shing sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub pa dang*/ mthar thug tu 'jam pa'i dbyangs la mnga' ba'i yon tan 'phrin las thams cad dang mnyam pa'i gnas thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ltar khyed rnams kyi dad pa dang 'dun pa'i sgo nas nged la gsol ba btab nas/ de la nged kyis brtse ba'i bsam pas ci shes kyi sgo nas/ rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rjes gnang byas pa 'di la phan yon ci yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad sems can gyi don du bsngos nas las byas pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir du 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ciga'adi bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba bdag gis gang thob pa/ /de yi skye bo thams cad kyis/ / 'jam dbyangs shes rab thob par shog/ ces pa lan gsum/ de'i dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa thams cad bla ma'i bka' bzhin du sgrub bo snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos sogs lan gsum/ rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum byas nas/ de ltar na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi rjes gnang zab mo grub pa yin pas/ des dga' ba bsgom pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid/ / ces sogs kyi smon lam 'debs shing phyag phul nas 'gro bar gzhug go

/de nas slob dpon gyis mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos nas/ mdun bskyed la mchod bstod sngar ltar byas nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang zhes sogs dang*/ mdun bskyed la brtan bzhugs bya'o/ /de nas smon lam bkra shis bya'o/ /mchod gtor rnams bsdu'o/ /kuna~X la ngo mtshar cher grags pa'i/ /'jam dkar sgrub thabs dga~X' ba'i tog/snyinga~X gi thig le 'dir bkod kyi/ /blo gsal rnams kyis myur po~Xr long*/ /'jam dkar kha che paṇa chen lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// /maṅgalaṃ bistā ra ku ru/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mtha' yas rgyal ba'i mkhyen pa kun/ /gcig bsdus 'jam dbyangs gzhon nu'i sku/ /de la btud cing gsol btabs nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /'dir shin tu byin rlabs kyi bka' babs che ba 'jam dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs ni/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ rang gi snying 'od kyi gur khang kha gyen du bstan pa'i nang du/ pad zla'i gdan la dhīḥdamar ser de las 'od 'phros/ rang gi mi shes pa'i dri ma sbyangs/ ba spu'i bu ga nas spros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems cad gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa las rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nu gyur pa sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu gur gum gzhon nu'i mdangs can 'od kyi dra ba 'gyed pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri sngo sangs dpung pa'i thad kar 'phyar ba/ g.yon ut+pal sngon po'i rtsa ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba rab tu rgyas pa'i steng du gsung rab kun 'dus pa'i po ti dang bcas pa/

dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing dbu skra ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ rigs bdag mi bskyod pas spras pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ / bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro na/ dpral bar oṃ las 'jam dpal dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas 'jam dpal dmar po/ snying gar hūṃ las 'jam dpal sngon po/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du dhīḥde las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rang nyid la zhugs par gyur/ dhī ཿ'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba dang*/ lce'i rtsa bar yang dhīḥyig mgo phug tu gnas par bsams la/ oṃ ā ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes ci nus su bzlas shing*/ na mo mañju shrī ye/ ku ma ra bhu tā ya/ bo dhī satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā kā ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ ā ra dze/ bi ra dze/ shud+dhe/ bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ya/ bi sho dha ya/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nir ma le/ dza ya wa re/ ru ru tsa le/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes shes rab blo 'phel gyi gzungs nyid ci rigs par bzlas nas/ thun 'jog pa'i dus su dbugs thog gcig la dhīḥbargya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas lus dhīḥyig gcig tu gyur par bsam/ thun 'jog mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pa'i sgo nas gtsang sbra dang mchod pa la brtson par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu can mchod pa ci 'byor dang dkar gtor gnyis dang bcas pa bsham/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas nas/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ pad zla la zhes pa nas/ gnas gsum byin rlabs kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod yon phal cher sogs tshigs bcad sngags dang bcas pas mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po sogs dang*/ rgyal sras gzhon nu mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor can/ /gur gum mdog can 'od kyi dra bas mdzes/

'od 'bar ral gri glegs bam phyag na bsnams/ /lha yi bla ma khyed la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje rnon po gsang sngags yi ge drug/brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi sgo ru bstan/ /gsung mchog mtshungs med rig sngags rgya mtsho yis/ /gti mug nyid log slong bar mdzad la 'dud/ /gang thugs nam mkha'i dkyil ltar dag pa la/ /thugs rje'i char rgyun rgyun chad med pa yis/ /'gro kun sgrib gnyis dri ma 'khrud mdzad pa'i/ /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag 'jam dbyangs khyod la 'dud/ /skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs khyod dang 'bral med cing*/ /bdag dang ma lus 'gro ba thams cad kyis/ /don rab rgya chen 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes pa'am shes shing spro na rgya bod kyi bstod pa ngo mtshar can du ma yod pa rnams kyis bstod do/ /gtor ma dang po 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la 'bul/ gtor ma phyi ma phyogs skyong bcu la cha gsum nang ltar btang*/ 'di'i 'jig rten 'das gtor yig rnying las ma bshad kyang phyis kyi phyag len yin/ mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ci 'grub bya ste/ slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rim pa'o/ /rjes gnang gi ngo bo ni/ phal cher sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i chings dang 'dra/ 'on kyang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par dang*/ go rim rnams bshad na slob ma rnams khrus byas/ phyag dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po sogs/ sho lo ka gnyis kyis gsol pa btab/ rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma lhar bskyed ye shes pa bstim/ bzlas lung gi skabs/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i thugs kar shes rab kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte bar oṃ a dhīḥ rtsibs bzhi la ra pa tsa na rnams bkod la/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i de las de 'dra ba gnyis pa chad nas/ zhal nas thon/ kha sgor zhugs/ slob ma'i snying ga'i 'khor lo sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim par bsams la/ sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/

slob ma'i lce'i rtsa bar dhīḥmago phug bstan/ dhīḥ'i 'od kyis ngag gi skyon thams cad sbyangs/ slob dpon kyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas byang sems kyi yon tan thams cad bsdus te dhīḥci nus shig rjes zlos byed/ de nas dam bca' ba'i lung dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa'i lung byas la dam tshig khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ yon 'bul/ rjes chog ni mchod pa kha gsos/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ mchod bstod yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /grub brnyes mkhas pa chen po dzi tā ris/ /lo bdun lon tshe 'di nyid zhal gzigs pas/ /blo gros mchog gyur mkhas pa'i grags pas khyab/ /rdo rje gdan pa gnyis kyi'ang 'di grub cing*/ /ba ri lots+tshā rig sngags 'di grub nas/ /'jam dbyangs zhal gzigs shes rab cher gyur la/ /sa chen mkhyen pa'i bdag po'ang 'di yis mthu/ /zhal gzigs brgyud pa mang por byin kyis brlabs/ /blo chen kuna~X dga~X' rgyal mtshan dpal/ khu dbon gsung gi bcud bsdus nas/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bkod pa la/ /nyes pa mchis na bzod par gsol/ /rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs a ra pa tsa na dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /mkhyen dngos 'jam dbyangs la btud nas/ /rdo rje mtshon chas mdzad pa yi/ /bstod pa'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang nas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la 'khor lo dmar ser rtsibs lnga pa lte ba la dhīḥrtsibs rnams la a ra pa tsa na dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang dang mdun gyi nam mkhar 'phags pa 'jam dpal gur gum gyi mdog can ral gri dang po ti 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/

dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa'i sku can re re gyur/ rang gi snying gar sngags kyi 'khor lo/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar dhīḥsangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ye shes pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying ga'i sngags 'khor las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas par bsam/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mdun bskyed mchod/ snying ga'i 'od zer las mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas/ mdun gyi 'jam dbyangs la mchod cing gsol ba 'debs par bsams la/ gang gi blo gros sgrib gnyis sprin bral nyi ltar rnam dag rab gsal ba/ /bden gnyis don kun ji bzhin gzigs phyir nyid kyi thugs kar glegs bam 'dzin/ /gang dag srid pa'i brtson rar ma rig mun 'thoms sdug bsngal gyis gzir ba'i/ /'gro tshogs kun la bu gcig ltar brtse yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan gsung*/ /'brug ltar cher sgrogs nyon mongs gnyid slong las kyi lcags sgrog grol mdzad cing*/ /ma rig mun sel sdug bsngal myu gu ji snyed gcod mdzad ral gri bsnams/ /gdod nas dag cing sa bcu'i mthar son yon tan lus rdzogs rgyal sras thu bo'i sku/ /bcu phrag bcu dang bcu gnyis rgyan spras bdag blo'i mun sel 'jam pa'i dbyangs la 'dud/ / ces nyer gcig la sogs pas bstod cing*/ mthar mdun gyi 'jam dbyangs 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ snying ga'i 'khor lo drag tu 'khor bar bsams la/ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥ zhes pa brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzla'o/ /mthar stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag ste/ dge ba bsngo/ 'od zer dgu phrugs kyi byin rlabs byed par 'dod pas/ spro na 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi sku'i drung du mchod pa bshams la byin rlabs bya/ de rnams med kyang rung ste/ slob dpon gyis bstod sgrub tshar gcig nyams su len/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa tshar gsum byed/

slob dpon 'phags pa 'jam dpal du gsal ba'i dpral ba nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad la mchod pa phul/ 'od zer dpral bar phog pas thugs rgyud yongs su bskul nas/ 'od zer gyi rnam pas dpral ba nas byung*/ slob dpon gyi dpral bar thim/ slob dpon 'jam dpal du gsal ba la mos gus dung bas bstod pa tshar gcig gam gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba nas 'od zer byung*/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim pas lus kyi sdig sgrib byang zhing*/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par mos su bcug de bzhin du/ mgrin pa nas 'od zer spro bsdu dang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dgagasung gi byin rlabs zhugs pa dang*/ thugs ka nas 'od zer spro bsdu dang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dgathugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs pa'ang rigs 'gre/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'di la mdun bskyed la rjes chog byed pa ni med do/ /mkhas mchog kun ༵ gyis bsngags pa yi/ /bstod sgrub zab mo rab dga~X' ba/ /'di yis rang gzhan don byed tshul/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bris pa lags/ /'jam dpal yon tan ye shes bzang po'i bstod sgrub tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba'i ye shes mkhyen pa rnams/ /gcig bsdus 'jam pa'i rdo rje la/ /gus pas btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /dam pa'i man ngag bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang*/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo'i gnas dang de'i mdun du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ gtso bo'i gdan pad zla'i steng du saṃ las seng ge sngon po mgo bo g.yas su bstan zhing gdong gyen du phyogs pa/ ral pa dmar ser grol ba nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng du/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i dhīḥyig gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can dang*/ gdan mdun ma'i steng du hrīḥyig sngo sangs sa bon de gnyis yongs su gyur pa las/

rang nyid rje btsun 'jam dbyangs sku mdog li khri'i phung po lta bu phyag gnyis chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i mtheb mdzub kyi bar nas byung ba ut+pa la'i sdong bu snyan g.yas g.yon gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng g.yas na ral gri dang g.yon na glegs bam can/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho dang ldan pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga dang bcas shing*/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis seng ge la bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zhi ba dang 'dzum pa dang sgeg pa'i cha lugs can/ mdun du 'phags ma dbyangs can ma sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba lha mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing*/ zhabs tsog pu'i phyed krung gis bzhugs pa/ bud med sgyu ma'i nga rgyal gyis 'gying zhing mtshan nyid gzhan thams cad yab dang mtshungs pa'o/ /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ yab yum gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ hrīḥdhī ma me ti pa swa ra swa sti/ mañju shrī muṃ hrīḥ pradz+nyā war+dha ni hrīḥdhīḥswāhā/

zhes ci nus su bzla/ 'jug tu lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs shing dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su 'jam dpal gyi sku gzugs la mchod bstod gang 'grub bya/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gtor ma'ang 'bul/ bsnyen pa lan gcig thon nas/ sgrub rdzas su dpa' bo'i ril bu sgrub ste/ spang rgyan gla rtsi mtshal dkar gsum/ /yung ba tsan dan a ka ru/ /spang spos aka ru shu dag gsum/ /shing mngar rgya skyegs a ru ra/ /dpa' bo bcu gnyis bsdus pa ni/ /zhib par btags la sbrang rtsi dang*/ /ba dmar 'o mas ril bur bya/ /zhes pa ltar yin la/ dar dkar la rgya skyegs dang rang byung gis pho 'khor bris pa la steng nas bkab/ dar dmar la ba la dang yur bas mo 'khor bris te 'og tu bting*/ gnyis ka'ang rtsibs brgyad dam 'dab brgyad/ mu khyud gsum pa/ mu khyud la ā li kā li ye dhar dang bcas pa bri/ ril bu dbyangs can ma bskyed cing sgrub/ oṃ ya mān+ta ka hūṃ gis bar chad bsrung*/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi lag len ni/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar ser can bri/ der bum pa kha rgyan can/ shar du 'jam dpal gyi tsa ka li/ lhor dpa' bo'i ril bu/ nub tu mtshan brjod/ byang du ral gri rnams bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor bsgrigs/ bdag bskyed sngon bzhin byas la mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin bris sku dhīḥlas 'jam dbyangs zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs pa/ ril bu hrīḥlas dbyangs can ma po ti ā li kā li byung ba'i mtshan brjod kyi glegs bam/ ral gri dhīḥlas byung ba'i phyag mtshan ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rnams su gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po/ / sogs kyis bstod/ mdun gyi rten thams cad la dmigs la bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/

gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ a las byung ba'i ka pā la'i nang du gtor ma sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags la lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs gsol btab dang*/ yan lag bdun pa spyi dang 'dra/ sku'i rjes gnang la sku bskyed bstim spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ de nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs pa/ /rgyu bzang rin chen bum pa 'di/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs su byin rlabs nas/ /mi bskyod chu yis dbang bskur ro/ / snying po'i mthar a bhi ṣiñca zhes btags la chu dbang bskur/ tsa ka li spyi bor bzhagatshig rkang dang po dang gsum pa gnyis 'dra ba las/ gnyis par/ dbyibs legs gzugs sku dam pa 'di/ / zhes dang*/ bzhi par/ rnam snang sku yis dbang bskur ro/ / zhes 'don pa spo zhing sngags kyang 'dra/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / de bzhin du ril bu sbyin la/ dpa' bo bcu gnyis sbyar ba'i bcud/ /dbyangs can lha mo zhes dang*/ rin 'byung yon tan dbang bskur ro/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / po ti gtad la/ rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog/ā li kā lir zhes dang*/ dpag med gsung gi zhes 'don pa spo/ bar 'dir bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa las/ rjes zlos lan nyer gcig byed/ ā li kā li dpag tu med pa mgrin par thim par bsam/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ / ral gri gtad la/ shes rab ral gri rnon po 'di/ /ye shes sems dpar zhes dang*/ phyag mtshan thugs kyi dbang bskur ro/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / yang maṇ+ḍal phul nas gsol ba btab/ yang slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi dpral ba nas/ dbyangs can dkar mo dpag tu med pa spros slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ de bzhin du mgrin pa nas dmar mo/

snying ga nas sngon mo/ lte ba nas ser mo/ gsang gnas nas ljang khu rnams spros te/ slob ma'i gsang bar thim pa'i bar dmigs pa rnams phog ste 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / rjes kyi bya ba thams cad ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /yang mngon rtogs cung zad rgyas par byed na/ tshogs zhing spyan drangs nas phyag 'tshal mchod pa yan lag bdun pa rnams byed cing*/ gshegs su gsol ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ ye shes pa dang dbang lha la yang mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ rgyas btab kyi rjes su mchod bstod rgyas pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i rjes su yang mchod bstod byed pa lag len yin no/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar sgrub pa'i thabs/ /kuna~X las zab cing dga~X' bar bsngags/ /gsar rnying yi ge phung po las/ /don ston snyinga~X po~Xr blangs pa 'di'o/ /dam pa sangs rgyas kyi thugs dam lha'i gtso bo 'jam dpal smra seng gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //'jam dbyangs/ dam pa/ kha che gu h+ya ba/ glan sgom yab sras/ bla ma 'od shaka slob dpon 'od zer mgon/ slob dpon shaka gzhon/ spyan snga bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ 'khon bzod pa dpal/ 'khon bsod nams 'od zer/ 'khon sher mgon/ shar pa ngor chen/ dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba sras bcas mkhyen pa'i dngos/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs la rab btud nas/ /zla 'byung sbas pa'i sgrub thabs bzhin/ /shes rab 'khor lo'i man ngag bshad/ /skyabs sems sngon du btang*/ snying 'od kyi gur khang du gyur dbus su zla ba la dhīḥde'i 'od kyis mchod 'os rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje gur nas 'byung ba ltar bdun rnam dag dang*/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ stong pa nyid kyi don bsam zhing*/ swa bhā wa sa sngags dang*/ shū n+ya tā gnyis brjod/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba la dhīḥlas ral gri'i yu ba dang rtse mor rdo rjes mtshan pa dhīḥs brgyan pa/

de'i 'od kyis snod gzhal yas khang bcud 'jam dpal du gyur/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa mkhas grub thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams 'od zer gyi rnam pas tshur bsdus yongs su gyur pa las 'jam dbyangs dkar po phyag g.yas ral gri dkar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar gtad pas po ti dang 'khor los mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can/ 'jam dpal zhi ba'i mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i thugs kar zla ba la 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar yang dhīḥrtsibs brgyad la sngags 'bru brgyad/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min nas ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod cing gsol ba btab/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying ga'i dhīḥl thim pas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpar gyur/ de'i thugs kar yang zla ba la dhīḥting nge 'dzin sems dpa' 'o/ / de nas 'jam dpal gyi spro bsdu dang lha sku snang stong la sems gtad/ bzlas pa'i tshe lte ba mi 'khor rtsibs 'khor zhing*/ 'khor lo yig 'bru bsnol mar 'khor ba la sems gtad la/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥhūṃ zhes 'bru 'bum bzla'o/ /rtags spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ thun mong ma yin pa ni gza' pa sangs shar ba mthong ba'o/ /mthar rjes gzhig gi rim pas 'od gsal du bsdus nas/ sdang ba'i tshe dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mgron spyan drangs/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhīḥbā ling gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas phul/ mchod bstod sogs 'jam dbyangs spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang sbyin par 'dod na/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi cho ga rgyas pa byang chub gzhung las sogs nas 'byung ba 'grub na rab min na'ang maṇ+ḍal bshams la/ zhing khams su mos/ tshom bu bkod de gdan du mos/ mchod pa sna lnga bzang du bsham/ bshos gtsang gtor ma dang mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal yang bshams/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/

gong ltar bdag bskyed kyi mthar bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mdun bskyed kyang bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gre zhing*/ mchod bstod gtor 'bul bzlas pa rnams bya/ 'grub na cha gsum gtor ma'ang btang*/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba drag tu btab/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la/ bgegs sbyang ba de'i sdig sgrib sbyang ba spyi dang mthun/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum btab/ slob ma sems dpa' sum brtsegs su skad cig gis bskyed pa'i snying gar sngags 'khor phyi rol du ā li kā lis bskor ba bsgom/ slob dpon gyi thugs kar yang de bzhin du bsgom pa mu tig gi 'phreng ba ltar zhal nas 'thon te slob ma'i snying ga'i de la bstim/ rjes zlos lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung bya/ de nyid lan gsum bskyar zhing*/ 'jug tu yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis brtan bzhugs bya/ rjes spyi dang mthun no/ /shes rab sgrub thabs bla med pa/ /kuna~X nas dga~X' ba'i man ngag ni/ /shin tu mang ba'i snyinga~X po~X tsam/ /bkod 'di'ang blo gsal yid bde'i gnas/ kha che paṇa chen gyi man ngag 'jam dbyangs shes rab 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dga' ldan gnas kyi 'khor los bsgyur/ /lha rgyal drang srong chen po'i tshul/ /rgyal tshab mi pham chos kyi rjer/ /btud nas sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la/ rang sems maiṃ gser mdog yongs su gyur pa spyi blugs kyi mtshan pa'i klu shing gi yal ga maiṃ gis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyi 'phro 'dus las rang nyid 'phags pa byams pa gser mdog mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/

phyag g.yas thugs kar chos 'chad dang*/ g.yon mnyam bzhag gi tshul gyi klu shing gi yal ga'i rtsa ba bzung zhing me tog snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ril ba spyi blugs dang bcas pa/ ral pa'i cod pan gyi ngos la mchod rten gyis spras pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab cing tshangs skud can rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la maiṃ de las 'od zer 'phros/ dga' ldan gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ sa bon gyi mthar sngags kyis 'phreng ba bsgoms te/ oṃ maiṃ mai tri ye swāhā/ 'bum phrag bcu rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa yin la/ oṃ ma ti ma ti smṛ ti swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas shes rab phun sum tshogs pa bskyed pa dang*/ oṃ mo hi mo hi mahā mo hi swāhā/ zhes bzlas pas 'gro don chen por 'gyur ro/ /rjes tshad med bzhi yun ring du bsgoms nas smon lam btab/ thun mtshams su phyag mchod dang*/ byams pa'i mtshan brgya dang*/ dam bcas pa'i gzungs 'don pa'am klogagazhan yang chos spyod 'phel zhing*/ tshul khrims dag pa la gtsang sbra dang ldan pas 'grub na/ rtags rnams myur du 'byung zhing*/ spyir ni byin rlabs shin tu che'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ spyi'i cho gas rigs 'gre zhing*/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol btab dang*/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yis/ / sogs kyi skyabs sems lan gsum 'dzin/ rgyun bshags mi dgos thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa yin/ 'di la yi dam gyi gtor chog mi dgos shing*/ spro na cha gsum gtor ma gtong ngo*/ /byams pa'i sgrub thabs kuna~X gyi phul/ /byin rlabs bka' babs dga~X' ba'i tog/ni ri ti pa'i rgya gzhung ni/ /zhal gdams bcas pa'i snyinga~X po~X 'di'o/ /byams pa'i sgrubs thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/

spros bral nam mkha'i rdo rje ni/ /rgyal ba skyed mdzad lha mo'i tshul/ /shes rab pha rol phyin btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du rang nyid skad cig gis phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ser mo zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ phyag dang po gnyis chos 'chad dang mnyam bzhaga'og ma gnyis po ti dang 'phreng ba/ lha mo'i mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /thugs kar 'khor lo rtsibs drug pa'i lte bar a dkar po/ rtsibs rnams la g.yas bskor gyis/ tad+ya thā/ ga te/ ga te/ pa ra ga te/ pa ra saṃ ga te/ bo dhi swāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags tshan drug gis bskor ba/ a las 'od 'phros/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ yan lag bdun pa gang yang rung ba zhig bya ba las/ bzang spyod ltar mdzad pa gtso che/ bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥrang la thim/ sku snang stong*/ gsung grag stong*/ thugs rig stong*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rjes kun nas bslangs ste/ gong gi sngags 'di nyid drag tu bzlas pas/ rang dang rigs drug gi sdig sgrib thams cad dag par bsam/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su sher phyin gyi mdo klogapo ti la phyag mchod dang mtshan brgya 'don pa sogs bya/ 'di la rjes gnang mi dgos/ sgom lung tsam gyis chog go /'di dang phyogs mtshungs pa zhig bka' gdams lugs la'ang gnang mod kyi/ 'di ni bi byā khya ta de wa dang*/ bud+dha shrī nas brgyud pa'o/ /kuna~X nas ngo mtshar sher phyin gyi/ /sgrub thabs zab cing ches dga~X' ba/ /'di la snyinga~X nas nyams len byos/ /blos gros gsal po~X skye bar 'gyur/ /sher phyin ser mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/

/rab dkar shes rab lha mo'i tshul/ / shes rab pha rol phyin dngos la/ /gus par btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang*/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las sdong bu dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po'i steng du/ slar yang pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma gsum pa la gnas pa'i a las zla ba/ de'i steng du rang sems oṃ dkar po 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba las pad+ma dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma sku mdog ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ bung ba ltar gnag pa'i dbu skra g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i phyag mthil g.yas la pad+ma dkar po dang g.yon las dmar po'i rtsa ba skyes shing snyan gnyis kyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bzhugs pa/ sked skabs phra zhing nu 'phur rgyas pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar yang pad zla la oṃ dkar po ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ / dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' dbang gi lha dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam ye gnyis su med par gyur/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsungs zhing dbang bskur ro/ /'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ ar+ghaṃ

nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /ye shes shes rab pha rol phyin/ /'phags pa thams cad bskyed byed yum/ /de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ 'khor lo'i bzlas pa'am/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā war+dha ni/ dz+wa la dz+wa la me dha war+dha ni/ dhi ri dhi ri/ bud+dhi war+dha ni swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzlas/ thun 'jog khar lha sku stong nyid du sbyangs/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas dge ba bsngo'o/ /thun mtshams su shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo bklag pa dang*/ mtshan brgya ci nus su 'don pa sogs dge ba la 'bad/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dri bzang dang ba byung gi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du/ bris 'bur gyi sku gzugs sam/ med na tshom bu zhig bkod/ mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ maṇ+ḍal bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las maṇ+ḍal gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i dbus su tshom bu pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka la ye s+t+waṃ/ gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i gtor snod yangs par/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ snying po'i mthar ā kā ro btags pas lan lngas phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol btab sogs rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /grangs bsnyen bzhi 'bum du bshad kyang 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dus zla ba drug gi bar du bya/ sgrub pa dang las sbyor rgyud las shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang zur bka'i lugs yin mod kyis/ rjes gnang gi cho ga sku bskyed bstim/

gsung lung gsum/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams spyi dang 'dra la/ khyad par ni bzlas lung mtshan brgya'i lung klog pa nyid yin no/ /kuna~X dga~X'i grags ldan 'ga' zhig gis/ /sgrub thabs 'khrul bar sbyar mthong nas/ /'khrul med snyinga~X po~X mdor bsdus tsam/ /bsnyen pa'i bya ba 'di ltar smras/ /sher phyin dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon pos rnam sprul zhing*/ /'jam dbyangs mgon dang dbyer med pa/ /dbyangs can mgon la gus btud nas/ /blo dman mgon du sgrub thabs bri/ /paṇ+ḍi ta bud+dha shrī nas brgyud pa'i man ngag 'di la/ rang dbyangs can mar gsal ba'i snying gar hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros/ dbyangs can mas thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'khor lo badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ e h+ya hi/ badz+ra de bi mahā tsakra sa mā yaṣ+ta/ sa ma ya dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ blo gros bskyed par gsol ba btab pas/ rang gi snying gar thim/ rin po che sna bzhi'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus/ rang nyid dbyangs can mar gyur pa ni/ sku mdog dang zhal gsum dkar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis ral gri dang ut+pal/ 'og ma gnyis kyis pi waṃ bsgreng pa/ pad zla la rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ lo bcu drug lon pa ltar lang tsho la bab pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ thugs kar pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma brgyad la dbyangs bcu drug g.yas skor yig 'bru rnams ral gri phyed pa'i gdan la gnas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra de wī pi tsu pi tsu pradz+nyā war+dha hrīḥhūṃ/ zhes 'bum phrag gsum bzla bar gsungs na'ang bcu gnyis bzla'o/ /thun zhabs su lha sku lte ba'i 'khor lo la bsdu/ de yang hrīḥl bsdu/ bsnyen pa song bas gzhung las bshad pa'i las tshogs rnams sgrub tu rung ba yin/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos/ gzhan rjes gnang gi bya ba sogs ni spyi dang 'dra/

thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan bstim pa nyid la mdzad do/ /dbyangs can kuna~X las phyag bzhi'i skur/ /ston mdzad sgrub thabs rnyed dka' ba/ /blo gros mchog gi dga~X' ston can/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X'i yi ge'o/ /slob dpon zla ba gzhon nu'i lugs dbyangs can ma phyag bzhi ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ bla ma dang ni lha mo la/ /btud nas sgra dbyangs lha mo yi/ /mngon rtogs shin tu mdor bsdus pa/ /mdo tsam rnam par bkod par bya/ /dbyangs can ma dmar mo bsgom par 'dod pas/ rang gi mdun du ba'i lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal bya/ rdza bum gtsang mar gzhon nu ma'i chu blug/bum rdzas bzang ba sin+dhu ra dang yongs grags rnams me long du bsres te gzhugadar leb rgan gyis bkab bo/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas hrīḥlas rang nyid dbyangs can ma dmar mo/ phyag g.yas na nor bu/ g.yon me long bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i bzhugs pa'i thugs kar hrīḥsngags kyis bskor ba/ oṃ swa ra swa s+t+yai hriṃ hriṃ hriṃ swāhā/ thun 'jog khar bdag bskyed kyi lha mo bum pa'i nang du bzhugs par bsam/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ byas pas gzhan thams cad kyi blo gros phrogs nas rang la thim par bsam/ dkar gtor bsangs sbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du 'bru gsum las bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ sngags snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ 'di blo gros bskyed pa la ches myur/ bsnyen sgrub thon nas bum chu 'thung ngo*/ /mngon rtogs rgyas pa bsgom par 'dod na/ yi ge rnying pa 'ga' zhig tu shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed na/ gtsang sbra shin tu che ba'i ngang nas/ maṇ+ḍal pad ma 'dab ma brgyad kyi steng du bum pa bca'/ sngon 'gro gtor ma bgegs gtor gyi tshul dang*/

gzhi bdag gtor ma'ang spyi dang mthun par btang*/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed sngar bzhin bsgom nas/ mdun bskyed bum pa bskyed chog spyi dang mthun/ bum pa'i nang du bdag bskyed bzhin lha mo bskyed la bzlas pa bya/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ de nas slob ma'i bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ bzang spyod kyi yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs sems rgyas bsdus long skabs dang sbyar/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon khyod kyis lha mo yi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*/ /byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob ma dam tshig pa 'jam dbyangs dmar ser du skad cig gis bskyed pa la/ ye shes pa dbyangs can lha mor bstim/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ snying po'i mthar ji ltar bltams pa sogs brjod/ lha mo'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ste spyi bor thim/ gsung bzlas lung spyi dang 'dra/ thugs rjes gzhig gi rim pas stong pa nyid du bsdu ba mdzad/ lhag ma spyi dang 'dra'o/ /dbyangs can sgrub thabs ma lus pa/ kuna~X las bab cing dga~X' ba'i tog/snyinga~X po~X mdor bsdus yi ge bkod/ /dge des blo gros mtshungs med shog/dbyangs can ma dmar mo sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ shes rab kyi lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu gnyis pa'o/ /zhus dag / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ma lus bgegs rnams nyams pa dang*/ /phyi yi bar chad bsrung ba'i mchog /rdo rje phag mo'i pho nya mo/ /'od zer can mas bdag srungs shig/'dir slob dpon rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug ni/ dgra sogs phyi yi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir 'od zer can ma dang*/ gdon bgegs sogs nang gi bar chad zhi ba'i phyir mi g.yo ba sngon po pus btsugs dang*/ nad zhi ba'i phyir lha mo sangs rgyas spyan ma dang*/

rmi lam ngan pa sogs bar chad bzlog pa'i phyir/ spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed dang bzhi pa dang*/ tshe bsgrub pa'i phyir thub pa me ru shi ṣa dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i bsgom bzlas te drug las/ dang po 'od zer can ma'i gzungs 'don thabs ni/ snga dro shar dang*/ dgong mo nub tu gdong phyogs shing*/ nyin mo snang byed nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ mtshan mo snang byed zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan bsgom pa blo yul tu nges par byas nas/ skyabs sems sngon du btang byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying gar snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor la oṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad dkar po byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ sangs rgyas rab tu byung ba'i cha lugs can/ ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od 'phros/ 'od zer dkar po'i rwa ba zlum po rtse mo mchod rten gyi rnam pa can du gyur/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya bcas la/ snying gar snang byed kyi dkyil 'khor la maṃ las mya ngan med kyi yal ga maṃ gyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las 'od zer can ma gser mdog skem pa'i lus can/ g.yas khab dang g.yon skud pa bsnams pa/ mnyam par bzhengs par gyur/ sna bug g.yas pa nas phyir spros mdun du bzhugs/ rang 'dra'i pho nya mo dpag tu med pa sprul/ gnod byed rnams dbang med du bkug ste/ kha mig btsems/ yan lag bcings nas rwa ba'i phyi rol 'obs kyi nang du 'phangs par bsam/ gzungs kyi mdo chung tshar gcig 'don/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi snying po brjod par bya ste zhes pa nas swāhā 'i bar lan bdun brjod/ de nas phyag rgya bshig la ci bder byas/ rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun te/ 'od zer can sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying gar thim pa las/ rang nyid lha mo 'od zer can gser mdog sgeg cing mdzes pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon myang ngan med pa'i shing gi sdong po las yal ga gcig 'dzin pa/

yid tsam khro ba/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phag ser po bzhis drangs pa'i shing rta la rol pa'i bzhugs pa/ rang dang phag las 'od byung*/ phag 'jigs rung dpag tu med pa sprul/ 'obs kyi nang gi gnod byed rnams zos shing*/ lhag ma gser gyi sa gzhir gyur/ phag rnams gdong phyir bstan pas rwa bar gyur/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai maṃ swāhā/ gang 'grub bzla/ mthar bdag bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod bya/ mi dmigs par bzhag la dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma ni dkar gtor bsangs sbyangs/ bh+ruṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'od zer can ma badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ oṃ mā ri ts+yai de wi sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pa la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gis mtshan tsam 'dzin zhing dran pas kyang*/ /'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob byed cing*/ /dri med bde chen nye bar stsol ba yi/ /lha mo 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun/ 'di la nges par rjes gnang dgos shing*/ 'on kyang rjes gnang gi bya ba ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin no/ /gsung bzlas lung gi mthar gzungs mdo klog dgos so/ /rgyal ba kuna~X gyi pho nya mo/ /dga~X' chen 'od zer can sgrub thabs/ /gzungs las 'byung ba ngo mtshar can/ snyinga~X po~X'i yi ge 'di tsam lags/ /'di'i lam bsrung la sogs pa khyad par gyi las tshogs ni/ yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ phyi'i bar chad sel ba gzungs las 'byung 'od zer can ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/

/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ston pa gau taṃ shākya'i tog/de la btud nas de sgrub thabs/ /ri rtse brtsegs pa 'od kyi rgyal/ /gzugs sngags sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /nam langs ma thag tu khrus byas shar du phyogs pas/ mdun gyi nam mkhar de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa gser mdog byang chub shing gi rtsa bar skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ g.yon chos gos kyi dra lte ba'i thad kar bzung ba/ g.yas skyabs sbyin no/ /ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal/ / sogs kyis bstod/ phyag spyi bor bzhag pas 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ na mo bha ga wa te/ me ru shi ṣa ra kū ṭa pra bha rā dzā ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ me ru me ru mahā me ru ye swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa bzlas/ 'od du zhu rang la thim pas rang yang thub par gyur/ sngags cung zad gcig bzla/ stong par sbyangs la dge ba bsngo/ dmigs kyis bkar nas tshe sgrub byed na/ nyin mtshan ci nus bzla ba yin no/ /dam tshig tu gzhan la gsang*/ 'di la bzlas lung gis chog pa'i lugs kyang yod la/ rjes gnang ltar na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa bzhin no/ /mkhas rmongs kuna~X la grags chung yang*/ /shin tu zab phyir yid dga~X'i gnas/ /sbas te snyinga~X nas bsgrubs gyur na/ /tshe ni mchog tu ring po~X gyur/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ /tshe ring po sgrub pa thub pa me ru shi ṣa'i sgrub thabs kyis le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ /nad dang sdug bsngal zhi byed phyir/ /rmi lam ngan pa'ang bzlog gyur la/ /tshe sgrub mchog gyur bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems stong nyid sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi mdun du skad cig gis spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po na bza' sngon po gsol ba/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/

tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags kyi 'phreng ba gsal btab te/ mos gus kyi gdung ba chen pos/ oṃ a ro lika / ces lan gcig brjod la/ a ro lika ces pa nyid brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis sngags oṃ can gcig gis 'go drangs nas/ gzhan brgya brgya bzla ba nyid ci nus su bya'o/ /mthar bdag gi sdig sgrib sbyong ba dang*/ bar chad zhi bar gsol ba drag tu btab pas 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rnam smin gyi lus sbyangs te 'od kyi rang bzhin gyi lha skur gyur/ de yang mi dmigs par sbyangs te cung zad mnyam par bzhagadage ba bsngo/ rmi lam du dge slong chos gos sngon po gyon pas lung ston pa sogs 'byung ngo*/ /'di la bzlas lung tsam mdzad pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ rjes gnang ltar byed na/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X la ming yang ma grags pa/ /man ngag shin tu dga~X' ba'i tog/dzi tā ri dang ba ri ba'i/ thugs dam snyinga~X po~X mchog gyur lags/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ rmi lam ngan pa bzlog pa spyan ras gzigs yi ge phyed dang bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ zhi ba'i las sgrub gtsor gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas spyan la gus btud nas/ /nad zhi rims sogs bzlog pa'i phyir/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang nas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems la yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo phyag g.yas pas 'khor lo mig 'bras kyis mtshan pa dang*/ g.yon pas pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du laṃ/ de las 'os 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying ga zla ba la sngags 'phreng sa bon ming yig dang bcas pa bsgom/ oṃ ru ru spu ru/ dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid+dhi lo tsa ne/ sarba ar+tha sa dha ni ma ma shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ spyan ni 'khor lo mdzes ma ste/ /'chi ba slong bar byed pa'i mchog/bdag cag sdug bsngal gyur ba la/ /lha mo khyod kyis bskyab par mdzod/ / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'di'i las tshogs bar chad zhi byed maṇ+ḍal nad 'don sogs ni yig rnying du shes par bya/ rjes gnang ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsas rigs 'gre'o/ /rigs sngags rgyal mo bde gshegs ma/ /kuna~X gyi thog mar rab dga~X' ba/ /spyan ma'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum las/ bsnyen pa tsam zhig snyinga~X po~Xr bris/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las nad zhi bar byed pa sangs rgyas spyan ma'i sgrub thabs kyis le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dkyil 'khor kun tu zhugs pa dang*/ /rigs sngags kun gyi gzhir gyur pa/ /sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyong ba'i thabs/ /dam tshig gsum bkod sgrub thabs bshad/ /gtsang sbra dang bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga la gnas pa'i sgo nas 'di nyid kyi bris sku'am/ ma 'byor na thub pa'i dbang po'i sku gzugs bris 'bur gang yang rung ba stegs bu la bzhagagatsang sbra can gyis mchod pa rgya cher bshams/

stan dma' ba la pus mo btsugs pa'i tshul gyis 'dug ste mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlab pa'am/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang sbrel ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du rin po che'i khri pad+ma'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ bdug spos 'thul zhing*/ ma lus sems can ma'i mthar rdo rje bsdams pa las/ gung mo gnyis bsgreng zhing rtse mo sbyar/ mthe bong gnyis mnyam par brkyang ba rdo rje gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya g.yab cing*/ oṃ ta thā ga to bha ga wān/ oṃ h+ye hi/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po byon te gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che sogs kyis bstod/ bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i yan lag bdun pa tshar gcig bya/ bcom ldan dam tshig gsum bkod ni/ /gser mdog rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs/ /tshangs spyod cha byad chos gos bsnams/ /phyag g.yon chos gos dra 'dzin zhing*/ /gnyis kar thugs kar chos 'chad mdzad/ /thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la/ /gsang sngags yi ge brgya pa bzhugs/ /na ma s+t+rai ya dhi kā nāṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tā nāṃ/ sarba tra a pra ti ha ta bsti/ dharma tā bā li nāṃ/ oṃ a sa ma sa ma sa man+to/ ā nan+dā bsti sha sa ni ha ra ha ra/ sma ra sma ra ṇa bi ga ta ra ga bud+dha dharma te sā ra sā ra/ sa ma ba la/ ha sa ha sa/ trā ya trā ya/ ga ga na mahā ba ra lak+ṣa ṇe/ dz+wa la dz+wa la na sa ga re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar mchod bstod byas te/ oṃ khyod kyi sems can sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de ltar na sngags 'bum tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ zla ba yar ngo zhig la phyag mchod lan bdun pa re'i mthar sngags re bzla/ thun re re bzhin lan nyi shu rtsa gcig bya ba nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum du bya ba yin no/

/des rmi lam du zhal ston zhing sdig pa dag pa'i rtags 'byung la/ lan gcig la ma byung kyang*/ zla smad la sngar bzhin bsnyen pa byas la lan gsum bskyar bas 'grub nges pa yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra/ sdig sbyong kuna~X las ches zab pa/ /yig brgya'i man ngag rab dga~X' 'di/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam gyi/ /snyinga~X po~X yin zhes mkhas pa bsngags/ rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha drug las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa'i sdig sbyong gi cho gar grags pa dam tshig gsum bkod gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las rdo rje gdan pa'i thugs dam lha lnga'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu gsum pa'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rje btsun rig byed lha mo la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs kyi/ /mchog tu grags pa lha lnga dang*/ /rjes 'brel cho ga'i khyad par bshad/ /'di la sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi bya ba gnyis las/ dang po'i skabs su/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du lha chen dbang phyug dang u ma bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du rā hu la nag po mda' gzhu 'dzin pa kha bub tu bsgyel ba la hrīḥlas ut+pal dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od zer lcags kyu sogs zhes dang*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes dang*/ shar du ha las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ lho ru ri las rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ nub tu ni las pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ byang du sa las las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu rnams ḍā ma ru dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga thod pa 'dzin pa gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /spyi bor hrīḥlas khro bo rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub can/ de'i thugs kar hrīḥdang rta mgo'i mdun du bla ma'i sku gzugs kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi la rig byed ma lha lnga dang*/

khro rgyal rta mgrin bla mar bcas pa/ gtso mo'i thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro'i thugs kar yang rang rang gi sa bon/ de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ zhes sogs bya/ lha dbang bskur ba mi dgos/ bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥhūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hri hri hri ha ri ni sa hri dzaḥ.a kar+ṣa ya hūṃ dzaḥ ba su wa shaṃ ku ru aṅku sha hri wa shaṃ ku ru hūṃ hūṃ dza dzaḥ zhes drag tu bzla'o/ /gnyis pa'i skabs su maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad/ thod pa chang gis gang ba/ sin+dhu ra'i dkyil 'khor/ chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab bzhi/ sa bon dang bcas pa bris pa rnams brtsegs/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma btang gnas yo byin rlabs bya/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gtor 'bul yan chad song nas/ bum pa gnyis bshams la/ gcig tu ku ru kul+le lha lnga dang*/ gcig tu rta mgrin skad cig gis bskyed la/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ mchod bstod bya zhing*/ bum nang gi lha 'od du zhu nas bdud rtsir gyur/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bcad/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rgyun bshags rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ mig dar bcings me tog gtad/ las bum gyi chu dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hūṃ phaṭa kyis bgegs bskrad/ 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi lce la bzhagade nas yol ba bsal/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig/rje btsun rig byed ma bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi sa bon lnga dang bcas pa bsgom du bcug la/ rig byed ma dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te bstim/ oṃ ku ru kul+le hriḥhriḥhriḥ.a be sha ya hri hri hri/ zhes drag tu bzlas me tog phul/ badz+ra tsak+ṣu tsak+ṣu badz+ra/ zhes mig dar phye/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob ma rig byed ma dam tshig sems dpa' gtso rkyang la snying ga'i lha lnga dang*/

spyi bo'i rta mgrin yongs su rdzogs pa skad cig gis bskyed/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ zhes brjod cing dbang bskur/ dbu rgyan spyi bor gtugs/ sngags de nyid brjod/ phyag mtshan bzhi po gtad la/ thabs shes mda' dang gzhu sbyar bkang byas la/ /mi shes nad sel ma rig dbug par bya/ / ut+pal mdzes pa lha mo'i phyag mtshan nyid/ /de ring bu khyod la ni sbyin par bya/ / mi shes 'dam nas 'dren mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba'i phyag mtshan lcags kyu bzung zhes dang*/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che/ /pad+ma rdo rje rgya gram rnams/ /mkha' 'gro rnams kyi phyag mdzad de/ /de ring khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ mkha' 'gro rtag tu byin rlob 'gyur/ /oṃ ḍā ki nī sarba a bhi ṣiñca mi sarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya hūṃ/ de nas bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ snying po'i mthar rdo rje'i ming btags la ming dbang bskur te/ bum dbang ngo*/ /maṇ+ḍal dbus kyi ka pā la'i bdud rtsi sbyin te gsang dbang*/ gnas gsum du sin+dhu ra'i thig le byas te lha rnams bstim pa sher dbang ngo*/ /stong pa nyid la mnyam par 'jog tu bcug dbang bzhi pa'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di la 'khor mkha' 'gro bzhi pa bskyed pa ni/ phag mo lha lnga'i 'dres yin no/ /zhes mkhyen ldan dam pa rnams bzhed kyang*/ yig rnying phal cher na yod pa dang*/ deng sang lag len byed pa'i grags pa dbang btsan par byos nas 'dir bkod pa yin no/ /dā na shī las ḍoṃ bi ba'i/ /man ngag kuna~X dga~X' rgyal mtshan dpal/ /sa skya paṇa chen la gnang ba'i/ snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam bkod pa yin/ /ku ru kul+le gsang sgrub tu grags pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ye shes lha mo sgrol ma dang*/ /las kyi lha mo la btud nas/ /shin tu zab par grags pa yi/

/dbang gi las la nyer mkho bshad/ /dpal mo snying gi gser thig can du grags pa'i sgrub pa las sbyor gyi rim pa yig rnying las shes par bya ba dang*/ 'dir bsnyen pa tsam dang rjes gnang gi tshe nye bar mkho ba'i dbang du byas te cung zad brjod na/ tsan dan dmar pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su chos 'byung gru gsum rtse mo rang la bstan pa/ dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu bya/ logs gcig tu bum pa yang bshams/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang*/ gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ tāṃ las ut+pal tāṃ gis mtshan pa'i 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ut+pal/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs pa/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ thugs kar pad zla'i steng du tāṃ la sngags 'phreng gis bskor ba bsgoms la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /mdun bskyes bsangs sbyangs/ pad zla'i steng du hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ lha mo ku ru kul+le dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis mda' gzhu/ 'og ma gnyis lcags kyu dang ut+pal/ g.yon brkyang gi gar stabs can/ de'i thugs ka rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar pad zla la hrīḥye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ku ru kul+le hrīḥswāhā/ bsgrub bya a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes ci 'grub bzla'o/ /bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa'i nang du skad cig gis rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma/ de'i steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma/ shar du gang bzang dkar po/ rin po ches mtshan pa'i bum pa bsnams pa/ lhor tshogs bdag ser po rin po che dang gser gyi ga'u bsnams pa/ nub tu rnam sras dmar po rin po che dang ljon shing*/

byang du dzam+bha la nag po rin po che dang ne'u le/ shar lhor dbang gi sgrol ma ljang khu rin po che dang ut+pal/ lho nub tu ku ru kul+le dmar mo ut+pal dang nor bus mtshan pa'i lcags kyu/ nub byang du nor rgyun ma ser mo rin po che dang 'phreng ba/ dbang ldan du gdugs dkar mo rin po che dang des mtshan pa'i pad+ma bsnams pa'o/ / sgrol ma dang ku ru kul+le'i snying po la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ de nas slob mas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyud bshags bya/ rje btsun rjes chags rnal 'byor ma/ /thugs rje'i bdag nyid 'gro ba skyobs/ /rig byed ma yi byin brlab pa/ /bdag la nye bar stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ sgrol ma'i sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas spros pa'i ku ru kul+le slob ma la bstim pas/ slob ma ku ru kul+le gyur pa la ye shes pa bcug dril bu dang bcas pa'i rol mo'i sgra bya/ ku ru kul+le pra be sha ya hūṃ/ wa shaṃ ku ru ho/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya/ sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ slob ma ku ru kul+le sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ de'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros te/ khams gsum gyi 'gro ba thams cad kyi snying nang nas sems kyi ngo bo a dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa bkug ste/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du/ rol mo dang sngags gong bzhin/ de bzhin du snod kyi 'jig rten gyi bcud dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyang bsdu/ re re bzhin rol mo dang sngags gong bzhin/ mthar lha sku rjes gzhig gi rim pas 'od gsal du bsdu ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/ slob ma dang mdun bskyed kyi rjes ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'gro kuna~X dbang bsdud gdams ngag ces/ /gnyan lo'i gdams ngag dga~X' bar grags/ /gong bsnyen tsam dang rjes gnang gi

/snyinga~X po~X'i yi ger ngo mtshar smad/ /dmar chung skor gsum du grags pa las/ dpal mo snying gi gser thig gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje phag mo la btud nas/ /de yi bka' nyan pho nya mo/ /nor rgyun dmar mor grags pa yi/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang cung zad bshad/ /'di'i bsnyen pa dang las sbyor ni/ yig rnying ji lta ba bzhin yin la/ 'di'i rjes gnang dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa zhig la ra khrag gis chos 'byung gru gsum du bris/ nang chag chag btab/ dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu gcig dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi tha mar me tog dmar po'i tshom bu nyi shu rtsa gcig dgod/ mdun du gtor ma shas brgyan pa dang*/ gtor mar bse gram gyi khrag gis sbran pa dang gzhan yang mchod pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ phag mo gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi tshom bu skad cig gis lha mo nor rgyun ma dmar mo nyi ma la brkyang bskum kyis bzhugs pa/ g.yas rin po che'i snye ma dang g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'dzum khro sgrub pa po la dgyes pas lta ba/ lang tsho la bab cing rin po che dang rus pas brgyan pa'o/ /

mtha' skor gyi tshom bu re nas me tog re blangs la dbus ma la 'bul zhing sngags re brjod/ tshul des nyer gcig song ba na snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma bstab/ dmar gyi ar+ghaṃ nas gtor zhing sngags kyi mthar ar+ghaṃ na maḥ zhes brjod/ mchod pa gzhan rnams yid kyis phul/ sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla ba nyid bstod pa yin no/ /sngags ni/ a ya bhi bhi/ bhu ṭi bhuṭ+ṭa/ ka ma rak+kaṃ ma/ sā ma pā ti/ sarba wi si ti/ ku ru ṇi re/ ga ru/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas lung blang ba ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal zhig phul la/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ mdun bskyed kyi lha mo gsal btab la/ slob dpon gyis sngags brjod/ slob mas me tog lan nyi shu rtsa gcig 'bul/ slob ma lha mor bskyed/ sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ mdun bskyed kyi me tog gi tshom bu kha gsos la/ gong bzhin me tog dang ar+ghaṃ phul/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wā naṃ/ zhes rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ dbang sdud kuna~X las myur ro zhes/ /dga~X' bar bsngags mod snyinga~X po~X'i don/ /sgom pa rnams la mi dgos kyang*/ /blo dman rjes su bzung phyir yin/ / nor rgyun ma dmar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ shes rab mar bcas he ru kar/ /btud nas de yi pho nya mo/ /dus mtshan dmar mo'i rnam 'phrul ni/ /lha mo ti nu'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /bde mchog yab yum gang rung gi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba zhig gis/ mdun du sin+dhu ra'i maṇ+ḍal la lte bar bsgom rgyu'i sngags 'khor lta bu zhig bri/ me tog dmar po dang chang dang mchod pa sna lnga bsham/ sems bskyed tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang skad cig gis lha mo ti nu sku mdog dmar mo g.yas gri gug 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/

zhabs g.yon brkyang gi skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can pad zla la bzhugs pa/ khro zhing sgeg pa/ rus pa'i rgyan can no/ /lte bar zla ba la dbus su hrīḥ shar du sa/ lho ru hi/ nub tu ka byang du la/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal gyi gnas su yang sngags kyi 'khor lo yig 'bru rnams lha'i rang bzhin du grub par gyur/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas sngags 'bru bkug la bstim pa yid kyis bya/ mdun gyi yi ge lnga char la mtheb srin gyis chang dang me tog blangs la gtor/ lte ba'i hrīṃḥlas sngags 'phreng thol thol 'ong bar bsams la/ sa hi ka la hriḥ zhes bzla'o/ /de ltar sngags 'bum phrag nyi shus 'di'i bsnyen pa rdzogs pa yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad pa'i steng du mañji la thod pa chang gis bkang ba/ de'i steng du sin+dhu'i ra'i sngags 'khor/ de'i steng du bris sku zhig bkod/ mdun bskyed mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las bdag bskyed bzhin lha mor bskyed/ gong bzhin me tog dang chang gis mchod/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gi drin sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ / slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /bdag la lha mo ti nu yi/ /rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/ /lan gsum/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ slob ma lha mor bskyed/ slob dpon gyi srin lag g.yon pas mdun gyi bdud rtsi nas blangs/ slob ma'i dpral bar thig le lan gsum bya/ sngags brjod cing nang mchod lan gsum sbyin/ mdun gyi lha mo'i bha ga las rak+ta byung ste 'thungs pas lus gang bar mos su 'jugalha mo las lha mo byung*/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ sngags kyi mthar oṃ mang du brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi yig 'bru las srin lag g.yon pas sin+dhu ra blangs te/ slob ma'i mgrin par thig le bya/ lha mo'i lte ba'i yi ge rnams lha mo'i mgrin par thim par bsam/ sngags kyi mthar a mang du brjod/

dril bu dkrol/ 'gro kun chags pas 'od du zhu/ slob ma'i snying gar dkrol bas de thams cad slob ma la thim/ lha mo'i thugs ka nas lha mo byung ste snying gar thim/ sngags kyi mthar hūṃ mang du bzla zhing*/ dril bu de slob mas 'khrol du gzhug rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang 'dra ba las/ sngags 'khor lte bar byed pa dang*/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed gnyis ka'i zhal nas byung ba/ slob ma'i khar nyis sbrag gi tshul gyis byung bar sgom pa ni khyad par ro/ /rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X du gab pa'i man ngag ni/ /gsal bar bstan na dga~X' spro skye/ /snyinga~X nas las tshogs sgrub na ko /gsong po~Xr smra la 'dun pa skye/ /lha mo ti nu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje phag mo'i bdag nyid can/ /zil gnon mthu stobs dpag tu med/ /thod pa rgyan zhes bya ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gtso la 'dud/ /'di'i sgrub thabs ni/ thog mar stong nyid bsgom/ de nas snying rje bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gar oṃ las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las sngags kyi sgra dang bcas pa lha mo'i skur gyur ba ni/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sku mdog dmar mo/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum seng ge'i gdong can ral pa 'phyar ba/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po gri gugaganyis pa ral gri 'phyar ba/ g.yon gyi dang po thod khrag zhal du gsol ba/ gnyis pa kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du/ mkha' 'gro sde lngas btegs pa'i rin po che'i gdan mi ro bsnol ba dang bcas pa'i steng du g.yon brkyang ba'i phyed krung can/ snying gi nang du sngags kyi yi ge g.yas su 'khor ba/ de las 'od 'phros/ 'dod khams dmar/ gzugs khams dkar/ gzugs med khams nag gi sems can rnams kyi srog rtsa zhal du bcugasnying khrag zhal du gsol bas/

sgrib pa dag cing skye 'chi rtsad nas bcad par gyur/ oṃ du kha ye na ma/ zhes zla ba phyed du bzla'o/ /de nas de la oṃ ha ra ṇi sa āḥri ni sa ha hūṃ ni ha sa ri/ zhes pa btags la zhag bdun bzlas pas mi dang mi ma yin dbang du 'du/ bdud tshogs zin gyis gnon/ mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin du 'du ba yin no/ /thod pa mtshan ldan du dkar gtor chang gis brgyan pa kha rang la bstan pa zhig bsham/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po la khā hi btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ phud me la bsreg cing lhag ma za'o/ /dpung pa gnyis su seng ge ral pa dkrug pa/ mkhal logs gnyis su stag mo mi ro za ba/ brla sgang gnyis su sbrul nag kha nas me 'bar ba bsgoms nas/ las la sbyor ba yin no/ /'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang ni tshogs 'khor bzang ba bsham/ nyon mongs dug gsum dbang du bsdu/ /rig pa nam mkha'i dbyings dang bsre/ /lha sku je che je bstim bya/ /'dzab bzlas bya zhing gtor dbang bskur/ /dam rdzas tshogs la rol bar bya/ /zhes pa ltar te/ bla ma'i man ngag las shes par bya'o/ /pad+ma'i man ngag gnyan ston gyis/ /legs grub kuna~X du zhal gzigs pa'i/ /zil gnon sgrub thabs rab dga~X' ba/ snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam bris pa yin/ /rje btsun ma thod pa rgyan gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje las/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes sprul/ /'phrin las myur sgrub dbang gis las/ /mchog stsol ma la gus pas 'dud/ /yig drug gi bsnyen pa sngon du song ba zhig gis skyabs sems tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun pa'i rjes su/ rang gi snying gar hrīḥdamar po/ de'i 'od kyis lus khar/ 'od du zhu ba las rang nyid gsang ba ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs kyis pad+ma la bzhugs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/

g.yas dang po gri guga'og ma ral gri/ g.yon dang po thod khraga'og ma rtse gsum gyis mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa/ gcer bu skra grol mgo 'phreng dang rus rgyan can/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis gdan gyi phyogs bzhi nas 'degs pa/ lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud pa/ thugs kar spyan ras gzigs dmar po mu tig gi 'phreng ba dang pad+ma 'dzin pa zla gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar sa bon dang sngags 'phreng gsal btab la/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ oṃ dhu ma gha yai na ma swāhā/ oṃ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hri ya/ zhes ci 'grub bzla/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi mdun du skad cig gis mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes 'khor dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ sngags kyi mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa btags pa lan lngas bdag mdun gyi lha gnyis char la phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che/ /mi rtog nam mkha'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rjai chen po'i sku sprul pa/ /lha 'dre mi gsum dbang du sdud/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes ni/ /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ mdun bskyed rang gi snying gar thim/ rang nyid mi dmigs par byas la/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di la dbang rjes gnang sogs mi dgos/ sgom lung phog pa nyid kyis chog go /kuna~X nas zab pa pad+ma'i gsung*/ /'di la brten nas las tshogs rnams/ /dga~X' bas bsgrubs nas myur 'grub ste/ /snyinga~X po~X'i sgrub thabs 'di tsam yin/ /'di ni bsnyen pa tsam ste/ me mchod la sogs pa las tshogs mang du yod do/ /mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ dbang sdud kyi lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu bzhi pa'o/

/dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ma lus rgyal ba'i thugs rdo rje/ /bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i skur bstan nas/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs 'joms las bzhi sgrub/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms la 'dud do/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying gar pad nyi la hūṃ ljang sngon de las 'od 'phros/ lus gang*/ sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sna bug nas phyir 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpas bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mcha ི sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ swa bhā wa sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od 'phros/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla bre/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ hūṃ ljang sngon las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūṃ ljang sngon gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhal khro ma 'dzum gyi rnam pa can/ mche ba'i myu gu cung zad gtsigs pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing dbu skra ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gzi brjid mtha' yas pa mnga' zhing*/ ma lus pa'i sprul pa 'chang ba'o/

/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra aṅku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūṃ/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha a/ slar yang snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra zhes sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lha ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ 'di skad bdag gis nas smras so 'i bar gleng gzhi tshar gcig bton/ gzungs kyi bzlas pa ci rigs par byed pa las/ gzungs yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ nye snying kho na bzla ba gnyis 'dam ka las gzhan med par grags na'ang*/ rtsa sngags dang snying po nye snying gsum ji ltar rigs par bzlas pas chog go /'jug tu phan yon tshar gcig bton pa la/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ gong bzhin mchod/ gang thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las/ /rdo rje'i rwa gur me dpung 'bar ba'i mthus/ /bdud bzhi'i stobs rnams rnam par 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum bkod/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/
