rjes gnang gi bya ba dngos ni/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang bum chog dang sbrel bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu dang bcas pa'i steng du bum pa bsham pa'am/ ma 'grub na bum gdan ci bde ba la bum pa kha rgyan dung chos chur bcas/ gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa bkod/ spro na de nyid la dgos mchod kyang bsham/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed song ba'i mtshams sam/ mdun bskyed dang bum bskyed lhan cig tu byas kyang chog ste/ gang ltar yang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i gang la paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang ldan pa/ dpag bsam kyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan zhes pa nas/ dbu rgyan gyi bar bdag bskyed nyid 'don pa spos pa rung ba las/ khyad par ni/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs pa'i rjes su/

ma lus sems can nas yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi da ra ṇa sa pa ri wā ra e h+ya hi/ zhes brjod/ de nas mchod bstod byas la/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste dmigs pa dang bcas pas gzungs mdo 'don cing bzlas pa byed tshul bdag bskyed kyis rigs 'gre/ mthar bum pa'i lha la mchod bstod dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol bya/ badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dung chos kyi chu blugamachod yon phul bas dam tshig pa 'od du zhu ste bum pa'i chur gyur zhes brjod/ de nas 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor 'bul dang*/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma cha gsum bzhin du btang*/ slob ma'i bya ba'i skabs/ rjes gnang dngos gzhi song mtshams su/ bkru byabs bsrung gsum bya ste/ 'di skad bdag gis nas/ nye snying yan chad rdzogs par bton mtshams nye snying gi mthar/ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṅku ru swāhā/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ sarba bigh+nān/ sarba ro ṣa/ sarba duṣ+taṃ/ sarba dz+wa re/ sarba u pa dra be/ sarba a ka la mṛ tu/ sarba dur sob ni/ sarba dur mi ti/ sarba tsit+ta ku le bh+yaḥ shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes bum pa'i chus slob ma la khrus bya zhing*/ mthar kha bshal lo/ /de bzhin du rma bya'i mdongs sogs kyis byabs te/ shān+tiṃ ku ru swāhā'i dod du a pa na ye swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de nas bsrung ba bya ste/ re re'i mthar rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes brjod cing*/ spyi bo snying ga sog phrag dpung pa g.yas g.yon/ dpyi g.yas g.yon rnams la rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ mthar rgyal ba sras bcas bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i mthu stobs kyis/ /'gro ba 'di la bdag gis bsrungs zin gyi/ /'di la sus kyang gnod par ma byed cig/ ces brjod la me tog dor zhing*/ rol mo dang bcas pa'i bkra shis bya'o/ /de nas gtso bos ji ltar sogs dam tshig khas blangs/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/

deng nas sogs yon dbul/ dge ba bsngo/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa kha gsos nas byin gyis brlabs te/ mchod bstod/ gsol btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'di'i bzlas lung gi skabs long skabs med cing mi spro ba dang*/ rgyun gyi nyams len bdag bskyed skabs dang rgyas pa mi lcogs na/ na ma sh+tsaṇ+ḍa badz+ra kro dhā ya/ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nye snying gcig pu bzlas pas chog cing*/ bkru byabs bsrung gsum dang bral ba'i rjes gnang kho na yang skabs su bab pa dag la sbyin pa dang*/ bsdu na sngon 'gro tshogs zhing tshogs bsag rnams kyang bor bas rung ngo*/ /rnam 'joms mthing kar grags pa'i lugs kyang cho ga'i bya ba 'di kho na la/ bcom ldan 'das sku mdog mthing nag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ skra ser gyen du brdzais pa/ g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs can/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyi rgyan can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /phyogs bcur skad cig tsam gyis sprul pa'i khro bo bcu rang dang mtshungs pa'i rnam pa can no/ / zhes bskyed pa ni khyad par ro/ /'di la gtor ma'i cho ga rnal 'byor rgyud ltar byed pa'i lugs kyang yod/ rnam pa gcig tu na 'jig rten 'das gtor med kyang chog pas ci bde bar bya'o/ /mkhas rmongs kuna~X la cher grags shing*/ /sngags rgyud ngo mtshar dga~X' ba'i tog/gzungs sngags snyinga~X po~X'i byin rlabs can/ /sgrub thabs mdor bsdus e ma ho/ /rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa ljang sngon gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i dngos/ /gsang ba'i bdag po thugs las sprul/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /de la gnas yid du 'ong bar ras bris dgram/

dbus dang phyogs bzhir maṇ+ḍal bya/ dbus kyi maṇ+ḍal du bum pa spyi dang mthun par bca'/ mchod pa dang gtor ma cha bzhi dang*/ bkra shis kyi rdzas kyang tshogs tshad bsham/ mchod pa yang rgya cher bsham/ shar gyi maṇ+ḍal du mañji la rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gzugs bzhagasangs rgyas kyi ras bris kyang dgram/ phyogs gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal la gzungs mdo'i glegs bam re bzhag cing*/ maṇ+ḍal bzhi po la yang mchod pa tshar re bsham/ dung chos su snying po'i sngags kyis bsangs chu bsgrubs/ gnas dang yo byad la bgegs sbyang ba lag len spyi dang mthun par byas la/ bsangs chus gtor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor mos/ gnas yo byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byas la/ shar gyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa rdo rje rnam 'joms kyi tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drangs par mos la/ ma lus sems can ma brjod/ mchod yon phal cher sogs sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod pa 'bul/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams spyi dang mthun par brjod/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje rtse dgu pa thugs kar gtod pa/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ mche ba cung zad brtsigs shing*/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ /thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje rtse dgu pa'i lte bar zla ba'i steng du hūṃ/ de'i mtha' skor du sngags kyis yongs su bskor bar mos/ ye shes pa bstim pa spyi dang 'dra/ bdag bskyed la dbang bskur mi mdzad/ rtsa sngags snying po nye snying gsum gang nus su bzla/ mdun bskyed bum pa bsangs sbyangs/

bum par bskyed la/ de'i nang du dam tshig pa bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ dbang bskur te mi bskyod pas rgyas 'debs/ dbus kyi mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rnam 'joms spyi dang mthun pa'i bstod pas bstod/ gzhan sgrub pa po dam tshig ldan pa gsum gyis phyogs gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi steng gi gzungs mdo klog cing*/ slob dpon gyis gzungs thag nas bzung la/ 'di skad bdag gis thos pa nas/ smras so/ / zhes pa'i bar lan gcig brjod/ sngags gsum po gang nus bzlas la/ mthar phan yon tshar gcig brjod/ phyogs gsum gyi klog mkhan rnams kyis mdo yongs rdzogs skyar gyin 'don pa yin pa la/ nyer gcig 'don na re res bdun bdun bya/ yang na brgyad brgyad dam so drug so drug 'don/ de dag gi mthar re res mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bum pa'i lha la dmigs nas mchod bstod byed/ bum pa'i lha la 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob ma rjes bzung bya bar 'dod na skabs 'dir bya ste/ maṇ+ḍal phul la/ yan lag bdun pa gang 'os zhig bya/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol sogs kyi gsol ba btab/ bgegs sbyangs ba dang*/ sdig pa sbyang ba byas pa'i rjes su bkru byabs bsrung gsum sogs byed lugs rnam 'joms ljang sngon dang 'dra ba las/ dmigs pa'i khyad par bum nang gi lha las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bkru ba sogs byed cing*/ he phu phu zhes pa'i skabs su khro bo phur bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ bar chad dang bgegs thams cad phur bus btab par bsam/ de dag gi mthar lha sku bsgom pa'i rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra ba las/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i mthar/ slar yang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ de dag gi mthar bzlas lung sbyin/ de la slob mas gang la lung len pa'i mdun bskyed de/ shar gyi rdo rje sems dpa'i sku gzugs las byed pa 'di'i khyad chos yin/

rjes gnang gi rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ slar mchod pa rnams kha gsos te rjes chog byed tshul spyi dang 'dra ba las/ bum pa'i lha ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ shar gyi sku gzugs la rab gnas byed/ de nas las rjes mi mngon par byas te/ smon lam dang bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /kuna~X nas gru dang dmar gyi lugs/ /lag len ngo mtshar dga~X' ba'i phul/ /shin tu mang ba'i yig tshogs las/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bkod pa lags/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru we/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin bcas la/ /gus pas yongs su btud nas de'i/ /gsung dang gong ma'i man ngag bzhin/ /kun la nyer mkho'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /gang zhig bgegs 'joms par 'dod pa dang*/ bsnyen pa thams cad kyi sngon du nye bar mkho ba'i phyir/ dpal sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag ltar/ bgegs mthar byed kyi man ngag bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs sems spyi dang mthun/ rang gi snying gar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ/ de'i 'od kyis bla ma dang bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang zhig thog med srid pa'i chu klung du/ / zhes sogs rgyun bshags bya/ gal te de tsam mi lcog na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs bya/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu'am/ nag po zhal gsum phyag drugartsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs shing*/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rang snang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis rdo rje nag po kha gyes pa dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis kyis rin po che dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas bdud sdig can chung ma dang bcas pa dang*/

g.yon brkyang bas tshogs bdag mnan pa/ spyan gsum/ skra ser stag lpags kyi sham thabs sogs khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing*/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ 'jog po dmar pos rna rgyan byas pa/ rigs ldan khra bos dpung pa brgyan zhing*/ dung skyong ser pos phyag gdub byas pa/ pad+ma dkar pos mgul ba brgyan zhing*/ stobs rgyu ljang khus mchod phyir thogs byas pa/ nor rgyas kyi bu bdud rtsi'i kha dog lta bus ske rags byas shing*/ pad+ma chen po dkar pos zhabs gdub byas pa/ sku las skyes pa'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing gsal bar bskyed do/ / mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dz+riṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ dpral bar skaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ rang gi snying gar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ/ dbang gi lha 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ bzlas pa ni/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer 'phro 'du la sems gtad de/ oṃ āḥbigh+nān+ta kṛta hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa nye snying dang*/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa snying po dang*/ oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ gardza gardza/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ bi s+pho ṭa ya/ sarba bigh+nan bi na ya ka na mahā ga na pa ti dzi wi tān+ta kā ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags chung ba'o/ / na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ri ṇaṃ/ na mo mahā badz+ra kro dhā ya/

mahā daṃṣ+to ta ka ṭa bhai ra wā ya/ a si mu sa la pa ra shu pa sha hastā ya/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha/ man chad brjod ma thag pa ste/ rtsa sngags che ba'o/ /'di rnams re res bsnyen pa rdzogs par byed na/ grangs ni rim pas 'bum phrag so gnyis/ bcu drugabargyad/ bzhi rnams yin la/ thams cad sdoms pas byed na/ 'bum phrag brgyad/ bzhi/ gnyis/ gcig rnams so/ /thun mtshams su dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ / gtor ma nye snying gis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bdud rtsi lnga'i phung po/ hūṃ bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de rnams 'od du zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ 'bru gsum lan lngas byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i lha tshogs badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ snying po'i mthar pañca a mṛ ta āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'jigs pa'i hūṃ sgra nges sgrog cing*/ / sogs kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ khyed kyis sems can sogs/ smon lam dang bkra shis gang 'grub bya/ bsnyen pa mthar phyin nas sgom pa dang*/ bris pa'i srung ba dang*/ las bzhi'i sbyin bsregaser ba srung ba/ sri'u gso ba sogs gong ma rnams kyis man ngag las 'byung ba'i las tshogs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang gsang 'dus sgyu dra rdo rje gur rnams las 'byung ba'i las tshogs rnams dang*/ gzhan yang rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa'i bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i las thams cad sgrub pa la dbang ngo*/ /'di nyid ngo bo gsang ba'i bdag po yin pa'i phyir/ gsang bdag gi sngags rgyud las 'byung ba'i las tshogs mtha' dag kyang sgrub pa la dbang bar mngon no/ khyad par 'di'i bsnyen pa sngon du song bas/

lha gzhan ci lta bu bsgrubs kyang de dang de'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum la bar du gcod pa mi 'byung zhing*/ rang gzhan gyi bgegs bsrung ba'i thabs 'gran zla med pa'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang lag len spyi dang 'dra'o/ khro bo'i lus can kuna~X gyi rgyal/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rig 'dzin mchog/dga~X' skyed shin tu rnyed dka' ba/ /snyinga~X po~Xs yi ge lam du byas/ /zhes pa ni khro bo bgegs mthar byed kyi sgrub pa'i thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅgalaṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ cha med kun 'gro chos kyi dbyings/ /bde stong zung 'jug lhan skyes sku/ /dus kyi 'khor lo la btud nas/ /nad kun zhi byed sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du song nas/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags don bsam/ rang gi snying gar paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du phraiṃ dkar po'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma sna tshogs yum zla ba nor bu'i 'od ltar sku mdog dkar ba zhi zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i rtsa ba mtheb srin gyis thugs kar 'dzin pa/ 'dab brgya snyan drung du rgyas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ dar gyi na bza' dkar pos spras pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ zla 'od 'phro ba/ rdo rje sems dpa'i dbu rgyan can no/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūṃ baṃ ho hi/ gnyis su med par gyur/

mdor bsdu na/ rdo rje bzhi byin gyis rlabs pa dang*/ ye shes bstim pa med kyang chog go / snying gar zla ba la phraiṃ gyi mthar sngags kyis 'phreng bas bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad sna tshogs yum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas snying ga'i sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa la thim/ rang gzhan gyi nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing*/ tshe dang bsod nams thams cad rgyas par gyur/ oṃ phraiṃ bi shwa mā taḥ badz+ra kaṇ+ḍa kaṃ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ ma ma sān+tiṃ ku ru ku ru swāhā/ ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ phraiṃ bi shwa mā tā badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūṃ/ shap+ta 'i bar spyi dang mthun par mchod pa'am/ yang na mchod pa bcu gnyis bya/ phra rab rdul gyi chos nyid 'das/ / zhes sogs sam/ sangs rgyas kun gyis bskyed mdzad ma/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa spangs/ /kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa can/ /sna tshogs yum de la phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad tshom bu can zhig byas la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ gtor ma 'bul ba gcig du dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ phyis kyi lag len ltar byed na/ dus 'khor nyid kyi gtor chog ltar byin gyis brlabs pa'am/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hraḥphaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ snying po mthar/ a kā ro btags te 'bul bar bya'o/ /rjes gnang gi ngo bo yang*/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa rnams yin pas spyi dang 'dra la/ sngon 'gro rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyis gsol btab dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ rdo rje shugs kyi rjes gnang gi skabs dang mthun par byas na legs pa yin te/ dus 'khor lhan skyes dang*/ dzaṃ bha la ljang khu dang*/ dus 'khor rgyud lugs kyi khyung khra rnams la'ang de bzhin du go dgos so/

/shin tu zab par rab grags pa/ /rgyud 'grel nyid las gsal ba'i phyir/ /mkhas pa kuna~X gyi yid dga~X'i gnas/ /snyinga~X po~X mdor bsdus tsam zhig bris/ /sna tshogs yum dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma yi dam phyag 'os la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag btsal nas/ /so sor 'brang ma sgrub pa'i thabs/ /rdo rje'i gur las 'byung bzhin bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du song nas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong bar sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du rang sems traṃ yig dkar po las/ rang nyid so sor 'brang ma sku mdog dkar mo/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon 'khor lo dkar po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis zlum po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ sgegs cing 'dzum pa dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhī ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ spros bsdu'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ ma ṇi dha ri badz+ri ṇi mahā pra ti sā re hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas shing*/ mthar mkha' nang nas/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sku dpag tu med pa sprul/ sems can gyi don byas par bsams la/ nyer gcig bzla/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su mchod gtor bla med spyi dang mthun pa'i byin rlabs mdor bsdus zhig bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ bcom ldan 'das ma so sor 'brang ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin can/

/chos dbyings ye shes ngo bo nyid/ /dung dang kun+da zla ba'i 'od/ /so sor 'brang ma la phyag 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang mthun par bya/ 'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba yang*/ rjes gnang spyi'i cho ga las zur khyad med cing*/ thugs kyi rjes gnang la phyag mtshan bstim pa kho na yin no/ /nad pa la sogs pa 'ga' zhig gi don du bum pa bca' zhing*/ sbyang ba dang bcas pa'i bkru byab srung gsum bya ba yin la/ rjes gnang gi cho ga'i yan lag tu sbyar nas thob dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /kuna~X las 'khyer bde bla med lugs/ /'dus gsal mchog tu dga~X' ba 'di/ /man ngag snyinga~X po~X tsam blangs nas/ /rgyud don ji bzhin brjod pa yin/ /rdo rje gur las 'byung ba so sor 'brang ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gtsug tor las/ /rab sprul phyir bzlog chen mo'i sku/ /gzhan gyis mi thub la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swā bha wa sa stong par sbyangs/ pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūṃ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las bsrung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che bar gyur ba'i dbus su/ bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad 'og tu mnan pa'i pad nyi'i gdan la rang sems gdugs dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas gdugs dkar can gyi sngags kyi yig 'bru dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags ma gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog dkar mo/ dbu'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang bcas pa/ dbus dkar g.yas sngo g.yon dmar ba'i zhal gsum la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas gsum na rdo rje mda' lcags kyu/

g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub zhags pa gzhu/ lhag ma nyams sna tshogs can gyi dbu stong mnga' ba/ phyag rgya ma nges pa sna tshogs pas rdo rje 'khor lo nor bu pad+ma ral gri mda' lcags kyu gzhu tho ba zhags pa la sogs pa mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'i phyag stong dang*/ sku lus kyi cha thams cad du khyab pa/ rnam 'gyur ma nges pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong can/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /pho nya dang pho nya mo dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer 'phro ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyis dbang bskur ba/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi rim gro byed pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad kyis mchod cing bstod la bka' sgrub pa'i sku can du gyur/ 'bring du na rtsa ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug tsam du gsal btab kyang rung*/ shin tu bsdu na skyabs sbyin dang gdugs dkar po can bsgom/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' dang dbang gi lha rnams spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam ye gnyis su med par thim/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsal ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai ra/ bai ra/ so me/ so me/ sarba bud+dha a dhiṣ+ṭha na a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇi ṣa si ta ta pa tre hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ ma ma hūṃ ni swāhā/ zhes snying po nyid gang 'grub bzla'o/ /mthar ye shes pa mdun du bzhugs pa la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ phyir bzlog chen mo rigs sngags rgyal/ /gzhan gyis mi thub stobs chen ma/ /gdugs dkar chen mo sangs rgyas dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bcas bstod/ / ces bstod bzod pa gsol zhing badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di la 'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor ma ni mi dgos so/

/byed par spro na/ dkar gtor a kā ro sa 'bul/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtsang ma'i zas sna sna tshogs btab pa'i dkar gtor zhig dang*/ sha chang sgog tsong sogs sna tshogs kyi sbags pa'i dmar gtor zhig bshams/ sngags drugaphyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro lan bdun bdun gyis gtsang rigs rnams dang*/ 'byung po rnams la sbyin/ de nas cha gsum gtor ma'ang gtong ngo*/ /thun mtshams su bris sku'i mdun du gzungs mdo ci nus su 'don pa'am klog go /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i rjes gnang gi cho ga nyid sbyar bar bya'o/ /rigs sngags kuna~X las phyir bzlog pa/ /phun tshogs kun gyi dga~X' bskyed 'di/ /gdugs dkar sgrub thabs rgya mtsho yi/ /snyinga~X po~Xr mkhas rnams nges shes bskyed/ /gtsug tor gdugs dkar gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rnam 'phrul du ma mtha' yas pas/ /'gro ba'i nad gdon zhi mdzad pa/ /ri khrod ma la rab btud nas/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ / rang gi snying gar pad zla la paṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyi dbu brgyan pa'i lha mo ri khrod ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na maḥpar+ṇa sha wa rī bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pā ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes phyag 'tshal/ oṃ par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ nas shap+ta āḥhūṃ gi bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyi tshad med bzhi bsgom/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i ri bo me tog dang 'bras bus brgyan pa'i nags tshal sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i rtse mor paṃ las pad+ma dang*/

a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems paṃ ser po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdug bsngal bsal/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod ma lo ma can sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal ser ba khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ g.yas zhal dkar zhing zhi ba/ g.yon zhal dmar zhing chags pa/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje gsor ba/ gnyis pas dgra sta/ gsum pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang po rdo rje'i zhags pa dkris pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas me tog dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing lo gsar ba'i sbrang yab/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas kyi rting pa gsang bar bstad cing*/ de nyid kyi pus mo dang g.yon gyi mthil gdan la brten pas phyed bzhengs kyi stabs kyi 'gying bag can/ dar dmar po'i stod g.yogs dang shing lo gsar pa bshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ rin po che dang me tog gi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ dbu skra phyed bcings su byas shing*/ lang tsho gsar du bdo ba/ mdzes shing grim la cung zad khro ba'i nyams can/ 'bar ba'i 'od dpung mtha' yas pa dkris pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūṃ sngon po/ snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i paṃ de las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od 'phros dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā nas/ shap+ta āḥhūṃ gis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma spyi bor lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul ba las byung ba/ /lha mo gang gi bsgrub pas nad gdon bgegs/ /kun tu zhi mdzad ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ pi sha tsī par+ṇa sha wa rī hrī haḥhūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ snying po dang*/ oṃ pi sha tsī par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes las sngags ci nus bzla zhing*/ shes shing spro na gzungs kyang bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar bdag bskyed kyi lha la gsol ba btab cing*/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam la/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ rdo rje sems dpa'i yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can nas muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ rang nyid dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal tsam gyis thun mtshams kyi bya ba'o/ /gtor ma dkar gtor a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar oṃ āḥhūṃ las gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan bdun/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros lha mo ri khrod ma 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs oṃ pi sha tsī par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa pā ya gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇa ye swāhā/ lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma nas kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'dod don gsol btab bya/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam rnams kyang gong dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra la/ 'on kyang de'i rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa la/ 'dir sku'i rjes gnang dang*/ dngos gzhi lung gsum la gsung gi rjes gnang dang*/ rjes snying gar lha bstim pa la thugs kyi rjes gnang gi tha snyad mdzad pa ni/

zur bkar grags pa 'di'i khyad par yin zhing*/ bsnyen pa'i thun thun mtshams skabs dang*/ rjes gnang gi rjes chog gi skabs bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gong bzhin gshegs su gsol ba yang lag len gyi khyad par snang ngo*/ /rjes gnang gi rjes chog gi tshe/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa sngon du gshegs nas/ dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis rjes chog byed pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog grub nas bdag bskyed gshegs pa dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod nas/ mchod bstod man chad chabs gcig tu byed pa'i lag len gsung snang ba/ dang po mi bde zhing*/ phyi ma gnyis po gang rung bya'o/ /'di lta bu'i sgrub mchod byed pa'i rigs la/ bdag mdun gyi bar du bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba'i lag len gyis deng sang sa steng khyab mod kyi/ shin tu nor ba yin pas mi bya la/ spyir cho ga'i yan lag gzhan thams cad bla med dang chog sgros thun mong yin pa'i phyir/ bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol ba byed mi dgos mod/ ba ri lo ts+tsha ba tshun chad kyi bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len yin zha

ི nga*/ 'di nyid thugs la bzhag nas bdag bskyed sgrub thabs yod pa ni/ rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ zhes sgrog par mdzad pa yin no/ /'di'i mtshon nas/ 'di rigs kyi sgrub thabs gong 'og thams cad la rigs 'a gra ེ bar bya'o/ /rgyal ba kuna~X gyis byin rlabs pas/ /ri khrod lha mo'i sgrub thabs ni/ /nyung gsal dga' ༵ ba 'dir bshad kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X len 'dod rnams kyis long*/ /ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ na mo gu ru/ bgegs dang bar chad kun 'joms pa'i/ /lha mo de la gus btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs mi 'dra ba'i/ khyad par cung zad bshad par bya/ /ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma ser mo'i sgrub thabs legs par shes par byas la/ lhag ma rigs bzhi po rnams la 'dor len cung zad tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur bas so sor bshad par bya ste/ de'i yang dmar mo phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs la/ sngon 'gro tshogs bsag gi skabs bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa zhes pa'i dod du/ bla ma 'od dpag med kyi rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan zhes 'don pa spo/ bskyed chog gi skabs rang sems paṃ ser po'i dod paṃ dmar po/ zhal phyag gi skabs/ rang nyid ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs tshogs la bsnun zhing*/ g.yon thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gnod byed thams cad la gzir ba/ dmar la zlum po'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ sku thung sbom la dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags dang rin po che dang*/ rus pa dang*/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes dang*/ rigs bdag gi skabs/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ zhes 'don pa spo ba rnams khyad par ro/

/de bzhin du sngon mo la bla ma don yod grub pa'i rnam pa can gyi zhes dang*/ paṃ sngon po las zhes dang*/ rang nyid ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sku mdog nam mkha' ltar sngo sangs zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi dang pos lha'i shing gi yal ga 'bras bu dang bcas pa 'dzin pas nad zhi bar mdzad pa/ gnyis pas dgra sta 'dzin pas gdug pa can la brdeg pa/ g.yon gyi dang po zhags pas bgegs rnams 'ching ba/ gnyis pas rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can 'dzin pas nad sel bar mdzad pa/ sgeg cing khro la rin po che dang rus pa dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ shing lo'i stod g.yogs can/ nyi ma'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ nyi ma'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ zhes pa dang*/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan zhes pa rnams khyad par ro/ /ri khrod drag mo kaṅka la chibs pa'i sgrubs thabs la sngon 'gro tshogs bsag mi dgos/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ pad nyi'i gdan la paṃ nag po las ri khrod ma lo ma gyon ma sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dbu skra gyen brdzais cher khros pa'i nyams can/ stag lpags dang/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas na gcod pa'i dgra sta dang*/ g.yon shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang yab 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis 'dab chags kaṅka'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ / yan lag lhag ma ser mo'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ rnam snang gis dbu rgyan can no/ / sngags ni/ oṃ pi sha tsī par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba ro ga tshe da ni hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa rnams khyad par ro/ /'di nyid sku mdog dkar mo cung zad zhi ba'i nyams can du byed pa'ang yod do/ ljang khu'i sgrub thabs ni/ bshad ma thag pa 'di nyid las sa bon paṃ ljang khu/ rang nyid ri khrod ma sku mdog ljang khu zhi ba'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rma bya'i sgro yab dang*/ g.yon sman sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/

skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas rma bya'i gdan la bzhugs pa'o/ / zhes pa dang*/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan zhes pa dang*/ oṃ pi sha tsī par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra sān+tiṃ ru swāhā/ zhes bzla ba rnams khyad par ro/ /lhag ma sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gi bya ba thams cad ser mo'i skabs ji lta ba bzhin no/ /kuna~X nas mos pa tha dad rnams/ /dga' zhing gus pa'i rnam cha ni/ /sna tshogs 'di yang ngo mtshar rmad/ /'dor len byed tshul snyinga~X po tsam/ /ri khrod ma rigs bzhi'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /bgegs kun 'joms par mdzad pa mo/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo la btud nas/ /de yis sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ / skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rang nyid rig pa'i rgyal mo gza' yum sku mdog dkar mo/ dkar sngo dmar ba'i zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis chos 'chad/ bar pa gnyis rdo rje dang pad+ma/ tha ma gnyis mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ lha rdzas kyi rgyan dang na bza' can no/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs ye shes dgug gzhug dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ rnam snang gi dbu rgyan/ oṃ sarba bid+ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa snying po dang*/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa tī swāhā/ zhes pa nye snying gang nus su bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang gi mtshan tsam bzung bas kyang*/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gdon rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi mdzad pa/ /rig pa'i rgyal mo khyod la bstod/ / ces bstod/ oṃ sarba bid+ya badz+ra muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na/ dkar gtor mchod pa dang bcas pa bsham/

oṃ badz+ra yak+sha hūṃ gis bsangs/ badz+ra dz+wa la 'i sngags rgyas gang bar byas/ a kā ro sa bzhed don 'grub par byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rig pa'i rgyal mo gza' yum la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' gza' dang rgyu skar 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ sarba bid+ya sarba bud+dha bo dhi satwā nāṃ/ sarba gra ha nak+ṣa tra/ sarba bhu ti bh+yaḥ i daṃ bā ling gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ gṛh+ṇa pā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams byas la/ de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir gzungs mdo 'don par bya zhing*/ mthar yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ rnams bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi cho ga ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'gro kuna~X dge legs mdzad pa yi/ /lha mo'i sgrub thabs rab dga~X' ba/ /shin tu rgyas pa'i snyinga~X po~X nyid/ /gzhan la phan phyir bkod pa yin/ /gza' yum rig pa'i rgyal mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshen no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ khro rgyal 'chol ba la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shin tu rnam mang las/ /'di ni ba ri lo ts+tsha'i lugs/ /dud khar grags pa'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ khro rgyal rme brtsegs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ u tsuṣ+ma mahā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha hūṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ khro bo'i rgyal po rme brtsegs ni/ /zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis bgrad/ /dud kha me ri'i dbus na bzhugs/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dkon mchog gsul bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang sems hūṃ yig dud kha las 'od 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid khro bo'i rgyal po rme brtsegs stobs po che'i skur gyur pa ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug rtsa zhal dang sku mdog dud kha/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar ba'i zhal spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing*/ mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa la sbrul sngon po lto ser gyis dkris pa/ sma ra smin ma phyag drug g.yas kyi dang po na rdo rje rgya gram/ gnyis pa na rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ gsum pa na rdo rje lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang po na rdo rje dbyug pa/ gnyis pa na rdo rje zhags pa/ gsum pa rdo rje'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ phyag thams cad brkyang zhing*/ thod skam gyi se ral kha dang*/ yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa'i stabs kyis nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gying ba'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad khro rgyal rme brtsegs kyi rnam par badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pa nas/ khro rgyal 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ gong bzhin mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ yang thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ga ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/

ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rab zhi chos sku'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir rab tu khros pa'i sku/ /rgyal ba kun gyi 'phrin las gcig bsdus pa/ khro rgyal rme ba brtsegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ oṃbhur khuṃ mahā pra na ye bhurtsi bhur khi bi ma na se u tsuṣ+ma mahā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bhur khuṃ ri li shu ba ra sha hur shi bi ma le u tsuṣ+ma mahā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzla'o/ /mngon rtogs bsdus pa sgom par 'dod na/ skyabs sems stong nyid sngon du btang nas/ snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis sdig sgrib dang*/ mi gtsang ba sbyang ba nas/ rang nyid khro bo chen por bskyed/ yan lag lhag ma rnams mi dgos par bzlas pa 'jug pa'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus sam g.yas g.yon ci bde bar bum pa bcas la gtor ma gsum dang mchod pa bsham/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang dang*/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su paṃ las pad+ma nas/ dbu brgyan gyis bar bdag bskyed ltar bsgom/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril nas song*/ bum nang gi lha'i sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs te bum pa gang bar gyur/ bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ mchod bstod rgyas pa'am/ bsdu na bdag bskyed bzhin bya/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsis rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ gtor ma dang po snying po'i mthar/

a kā ro btags pa lan lngas khro bo chen po la 'bul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gnyis pa chos skyong nag po chen po la 'bul/ gsum pa kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis rigs drug la bsngo/ slar yang bum bskyed kyi lha la mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol dang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes mchod yon phul/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chu nus pa kun dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod de/ /slob dpon gyi bya ba'o/ /slob ma la bya ba ni/ phal cher sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i chings dang mthun pa las/ rgyun bshags song ba'i rjes su sku'i rjes gnang gi gsol 'debs 'di skad ces bya ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku yi ngo bo slob dpon gyis/ /bdag la khro rgyal rme brtsegs kyi/ /sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs/ sku'i rjes gnang gi ye shes pa bstim pa song mtshams su mngon rtogs ltar lha dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa 'bogs/ gsung dang thugs kyi rjes gnang gi 'gor yang*/ sku'i zhes par gsung gi zhes pa dang*/ thugs kyi zhes 'don pa spos la gsol ba btab/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar bum pa'i chus bkru ba dang*/ byabs srung bya ste sngags kyi khyad par ma gtogs/ rdo rje rnam 'joms ljang khu'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes kyi bya ba yang spyi dang 'dra'o/ /shin tu zab mor rab grags pa/ /yig rnying man ngag kuna~X mthong nas/ /dga~X' bas snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdebs/ /dgos 'dod sgrub la 'di yis chog/rme brtsegs dud kha'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsang bdag dang ni de'i sprul pa/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal nas/ /stobs chen 'chol ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ /jo bo'i lugs su grags pa bshad/

/skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du song nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis sdig sgrib dang ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad bsregs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid khro rgyal rmai brtsegs sku mdog ljang khu/ ljang sngon dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsnol ba/ bar pa gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ tha ma gnyis lcags kyu dang zhags pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad gnon par mdzad pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal/ mi lpags glang lpags stag lpags la sogs pa dpal gyi chas yongs su rdzogs pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams bya zhing*/ rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /bzlas pa'i snying po ni dud kha'i skabs dang 'dra/ grib sel ba'i sngags/ i ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ bi ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ raṃ ho shud+dhe shud+dhe/ i bi raṃ shud+dhe shud+dhe/ a a a swāhā/ zhes pa'ang btags te bzlas/ thun 'jog khar/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/

dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi 'phrin las kun sgrub pa/ khro bo'i rgyal po stobs po che/ /gdul dka' 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ / ces bstod do/ /lha sku stong pa nyid du sbyangs nas/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /rjes gnang byed tshul ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar bum pa spyi dang mthun par bsham/ gtor ma gsum dang*/ mchod pa yang bsham/ bdag bskyed gong bzhin byas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ mdun bskyed bum pa sangs sbyangs/ bum pa'ang spyi dang mthun par bskyed nas/ bum pa'i nang du mngon rtogs ltar lha bskyed/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod/ gtor ma rnams 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel nas/ gtso bo la snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pas 'bul/ gtor ma gnyis pa phyogs skyong bcu dang*/ gsum pa bgegs la kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis gtong ba'i lag len nam cha gsum gyi cho gas 'bul/ spro na gzhi bdag gtor ma'ang bya/ bum pa la dmigs nas bzlas pa ci 'grub bya zhing*/ mthar bum pa'i lha 'od du zhu/ de nas slob ma khrus bya/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ bgegs gtor btang*/ a mṛ tas bsrungs/ gsol btab ni/ jo bo'i lugs kyi rjes gnang gzhan dang 'dra/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma'i spyi bor hūṃ las khro bo bskyed rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar byas te/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūṃ gi 'od kyis/ slob ma'i lus byin gyis brlabs nas/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gi lus byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ khro bo 'od du zhu nas slob ma khro bo'i skur gyur/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes brjod cing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/

rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab ste sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /gsung gi rjes gnang bzlas lung dang byin gyis brlab pa'i lung spyi dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang slob ma'i snying ga'i sngags 'khor las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum 'od du zhu ba nas snying ga'i hūṃ gi nā da'i bar du bsdus te/ stong pa la mnyam par bzhagaslar yang lha skur ldang ngo*/ / rjes gnang gi rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog kyang spyi dang 'dra/ 'di'i grib sel gyi rim pa ni/ bum pa snga ma bzhin bsgrubs/ mtheb kyu nyer gcigachang bu nyer gcigadamar gtor gcig dang srad bu nag po rnams bshams/ dang por bkru ba dang byab pa gnyis bya/ chang bu re dang mtheb kyu re la/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gsum bzla zhing bskor/ grib sel ba'i sngags kyang re re btags/ bsgrub bya la gu gul gyis bdugadrag sngags bzla zhing yungs kar gyis brabs/ srin mdzub bzhi la srad bu nag po btags/ byabs pa'i tshul gyis grib rnams srad bu la bstim par mos/ de nyid khro bo'i sngags grib sel gyi sngags dang sbrags pas bcad nas gtor ma'i nang du bor/ gtor ma gong gi sngags kyis bgegs rnams la bsngos/ bden pa bdar te/ khrus khu dang gtor ma sogs lam gyi bzhi mdor bskyal/ de nas srung ba dang shis brjod bya'o/ /gzhan yang lam gtor gyis phyogs sel ba/ chu mig mtsho rdzing yul phyogs sogs kyi grib sel ba dang*/ srung skud/ sri'u gso ba/ sbyin bsreg la brten nas las bzhi sgrub pa sogs kyang bsnyen pa sngon song gi rnal 'byor pas ci rigs par sgrub bo/ /'di yi gdams pa ngo mtshar zhes/ /bka' gdams pa kuna~X sgrog cing dga~X'/ /yig rnying rnams kyi snyinga~X po~X tsam/ 'dus la gsal bar bkod pa yin/ khro bo rme brtsegs ljang khu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma mchog dang khro bo'i rgyal/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro mar bcas la/ /btud nas sgrub thabs bzlas lung gi /bya ba cung zad bshad par bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hūṃ mthing nag gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las mkha' 'gro ma rme brtsegs sku mdog sol ba ltar gnag pa/ khro mo'i cha lugs spyan gsum pa/ phyag gnyis kyis dag byed kyi bdud rtsis gang bas bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ skra lhug par grol zhing rgyan spangs pa/ dar nag gi na bza' lhug par 'phyang ba/ pad nyi la mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes dgug gzhugadabang bskur zhing mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ ar khaṃ tsir khaṃ bi ma na se u tsuṣ+ma mahā kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces bzla/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī u tsuṣ+ma kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pas 'bul/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ sgom lung 'bogs pa ste/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa kho na yin/ bum chog ni gzhi dkar po'i steng du/ 'bru dkar gyis g.yung drung ris bris te/ der bum pa spyi dang mthun par bcas la/ dngos gzhi bum pa sgrub tshul/ bkru byabs srung gsum dang bcas pa ni/ rme brtsegs dud kha'i bum chog dang 'dra la/ grib srung ba'i sgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor mkha' 'gro ma skad cig gis bskyed la/ bum chus bkrus par bsams te bzlas brjod byed/ mthar mkha' 'gro ma rang la bstim/ kuna~X tu zab cing ches bla ba/ /don chen 'grub pa yid dga~X'i gnas/ /gzhan 'ga'i snyinga~X la'ang dga' bskyed pa'i/ /'dus po~Xr bris 'di e ma ho/ khro mo rmai brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka dpal khros pa'i sku/

/'jigs pa 'joms pa la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs shin tu rnam mang las/ /shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul lugs bri/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ bh+ruṃ gsum las rtse gsum/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gsum sbrag tu gnas pa'i nang du/ chos 'byung la gnas pa'i rlung me chu sa'i 'og gzhi dang gur khang*/ de'i nang dur khrod chen po'i dbus su 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa lte ba la hūṃ dang baṃ las rdo rje dang tri shu la rnams su gyur pa las/ rang nyid bcom ldan reg tshig sku mdog nag po/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i steng na me'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dang*/ g.yon tri shu la'i rtse mor rlung gi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sku sbom thung khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ dur khrod kyi chas brgyad dang ldan pa/ 'khor lo dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spyi bo brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i dus mtshan ma dang*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed mnan pa/ yum g.yas gri gug dang*/ g.yon tri shu la 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ snying gar hūṃ sngon po/ lte bar a ser po/ bol du taṃ ljang khu/ mig la traṃ dkar po/ rna bar hūṃ ser po/ sna la tri dud kha/ lce la āḥdamar po/ lus la khaṃ ljang khu/ yid la tuṃ mthing kha rnams su gyur/ ye shes pa bstim pa dang*/ dbang bskur spyi dang 'dra ba las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams su spros/ rang dang 'dra ba'i khro bo dang khra gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo mtshams kyi khro bo yab yum zhal sbyor rnams su gyur/ steng dang 'og tu gtso bo yab yum gyi sku re re/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ khro rgyal reg tshig stobs po che/ /mun nag lta bu'i sku 'dzin zhing*/

/phaṭa kyi sgra 'byin me dpung 'bar/ /mgon du gyur la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na/ khro rgyal 'khor bcas sdang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /zhal du ma lus dgra bgegs don snying gsol/ /gtum chen me 'bar las rnams grub par mdzod/ / ces bstod/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab nas/ oṃ bha ya nā sha ni trā sa ni/ sarba mā ra/ pra t+yeṃ gi ra/ bi nā sha ya/ ye ke tsi ta/ duṣ+ṭhaṃ satwa ba da ki ma ma bi rū ba/ kur bhan+ti ta ni/ sarba mā ra/ pra t+yeṃ ga ri ṇe pa ta tu hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /'bum phrag bco lngas bsnyen pa 'grub par bshad/ thun 'jug tu dkyil 'khor 'od gsal du bsdu zhing dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma byin rlabs bla med gang yang rung ba zhig dang mthun par byas nas/ dgra bgegs thams cad bkug ste gtor ma la thim par mos/ khro bo chen po 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bha ya nā sha ni/ trā sa ni/ badz+ra kro dha bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ thum+bā thum+bā khā hi khā hi/ mahā maṃ sa kha khā hi/ mahā rak+ta kha khā hi/ gti mug sha yi mchod pa bzhes/ /zhes sdang rus pa'i mchod pa bzhes/ /'dod chags khrag gi mchod pa bzhes/ /ma ra ya tsit+ta srog thun kha khā hi/ zhes lan bcu gcig gis bstab/ mchod bstod nas/ gshegs gsol gyi bar spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni chos 'byung nag po gru gsum gyi steng du rten gtor bkod/ rjes gnang gi bya ba sgrub thabs brgya rtsas rigs 'gre ba las mthar gtor dbang byed pa nyid yin/ mu stegs ngan sngags kuna~X bzlog ces/ /rdo rje gdan pa'i ba ri la/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i gser chos kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X mdo bsdus 'di bzhin lags/ /spyir 'di la dbang bzhi sogs chos skor shin tu tshogs che bar yod na'ang*/ bsdus pa 'di rjes gnang tsam gyis 'grub pa/ bde mchog khro bo reg tshig gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ he ru ka la btud byas nas/ /mngon brjod rgyud rgyal las gsungs pa/ /man ngag kha bsgyur dang bcas pa'i/ khrag 'thung mkha' lding sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las rgya mtsho'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi lte bar raṃ las nyi ma/ der rang sems hūṃ las rdo rje 'bar ba hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing ga rtsa zhal gnag pa/ g.yas zhal dud kha dang dmar po/ g.yon zhal ljang khu dang dud kha/ steng zhal mkha' lding gi gdong dmar po/ nyi ma bcu gnyis kyi gzi brjid can phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ yum la 'khyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis gri gug dang*/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ g.yas gsum pa mtha' yas dkris pa rdo rje 'bar ba gsor ba/ bzhi pa pad+ma dkris pa'i lcags kyu/ lnga pa ma dros pa dkris pa'i ḍa ma ru/ g.yon gsum pa nor rgyas zhags pa'i tshul du 'dzin pas sdigs mdzub/ bzhi pa 'jog po ba dan du btags pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang thod pa/ lnga pa pad chen gyis dkris pa'i mdung*/ tha ma gnyis dbang po'i pags pa stod g.yogs su bsnams pa las g.yas kyis stobs rgyu dang*/ g.yon gyis dung skyong 'dzin pa'o/ /chu lha pho mo'i steng na g.yas rkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'i rdo rje'i gshog pa brdeb pa/ he ru ka'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs shing*/ yum rdo rje phag mo ser mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying khar rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa'/ de'i thugs kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūṃ naṃ hūṃ/ spyi bor mkha' 'gro ma gsang bar lā ma/ mgrin par dum skyes ma/ lte bar gzugs can ma/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su dpa' bo dpa' mo bzhi bcu zhe brgyad/

khar khwa gdong ma/ sna bug gi 'dom sor 'ug gdong ma/ gsang bar khyi gdong ma/ gshang sgor phag gdong ma/ mig g.yas su gshin rje brtan ma/ rna ba g.yas su gshin rje pho nya ma/ rna ba g.yon du gshin rje mche ba ma/ mig g.yon du gshin rje 'joms ma/ thams cad kyang phyag gnyis pa/ dpa' bo thams cad rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ rnal 'byor ma rnams gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pa/ mkha' lding gi zhal dang rdo rje'i gshog pa can no/ / de nas go cha gnyis 'god/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ dam ye bsre ba/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams bya ste/ sdom pa'i mngon rtogs gang yang rung ba zhig dang bstun no/ / snying gar nyi ma'i steng du hūṃ gi mtha' skor du sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūṃ/ ḍā ki nī dzā la sam+bha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ ces 'bum phrag nyi shu rtsa gnyis su bzla'o/ /de nas oṃ ga ru ḍa sa ma ya hūṃ dzaḥ zhes btags pa 'bum bzla/ de nas taṃ ka ra kaṃ ka ra/ ts+tsha ti/ ts+tsha ti/ khyung hur rbad/ zhes btags pa 'bum bzlas pas gdon thams cad dang*/ khyad par klu nad zhi zhing*/ 'byung po thams cad mngag gzhug tu 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan gyi klu gdon drag po 'dul na/ nā ga srog tshig nan rbad mā ra ya hūṃ/ zhes btags pa 'bum phrag bzlas te las la sbyar ro/ /rjes lha sku stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las lha skur langs te go cha bkod tsham rngam byas la thun mtshams la 'jug go / gtor chog lū hi pa dang 'dra/ sngags kyi sham bu bzla ba nas bzung ste/ bdag bskyed dang gtor chog gnyis kar la he ru ka bya khyung gi 'khor gyis bskor ba bsgom pa dang*/ gtor chog gi skabs/ bzlas gtor gyi rjes la/ oṃ mahā ga ru ḍa i dam bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes btags pas 'bul/ 'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ dbus su bum pa bca'/ mchod gtor rgya cher bshams/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/

mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ bum pa bskyed chog spyi dang mthun/ bum pa'i nang du bdag bskyed ltar lha bskyed mchod pa phyi nang gsang ba tshang ba dang*/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ gtor ma 'bul/ klu gtor yang btang la bzlas pa ci nus zhi bya'o/ /slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags/ rigs lnga'i sdom bzung*/ dam tshig nyer gnyis bzung ba rnams bya/ lha'i sku las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bkru bar bsams te/ bum chu spyi bo nas gtor zhing 'thung du 'jug/tshad med bzhi nas rigs bdag rgyas 'debs kyi bar bdag bskyed bzhin dmigs pa phog/dbang bskur gyi skabs/ bum chus dngos su dbang bskur/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung byin te/ sham bu rnams byin mi dgos/ slar yang bum pa'i chus gnas so sor gtor la/ lha thams cad kyi sngags la a bhi ṣiñca zhes btags la dbang bskur ro/ /'di la phyag mtshan gtod pa dang*/ gtor dbang byed pa zhig kyang snang ste/ blos btags yin yin 'dra ba'i mi dgos par mngon no/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ 'di rgyud las char 'bebs kyi skabs su/ bsnyen pa song na las de la lhag par bsngags shing*/ 'di nyid kyi bka' nyan srin mo ral gcig ma bsgrub par bya ste/ logs su bstan pa zhig yin no/ /kuna~X las khyad 'phags mkha' lding gi /sgrub thabs mchog tu dga~X' ba'i tog/rwa lo'i gdams par grags pa yi/ /snyinga~X po~X nyung ngu tsam zhig bris/ /bde mchog rdo rje mkha' lding gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ye shes lnga ldan dus 'khor ni/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad bya khyung tshul/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs ni/ /rgyud don bzhin tu gsal bar bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags kyis stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa'i gdan la k+ṣiṃ kha dog lnga ldan du zhu ba las/ rang nyid 'dab chags kyi mgon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ rkang mthil nas dpyi'i bar ser po/ de nas lte ba'i bar dkar ba/ de nas mgrin pa'i bar dmar ba/ de nas smin ma'i bar nag pa/ de yan chad ljang khu spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ rgyal ba ljang khu dang rnam rgyal sngon pos dbu skra bcings pa/ stobs rgyu dang pad+ma nag pos snyan cha/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong dmar pos phyag gdub/ 'jog po dang pad chen ser pos zhabs gdub/ mtha' yas dang rigs ldan dkar pos 'og pag dang mgul rgyan byas pa/ gshog pa kha dog sna tshogs pa 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ rigs lngas dbu brgyan pa/ klu rgyal gdug pa can sbrul gyi rnam pa sked pa nas phyag gnyis kyis bzung zhing mgo bo zhal du gsol ba/ mjug ma zhabs 'og tu mnan pa'o/ /lte bar sa'i dkyil 'khor la laṃ/ snying gar chu la u/ mgrin par me la raṃ/ dpral bar rlung la i/ gtsug gtor du nam mkha' la a/ thugs kar nyi ma la k+ṣiṃ/ de la sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs te/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ de ltar bye ba bzlas na/ ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad 'grub bo/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'am/ yang na maṇ+ḍal la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa bcu gnyis kyi rnam pa bsham/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas mchod pa byin rlabs dus 'khor khros pa rdo rje shugs dang 'dra/ mdun bskyed oṃ āḥhūṃ hra phaṭa kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/

nyi ma la k+ṣiṃ gi bar gong bzhin/ de nas so so'i phyag rgya dang bstun te/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ badz+ra gan+dhaṃ pra tīts+tsha na maḥ zhes pa la sogs pa/ pak+ṣiṃ zhes pa mgo bor sbyar nas/ oṃ pak+ṣiṃ kā maṃ pra tits+tsha na maḥ'i bar du mchod pa bcu gnyis rdo rje shugs dang 'dra/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos shing*/ gal te byed par spro na rdo rje shugs kyi skabs bzhin pas/ badz+ra bhe ra wa bhiska ra zhes pa'i tshab tu/ pak+ṣiṃ tra zhes brjod/ slob ma'i bya ba yang dus 'khor lhan skyes kyi skabs 'don pa spos pas rung ngo*/ /rgyud 'grel gyi dngos bstan 'di ltar na nam mkha' lding la rwa mi dgos shing*/ zhal ras lha zhal la bya'i mchu yod par bya/ mkha' lding gi mngon rtogs thams cad na mjug ma'i gsal kha med kyang 'jug sgro dgos shing*/ pus mo man chad bya'i rkang pa'i rnam pa/ phyag zhabs thams cad la sen mo lcags kyu ltar rno ba/ dbu skra nag po thor tshugs sam/ ser po gyen brdzes gang rung dang*/ zhal bzhi na zhi khro skabs dang sbyar/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan gyi steng du rin po che'i dbu rgyan yang bya'o/ /de ltar byas na rgya gar yul gyi mkha' lding gi bkod pa dang yang mthun zhing*/ rgyud 'grel gyi dgongs pa yang de las mi 'da'o/ /bya khyung rwa can ni/ bal po dang li dang rgya nag sogs yul gzhan gyi bkod pa las 'byung zhing de nas de dag las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs dang*/ bod rnying ma dang*/ rgya gar la kha 'phangs pa'i bod ma sogs la de nyid kyi rang lugs yin pas bya yi/ rgya gar gyi yin nges rnams la de'i rigs 'gre mi sbyor zhing*/ bris rgyud nor ba rgya 'byams pa la'ang snying po med do/ khyung sgrub kuna~X la yod mod kyi/ /rgya gar yul dang mthun na dga~X'/ /rnying ma'i snyinga~X po~X gsar ma la/ /sbyor ba 'di yang gad mo'i gnas/ /ye shes khyung khra rgyud lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel//

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin mchog/rigs lnga mkha' lding la btud nas/ /ye shes khyung khra'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mal lo'i man ngag bzhin du bri/ / skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi'i steng du phuḥyig las klu rgyal sog ma med nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng du/ k+ṣiṃ mthing kha las bdag nyid ye shes khyung khra tsog pu'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ brla man chad sa'i rang bzhin ser po/ lto ba chu'i rang bzhin dkar po/ stod me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ mgo bo rlung gi rang bzhin nag po/ spyi gtsug ye shes kyi rang bzhin sngon po/ gshog pa nam mkha'i rang bzhin kha dog sna tshogs pa/ sprin sna lnga la rgyab brten pa/ phyag g.yas skyabs sbyin dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ gnam lcags kyi rwa gnyis kyi dbus na klu'i rgyal po'i gtsug gi nor bu phrogs pa rgyan du mdzad pa/ me dpung drag la rtsub pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ de'i mgrin par khyung rigs lnga snying gar snying po yi ge lnga/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pas rgyas btab/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dug rnams kun/ /me dang chu bzhin 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /ye shes lnga yi ngo bo nyid/ /mkha' lding khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / 'byung ba lnga dang dug lnga 'joms/ /rigs lnga khyung la phyag 'tshal lo/ /brtan g.yo'i dug rnams rab zhi nas/ /dug lnga ye shes mngon 'gyur shog/oṃ pak+ṣiṃ swāhā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla zhing*/ badz+ra ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ khaḍ+ga/ bud+dha ga ru ḍa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces btags pa'ang cung zad bzla/ mtha' stong par sbyangs nas dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ rin po che'i snod du oṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes khyung khra 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngags tshan drug gi rjes su/

a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam bkra shis rnams bya'o/ /'d-i'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu lnga dang bcas pa mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor ba/ maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du mañji la gtor ma che ba gcig rnams bzhagamachod pa byin rlabs dang*/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gtso bo gong bzhin/ de'i thugs kar nyi ma la k+ṣiṃ las sangs rgyas mkha' lding dkar po/ g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon sbrul dkar bzung nas bza' ba/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir nyi ma la k+ṣiṃ re re yongs su gyur pa las shar du rdo rje mkha' lding g.yas rdo rje/ lhor rin chen mkha' lding g.yas rin po che/ nub du pad+ma mkha' lding g.yas pad+ma/ byang du ral gri mkha' lding g.yas ral gri/ de rnams rim pas sku mdog sngo ser dmar ljang ba/ phyag g.yon par rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i sbrul bzung nas bza' zhing sku'i dbyibs gtso bo dang mtshungs pa'o/ / ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ mchod pa byin rlabs/ bzlas pa mchod bstod gtor 'bul rnams byas la/ slob mas phyag byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes sogs sho lo ka gnyis kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag la bcom ldan 'das ye shes khyung khra'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ni/ sku bskyed bstim/ gsung bzlas lung*/ thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa/ 'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo dang bcas pa yin pa las/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs/ mkha' spyod kyi gnas nas khyung rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs nas bstim pa dang*/

bzlas lung gi skabs/ mdun bskyed lha drug so so'i thugs kar nas rang rang gi sngags byung ste/ slob ma'i snying gar bstim pa dang*/ de'i rjes su sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas sngags 'gugs shing bstim pa rnams mdzad/ dam bca' ba'i lung mi dgos/ lhag ma rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra/ 'di ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud la brten pa yin mod kyi/ gtso bor nā ro pa'i man ngag pham thing pa nas brgyud pa dang*/ sa skya pa'i lcags ri khongs las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos kyi nang tshan yin pas zab mor grags shing*/ las tshogs kyang klu nad gso ba/ gag lhog bcos pa/ dug gi bcud len/ bya khyi gnam gsum bcos thabs sogs man ngag rnon po mang du yod do/ /rigs kuna~X 'dus pa'i ye shes kyi/ /rnam cha shin tu dga~X' ba'i phul/ /yi ge snga phyi rgya mtsho las/ /snyinga~X po~X bsdus pa e mo ho/ khyung khra man ngag lugs su grags pa'i sgrubs thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsang ba'i bdag po'i byin brlabs pa'i/ /rdo rje mkha' lding la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa/ /cung zad tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems phyag rdor gyi bdag bskyed rnams sngon du btang nas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems kyi snang ba'i hūṃ yig badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas pa zhig mdun du chad pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rin po che 'bar ba hūṃ gi mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyi 'phrau 'du las mkha' lding gi rgyal por gyur/ ri dza pri dza hūṃ/ bya khyung gser gyi gshog pa dang rdo rje'i mchu can/ lus rdo rje'i rang bzhin me 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon na nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yas na klu mgo bo gsum pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che dang mu tig dang gser gyi dbu rgyan can/ sbrul mgo dgu pas rgyan du byas pa/ klu brgyad zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/

'khor mkha' lding gi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor bar gyur/ mkha' lding gi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dun+ti mi li mi li swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ mkha' lding 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ bzlas pa na/ oṃ badz+ra ba ti ga ru ḍa be ge ta hūṃ hūṃ dza dzaḥ ri dza pri dza hūṃ phaṭa/ ces nyin re bzhin stong nas khri'i bar bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i ngang nyid nas/ /thabs las mkhas pas gdug pa 'dul ba'i phyir/ /phyag na rdo rje'i las kyi pho nyar sprul/ /bde gshegs mkha' lding tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ gu gul gyi bdug spos btang*/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas thun mtshams su sangs rgyas kyi sku gzugs kyi drung du/ phyag mchod yan lag bdun pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed len pa gang nus bya/ gtsang sbra'i spyod pa la gnas par bya'o/ /yang 'di bdag bskyed du byas kyang rung bas gong du bshad pa la 'dod pa spo bar bya'o/ /'di la rjes gnang sogs byed pa med de/ ngag gam glegs bam las lung thob pas chog/phyag na rdo rje'i gzungs kyi las tshogs kyi lha yin no/ /a ti sha yi man ngag ces/ /bka' gdams kuna~X la grags pa ltar/ /thos nas dga~X' bas bris pa lags/ /legs par bsgrubs na snyinga~X po~X 'byung*/ /rdo rje mkha' lding khyung ser du grags pa/ bka' gdams lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ni/ /zhi khro mig sman mdog 'chang ba/ /de la btud nas de sgrub thabs/ /gsal zhing 'dus pa bri bar bya/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba/ rang sems dhīḥmathing nag gi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las rang nyid 'jam dpal nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/

g.yon ut+pal thugs kar 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba'i steng na sher phyin gyi po ti bzhugs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung can yid tsam khro zhing dar dang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /oṃ pra sod/ chu sod/ dur ta sod/ snying mgo la chod/ kha la dz+wa/ kaṃ shaṃ traṃ rbad phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa sogs gang 'grub bzla'o/ /rnam rtog che na sku khro bo'i cha lugs can/ dbu skra bcings pa/ phyag g.yon po ti thugs kar bsnams pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gi stabs can du bsgoms la/ stong dang nyi shu rtsa gcig re bzla'o/ /zhal gdams bcu gcig gi don ni/ skya rengs shar ba'i dus kha shar du blta/ sgal tshigs bsrang*/ rlung g.yas nas drangs g.yon la 'bud/ bla ma spyi bor bsgom/ sngags kyi sham bur/ sarba dz+wa ra ro ka duṣ+ta bigha nan u pa tra be/ shān+tiṃ ku ru ye swāhā/ zhes gdags/ rang gi rkang pa'i rgyu mo khung gnyis kyi dreg pa srin lag g.yon pas blangs nas/ bu ga dgu dang drug mdor byugade rnams phyi sgom phye ba'i sngon du bya/ bzlas pa'i mthar rkan sgra drag po lan gsum bya/ rkang pa g.yon pa'i sen mos g.yas pa'i mthe bong mnan/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten man chad kyi gnod byed thams cad mnan par bsam/ shin tu rtog pa che na/ gos mgo mjug tu zlogathal mo gdab/ rlung drag tu 'bud/ bzlas sgom rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o/ /'di yis nad gdon grib sogs mi thub pa gang yang med par grags shing*/ byin rlabs kyang che ba yin no/ /'di la sgom lung tsam gyis chog/'ga' zhig gi lag len ltar rjes gnang byed na/ zhi ba'i sku la brten nas sgrubs thabs brgya rtsa'i chings sbyor ba yin no/ /kuna~X las zab par bsngags pa 'di/ /gsar ma nyid du dga~X' bas sgrog/rnying ma'i chos su gsal ba la/ /bdag snyinga~X ya mtshan chen po~X skyes/ /'jam dbyangs nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'phags ma sgrol ma la btud nas/ /dpa' bo gcig sgrub las byung ba'i/ /rmi lam lung ston gdams ngag ni/ /shin tu zab par grags pa bri/ /shing drung ngam brag phug sogs shin tu dben zhing gtsang ba khyi sgra med pa'i phyogs su sa phyogs byi dor byas gu gul gyis bdugagazhi bdag gtor ma mang du btang*/ thun mong gi srung 'khor bsgoms te/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re rak+ṣa rak+ṣa swāhā/ zhes 'bum tsam bzla'o/ /de nas zhag bdun tsam du rdo rje sems dpa'i yig brgya bsgom bzlas la 'bad par bya'o/ /de dag tu yang khrus dang gtsang sbra gal che'o/ /dngos gzhi ni/ stegs bu grub bzhi'i steng du pad+ma 'dab brgyad bri/ de'i steng du bum pa dkar gsum dang*/ bum sman sbyar ba'i chu gtsang mas gang ba/ shug pa lta bu'i shing gi yal gas kha brgyan/ yod na de la tsa ka li 'dogatsa ka li med kyang btub/ steng nas dar sngon po'i gdugs phub/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ sgrol ma'i bris sku dang*/ dkar gtor gsum yang bsham/ a mṛ ta bzla zhing bgegs bskrad/ bdag bskyed sgrol dkar gyi mngon rtogs bzlas pa dang bcas pa ci rigs bya/ mdun bskyed

swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ bum pa ri rab lhun por gyur pa'i rtse mor kha rgyan dpag bsam gyi shing yal ga lo 'dab me tog 'bras bu rgyas pa/ ri rab kyi steng du pad zla'i gdan la lha mo shra ma ṇa sku mdog sngon mo zhi zhing sgeg pa/ ri rab la khyel bzhugs kyi tshul can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas me long ngam rnga yab/ g.yon dpag bsam shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ lha mo shra ma ṇa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ 'dod don gsol ba drag tu btab/ lha mo la phul bar mos te/ me tog gtsang ma bum pa'i nang du phul/ oṃ shra ma ṇa pi sha tsi ni muṇ+ḍe swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ gtor ma dang po/ oṃ shra ma ṇa pi sha tsi i dam bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa gzhi bdag la 'bul/ thun mtshams su yang bzlas pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya zhing*/ khyad par nyal khar drag tu bzla'o/ /zhag bdun gyis bsnyen par 'grub cing*/ rang gzhan gyi don phal cher dang tshe ring thung skye ba snga phyi sogs phal cher lung ston par gyur ro/ /gal te ma 'grub na/ grib shas che ba yin pas khrus chog dang*/ bshags bsdams byas la/ slar zhag bdun sgrub bo/ /sgrol ma'i bsnyen pa sngon du song na/ zhag nyer gcig gis mi 'grub pa ye mi srid par grags so/ /'di sgrub dus bya rgyud nas bshad pa'i bsrung bya gang yod kyi steng du/ mi khyi dang mi 'phrad/ sngo rngad mi bza'/ dkor zas dang*/ grib zas la 'dzem pa gal che'o/ /'di la rjes gnang mi dgos/ lung tsam gyis 'grub bo/ /zab mo yin zhes kuna~X la grags/ /rgyud las gsungs phyir mkhas rnams dga~X'/ /lung bstan sgrub pa'i snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /gzhan pas ngo mtshar che bar 'khum/ /lha mo shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa'i/ /mkha' 'gro ma dpal drag shul can/ /'jigs med zhal can la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnas mdo tsam bri/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi/ /gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag rgya che zhing gting zab pa/ 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba 'khrugs pa/ de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma chen po dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma la gnas pa'i mi ro'i snying gar rang sems kyi ngo bo hūṃ yig mthing kha/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma thams cad tshar bcad/ mtshan ltas ngan pa dang*/ nyer 'tshe thams cad bsregs/ slar 'dus hūṃ la thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog mthing nagasku bong che bas srid gsum khyab pa/ yan lag dang nying lag mkhrang zhing hrags pa/ rab khros seng ge'i zhal gdangs shing*/ ljags 'gril la mche ba gtsigs pa/ dug gi kha rlangs na bun ltar 'thibs shing*/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum pa/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar zhing la la thur du 'phyang ba/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+waṃ ga la ḍā ma ru dang 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs can/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ mi lpags dang glang lpags sbyar ba'i stod g.yogs gsol ba/ thod pa skam pos dbu brgyan zhing*/ sbrul dang rus rgyan dang*/ mi mgo'i do shal can/ khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris/ thal chen gyi tshom bus brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'od 'bar ba'i dbus su bzhugs shing*/ mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs thams cad kyang phyag g.yas pa rnams na sna tshogs pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin zhing*/

g.yon gtso bo dang mtshungs pa/ seng ge'i zhal nas drag sngags kyi sgra 'ur ru ru sgrog par gyur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i pho brang nas mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can 'khor dang bcas pa pheṃ pheṃ/ zhes 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bskor bas spyan drangs/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes nang mchod phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor los bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ / dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ yang 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsungs shing*/ de rnams kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan/ aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥraḥyaḥphaṭaḥ ces drag tu bzlas pas/ dmigs pa dang bcas thal mo brdab cing*/ mthar/ khro mo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog/rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ / mthar lha sku mi dmigs pa'i ngang nas dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral bar bya/ gtor ma sha khrag gis brgyan pa bshams la/ nang mchod byin gyis brlabs te bran/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i 'od kyis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug ste/ 'bru gsum la thim/ de rnams zhu ba las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ gong bzhin ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ singha mu kha ḍā ki nī i dam bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sogs btags pa lan bdun gyis phul/

oṃ singha mu kha ḍā ki nī sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pa 'go bor sbyar te/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod 'bul/ bcom ldan ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /'jigs gzugs dpa' bo chen mo ni/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyis gdug pa 'dul/ /rngam pa'i zhal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /phyag g.yas gri gug bsnams pa yis/ /dgra bgegs ma lus srog rtsa gcod/ /mi mthun bar chad sel mdzad ma/ /mthu stobs drag mo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yon pa thod khrag bsnams pa yis/ /bdud bzhi zhing bcu'i snying khrag gsol/ /'khor ba'i khrag rgyun rtsad nas gcod/ /byad ma sgrol la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dug gsum sgrol mdzad kha ṭ+wāṃ bsnams/ /'jigs pa'i sku la thod 'phreng can/ /zhabs gnyis nyi zla pad steng dbus/ /me dpung klong bzhugs phyag 'tshal bstod/ / dug gsum rnam dag chos 'byung ni/ /rnam thar sgo gsum yongs rdzogs pa/ / mthing nag gru gsum me ri 'bar/ /e las drag byed phyag 'tshal bstod/ / bsnyen sgrub mchod bstod bgyis pa yis/ /sa lam bar chad zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ /rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas myur thob shog/mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar spyi dang mthun/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs la/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya'o/ /rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag re kha dkar po can/ dbus su nyi gdan la tshom bu dkar po dgod/ mtha' rdo rwa me ris zlum skor bya/ khyams zla gam rdul tshon dmar pos dgang*/ dbus su mañji'i steng du dmar gtor gru gsum rgyan gyis brgyan pa bzhagamatha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ spro na/ go skabs yangs pa zhig tu bum pa'ang 'cha'/ mañji'i steng gi gtor ma dang*/ bum pa bca' ba phyag len yin gyi yig rnying ni ma bzhugs/ gtor dbang byed pa'ang de dang 'dra'o/ /rdor dril cang te'u nang mchod sogs yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas nas/

mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par bya/ gong bzhin mngon rtogs blangs nas bzlas pa song mtshams su/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ bzlas pa 'i bar bdag bskyed nyid 'don pa spos pas chogade nas mchod bstod byas la/ bum pa bcas yod na/ bum pa sngags kyi yig 'brus yongs su gang bar gyur/ sngags ci rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ yig 'bru rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang gi chur gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas gtor chog gong bzhin las/ mgron spyan 'dren pa mi dgos so/ /slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod/ slob dpon gyis slob ma rnams la sems bskyed gsal btab/ sngon 'gro'i chos rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa dang*/ 'di nyid kyis lo rgyus bshad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar bskul/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs kyis gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug/yang na/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ / zhes sogs byas kyang rung*/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ brjed ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ snod kyi skyon gsum spangs te gsan par zhu/ ces brjod/ rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs spyi dang mthun/ dngos gzhi ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i 'od kyis slob ma'i lus sogs ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad sbyangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu brgyan gyi bar mngon rtogs ltar gyi dmigs pa sprod pa yin pa las/ ye shes spyan 'dren gyi skabs/ rol mo'i byin 'bebs/ bum pa bcas na dbang bskur ba'i sngags 'don bzhin du/ bum pa slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzhag cing bum chung sbyin no/ /de dag rjes gnang gi gzhi 'god pa yin/

de nas slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las/ mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can gyi sku dpag tu med pa byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs par mos mdzod/ ces brjod la rol chen bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /slob dpon gyi mgrin pa'i āḥlas ā li kā li dang sngags 'phreng dpag tu med pa byung*/ mgrin par thim/ rol chen bya/ de rjes bzlas lung dang*/ bcom ldan bdag gi sogs byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung yang spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las/ gri gug ral gri kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum cang te la sogs pa'i phyag mtshan dpag tu med pa byung*/ slob ma'i snying ka'i hūṃ la thim/ rol chen/ thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /slob dpon gyi gnas gsum nas yi ge 'bru gsum dpag tu med pa spros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim/ rol chen/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de rnams bum dbang la sogs pa dbang bzhi'i don yin no/ /zhes kyang ngo sprad/ de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba ni/ gtor ma 'di nyid ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum sdes bskor bar dngos su bsgom/ de la mos gus dung ba byas pas/ de nyid 'ur 'ur chem chem khyed rang gi spyi bor byon/ phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad bsrung ba dang*/ gnod byed bgegs dang log 'dren/ mthu gtad sbyor ba ngan pa byed pa'i byad ma thams cad zhal du chom chom gsol bar mos shig byas la/ gtor ma de rnams kyi spyi bor bzung*/ rol chen dang bcas par bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o/ /'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / rjes gtso bos ji ltar sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal dang*/ deng nas brtsams te sogs dang*/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs bya'o/ /rjes chog ni/ mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/

gong bzhin mchod bstod byas la/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs pa/ dam tshig pa bsdu ba/ rang gi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs pa/ smon lam gdab pa/ bkra shis kyis mtha' bsten pa rnams rim pa bzhin spyi dang mthun par bya'o/ /kuna~X khyab zab par grags pa yis/ /phyir zlog man ngag rab dga~X' ba/ /sgrub thabs snga phyi bgrang yas las/ /snyinga~X po~X khol byung tsam zhig bkod/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge'i gdong can sngon mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dbang du byed dang phyir bzlog la/ /mchog tu rno zhing myur ba yi/ /seng gdong mkha' 'gro'i rig sngags la/ /btud nas dmar mo'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la e las chos 'byung mthing nag yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ srung ba'i 'khor lo yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ rang sems hrīḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid ye shes mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas gri gug gser mdog nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin pa/ gru mo na kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang bcas pa/ spyan gsum/ skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal byas pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ pad nyi ru ṭa pho mo gan rkyal du bsnol ba'i steng du zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus nas bzhugs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ dang hrīḥde las 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ oṃ sidha mu kha ḍā ki nī badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ phaiṃ/ dza hūṃḥbaṃ hoḥ slar yang 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/
