zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ snying gar pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu bzhi pa'i lte bar nyi ma la hrīḥ'adab ma rnams la sngags 'phreng g.yas skor du 'khor bar dmigs la/ yi ge bcu bzhi pa nyid bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sku mdog dmar mo dgyes pa'i nyams ldan ma/ /bde ba'i nyams ldan dgyes pa'i 'dzum ldan ma/ /thar pa'i lam ston mchog gi dngos grub ster/ /mu stegs tshar gcod drag sngags 'brug ltar sgrog/sngags kyi yig 'brus mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud/ /sangs rgyas bstan bsrung drag po'i spyod pa mdzad/ / rnal 'byor bar chad bzlog la rab brtson ma/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / ces bstod/ gtor ma byin rlabs bsdus pa bla med spyi dang mthun pa zhig byas la/ phaiṃ/ zhes 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ oṃ sidha mu kha ḍā ki nī pañca a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ mahā rak+ta kha raṃ khā hi/

zhes pa lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol ba btab/ badz+ra muḥ zhes gshegs su gsol/ 'di'i gsang ba thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag ni/ lte bar mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sa bon bsgom/ de'i 'go drangs nas bzlas pa byed pa yin no/ /dbang sdud dang bsrung bzlog bsad gsum dang*/ gzhan yang las tshogs thor bu rnams ni snga phyi'i yi ge rnams las shes par bya'o/ /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ bca' gzhi sngon mo dang mtshungs pa las/ mdun du gri gugagayas su thod pa/ rgyab tu ḍā ma ru/ g.yon du phur pa rnams bkod/ mdun bskyed sgrub pa dang*/ gtor dbang gi bar seng gdong sngon mo'i skabs dang mtshungs shing 'don pa spo/ de nas gri gug gtad la/ skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin brlabs pa/ /gri gug mtshan ma'i dbang bskur bas/ /zhi ba'i las kyi dbang thob shog/oṃ badz+ra shān+tiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ thod pa gtad de/ gri gug mtshan ma'i zhes pa'i tshab tu/ bdud rtsi thod pa'i zhes dang*/ zhi ba'i zhes pa la rgyas pa'i zhes dang*/ shan+tiṃ ku ru la puṣ+tiṃ ku ru zhes 'don pa spo/ de bzhin du/ ḍa ma ru 'khrol du bcug la/ sgra snyan rnge'u chung zhes dang*/ dbang gi zhes dang*/ wa shaṃ ku ru zhes 'don pa spo/ phur bu gtad la/ 'phrin las phur bu'i zhes dang*/ drag po'i zhes dang*/ mā ra ku ru zhes 'don pa spo/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gal te 'di'i gsang ba'i dbang bskur na/ me long la tsan+dan dmar po dang*/ gi haṃ dang rang byung gtsang ma sbyar bas mkha' 'gro sde lnga'i sa bon bri/ sa dmar gyi maṇ+ḍal chos 'byung sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bri/ bdag mdun gyi skabs gsang ba'i sngags bzla/ rjes gnang snga ma bzhin rdzogs pa'i rjes su me long gnas lngar gtugs/ mkha' 'gro rigs lnga gnas lngar bstim/ maṇ+ḍal gyi sa dmar nas slob dpon gyis mtheb srin gyis blangs te/

spyi bor thig le gcig bya/ rigs bdag bla mar mos/ dpral bar thig le gcig bya/ lus lha skur bsgom pa'i brda'/ snying gar thig le bcu bzhi bkod/ yig 'bru bcu bzhir mos/ lte bar thig le lnga bkod/ mkha' 'gro sde lngar bskyed cing bstim/ me long gi yi ge rnams nang mchod kyis bkrus la spyi bor blug 'thung du gzhugakhrus kyang byar gzhug go /'di bka' gnyan par byed pas gang thod thod du mi sbyin no/ /mkha' 'gro seng ge gdong can gyi/ /sgrub thabs kuna~X las dga~X' ba'i phul/ /bsgrub bya snyinga~X nas 'gugs pa dang*/ /drag po~X'i sngags kyi phyir bzlog yin/ /mkha' 'gro ma seng ge'i gdong pa can dmar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jam dpal sprul pa'i khro bo ni/ /klu'i gshed po klu srin tshul/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /klu nad can la phan phyir bri/ /skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ rang sems phe yig nag po las phe yig dpag tu med pa spros/ phe rak+ṣa ku ru hūṃ/ rin po che bkrams pa'i rgya mtshor sbrul las byas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang du sa bdag klu gnyan stan du bting ba'i steng du/ rang nyid rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+shas sku mdog nag po dbu bcu phyag bco brgyad pa/ rtsa zhal srin po'i gdong shin tu khros pa'am/ yang na dbu dgu khro zhal du byas kyang legs/ gang ltar yang sbrul mgo dgu bar snang khams su 'phyo ba/ sprul mgo dbus ma'i spyi bor rgyal ba mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas brgyad gri gug gam ral gri/ g.yon brgyad sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ dang po gnyis thugs kar bsnol bar byas pa'ang yod/ sku stod srin po'i lus ri rab la rgyab brten pa/ sku smad sbrul 'jug rgya mtsho'i gting du 'khyil ba/ zhal thams cad nas ig sha'i sgra sgrog pa/ ral pa sprugs pa las srog chags gdug pa'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ klu chen brgyad kyis sku la brgyan pa/

klu rigs thams cad zas su za ba/ gdol pa nag po 'og tu gnon pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /snying gar ye shes sems dpa' sbrul dkar po 'khyil zhing gdengs ka byas pa'i snying kar ting 'dzin sems dpa' nyi ma la gnas pa'i phe nag po la sngags kyis bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ phe laṃ hūṃ/ zhes yig 'bru bzhi pa bzla zhing*/ nag po ti pa tsa nā ga rak+sha oṃ phe laṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa'i drag sngags kyang cung zad bzla/ bsnyen sgrub byed na sgrub yig nas bshad pa bzhin las/ bzlas pa mang nyung sogs blo bzo byar mi btub/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar/ i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags la phul/ rjes gnang ni/ gtor ma gru gsum gyi mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gtor 'bul rnams song ba'i rjes su gtor ma lha skur gsal ba'i sbrul mgo dbus ma'i rin po che'i dprog zhu'i nang du/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can bzhugs par mos la/ bla ma rin po che bdag la 'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha sa'i rjes su gnang ba ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon gyi dpral ba'i oṃ las 'od zer byung*/ slob ma'i dpral bar thim/ bum dbang/ de bzhin du/ mgrin pa'i āḥlas gsang dbang*/ thugs ka'i hūṃ las sher dbang*/ gnas gsum gyi 'bru gsum las dbang bzhi pa len zhing*/ de bzhin du rig pa'i rgyal po'i sku las kyang len/ de rnams re re'i mtshams su spos dang rol mo bya/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhagabaka' bsgo re mdzad/ lha zhi drag gnyis ka bsgom pa dang*/ sngags bzlas pa'i lung 'bogs/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /'og gdon kun la ches rno ba'i/ /gdams ngag gu ru'i gter mar grags/ /kuna~X tu nyer mkho rab dga~X' 'di'i/ /rjes gnang byed tshul snyinga~X po~Xr bkod/ /'jam dpal nā ga rak+sha'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ sna tshogs pa'i sde'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bco lnga pa'o// //zhus dag/ dar rgyas 'phel/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'dren pa sangs rgyas rnams sangs rgyas/ /dpa' bo bdun la rab btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs rmad byung ba/ /shin tu rnyed dka' bkod par bya/ /sems bskyed tshad med bzhi dang bcas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gzhal med khang gi dbus su/ rin po che dang pad zla'i gdan dgu la hūṃ re re yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su rang nyid rgyal ba shākya thub pa chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ shar du rnam gzigs sa gnon dang mnyam bzhag mdzad pa/ byang shar du gtsug tor can mchog sbyin mnyam bzhagashar lhor thams cad skyob skyabs sbyin mnyam bzhaganub tu 'khor ba 'jig ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ lho nub tu gser thub chos 'chad mnyam bzhaganub byang du 'od srungs g.yas mchod sbyin dang g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang gser mdog mtshan dpes spras pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol zhing*/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gi rang rang gi byang chub shing drung du bzhugs pa/ lho ru khro bo chen po sngon po mchan khung ral gri dang zhags pa bcug cing thal mo sbyar ba/ khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /byang du phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang khu g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon gdan la brten pa rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /sgo bzhir rgyal po chen po bzhi dang bcas pa gsal btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ / sogs kyis bstod/ dkar gtor zhig sngags drug gis byin gyis brlabs/

dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams yid kyis bkug ste/ a kā ro lan bcu gcig gis bsngos/ sangs rgyas rnam gzigs mya ngan 'tshang la gnas/ /rgyal ba gtsug tor pad+ma dkar po'i drung*/ /thams cad skyob pa sā la'i drung na gnas/ /bram ze 'khor ba 'jig ni shir+sha'i drung*/ /sangs rgyas gser thub u dum ba ra'i drung*/ /'od srungs n+ya gro da yi drung na gnas/ /shākya thub mchog a shād+tha drung du/ /phyin nas byang chub thob gyur gau ta ma/ /sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul chen po de dag la/ /mngon par dad pa'i lha gang 'khod pa dag/lha rnams de dag yid dga' mgu gyur nas/ /rtag tu dge zhing zhi bar 'gyur bar mdzod/ / ces brjod la/ gtor ma dor/ gats+tsha gats+tsha swa bhā wa naṃ/ zhes mgron rnams gshegs/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta hri da ya/ a nu ga te/ oṃ ku ruṃ gi ni swāhā/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi spyi'i sngags dang*/ sangs rgyas bdun pa'i gzungs las 'byung ba ltar so so'i gzungs kyang nus na bzla'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rang la bsdu/ rang yang snying ga'i sa bon la bstim la cung zad mnyam par bzhag/dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su lha'i snang ba dang ma bral ba dang*/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa dang*/ sangs rgyas bdun pa'i gzungs klog pa'am/ 'don pa ci nus su bya zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa bdun gyi sku gzugs la phyag mchod rgya cher bya/ 'di'i rigs gtad bya tshul ni/ bsgom bya dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor ras bris rdul tshon sogs 'grub na rab/ min na rgya gar pa'i lugs kyi maṇ+ḍal me tog gsar ba'i tshom bu can bsham/ bum pa gtsang ma bum rdzas kyis gang ba gnyis bsham/ mchod gtod yang mang du bzhag go /bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mdun bskyed bzlas pa la thug gi bar yang bdag bskyed kyi rigs 'gre/ bum pa gcig gi steng du de bzhin gshegs pa bdun/ rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas pa bskyed cig shos su khro bo chen po dang gsang ba'i bdag

por bskyed/ 'di la oṃ bi kṛ ta daṃṣ+te/ a mo gha sa ma ye/ a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ sarba bid+ya a mo gha/ a bi ṣe kai hūṃ mi li mi li swāhā/ zhes bzla'o/ /de dag gi sku las byung ba'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar mos/ lha rnams mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal byas te/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rig sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ yan lag bdun pa dang skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gang yang rung ba zhig bya/ sngags kyi che ba mang du brjod/ bgegs rnams la gtor ma byin te phyir bskrad/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa sgom du bcugadang por khro bo chen po'i sngags kyis dbang bskur/ des bkru byabs bsrung gsum bya/ de nas gzhal yas khang gi shar sgo'i nang du 'dug par mos su bcug la/ snying po'i mthar a bhi ṣiñca btags la/ bum pa gtso bo des dbang bskur zhing*/ spro na so so'i mtshan sngags kyis kyang dbang bskur ro/ /de nas gong gi mngon rtogs bzhin bsgom lung phog la sngags kyi bzlas lung kyang sbyin no/ /rjes spyi dang 'dra/ de la mtshan sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bi pa sh+ye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maḥshi khi ni ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na mo bi shwa bhu dze ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maḥkra ku ta tshan+te ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na mo na ka na ka mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maḥka sh+ya pa ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ oṃ na maḥshākya mu na ye ta thā ga tā ya swāhā/ zhes pa rnams yin no/ tad+ya tha/ oṃ mu ni mu ne mahā mu na ye swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzla'o/ /sangs rgyas kuna~X las dpa' bo'i sku/ /chos 'dul gcig tu rab dga~X' ba/ /rnam bdun sgrub thabs rmad byung 'di/ /nyams len snyinga~X po~Xr byed na'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣa ta'i man ngag sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun gyis sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsung gi rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /bde ba can gyi zhing sbyangs te/ /'od dpag med par sangs rgyas pa/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya ta sa stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar hrīḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rgyal ba 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ na bza' chos gos rnam gsum gsol ba/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs kar hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags 'phreng dmigs la/ oṃ a mṛ ta pra bhe a mṛ ta hūṃ/ zhes ci nus bzla/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams sku gzugs kyi drung du mchod bstod/ bde ba can gyi zhing bkod kyi mdo dang bzang po spyod pa 'don/ 'di la gtor chog mi dgos/ slob ma la'ang bzlas lung tsam gyis 'grub/ slob dpon gyis bdag la rigs sngags dam pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa gsol ba lan gsum du gdab dgos te/ slob dpon gyi rjes zlos byas pas chog go /de yang sems bskyed gsal btab la/ shū n+ya tā nas/ thugs kar hūṃ zhes pa'i bar mngon rtogs bzhin phogagasung gi rjes gnang gi lung bzhin rjes su bzlas pa'i lung ster ba yin no/ /dbang ma thob pa la bzlas lung sbyin yang don med pas rgyud sde bzhi gang rung gi dbang bskur thob pa zhig la sbyin no/ /sangs rgyas kuna~X las ches dga~X' bar/ /zhing mchog bla na med sgrub pas/ /rgyal ba mchog la snyinga~X nas dad/ /sgrub thabs 'dus shing gsal po~Xr bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/

/ ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal tshab mi pham mgon po la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu zab cing 'khyer bde ba/ /'phags yul bla ma'i gsung bzhin bri/ /tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar maiṃ dmar ser yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun byams par gyur/ oṃ mai tri ya tri/ de yang sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis bshad pa'i phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon pas klu shing gi yal ga me tog dang bcas pa snyan gyi thad kar kha phye ba dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ dar gyi smad dkris dang ri dwags kyi pags pas nu ma g.yon pa bkab pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la byang chub chen po'i mchod rten can mtshan dpe yongs su rdzogs pa/ khro bo gzhan kyis mi thub pa dang bcas pa'o/ /zhabs kyi bzhugs tshul rang gang mos pa bya/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ mai tri dṛ ḍha tsit+ta tiṣ+ṭha ho/ zhes lan gsum gyis brtan par byin gyis brlabs/ snying gar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod la/

oṃ a dzi tañja ya/ sarba satwa sa mā ya ma nu ga ta swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ stong pa nyid du bsdus nas/ slar lha skur ldang*/ dge ba bsngo/ thun 'tshams su mchod bstod spyi mthun gang 'grub dang*/ byams pa'i mtshan brgya dang dam bcas pa'i gzungs rnams 'don no/ /'di la gtor bsngo mi dgos/ 'di bzlas lung blangs pa kho nas chogade yang lha'i mngon rtogs slob ma la phog la/ sngags nyid bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin no/ /de la'ang dbang bskur ba thob pa dgos so/ /sangs rgyas kuna~X dngos sangs rgyas sras/ /rab dga~X' la sogs sa bcu'i bdag/gsung rab snyinga~X po~X'i don ston pa/ /gang 'di'i sgrub thabs rmad byung spel/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag byams pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas kyi/ /smon lam rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa/ /mchod pa'i sprin la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /kun tu bzang por gus pa'i 'dud/ /sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems s+t+waṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las kun tu bzang po sku mdog dmar po/ g.yas gang ba'i bum pa thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon nyi ma dang pad+ma dkar po bsnams pa/ khro bo ṭāk+ki rā dza dang bcas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan can/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs kar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod de/ oṃ swaṃ hriḥka ya swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ 'jug tu sku stong par sbyangs/ dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ thun mtshams su kun du bzang po'i mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa la sogs pa ci nus su 'don zhing*/ phal po che dang gser 'od dam pa la sogs pa bklag par bya'o/

/gzhan yang sku gzugs la mchod bstod dang smon lam mang du 'debs/ 'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs pa ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X tu bzang po grags che yang*/ /mkhas rnams dga~X' ba'i sgrub thabs ni/ /sngon chad bod kyi phyogs na med/ /de phyir snyinga~X la dam po~Xr bzung*/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa kun tu bzang po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal sras thugs rje'i dbang phyug ni/ /nam mkha'i snying po la btud nas/ /nang mtshon mu ge'i 'jigs pa dag/zhi phyir lhag pa'i lha de bsgrub/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar khaṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid nam mkha'i snying po sku mdog sngon po na bza' sngon po can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i g.yon pas pad+ma'i rtsa ba 'dzin pa/ snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri sngo sangs can/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin gyi khang bzang 'od zer sngon po 'bar ba'i dbus na/ khro bo dbyug sngon sogs 'khor rig 'dzin mtshon cha thogs pa mang po dang*/ rang gi sprul pa kha dog sna tshogs can mang pos bskor ba/ spyan gyi 'od kyis nam mkha' thams cad 'od dang dri zhim pos khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ swā sti ka ma lāk+ṣi/ bi pu la/ saṃ bha wa/ dharma dhā tu/ go tsa re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba dang*/ thun mtshams kyang kun tu bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ nam mkha'i snying po'i mtshan brgya rtsa klog pa nyid khyad par ro/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /nyes ltung kuna~X nas dag mdzad pa'i/ /yi dam 'di 'dra mchog tu dga~X'/

/mtshan brgya'i man ngag snyinga~X po~X ni/ /zur du bkol ba 'di tsam yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po'i sgrub thabs kyi len tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig dran pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha min 'joms shing 'byor ba rgyas/ / chos ldan rgyal srid brtan 'gyur ba'i/ /sa snying sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ pad zla la rang sems k+ṣiṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid sa'i snying po ser po stod g.yogs ser po can/ zhi ba spyan rtsa dmar ba/ me tog sngon po'i phreng ba'i thod can/ phyag g.yas shing tog dang g.yon pad+ma'i steng na nor bu dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ 'od zer ljang khu 'phro ba rdo rje sa 'og la sogs pa 'khor gyis bskor ba/ gzhal yas khang ser po rin po che'i brag ri dang gangs ris bskor ba/ dar dang rin po che'i brgyan pa sogs mngon rtogs lhag ma kun du bzang po'i skabs dang 'dra/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha/ ha ra tsa ra/ mahā pa sha mā ru ta/ a mo gha badz+ra san+ta swāhā/ zhes bzla/ rjes dang thun mtshams kyang kun bzang gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sa'i snying po'i mtshan brgya nyid klog pa khyad par ro/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang*/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs su bshad pa dang 'dra'o/ /sa steng kuna~X du rnyed dka' ba'i/ /sgrub thabs thos pa dga~X' ches nas/ /snyinga~X nas dad pa skyes gyur te/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig gsal po~Xr bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa sa'i snying po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba dang*/ /rdo rje'i tshe 'grub phyir bzlog che/ / sgrib pa thams cad rnam sel gyis/ /rig sngags lags pas de phyir bsgrub/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/

shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i gdan la rang sems skaṃ las rang nyid sgrib pa rnam sel sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa snyan gyi thad kar kha bye ba'i steng du/ zla ba nya gang ba ra ri med cing 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyir bzlog chen po gtsug gtor 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs rig pa'i khro bo mang pos zhabs la btud pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar kun tu bzang po'i skabs bzhin no/ / oṃ a mṛ ta bin+dhu dzā wā/ ma hā su kha swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla/ rjes dang thun mtshams kun bzang gi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ sgrib pa rnam sel gyi mtshan brgya klog pa nyid khyad par ro/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang*/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs su bshad pa 'dra'o/ /bod yul kuna~X du 'di yis ni/ /sgrub thabs yod par ma mthong nas/ /bla ma'i drung du dga~X' bas zhus/ /gsung tho snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa sgrib pa rnam sel gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang zhig bsam pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jigs pa brgyad las nges skyob pa/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdor bsdus bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ paṃ las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i dbus su/ pad zla la rang sems a dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dkar po 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan can/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na/ seng ge glang chen dug sbrul gza'/ g.yon bzhi na/ me chu lcags sgrog mi rnams 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i gar stabs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mdun du tāṃ las sgrol ma ser mo phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar bas nor bu 'dzin pas gtso bo la 'dud pa'o/

/oṃ a wa lo ki te pad+me ni/ wa rāṃ gi ṇi/ tu ru tu ru hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ ma ṇi hā re hūṃ/ zhes pa yang ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /thun 'jog khar sgrol ma rang gi snying gar thim/ phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis thun mtshams la 'jugagatsang sbra dang ldan pa'i sgo nas/ bris sku dang mchod rten la phyag mchod gang 'grub bya'o/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X las ngo mtshar rmad byung sku/ /'jigs brgyad skyob pa rab dga~X'i gnas/ /rgyud kyi snyinga~X po~X yin no zhes/ /bla ma'i gsung las gsal bar thos/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag spyan ras gzigs 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang la gang 'dul sna tshogs sku/ /don yon zhags pa la btud nas/ /sna tshogs dbang po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu mdor bsdus bri bar bya/ / sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rlung me chu sa ri rab pad+ma zla ba nyi ma brtsegs pa las sgra gcan 'gyel ba'i steng du/ rang sems hrīḥlas rang nyid don yod zhags pa sna tshogs dbang po sku mdog dkar po/ zhal bcu gcig rtsa zhal zhi ba dkar po spyan gsum pa ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ g.yas su lha zhi ba dang*/ gshin rje gnod sbyin/ drag po chen po/ zla ba rnams kyi zhal brtsegs pa dang*/ g.yon du khyab 'jugachu lha/ gdong drug khros pa/ drag po/ nyi ma'i zhal rnams brtsegs pa'o/ /kun gyi steng gi dbus su 'od dpag med mchog sbyin mdzad pa/ g.yas su rlung lha dang*/ g.yon du me lha lus phyed phyed snang ba/ phyag sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi dang po gnyis nor bu dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan rnams kyis brgya byin gyi rdo rje la sogs pa lha rnams kyi mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'o/

/zhabs brgyad kyi 'og tu klu dang lha min dang srin po'i tshogs rnams mnan pa/ dar dang pags pa'i gos dang*/ rin po che dang*/ sprul dang*/ me tog la sogs pa na bza' dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ me dpung dang 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba'o/ /thugs kar zla ba la zhags pa dmar po'i steng du hrīḥmatha' mar sngags kyis bskor ba/ oṃ a mo gha pā sha kro dha a kar+ṣa ya/ pra pe sha mahā pa shu pa ti/ ya ma/ wā ru ṇa/ ku be ra/ pra h+ma/ be ṣa dha ra/ a mo gha hrīḥd ya/ pad+ma ku la sa mā ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'i snying po nyid ci nus su bzla zhing*/ don yod zhags pa'i gzungs ring kyang 'don no/ / rang lus cha gnyis su gyur pa las g.yas kyi cha ni sna tshogs dbang po'i sku dang*/ g.yon gyi cha lha mo gos dkar mo rang dang mtshungs pa las lha mo'i rnam pa can/ phyag na pad+ma 'ba' zhig 'dzin pa'i skur gyur/ oṃ pad+me paṇ+ḍa ra wā si ni kuṇ+ḍa kuṇ+ḍa swāhā/ zhes pa ci rigs pa bzla'o/ /thun mtshams kyi bya ba dang*/ lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs dang 'dra'o/ /mos pa sna tshogs kuna~X 'dud cing*/ /mu stegs 'dul ba rab dga~X'i gnas/ /spyan gzigs sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /shin tu ya mtshan che phyir bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sna tshogs dbang po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang 'od dpag med/ /bla mar bcas la gus btud nas/ /pad+ma'i phyag tu mtshan gsol ba/ /spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs bshad/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du btang ste/ shū n+ya tā sa stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud thams cad rang bzhin ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor du gyur/ oṃ pra kṛ te pa ri shud+dha sarba dharma pra kṛ te pa ri shud+dho3haṃ/

snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ bcud kyi sems can thams cad kyi lus gcig tu 'dres pa zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sems gcig tu 'dus pa nor bus mtshan pa'i pad+ma dkar po dag gcig tu 'dus pa de'i lte ba la hrīḥs mtshan pa/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ zla ba la pad+ma hrīḥdang bcas pa la thim/ thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa yongs su gyur ba las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyugazhal bcu gcig phyag stong dang ldan pa/ sku lus ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar zhing mgrin pa sngo ba/ rtsa zhal dkar po'i steng du 'tshog ma dang rna ltag g.yas g.yon gyi phyogs la zhi ba'i zhal drug sngo ser dkar dmar ljang ba dang rgya tshos kyi kha dog can/ de'i nang rim la khro bo'i zhal gsum ste/ nag po dmar nag sngo skya'o/ /ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi rtse mor sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i zhal tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can dmar po'o/ /dbu bcu gcig po thams cad kying mgul pa dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas pa rnams kyis bgrang 'phreng mda' 'khor lo ral gri rtse gsum/ g.yon pa rnams kyis gser gyi pad+ma gzhu spyi blugs po ti kha ṭ+wāṃ ga rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag lhag ma dgu brgya dang brgyad cu gya brgyad mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun 'bab pa/ phyag gi mthil na spyan re re dang bcas pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yon phyogs su lha mo sgrol ma dkar mo cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can/ phyag g.yas pas gtso bo la 'khyud cing*/ g.yon pas ut+pal sngon po mdzes pa/ steng gi nam mkha' la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa'i chu rgyun gyis rtag tu dbang bskur ba'o/

/dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mig tu k+ṣiṃ/ rna bar dz+riṃ/ sna la khaṃ/ lce la gaṃ dpral bar skaṃ/ lte bar saṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ a mṛ ta u pa ta ya mi/ 'khor 'das thams cad kyi bcud kyi bdud rtsi gsol/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta a nu rā ga ya mi/ rjes chags kyi bde bas rgyud gang*/ lte bar pad+ma dmar po la āḥ snying gar sngon po la hūṃ/ spyi bor dkar po la oṃ mgo thur bstan/ srog rtsol bsdams te 'bar dzag ci nus su bsgom mo/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ pad+ma hasta/ sa ha sra badz+ra bhu dza nes+t+ra nī la kaṇ+ṣa/ lo ke shwa rā ya hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ pad+ma tā re hūṃ/ zhes ci nus su bzla zhing mthar dmigs med du mnyam par bzhagadage ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su snang grag thams cad lha sngags su shes par bya/ mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa sogs ci rigs par spyad/ 'di la dbang bskur thob pa la sgrub thabs bshad nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa nyid kyis chog go /'di ni spyan ras gzigs kyis grub thob chen po ka ma la ga ma'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs yin no/ /kuna~X dga~X'i yul mchog li yul

nas/ /dge bsnyen pad+mas spyan drangs pa'i/ /rgyud las snyinga~X po~X tsam bsdus pa'i/ /sgrub thabs ngo mtshar e ma ho/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba li yul nas gdan drangs par grags pa/ zhal bcu gcig pa pad+ma'i phyag gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ yi ge drug pa'i bdag nyid can/ /bde ldan jo bor mtshan gsol pa/ /su kha de bas zhal gzigs pa'i/ /sgrub thabs bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi rnams sngon du btang nas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i gdan la pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs jo bo su kha wa ti sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang po ba dan rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya/ gnyis pa na bgrang 'phreng*/ gsum pa na nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin/ g.yon dang po pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu nor bus mtshan pa/ gnyis pa na dbyug gu rtse gsum/ tha ma na spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ zhabs rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ ral pa'i cod pan can/ g.yon phyogs su rang snang gi yum ut+pal 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan pa'o/ /mig tu oṃ dkar po/ rna bar ma sngon po/ snar ṇi ser po/ lce la pad dmar po/ dpral bar me ljang khu/ lte bar hūṃ sngo skya/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin pa āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /'jug tu chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i sgo nas dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su lha'i snang ba dang ma bral bar bya/ jo bo bde ldan dmar po bsgom par 'dod na/ phyag g.yon gyi dang po pad+ma dkar po'i steng du glegs bam dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/

sku mdog dmar po thugs kar sbas pa'i yum sgrol ma ut+pal dmar po 'dzin zhing kha 'byed pa/ de'i thugs kar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bsgom pa dang*/ bzlas pa'i tshe/ yum la/ oṃ pad+ma tā re hūṃ/ zhes bzla ba ni/ 'di dang mtshungs pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub thabs mahā dza nas mdzad pa zhig sngar 'gyur yang bka' med la/ 'di ni dbang thob pa zhig la sgrub thabs bshad nas/ sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin pa tsam gyis chog go /tshong dpon rigs las grub brnyes pa/ /kuna~X dga~X' grags ldan de yi gzhung*/ /snyinga~X po~Xr bsdus pa'i nyams len ni/ /'di ltar lags pas gces par bzung*/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ spyan ras gzigs su kha wa ti'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas/ /don yod lcags kyu sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdo tsam bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /gzhan la phan phyir bri bar bya/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hrīḥyig dmar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid don yod lcags kyu skya rengs gsar pa'i mdog can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa/ rgyan spangs pa/ spyan gsum 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can/ rgya nag gi bla gos dang*/ ri dwags kyi pags pa'i smad g.yogs can mnyam par bzhengs pa/ phyag brgyad kyi g.yas bzhi na lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon bzhi na zhags pa bsnams pa'o/ /snying gar zla ba la sngags 'phreng bkod de/ oṃ aṅku sha a mo gha a khar+ṣa ya hūṃ/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku brnyan la mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ mdo sde klog pa la nan du bya'o/ /'di'i lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra ba yin no/ /kuna~X du spyan ras gzigs kyi thugs/ /rab dga~Xs skul bar byed pa'i lha/ /don yod lcags kyu'i sngags rgyud ni/

/mtha' yas gsungs pa'i snyinga~X po~X 'di'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag don yod lcags kyu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud nas/ /don yod mchod pa sgrub pa'i thabs/ /mdo tsam bla ma'i gsung bzhin du/ /gzhan la phan phyir bri bar bya/ / sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la hrīḥyig las/ rang nyid 'phags pa don yod mchod pa'i nor bu zhes bya ba/ sku mdog dkar po yid tsam khro zhing spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yas gnyis na ral gri dang tri shu la/ g.yon gnyis na zhags pa dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la 'od dpag med kyis brgyan pa/ chu'i dbus su pad+ma'i sdong po la gnas pa/ g.yas g.yon na klu dga' bo nyer dga' dkar po pus mo btsugs shing*/ thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /oṃ a mo gha pū dza ma ṇi/ pad+ma badz+re ta thā ga tā/ bi lo ki te/ sa man+ta pra sa ra hūṃ/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su bris sku la phyag mchod ci 'grub bya/ bsnyen pa 'bru 'bum du song nas/ bdag dang bris sku gnyis ka lhar bskyed la/ mchod bstod yan lag bdun pa dang bzlas pa 'bum tsam bya'o/ /phyis de la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa tsam gyis klu nad gso ba dang*/ char 'bebs pa dang*/ longs spyod sgrub pa thams cad thogs pa med pa yin no/ /'di'i lung 'bogs tshul ni/ 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud las gsal bar gsungs na yang*/ /kuna~X gyis mtshan yang ma thos pa/ /bdag gis thob 'di yid dga~X'i gnas/ /nyams len snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'phags pa don yod mchod pa nor bu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rdo rje sems dpa' thugs kyi bdag/thugs kyi rdo rje thugs kyi

gtso/ /thugs gyi dbang phyug gsang ba'i rgyal/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i zhabs la 'dud/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar hūṃ yig rdo rje dang bcas pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po zhi ba phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ yid tsam khro ba'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan pa/ rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ yum mā ma kī dkar la sngo ba'i mdangs can/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas sku'i g.yon phyogs nas 'khyud pa/ oṃ sarba mahā badz+ra a gra wa raṃ hūṃ/ oṃ ki ri ki ri mā ma kī hūṃ/ zhes cung zad bzlas/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi phung por gyur/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes bskul bas/ de nyid hūṃ du gyur/ de las rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum shin tu khros pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba 'phyar zhing g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa/ nyi ma'i 'og tu dbang phyug chen po dang*/ u ma dang*/ nor bdag dang*/ klu dang*/ lha ma yin la sogs pa dregs pa thams cad kha bub tu mnan pa/ gdug pa'i sbrul zhal du gsol zhing stag lpags dang sbrul rgyan dang mi mgo'i do shal can/ khro bo'i rgyan cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yum rig 'dzin ma sngon mo cung zad zhi zhing sgeg pa/ skra grol ba/ rdo rje dang thod khrag 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ gnyis ka'ang me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing*/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ri rab kyi rtse mor byon par gyur/

snying gar sngags 'phreng bkod la/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+taṃ ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ku lān+dha ri ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces kha sbyor gyi bzlas pa ci nus su bzla'o/ kha zas kyi phud yi ge 'bru gsum gyis gtor mar byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po' ི mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes btags pas 'bul/ /'di'i byin rlabs byed par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal gru gsum nag po zhig bya/ der mañji'i steng du thod pa dam rdzas kyis bkang ba'i nang du lcags kyi rdo rje zhig bzhagasha chang gis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang mchod pas bskor/ thams cad a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ bdag mdun dbyer med kyi tshul du bzlas pa'i bar tshar gyis bsgom/ thugs ka nas las kyi rdo rje zhig chad de/ mchod pa 'bul bar bsams la/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod/ gtor ma'ang gong bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas 'bul/ stobs po che la drag shul che/ /rigs sngags 'chang ba bde ba po/ /gdul dka' ma lus 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes bstod/ de nas slob mas/ oṃ he badz+ra ā tsar+ya ma ma a tiṣ+ṭhan+tu ku ru hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ slob dpon gsang ba'i bdag po dngos su bsgom du gzhugaslob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad gsang bdag yab yum gyi sku'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma la bstim/ de bzhin du yig 'bru dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam par yang spyan drangs te bstim/ de gsum la rol mo'i sgra re bya/ slob ma zhi ba yab yum du sgom du bcug la de'i sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ khro bo yab yum du'ang sgom du bcug la de'i sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin/ gtor ma nas kham gcig sbyin la 'bru gsum brjod/ bum dbang ngo*/ /snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pas thod pa'i nang gi dam rdzas sbyin/

gsang dbang ngo*/ /rdo rje snying gar gtad la/ bde stong gi ye shes sgrib gnyis 'joms byed du ngo sprad/ sher dbang ngo*/ / mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs slob ma la bstim/ mi rtog pa sgom du gzhug ste dbang bzhi pa'o/ / rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ /sangs rgyas kuna~X gyi thugs rdo rje/ /lhan cig skyes dga~X'i rang bzhin dngos/ khro rgyal 'di la snyinga~X nas dang*/ /sgrub thabs 'di yang gsal por bkod/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ 'gro lding gi rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de wa saṃ bha wa'i man ngag phyag rdor lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rig sngags kun gyi rgyal mo ni/ /mtha' dag bgegs kyi gshed ma mchog/bzod dka' gzi brjid chen po 'chang*/ /mā ma kī la rab tu 'dud/ /sems bskyed dang tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ las rdo rje hūṃ gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje lha mo mā ma kī sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes kyi rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa me lce'i zer 'phro ba 'phyar ba'i tshul 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas thugs kar ut+pal sngon po'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ sde brgyad kyi gtso bo dregs pa can thams cad kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ sbrul dang rin po che dang me tog gis brgyan pa/ bcu drug lon pa'i lang tsho can/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba'i myu gu gtsigs pa/ khro chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/ dbu skra phyed ltag par bcings shing phyed grol ba/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbu la brgyan zhing*/ tsha zer 'khrugs pa'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/

/ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs kar rin po che ljang khu cha dgu pa dang*/ lte bar pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ mgrin par nyi ma'i gdan dgu/ de rnams la rigs lnga yum bzhi'i phyag mtshan dang sku dang sa bon rnams 'god/ lte 'og sor bzhi'i gnas su thod pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje'i lte bar sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa bkod la/ oṃ ku lān+dha rī ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ shaṅka ri shan+ti ka ri/ ghuṭ+ṭa ghuṭ+ṭa/ ghuṭ+ṭe ni ghuṭ+ṭe ni/ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzla/ sngags kyi 'od zer gong nas gong du spros te spyi bo nas thon pa dang*/ yang rim pa de nyid go bzlog ste tshur bsdu ba dang*/ yang gsang ba'i lam nas spro zhing bsdu ba ci nus su bya/ mthar phyag rdor lhan skyes kyi mngon rtogs bzhin gtor ma phul la mi dmigs par bzhag go /'di'i byin rlabs byed tshul ni/ phyag rdor lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs byed tshul nyid 'don pa spos pas rung ngo*/ /bgegs 'joms kuna~X las 'di mchog ces/ /rgyud las dga~X' bar bsngags na yang*/ /phyogs 'dir shin tu dkon pa'i phyir/ /snyinga~X po~X 'di yang 'bad pas zhus/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ 'gro lding gi rdo rje'i slob dpon chen po/ de wa saṃ bha wa'i man ngagardo rje lha mo mā ma kī'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dbang du byed dang nad zhi dang*/ /blo dang ting 'dzin nor sgrub pa/ /rig sngags 'di yis 'grub bo zhes/ /rgyud sde kun las gsal bar gsungs/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar gnas pa'i paṃ yig gi 'od kyis snang ba thams cad dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor bsgyur/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid lha mo gos dkar mo chen mo sku mdog dmar mo/

phyag g.yon pa pad+ma'i khu tshur gyis pad+ma dmar po'i sdong bu brla g.yon pa'i steng du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yas pas de nyid thugs kar kha phye nas lte bar gnas pa'i nor bu dmar po la gzigs pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs shing*/ stod g.yogs dkar po sogs dang dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rig sngags kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūṃ/ snying gar pad+ma dmar po kha sbyor gyi dbus su zla ba la sa bon sngags 'phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab ste/ oṃ ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /'di'i bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /lha 'di dkyil 'khor kuna~X la yod/ /logs su rab dga~X'i sgrub thabs med/ /de phyir 'phags yul mkhas pa la/ /ched kyis zhus pa'i snyinga~X po~X'o/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag lha mo gos dkar mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang la 'chi med tshe sgrub cing*/ /sdig 'phrog rgyal ba'i byin rlabs 'jug/nyi ma'i bu las rgyal ba'i thabs/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /byang chub tu sems bskyed/ rang gi mdun du bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sa gnon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya mdzad cing seng ge la bzhugs pa/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ grags chen snyan grags chen po ba/ /thub chen dpa' bo chen po ba/ /srid pa'i mya ngan bsgal ba po/ /nyon mongs brgal la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ /bdag la 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba drag tu btab pas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi dbu'i gtsug tor las sngags 'phreng dang bh+ruṃ yig brgya rtsa brgyad byung ste/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das ma dkar mo g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje dang*/ g.yon lhung bzed bdud rtsi'i gang ba 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad du bzhugs/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun spyi bo nas blug par bsam la/ rnam rgyal gzungs ring nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas/ bcom ldan 'das ma bh+ruṃ yig tu gyur/ bh+ruṃ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas pas/ rang nyid gtsug tor rnam par rgyal mar gyur/ rang gi snying gar rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa/ de'i thugs kar sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la bh+ruṃ/ mtha' skor du sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/ oṃ a mṛ te a mṛ tota bha we/ a mṛ ta bi krān+te/ a mṛ ta ga te/ a mṛ ta ga mi ni/ a mṛ ta ā yur da te/ ga ga na krīt+ti ka re/ sarba kle sha k+ṣa yaṃ kā ri ye swāhā/ zhes pa'i gzungs thung 'di nyid ci nus su bzla'o/ /gzungs ring la mos na stong phrag brgyad/ gzungs thung la mos na 'bum phrag bzhi bzlas pas/ bsnyen pa'o/ /thun gyi mthar/ mdun gyi bcom ldan 'das la mchod bstod gsol btab gong bzhin byas nas/ rang gi snying gar thim/ 'jug tu dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/

'di'i lung 'bogs pa la/ thub dbang gi bris sku'i drung du/ dpon slob gnyis kar gyis phyag mchod rgyas par bya/ slob dpon gyis gong du bshad pa'i bsgos bzlas de tshar gcig byas nas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ 'od dpag med kyi sgrub thabs ltar gsol ba btab/ gong du bshad pa ltar gyi mngon rtogs sgom tshul tshar gcig bshad nas/ gzungs ring thung gnyis la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa nyid yin no/ /rnam rgyal sgrub thabs sngon byung ba/ /kuna~X dang thun mong ma yin pa'i/ /ngo mtshar dga~X' bskyed chos mang can/ /snyinga~X po~X 'di 'dra'ang bdag gis thob/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi tas man ngag gtsug tor rnam rgyal phyag gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bar chad zhi zhing ye shes 'bebs/ /bsrung zhing lha sogs dbang du byed/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa/ /tsun+da'i rig sngags la phyag 'tshal/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla la rang sems tsuṃ yig dkar po las/ lha mo tsun+da dkar mo 'od zer dmar po 'bar ba/ dbu la rgyal ba rigs lnga bzhugs pa/ dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar rang gi rtsa ba'i phyag rgya 'ching ba/ lhag ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi yi/ /g.yas rnams skyabs sbyin ral gri 'phreng*/ /bi dza pu ra mda' dgra sta/ /ga da tho ba lcags kyu dang*/ /rdo rje ba dan bgrang phreng 'dzin/ /g.yon rnams rgyal mtshan pad+ma dang*/ /spyi blugs zhags pa gzhu shak+ti/ /'khor lo ral gri sdigs mdzub bum/ /'phang mdung sher phyin po ti 'dzin/ /zhabs gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa yid tsam khro zhing thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og dang*/ rang gi ba spu'i bu ga rnams la sangs rgyas bye ba bye ba bzhugs shing*/

de rnams la mchod cing de rnams kyis bstod pa/ thugs kar zla ba la tsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ snying ga'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la sngags yi ge dgu bkod de/ de dag las byung ba'i 'od kyi gong bu dgu'i nang du rigs lnga yum bzhi bzhugs par gyur/ de rnams kyi 'od kyis 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad dang*/ tshangs pa dang*/ sa'i lha mo rnams kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs bar bsam/ oṃ tsa le tsa le tsun+de swāhā/ zhes lan dgu bzlas so/ /de nas bzlas pa ni/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ko ṭī naṃ/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tsa le tsu le tsun+de swāhā/ zhes pa nyid gang 'grub tu bzla'o/ /thun mtshams su sku gzugs la mchod bstod dang mdo 'don/ maṇ+ḍal mchod chog byed na/ bdag bskyed la dpags na spyi'i rigs 'gre zhing*/ gtor chog gcig tu dgos pa ma yin kyang*/ spro na gsang 'dus ye shes zhabs lugs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ slob ma rjes 'dzin ni/ bzlas lung byed pa ste 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rtsa ba'i phyag rgya ni mdzub mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs bar pa la btsugs/ mthe bong gnyis kyi rtse mo mdzub mo'i rtsa ba la bzhag pa'i thal mo sbyar ba'o/ /sangs rgyas kuna~X gyis bstod gyur pa/ /rab dga~X' lha mo mthu ldan 'di'i/ /snyinga~X po~X bzlas pas pā la bdun/ /chos skyong rgyal por gyur zhes thos/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag lha mo tsun+da'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mi pham mgon po'i rnam 'phrul las/ /de yi rjes 'brang khro rgyal ni/ /shes rab mthar byed rnam sprul pa/ /bgegs kun 'joms la phyag 'tshal lo/

/sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la rang sems hūṃ ser po las/ khro rgyal gzhan gyis mi thub pa sku mdog gser mdogagayas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con dkar po 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod tshul gyis yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon bskyang bas srin po pho mo mnan pa/ stag lpags dang sbrul dang mgo 'phreng gi rgyan can/ de'i pang du oṃ las gzhan gyis mi thub ma sku mdog ser mo g.yas thal mo sbyar zhing*/ g.yon zhags pa 'dzin pa'i sdigs mdzub kyis yab la 'khyud pa/ gcer bu rin po che'i rgyan dang ldan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khyud cing*/ g.yas brkyang bas tshogs bdag mnan pa'o/ / gnyis kar yang rnam snang gi dbu rgyan can me dpung 'bar ba'i sku can gyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lag g.yas thal mo sbyar/ g.yon sdigs mdzub byas la ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ lheng sna dang*/ sog phrag dang*/ rtsibs logs g.yas g.yon dang*/ sta zur g.yas g.yon dang*/ spyi gtsug dang lte ba rnams su rnam gzigs la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bdun dang*/ byams pa la sogs pa bzhugs par bsam/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ na maḥs man+ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra ṇi oṃ hūṃ dzi na ri ṭiṭ+ṭa hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes yab kyi sngags dang*/ oṃ oṃ a pa ra dzi tā+e dhi ka swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ gtor chog tsun+da'i sgrub thabs kyi rigs 'gre/ lung 'bogs tshul yang 'dra'o/ khro bcu kuna~X gyi zhor tsam las/ logs su sgrub thabs sngar med pa/ /dga~X' bas bla ma la zhus te/ snyinga~X po~X tsam 'di rnyed pa lags/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag khro bo gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/

/ ༄༅/ oṃ swā sti/ gsung mchog bde stong lha yi sku/ /ye shes ha ya gṛ ba la/ /btud nas de yi sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu zab pa'i man ngag bshad/ /snying rje chen po dung ba zhig bsgom/ rang sems hrīḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rta mchog rol pa sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ phyag g.yas pad+mas mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pad+ma'i zhags pa 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ pad nyi'i steng du g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bgegs thams cad gnon pa/ dbu'i steng du rta mgo sngon po can khro bo'i rgyan dang cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /yum ral gcig ma sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar traṃ/ gsang gnas su a/ nor bu gzhal med khang gi nang du hrīḥlas rta mgrin rang dang mtshungs pa las sku mdog ljang khu yum gyi pad+ma'i sna rtser rdo rje sder mo sngo skya phag gdong can ḍā ma ru dang thod pa 'dzin pa rjes chags snyoms 'jug gi bde bas mchod par bsam/ rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgya zlog ste rtse mo bstan la snying pos dam la bzhag/oṃ badz+ra khu ra wi kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wa tī yak+ṣi ṇī ye/ e ka dza ṭī ṇe/ rak+ta sa hi te/ de wi bigh+nān pra sha ma ṇi swāhā/ phyi'i yab yum gnyis kyi sngags so/ /gsang ba'i lha la dmigs nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta bha wot+bha wa se swāhā/ oṃ e h+ye hi/ badz+ra na khī/ badz+ra mu khī/ ha na ha na/ ha na ha na/ pa tsa pa tsa/ raṅga raṅga/ a wa a wa/ ā bi sha ā bi sha ha ya gṛ wa pa ya ti swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ dbyug pa sbrul gyis dkris pa la/ /nyi zla rlung gi 'gro 'od can/ /nyi zla mchod cing nyi zla btud/ /'di ni rdzogs pa mchog yin no/ / 'di zab mo'i sgrub thabs kyi lugs yin pas phyi'i mchod gtor med/ lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ 'dod yon lnga la rol pa'i mchod pa dang*/

'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas kha zas bza' ba'i gtor ma dang*/ dngos sam yid las byung ba rjes chags kyi tshogs kyi 'khor lo rnams so/ /'di'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur byed par 'dod na/ mdun du thod pa chang gis bkang ba dang dbyug pa dang zhags pa rnams bzhagabadag dang de rnams ro gcig tu bsgoms te/ gong bzhin mngon rtogs bsgoms nas bzlas pa ci nus bya'o/ /de nas slob mas/ oṃ he badz+ra ā tsar+ya ma ma a ti ṣ+ṭhan+tu ku ru hūṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba bzhin yan lag bdun pa bya/ slob ma'i blo ngor slob dpon mngon rtogs ltar bsgom du bcugade las sku gnyis pa zhig chad nas slob ma la bstim pas/ slob ma rta mgrin du gyur pa'ang mngon rtogs bzhin/ bar der bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par phogayab kyi sngags kyis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs pa'i dbyug pa lag pa g.yas su sbyin/ ral gcig ma'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i zhags pa g.yon du sbyin/ dbyug pas khams gsum 'dul ba dang*/ zhags pas khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i dmigs pa bsgom du gzhugabum dbang ngo*/ /yab kyi sngags gsang ba brjod cing*/ thod pa nas myos byed cung zad sbyin/ nyams myong brjod du med pa ngo sprad de gsang dbang*/ rdo rje sder mo'i sngags brjod cing thod pa'i chang rim gyis btung du gzhuganyams myong shes rab ye shes kyi dbang du ngo sprad/ pi waṃ ngaṃ gling bu'am dril bu'i sgra grag stod dbang bzhi par ngo sprad de/ de nas yon 'bul/ tshogs la longs spyod do/ /'di la rjes kyi cho ga'i bya ba ni med do/ /sgrub thabs kun ༵ las lhag pa yi/ /mchog grub rta mgrin ches dga' ༵ bas/ /snying ༵ po ༵ 'i ye shes 'char ba 'di/ /mchog tu gsang ba bla med yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag rta mgrin dkar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rnam par 'dren pa thams cad kyis/ /bka' bzhin sgrub pa mi g.yo mgon/ khro bo'i dbang por rab btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs mdo tsam bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ swa bhā wa sa sngags brjod/ rang gi snying gar hūṃ de las 'od 'phros/ lus thams cad gang 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ de las rang nyid khro rgyal mi g.yo ba sku mdog dmar po phyag dang po gnyis ral gri dang zhags pa/ bar pa gnyis lcags kyu dang thod pa/ tha ma gnyis dbyug pa dang sdigs mdzub/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas bdud dang dga' ma mnan pa/ rgyab ma gnyis gar stabs kyis tshangs pa/ khyab 'jugadabang phyug rnams mnan pa/ yum gtum mo dga' byed ma/ ḍā ma ru dang me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ thags bzang ris dang*/ klu zhabs 'og tu mnan pa/ yab yum gnyis kar khro bo dang khro mo'i cha lugs yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rang gi spyi bor rnam snang*/ mgrin par 'od dpag med/ snying gar mi bskyod pa/ lte bar rin chen togagasang bar don grub/ de rnams las mi g.yo ba rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros te/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ yum gyi spyi bor spyan ma/ mgrin par gos dkar mo/ snying gar mā ma kī lte ba rin chen glog ma/ gsang bar sgrol ma/ de rnams las gtum mo dga' byed ma rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spros te/ skye 'gro thams cad dbang du bsdus par bsams la/ oṃ ka ni dhu ni hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa nyid gtso bor bzla zhing*/ oṃ a mo gha tsaṇ+ḍa mahā ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa ya hūṃ tra sa ya hūṃ/ tra ṭa raṃ maṃ zhes yab dang*/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍi ha ha ma ra ma ra/ a kār+ṣa a kār+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces yum gyi 'phreng sngags kyang ci rigs par bzla'o/ /mjug tu dge ba bsngo/ gtor ma 'bru gsum lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ yab kyi rtsa sngags kyis spyan drangs te/

a kā ro 'i sngags kyis 'bul/ 'di'i byin rlabs ni/ phyag rdor lhan skyes kyi skabs dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ chos 'byung dmar por bris/ rdo rje'i tshab tu ral gri bzhagalha bsgoms sngags bzlas kyi lung gi skabs mngon rtogs bzhin du lha'i rnal 'byor phog la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ sher dbang gi skabs ral gri snying gar bzhagabastod pa'i skabs mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa gang rung zhig gis bstod/ 'di'i bstod pa logs su yod pas shes na de yang 'don/ lhag ma 'don pa spos pas 'grub bo/ /ngo mtshar dngos grub snang brnyan can/ /sa kuna~X skyong bas bsgrubs pa na/ /phun tshogs dpal la dga~X' mgur spyad/ /dbang bsgyur lha yi snyinga~X po~X lags/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag mi g.yo ba dmar po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ ma lus bgegs rnams 'dul mdzad par/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis byin rlabs shing*/ /nyi zla'i 'od dang rtag rol ba/ /lha mo 'od zer can la 'dud/ /sems bskyed dang stong nyid sngon du 'gro bas/ rang sems maṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'od zer can ma li khri'i mdog can/ zhal gsum phyag drug gi g.yas rnams kyis rdo rje khab skud sbyar ba/ mda'/ g.yon rnams kyis zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ a shwa ka gzhu rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang*/ dar dang rin po che dang me tog gis brgyan pa/ nyi ma'i rgyab yol can rgyal ba rigs lnga dbu la bzhugs pa/ rta bdun gyis drangs pa'i shing rta la gnas pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ snying ga'i 'od zer gyis rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang phag gi rwa ba dang*/ mda' gzhu'i gur khab skud dang zhags pa'i dra ba/ phyi rol du mya ngan med pa'i shing gis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ mā rī ts+yai de wa ta ye swāhā/

zhes ci 'grub tu bzla'o/ /nyi ma dang zla ba 'char nub kyi tshe/ mchod pa la brtson par bya/ gtor ma mi dgos/ slob ma la bzlas lung byed tshul 'od dpag med kyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rgyud kuna~X bdag po sgyu dra las/ /legs gsung sgrub thabs dga~X' ba'i phul/ /mgyogs 'gro'i shing rta dang bcas pa'i/ /mngon rtogs snyinga~X po~X ngo mtshar rmad/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag 'od zer can ma rta ljang can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no/ /dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi sgrub thabs so/ /oṃ swā sti/ lha min g.yul las rgyal ba dang*/ /bgegs rnams mtha' dag nyams byed pa'i/ /rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan gyi/ /rig sngags sgrub thabs bdag gis bshad/ /sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong par sbyangs/ rang gi snying gar dh+waṃ yig gi 'od zer gyis rang nyid rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i dpung rgyan rdo rje ro langs mar gyur pa ni mthing nag drag mo/ zhal bzhi mthing kha/ phyag brgyad g.yas rnams ral gri/ gtun shing*/ 'khor lo/ mda'/ g.yon na rtse gsum/ zhags pa/ gzhu/ sdigs mdzub/ zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan can/ khro mo'i cha lugs dang rgyan dang na bza' yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ na mo bha ga wa te/ dh+wa dza a gra ke yū re/ pa ra s+yai n+ya/ bidh+wa n+sa nā kwa swa sai n+ya ba ri la ni/ u mu kā mu khi kha kha khā hi khā hi/ pa ra ma sai n+ya ma/ a nan+da bhu dze/ a nan+da mu khe/ pra ha ra pra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla zhing ba spu'i khung bu rnams nas 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mnyes par byas shing*/ ming po gsum gyis dmag tshogs bskul te/ gdug pa can tshar bcad par bsam/ mchod pa dang gtor ma spyi dang mthun/

bzlas lung 'bogs tshul yang 'od dpag med kyi skabs bzhin no/ /dgra 'joms g.yul las rgyal ba'i lha/ kuna~X gyi mchog gyur rab dga~X' 'di/ /rgyud las gsungs pa'i snyinga~X po~X zhes/ /zab mor nges nas don gnyer byas/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag rgya mtshan rtse mo'i dpung brgyan gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bde gshegs mtha' dag skyed byed yum/ /ye shes dbang phyug ma las sprul/ /gtum mo ro langs ma zhes grags/ /de la btud nas sgrub thabs bshad/ /rgyud kyi dngos bstan las gsungs pa'i dud gsol ma ni/ 'di kho na yin ces gsungs te/ bdag bskyed gtso bor byas te sgrubs kyang rung*/ mdun bskyed kho nas bsgrubs kyang rung ba las/ 'dir phyi ma bshad na yi dam gyi bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du pad nyi dang mi ro'i gdan la/ oṃ ma tha ma tha duṣ+ta hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa yongs su gyur pa las ro langs ma nag mo skra dmar ser g.yon ngos su 'khyil ba/ phyag dang po gnyis ral gri dang thod khraga'og ma gnyis kyis rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum mche gtsigs sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang*/ glang lpags kyi stod g.yogs gsol ba/ dur khrod chen po'i gnas me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su ma mo 'bum sdes bskor ba/ sku'i g.yas g.yon na gdug pa'i sbrul gyi pho nya 'gyed pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dur khrod kyi gnas thams cad nas ro langs ma badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ bhi tsam+ba ta hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa re res mgor te/ ar+ghaṃ nas nai wi t+ya 'i bar gyis mchod/ de'i mgo bor oṃ/ mig tu hūṃ/ rna bar hri/ sna la ha/ lce la hra/ snying gar hriḥ zhes pa rnams kyis rgyas btab/

rdo rje bsdams pa las gru mo brkyang ba'i phyag rgyas gnas lngar reg par bsam/ phyag rgya de nyid kyis dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ phuṃ pheṃ phaṭa hūṃ swāhā/ rdo rje rtse lnga pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ mchod gtor spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs nas/ gong bzhin mchod yon nas rol mo'i bar gyis mchod pa phul/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang gi stabs bca'/ lag pa g.yas brkyang gis se gol gtog/g.yon sdigs mdzub bya ba ni lha mo'i dam rgya ste/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍi be ta mi sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes lan bdun gyis dam tshig la gnas par bya/ de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ hrīḥha na ha na sarba sha trūṃn ma tha ma tha ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ/ a mu ka saṅga ta ya/ saṅga ta ya/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ phuḥphuḥ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mthar oṃ a kār+ṣa ya/ a kār+ṣa ya/ mahā pū dza bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pa bdun nam nyer gcig gis gtor ma phul/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ oṃ muḥ zhes ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ tshul de'i bzlas pa 'bum phrag brgyad song ba na/ ra'i pags pa la bris sku byas te/ de'i mdun du ra nag po'i shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ sogs mchod pa bshams/ mdun bskyed kyi sngon du lag pa g.yon snying gar sdigs mdzub/ g.yas khu tshur sked par sbyar la/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ zhes bgegs bskrad/ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ tshul des sngags 'bum phrag bzhi bzla/ de nas ra nag dang bya nag gi sha khrag gis sbyin sreg bya/ sreg blugs kyi cho ga spyi dang 'dra ba las/ gong gi gtor ma'i sngags kyis sha bsregs pa la grangs 'dzin pa yin/ sbyin sreg stong phrag bzhi'o/ /de tsam gyis kyang las phra mo 'grub cing*/ tshul des 'bum phrag bzhi bcu bzlas na/ rbod gtong las thogs pa med par 'grub par the tshom med do/ /'di la rjes gnang gi bya ba ni mi mdzad/ slob dpon gyis mchod gtor bzlas pa/

slob ma'i don du gsol ba gdab pa rnams byas la/ 'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi las sbyor rnams slob ma la tshar gcig bshad/ de phyin chad lha mo ro langs sgoms shigasngags tshar gcig bton te 'di zlos shig/bsnyen pa gyis shigasgrub pa gyis shigalas la sbyor ba gyis shigagadug pa can rnams tshar chod cigaces bka'i gnang ba sbyin/ de tsam gyis don sgrub pa yin no/ /'di'i las sbyor yang dgra bgegs 'gugs 'dren byas so/ /liṅga me la bsreg pa dang*/ gtso bor sbyin sreg gi las sbyor la brten nas rbod gtong sgrub pa yin no/ /kuna~X las yid ches rab dga~X' yi/ /sgrub thabs rgyud las gsungs pa bzhin/ /man ngag mchog gi snyinga~X po~X can/ /mdo tsam 'di yang ngo mtshar rmad/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag lha mo ro langs ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ thub pa shākya seng ge dang*/ /gsang bdag rdo rje 'chang ba la/ /btud nas 'phrog ma zhes bya ba/ /gnod sbyin mo yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /chang bu dang shing thog sna tshogs pas brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang mchod pa sna tshogs pa bshams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang*/ kha 'bar ma'i sngags rgya dang*/ yi ge 'bru gsum gyis mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs/ tsan+dan gyi maṇ+ḍal me tog sna tshogs bkram pa zhig mdun du bzhag rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang phyogs nas gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma bu lnga brgya dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs te maṇ+ḍal gyi steng du bzhugs par gyur pa ni sku mdog dmar ser g.yas lcags kyu/ g.yon zhags pa dang bcas pa'i ne'u 'dzin pa/ mdzes shing sgeg pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ bu lnga brgyas bskor ba/ thams cad kyang ser skya be con dang chang bus gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas khro bo gshin rje gshed be con dang zhags pa thogs pa spros/

'phrog ma'i spyi bor bzhugs/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ sngags kyi mthar kha kha hūṃ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis gtor ma phul/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ ha rī t+yai mahā yak+ṣi ṇī ye ha ra ha ra sarba yak+ṣi ṇi pra be sha ni swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ mthar mchod bstod byas la/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bru 'bum mo/ /nor sgrub kyi tshe/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad pho dgu dang bcas te sgrub pa byed pa yin/ 'di'i lung sbyin pa ni/ gong bzhin gyi mchod bstod bzlas pa dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ 'di'i sgrub thabs slob ma la bshad/ sngags la rjes zlos lan gsum byed pa nyid yin no/ /'di bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong ma chen mo yin gsung ngo*/ /kuna~X las 'phags pa'i mthu stobs can/ /dga~X' byed ma zhes rab grags pa'i/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X tsam 'di ni/ /rgya gar mkhas pa'i zhal lung yin/ /paṇ+ḍi ta pur+ṇa badz+ra gsung las byung ba/ gnod sbyin mo 'phrog ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan bde chen mgon po la/ /btud nas tshogs kyi bdag po ni/ /gser gyi mdog can sgrub pa'i thabs/ /shin tu rnyed dka' cung zad bshad/ /yi dam khro bo'i bdag bskyed zhig sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun du tshogs bdag gi bris sku la dmigs te bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba byi ba rnams kyi gdan la yi ge gaḥn las tshogs kyi bdag po glang po'i gdong can ser po g.yas gnyis na tri shu la dang dgra sta/ g.yon gnyis na nor bus gang ba'i snod dang la phug 'dzin pa/ lto ba 'phyang zhing rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ mdun du la du la sogs pa kha zas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod la gzigs pa/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ tshogs kyi bdag po spyan drangs par bsams la/

oṃ gaḥn pa ti badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ a mṛ ta sa bgegs bskrad/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ yi dam kyi sngags kyi mthar/ gaḥn pa ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje bzhag cing dbang bskur/ mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs te 'bul/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ traṃ ṭha ṭha ṭha hūṃ dza swāhā/ / zhes ci nus su bzla/ me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ la du la phug sha chang rnams dang bcas pa'i gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ a kā ro bdun gyis phul/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis mthar/ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs pa'am/ bris sku yod na yig brgya'i mthar brtan bzhugs bya/ dus bzang po rnams su gtor chog gi gzhug la snod gtsang ma chus bkang ba 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ la du'i ril bu 'bru gsum brjod cing chu nang du dor bas ci nus 'bul/ 'di la'ang slob ma rjes su 'dzin pa ni/ slob dpon gyis mchod bstod bzlas pa/ gsol btab sngon du 'gro bas/ sgrub thabs bshad nas bka' gnang sbyin pa tsam nyid do/ /sngon chad bod kyi yul kun na/ tshogs bdag ser po'i sgrub thabs med/ /de phyir dga~X' bas 'di zhus nas/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam re bsgrub par bya/ /paṇ+ḍi ta gang ba'i rdo rje'i gsung las byung ba/ shākya rak+ṣi ta'i man ngag tshogs bdag ser po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ shākya rak+ṣi ta las brgyud pa'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu drug pa'o// // ༄༅/ / rgyal kun sras kyi thu bo ni/ /kun gyi mchog gyur 'jam dpal la/ /gus pas btud nas sgrub pa'i thabs/ /ngo mtshar chen po 'bri bar bya/ 'grub na maṇ+ḍal mchod pa sngon du btang*/ gang ltar yang smon pa byang sems dang stong pa nyid bsgom/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags brjod/ rang gi snying gar pad zla la dhīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/

rang nyid 'phags pa 'jam dpal gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ phyag g.yon po tis mtshan pa'i ut+pa la'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ mi bskyod pas dbu la spras pa/ zur phud lnga pa'am ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhabs kyi drung du khro bo gshin rje gshed po mthing nag thod pa'i 'phreng ba can/ g.yas 'jam dpal gyi zhabs la brten pa'am phyag 'tshal ba/ g.yon tho ba rwa nyi shu pa 'dzin zhing khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /ye shes spyan 'dren gnas gsum byin rlabs bya/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ oṃ ra ra sma ra a pra ti ha ta shā sa naṃ/ ku mā ra rū pa dha ri hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ thun mtshams su 'jam dpal gnas pa zhes bya ba'i mdo klog pa dang*/ 'jam dpal gyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa 'don pa sogs chos spyod ci nus su bya'o/ /blo ldan kuna~X nas dga~X' ba yi/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di tsam yin/ /mi sgom na ni rgyas pas ci/ /sgom na bsdus kyang don mchog 'grub/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad las 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs so// // ༄༅/ / dmigs med thugs rje mkha' ltar khyab/ /rgyal sras kun gyi thu bo ni/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang la btud de/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam 'bri bar bya/ /thugs rje chen po'i dbang phyug mtshan thos pa dang bzung ba tsam gyis mi ldog pa'i sa thob par 'gyur ba'i 'phags mchog de la ba spu ldang zhing mchi ma 'khrug pa'i mos gus kyi sgo nas/ phyag dang mchod pa dang bstod pa dang bskor ba byas la/ byang chub kyi sems sgoms/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags don bsam/ rang gi snying gar hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ 'jig rten mgon po ston ka'i zla ba ltar dkar ba'i sku lus ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi ngos la bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa/ phyag gnyis thugs kar chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya'am/

g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon gdan la brten pas pad+ma dkar po'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ ri dwags kyi pags pa phrag pa g.yon pa la gnas pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i drung du khro rgyal rta mgrin dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ dbu'i steng na rta mgo ljang khu rta skad 'tsher ba/ phyag g.yas phyag 'tshal ba dang g.yon pas be con dkar po 'dzin pa'o/ / ye shes pa spyan drangs/ mchod pas mchod/ rang la gzhug oṃ āḥhūṃ gis gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ na mo ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa rā ya/ bo dhi satwā ya/ mahā satwā ya/ mahā kā ru ni kā ya/ kā ru ṇe kā ru ne/ mahā kā ru ṇa/ pra tiṣ+ṭhe ti kā ru ṇā ya swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ lha sku 'od gsal tu bsdus te dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su spyan ras gzigs kyis zhus pa zhes bya ba'i mdo dang*/ za ma tog bkod pa dang*/ 'phags mchog 'di nyid kyis mtshan brgya sogs 'don no/ /kuna~X las dga~X' ba'i sgrub thabs 'di/ /snyinga~X nas nyams len byas gyur na/ /'jig rten dbang po nyid mtshungs pa'i/ /go 'phang thob 'gyur a la la/ /'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sgrub thabs

so// // ༄༅/ /na mo gu ru/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum la/ /rang byan chud pa mthu stobs dbang*/ /rdo rje 'chang ba la 'dud do/ /bdag kyang khyed dang mtshungs par shog/sngags dang rgyud la mngon par dga' ba rnams 'phags pa phyag na rdo rje la blo brtad 'cha' dgos te/ sngags rgyud thams cad kyi bdag po yin pa'i phyir ro/ /skyabs sems tshad med stong nyid sgom pa sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa sngags brjod/ hūṃ las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su nyi ma la hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas 'dus pa las 'phags mchog phyag na rdo rje zhi ba ljang khu/ rin po che'i dprog zhu can/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas thugs kar 'bar ba'i rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang*/ g.yon gdan la brten pa/ na bza' mchog dang rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ rab tu bzhad cing rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can no/ /yang na sku mdog sngon por byas kyang rung*/ de'i drung du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba khro bo'i cha byad rdzogs shing*/ ljang khu'am sngo sangs dgra sta 'dzin pa'o/ de nas ye shes dgug gzhug dang*/ sgo gsum byin rlabs bya/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇa ye/ mahā badz+ra/ pra tiṣ+ṭhi tā ya/ sarba ta thā ga ta sha rī rān+ta rga tā ya/ badz+ra shā rī raṃ/ me ku ru badz+ra a dhiṣ+ṭha na swāhā/ snying po'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdo dang*/ gsang bdag nyid kyi mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad pa klogamachod pa dang gtor ma la yang brtson par bya'o/ /bde gshegs kuna~X gyi 'phrin las ni/ /rab dga~Xs sgrub mdzad sems dpa' che/ /de yi mngon rtogs snyinga~X po~X tsam/ /u dum ba ra'i me tog 'dra/ /nye ba'i sras brgyad las phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs so/ /zhus dag/maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs dang rjes su 'brel ba 'dus gsal go bde ba bzhugs/

༈ na mo gu ru ār+ya tā rā yai/ mtha' dag rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum/ /lha mo de la gus btud nas/ /sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rim pa rnams/ /ma 'dres mchog tu gsal bar bshad/ /'dir phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs nyams su len pa la/ thog mar spyi sgrub nyams su blang dgos pas/ de'i tshul ni/ spro na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i tāṃ yig las 'od zer 'phros/ bla ma rigs kyi bdag po'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan pa'i 'phags ma sgrol ma la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba/ badz+ra sa mā ya dzaḥ oṃ ār+yā tā ra sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun la/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ tāṃ yig ljang khu yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas skyabs sbyin dang g.yon mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i sdong bu thugs kar 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i rol pas bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ mig gnyis la oṃ tā re swāhā/ rna ba gnyis la oṃ tut+tā re swāhā/ mgrin pa oṃ tu swāhā/ snying gar oṃ re swāhā/ spyi bor oṃ tā re ṇi swāhā/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'phags ma sgrol ma'i rnam par spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dbang gi lha rigs lnga mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ puṣ+pe sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du tāṃ gi mthar sngags kyis bskor bar bsam la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /gtor chog ni a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ ha ho hrīḥ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags ma sgrol ma'i lha tshogs thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ yi ge bcu pa'i mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ phyi mchod/ 'bru gsum gyis nang mchod/ lha dang lha min cod pan gyis sogs bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod gsol dang*/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ tshul 'dis bsnyen pa legs par song nas/ las tshogs kyi lha nyi shu rtsa gcig po rnams 'og nas 'byung ba ltar/ so so'i sgrub thabs bsgom bzhin pas/ rab tu bzlas pa khri phrag bzhi bzhi'am/ 'bring du khri phrag re re/ tha ma yang stong phrag bzhi bzhi byas pas/ gzhung las ji skad bshad pa'i las tshogs mtha' dag sgrub pa la dbang ba yin zhing*/ sgrol ma bla med lha bcu bdun gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i rgyun thob na/ bsnyen pa 'di kho nas de'i dbang bskur du rung ste/ de'i dbang bskur ba'i cho ga yang phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs 'di nyid kyi las tshogs su snang bas so/ khyad par spyi sgrub 'di dang las tshogs kyi lha nyi shu rtsa gcig po rnams kyi rjes gnang gi bka' nges par bsgrub par bya ba yin la/

sgrol ma lus dkyil du grags pa yang 'di nyid kyi byin rlabs kho nar 'gyur zhing*/ sngon dus sgrol ma nyer gcig dkyil 'khor gcig tu bsdus pa'i dbang bka' zhig kyang byung bar mngon la/ bar skabs su de la brten te gtso bo go 'pho rang bzor sbyar nas dkyil 'khor nyi shu rtsa gcig gi dbang bskur byed pa byung snang ba ni/ grangs mang ba la dga' ba tsam ste/ tshegs chen la don med pa'o/ /nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrol ma nyer gcig gi chos skor 'di rnams bla med du bkral ba shin tu zab cing byin rlabs che ba yin/ sngon dus bod du 'di dar rgyas che zhing*/ sa skya ba'i rjes btsun dkar po rnam gsum gyi ring la chos skor 'di'i phyag len shin tu dar/ las tshogs rnams man ngag khyad par can du thugs yid ches kyang*/ gzhung gi rtsom rgya gar ma yin min cung zad dpyad gzhi yod pa'i skabs/ rje btsun chen po'i chos grwar kha che'i dge tshul zhig byung ba'i lag nas 'di'i rgya dpe byung*/ phyis yul tha dad kyi rgya dpe gnyis gsum 'dzoms pas/ rgya gzhu rtsod med du gyur te/ skyes mchog dam pa rnams shin tu thugs yid ches par mdzad do/ /da ni so so'i sgrub thabs bsten par bya ste/ de yang 'di rnams la skyabs sems tshad med sngon du 'gro bas/ shū n+ya tā sa stong pa nyid du sbyong ba nas brtsams te/ bzlas pa'i bar du sgrub thabs spyi'i bya ba gong dang mtshungs pa las/ mig byin rlabs sogs mi dgos/ sa bon dang sku'i rnam pa dang rigs bdag rnams rim pas 'gyur ba'i khyad par tsam yin par shes par byas te/ lhag ma rnams mthun par nyams su blang ngo*/ /de la dang po rab tu dpa' ba'i sgrol ma ni/ chos 'byung gi dbus su pad+ma ser po dang zla ba'i gdan la oṃ las sgrol ma rab tu dpa' mo sku mdog dmar mo me dpung 'phro ba/ zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol ba'i rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/

gnyis pa gnyis mda' dang gzhu/ gsum pa gnyis 'khor lo dang dung*/ bzhi pa gnyis ral gri dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhi ba'i sku can rigs bdag rnam snang ngo*/ /gnyis pa dkar mo zla mdangs kyi sgrol ma ni/ pad zla la tā yig las sgrol ma dkar mo dkar sngo ser ba'i zhal gsum phyag bcu gnyis kyi dang po gnyis mnyam bzhagagayas lhag mas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga'akhor lo nor bu rdo rje me tog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon rnams kyis spyi blugs ut+pal dril bu/ bum pa po ti 'dzin pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /gsum pa gser mdog can gyi sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma nyi gdan la re yig la sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bcu ma g.yas rnams kyis 'phreng ba/ ral gri/ mda'/ rdo rje/ dbyug gu/ g.yon rnams kyis dar dpyangs/ zhags pa/ pad+ma/ dril bu/ gzhu bsnams pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni rin 'byung ngo*/ /bzhi pa gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma ser po dang zla ba la tu ta yig las sgrol ma ser mo gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas mchog sbyin dang 'phreng ba/ g.yon spyi blugs dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can no/ / rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ /lnga pa hūṃ sgra sgrog pa'i sgrol ma ni/ zla ba la tā yig las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma ser po bsnams pa/ rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /drug pa 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma'i gdan la re yig las sgrol ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ g.yas dang po rdo rje/ gnyis pas ral gri/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ /bdun pa rgol ba 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma ser po dang nyi ma la tu yig las sgrol ma sku mdog nag mo na bza' ser po bsnams pa/ drag mo dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/

zhal gcig phyag bzhi/ g.yas kyi thog ma 'khor lo phyi ma ral gri/ g.yon gyi thog ma pad+ma la gnas pa'i rdo rje phyi ma'i sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs can no/ /rigs bdag ni rin 'byung ngo*/ /brgyad pa dbang mchog ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba dang chu srin rnams brtsegs pa'i gdan la/ de las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ phyag dang po gnyis mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga dang pad+ma/ 'og ma gnyis nor bu dang bcas pa'i mchog sbyin dang bum pa bsnams pa/ zhabs skyil krung phyed pa'i rol stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ / dgu pa ni/ bstod pa rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu las/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma mdzad de/ de yi ltar na gong gi sgrol ma spyi sgrub ltar las/ phyag g.yas mchog sbyin mdzad pa tsam yin la/ seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs logs su yod pa ltar na/ gtso mo de nyid dang 'dra ba las/ g.yas su maṃ las 'od zer can ma ser mo rdo rje dang mya ngan med pa'i shing gi yal ga 'dzin pa/ zhi ba'i cha lugs can/ g.yon du hūṃ las ral gcig ma nag mo gri gug dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum stag lpags dang*/ glang lpags kyi na bza' can/ drag mo'i cha lugs rdzogs pa gnyis ka'ang rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ / 'di'i rjes gnang gi rgyun ni logs su yod pa ltar 'phros don du bkod pa yin gyi/ dkyus ni sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs ltar yin pas/ mchod stsol ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la swā yig las sgrol ma dmar mo phyag bzhi dang po gnyis/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas dga' ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor 'ching ba/ g.yas pa gar gyi tshul gyis se gol gtogs pa dang*/ g.yon gnyis pas a shwa ka'i yal ga 'dzin pas 'gro ba rnams la rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'o/ /dbu rgyan ni don grub bo/

/ bcu pa mya ngan sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la sa yig las sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag bzhi'i dang po gnyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ral gri dang mya ngan med pa'i yal ga me tog dmar po can 'dzin pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/ / bcu gcig pa 'gro ba 'gugs pa'am/ 'phongs pa sel ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la hā yig las sgrol ma nag mo drag mo'i sku can/ g.yas gza' brgyad 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'phongs pa sel ba'i lcags kyu zhags pa dang bcas pa bsnams pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni rin 'byung ngo*/ / bcu gnyis pa bkra shis snang ba'i sgrol ma ni/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du a yig las sgrol ma ser mo zhal gcig phyag brgyad kyi g.yas rnams rtse gsum/ lcags kyu rdo rje ral gri/ g.yon rnams thugs kar gtod pa'i rin po che lcags kyu/ dbyug gu bum pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ / bcu gsum pa yongs su smin par mdzad pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang nyi ma la bh+rūṃ yig las sgrol ma dmar mo drag mo'i sku can/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri/ gnyis pas mda'/ g.yon gyi dang pos 'khor lo/ gnyis pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ / bcu bzhi pa khro gnyer g.yo ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar ser nyi ma la mi ro'i gdan gyi steng du/ a ta yig las sgrol ma mthing ga nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ mi'i rgyu ma zhal du gsol ba/ phyag drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis ral gri/ lcags kyu/ dbyug pa/ g.yon pa rnams kyis thod pa zhags pa tshangs mgo 'dzin pa/ mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ stag lpags dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du rin po che'i shing gi myu gu skyes pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don grub bo/
