/ bco lnga pa zhi ba chen mo'am dge legs ster ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dkar po la ṇi yig las/ sgrol ma dkar mo phyag g.yas gsum na/ 'phreng ba mchog sbyin dbyug pa/ g.yon gsum na pad+ma ril pa po ti 'dzin pa'o/ / bstod pa las ni ut+pal la gnas pa'i po ti yin par bshad do/ / rigs bdag ni 'od dpag med do/ / bcu drug pa chags pa 'joms pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar ser dang nyi ma la e las sgrol ma dmar mo/ phyag g.yas thugs kar rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub 'phyar bas snying po dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing 'dzin pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ / 'di la rig pa hūṃ las sgrol ma nyid ma zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ hūṃ las bskyed na legs par mngon no/ /bcu bdun pa bde ba sgrub pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dkar po dang nyi ma la sha yig las sgrol ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don yod grub pa'o/ / 'di yang hūṃ las bskyed na legs pa 'dra'o/ /bco brgyad pa rab tu rgyas pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dkar po zla ba dang ngang pa'i gdan la ki yig las sgrol ma dkar mo phyag bzhi pa/ dang po gnyis spyi bor bsnol bas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhag ma gnyis mchog sbyin dang glegs bam gyis mtshan pa'i ut+pal bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung can/ rigs bdag ni snang ba mtha' yas so/ /

bcu dgu pa sdug bsngal sreg pa'i sgrol ma ni/ pad dkar dang nyi ma la dza yig las sgrol ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar me thab bsnams pa/ cung zad g.yas brkyang ba'i sems dpa'i skyil krung can no/ /rigs bdag ni rnam snang ngo*/ / nyi shu pa dngos grub 'byung ba'i sgrol ma ni/ pad+ma dmar po dang zla ba la tse yig las sgrol ma dmar ser phyag gnyis kyis thugs kar gser gyi bum pa bsnams pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /rigs bdag ni don yod grub pa'o/ / nyer gcig pa yongs rdzogs byed pa'i sgrol ma ni/ ha yig las byung ba'i khyu mchog glang dkar po'i steng na pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du phe yig las sgrol ma dkar mo cung zad khro zhing spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas mdung rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon mu tig gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing stag lpags kyi sham thabs can no/ /rigs bdag ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ / de dag rnams kyi sa bon ni thams cad tāṃ yig 'ba' zhig gis rung la/ zhabs stabs mi gsal ba rnams rdo rje'i skyil krung ngo*/ /de ltar na nyi shu rtsa gcig po rnams kyi yang bsnyen pa'i dus dang rjes gnang ngam/ bzlas lung gi gnas skabs su yi ge bcu pa nyid bzla zhing sbyin par bya ba yin la/ so so'i las tshogs sgrub pa'i sngags ni rgya gzhung na gsal lo/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed thabs ni/ dang por spyi sgrub kyi rjes su gnang ba sbyin dgos pas mdun du tshom bu/ mchod gtor dang bcas par spyi dang mthun par bsham/ rdor dril nang mchod/ 'thor nas sogs yo byad rnams 'joms par byas la/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas/ dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed dang 'dra ba las/ rang gi zer ba sogs dor/ de nas mchod bstod byas la snying po ci rigs par bzlas/ gong bzhin gtor ma phul/ chos skyong so so dang*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor/

gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang spro na bya/ de nas bum pa zhig bcas la/ bum pa bskyed chog spyi dang mthun/ bum pa'i nang du mdun bskyed ltar sgrol ma bskyed la bzlas pa cung zad bya'o/ /mchod bstod mchod yon phul bas lha bdud rtsir zhu/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ rjes gnang spyi'i go ba chags pa zhig gis bya ste/ 'dir go rim ni phyag 'tshal sems bskyed gsal btab chos bshad maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba ltar gyi rgyun bshags rnams bya ste sngon 'gro'o/ / bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis slob ma sbyangs la/ shū n+ya tā 'i sngags nas dbu brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed kyi dmigs pa ltar slob ma la 'bogs pa ni sku'i rjes gnang yin la/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs dril sil dang*/ dbang bskur ba'i skabs bum chu sbyin/ gsung gi rjes gnang la/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung dang*/ dam bca' ba'i lung dang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung rnams spyi dang mthun/ thugs kyi rjes gnang phyag mtshan ut+pal bstim pa yin/ slob ma'i rjes kyi bya ba/ khas blang maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba bran du bzung ba dge ba bsngo ba sogs bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa kha gsos nas mdun bskyed la mchod bstod dngos grub blang*/ yig brgya bzla bzod gsol gshegs gsol smon lam bkra shis sogs spyi dang mthun no/ /nyi shu rtsa gcig po so so'i rjes gnang la/ bum pa bca' ba mi dgos shing sku'i rjes gnang gi skabs rnam snang gi dbu brgyan can zhes sogs dbu brgyan rang chas su bskyed pa tsam las dbang bskur ba mi mdzad do/ /gal te thun re la rjes gnang mang du byed pa dang myur bar 'dod na/ nyi ma gcig la ji tsam byed pa'i tshom bu rnams phyogs gcig tu bshams te/ gtor ma'ang de nyid kyi grangs bshams/ dang por bdag bskyed rnams kyang sbrel te bsgom/

mdun bskyed dngos gzhi yang go rim bzhin tu sbrel/ mchod bstod gtor ma byin rlabs rnams phyogs gcig tu byas te/ so so la dmigs nas gtor ma go rim bzhin du 'bul/ yang mchod bstod sogs chabs gcig tu bya/ rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro rnams gcig gis chog pa bya zhing*/ rjes kyi bya ba'ang gcig gis rung ngo*/ /'di ni lag len cung zad bsdus pa yin la/ cung zad rgyas par spro na rjes gnang dang po de nyid legs par bsgrubs nas/ slob ma la'ang rjes gnang dang po'i thugs kyi rjes gnang yan chad dngos gzhi rnams grub pa na/ de'i mchod pa kha gsos rjes chog byas la/ slar yang tshom bu gsar pa bkod/ mchod pa dang gtor ma gsar du bsham thub na legs shing*/ de bzhin min na kha gsos la/ rjes gnang gnyis pa bsgrubs/ de dag gi bar du slob ma rnams phyag 'tshal nyer gcig dang yan lag bdun pa sogs 'don/ sgrub thabs zin mtshams su rjes gnang gnyis pa de nyid kyi dngos gzhi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang rnams bya/ yang sngar bzhin sgrub pa sogs nyi ma de nyid la ci 'grub byed pa yin zhing*/ ci tsam byed pa rnams rdzogs pa na/ rjes gnang rjes ma de'i thugs kyi rjes gnang song mtshams su gtso bos ji ltar sogs slob mas rjes kyi bya ba rnams byas te/ de'i rjes su mdun bskyed de'i rjes chog bya'o/ /spyir lag len rgyas bsdus kyi rim pa 'di dag gsung rgyun dang mthong ba brgyud pa las rtogs pa gal che'o/ /lam 'di nyid las mchog brnyes pa/ /grub chen nyi ma sbas pa'i bzhed/ /sgrol ma nyer gcig sgrubs pa'i thabs/ /slob ma rjes 'dzin dang bcas pa/ /lag len rgyun ni ma chad kyang*/ /nyer mkho go bde'i yi ge ni/ /sngon chad gsal po ma mthong zhing*/ /blo ldan gzhan gyi'ang bskul ba'i phyir/ /tā ra nā thas sbyar ba yin/ /zha ེ sa pa sgrol ma nyer gcig nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs kyi sgrub pa'i thabs mdo tsam shin tu gsal ba 'di ni/

rigs dang tshul khrims dang thos pa la sogs pa lugs gnyis kyi yon tan du mas mngon par mtho ba'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chos kyi rje mi pham rdo rje bdud 'joms zhes bya ba'i gsung gis bskul ba'i ngor/ tshul 'di dag gi chos skor la yang cung zad sbyangs pa/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā tha zhes bya bas/ rang lo sum cu rtsa gcig pa la sbyar ba'o/ /kuna~X nas dga~X' bar grags pa'i chos/ /gzhung dang yig sna la sogs pa/ /rgya bod gsung rab mtha' yas las/ /yang snyinga~X 'dril po~Xr byas 'di mtshar/ /sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ /nyi ma sbas pa'i lugs sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gi sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te bcu bdun pa'o// //zhus dag /maṅga laṃ/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ kun mkhyen rgyal ba thams cad kyi/ /bka' yi srung ma chos skyong che/ /rin chen mang la rab btud de/ /rgyal chen ser po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /bris sku rten rdzas mchod gtor sogs 'dzom par byas la/ bgegs gtor btang*/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ gsang bdag gos sngon can gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ slar yang oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa dz+wa la raṃ dz+wa la raṃ phaṭa raṃ phaṭa raṃ/ zhes phyogs kun tu bsangs gtor bya/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ byang phyogs nas rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i mchod yon 'di/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha oṃ āḥhūṃ/ de bzhin du zhabs bsil nas rol mo 'i bar pād+yaṃ nas shab+ta 'i bar du spel/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos sras nor mang ldan/ /gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid chags shing*/ /sprin bral nyi 'od stong gi gzi ldan pa/

/'dod dgu'i char 'bebs mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod cing*/ mkha' khyab yid 'ong lha rdzas dngos kun dang*/ / zhes sogs spro na yan lag bdun pa bya/ bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis chog /bdag nyid phyag na rdo rjer gsal ba'i gnas gsum nas 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum du thim pas 'od du zhu nas stong pa nyid du gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ rnams las srung 'khor 'byung bzhi brtsegs pa gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bhuṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan pa/ kha nang ltas khor yug tu bskor ba'i shar shel/ lho baiḍūr+ya/ nub pad+ma rā gabyang dzaṃ bu chu bo'i gser las grub pa/ phyogs re re nas ka ba nyis stong lnga brgya lnga brgyas btegs pa'i gdung ring dang*/ gdung thung gis mdzes par phub pa/ phyi rol du dpyangs pa'i dra ba dra phyed/ pha gu shar bu mda' yab sogs rgyan thams cad dang bcas pa/ dbus su rin po che'i khang bzang gsum brtsegs su yod pa/ sa 'og tu gter gyi khang pa bco lnga dang bcas pa/ phyi rol du 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ 'khor sa dang po la phyogs mtshams brgyad du khang bzang brgyad/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol yongs su bskor ba'o/ /dbus kyi pho brang gi nang du hrīḥlas sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i saṃ las seng ge dkar po/ de'i steng du bai ser po la yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan bai yig gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dpal dang 'byor pa phun sum tshogs pa thams cad bsdus te bai yig la thim/

de yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po ngal gsos po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po ches mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ g.yon na gter gyi ne'u les yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char 'bebs pa bsnams pa/ ne'u le la mig mngon du phyogs pa'i seng ge dkar po lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa nyal stabs su gnas pa'i steng na rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal nas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa/ nyi ma 'bum dus gcig tu shar ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ rin po che'i thor tshugs dang dbu rgyan la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yas nas nyi ma dang g.yon pa nas zla ba 'char ba/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod la mnga' brnyes pa'i sku can du gyur pa la/ lha klu gnod sbyin mthu bo che du ma dang*/ gnod sbyin bye bas bskor ba'o/ /phyogs mtshams kyi khang pa brtsegs pa brgyad la/ shar du dzaṃ las dzam+bha la ser po rin po che bsnams pa/ lhor paṃ las gang ba bzang po ser po rin po che'i bum pa gang ba 'dzin pa/ nub tu maṃ las nor bu bzang po dkar po nor bu 'dzin pa/ byang du keṃ las ku be ra nag po ral gri 'dzin pa/ shar lhor saṃ las yang dag shes ser po ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gaṃ las 'brog gnas nag po rin po che'i mdung dmar 'dzin pa/ nub byang du paṃ las lnga rtsen ser skya khang brtsegs 'dzin pa/ byang shar du paṃ las dzaṃ po 'khyil pa dkar po g.yas gri dang g.yon phub 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams shing*/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i rta la chibs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras pa/ dpa' zhing brjid la mi sdug pa'i cha byad can rnams rang rang gi 'khor dang bcas pa/ 'khor sa bar pa na klu chen brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ 'khor sa tha ma na lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs rnams sku mdog ma nges pa/

mi sdug cing brjid la rngam pa/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa/ 'khor sa tha ma de nyid kyi nang rim na/ sde dpon nyi shu rtsa brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar nag ral gri dang phub 'dzin pa rnams dang*/ phyi rim la stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis po thams cad sku mdog ljang nag go cha dang bcas pa/ mdung dang ral gri 'dzin pa rnams rang rang gi 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa/ thams cad kyang g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa'o/ /spos sbyor bsreg cing*/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ 'od zer gyi sne la khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa byung ste/ rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ mgon po kun gshegs thugs dam can/ /da lta snyigs ma lnga yi dus/ /thams cad nyon mongs 'dam bying pas/ /mtshams med lnga ni kun spyod cing*/ /gzigs shing gshegs pa'i gnas ngan yang*/ /shākya seng ge'i spyan sngar khyod/ /thugs dam gang bzhes de dgongs la/ /'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /sems can kun la sman slad du/ /byang phyogs gnas na bzhugs pa rnams/ /sems can don phyir gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ bai swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ bai ring po brjid dang ldan pa mig 'dzum sum cu so gnyis kyi yun tshad du brjod/ a mṛ ta' ི sngags kyis phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ rgyal po'i thugs kar pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi 'dab ma re re la bai bzhi bzhi/ bdag mdun gyi thugs 'od zer gyi lcags kyus sbrel bar gyur/ oṃ rat+na mu ka ṭa a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ zhes cod pan gyis dbang bskur/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis gong bzhin phul/ rin chen gdugs dang gser nya dang*/

/gter chen bum pa pad+ma bzang*/ /dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u/ /mchog gi rgyal mtshan 'khor lo sogs/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis stsol ba'i phyir/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pā ri wā ra aṣ+ta maṅga laṃ pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūṃ/ phun tshogs 'khor lo rin po che/ /dri med btsun mo khyim bdag dang*/ /cang shes rta dang glang po dang*/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcod pa'i/ /dmag dpon rin chen sna bdun rnams/ /bdag gi bsam pa yongs rdzogs phyir/ /rgyal chen sras dang btsun mor bcas/ /'khor dang bcas pas bzhes su gsol/ /sab+ta rat+na/ yid 'ong nags tshal ral gri dang*/ khang bzang mal cha lha yi gos/ /sbrul gyi pags pa lham la sogs/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /u pa sap+ta rat+na/ me long gi haṃ ba zho dang*/ /dur ba bil ba li khri dang*/ /nyungs kar la sogs bkra shis rdzas/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /aṣ+ta maṅga la dra bya/ yid 'ong gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra/ / yid 'dzin dri dang ro brgya'i zas/ /'jam mnyen 'khril chags reg bya'i mchog/ rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /pañca ka ma gu ṇa/ bstod pa ni/ hūṃ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sa brgyad dbang phyug khyod la bstod/ /btsun mo bzhi dang sras bzhi dang*/ khyad par las sgrub gnod sbyin brgyad/ /nor mchog ster ba'i klu chen brgyad/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ /dgra bgegs ma lus gzhom pa dang*/ /'byor ba'i longs spyod phun tshogs shing*/ /'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /gzhan don lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ /

de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la/ tad+ya thā/ hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ hi li hi li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ki li ki li ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ ku ru ku ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tu ru tu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ su ru su ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ tsu ru tsu ru ma ṇi bha dra/ oṃ e h+ye hi/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha sarba ar+tha me sā dha ni/ tad+ya tha/ su dha ni/ su ra s+ya/ su ma ti/ su pu ṣi/ hi li mi li swāhā/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyis sngags so/ /oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ya swāhā/ gtso bo'i snying po'o/ / oṃ bai swāhā/ nye snying ngo*/ oṃ dzam+bha la ye swāhā/ oṃ purba bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ ku be ra ye swāhā/ oṃ saṃ pra dza na ye swāhā/ oṃ gu h+ya tha na ye swāhā/ oṃ pañci ka ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa la ye swāhā/ 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad po rnams kyi sngags so/ /de ltar ci nus par bzlas nas/ thun gyi mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dhas bgegs bskrad/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod kyi nang du khaṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ de nyid kyi mtha' skor du kaṃ las bum pa/ baṃ las khrus kyi rdzing bu/ khaṃ las dpag bsam gyi shing dang*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba mo la sogs pas bskor ba dang*/ gtor ma'i steng du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhu ba las kha dog dri ro nus pa'i mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ lan gsum/ a kā ro sogs dang*/ ru ru sogs dang*/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya rnams lan gsum mam bdun bdun gyis rgya cher spel/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa i daṃ bā liṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma ya rak+ṣan+tu ma ma sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha ma ma sarba karma sā dha a mo gha ya swāhā/

zhes lan bdun la sogs pas gtso bo dang*/ oṃ dzam+bha la ye i daṃ sogs rang rang so so'i ming sngags spel bas/ rta bdag brgyad dang*/ oṃ aṣ+ta nā ga sha ta sa ha sra ko ṭi yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa i daṃ sogs kyis 'khor spyi la 'bul/ bsdu na/ a kā ro'am/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye sa pa ri wā ra sogs kyis phul kyang chogade nas bstod pa ni/ bsdus pa gong bzhin nam/ shin tu bsdus par na/ gnod sbyin rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /nor la dbang bsgyur 'dod yon char du 'bebs/ /dbul ba'i gdung sel mgon po thugs rje can/ /rgyal po 'khor dang bcas la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pa tsam gyis kyang chog la/ cung zad rgyas par spro na/ rin chen pho brang dam pa na/ /mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /ngal gsos dge ba stobs po che/ /sems dpa'i skyil krung dag gis bzhugs/ /g.yas na rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin/ / g.yon na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams/ /sku ni gser gyi 'od pas mdzes/ /zhal nas rin chen char pa 'bebs/ /thugs rjes phongs pa las sgrol mdzad/ /rin chen rgyan rnams kun gyis brgyan/ /byang phyogs rgyal por sku yang sprul/ /rnam thos sras su mtshan yang grags/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbu la rin chen cod pan gsol/ /yon tan rdzogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sde po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan gyi dpung rnams 'joms par byed/ /stobs po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bum pa bzang pos rnam par brgyan/ /dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*/ /rdzing bu bzang po 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /gter bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dzam+bha la ni gser gyi mdog/rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u le g.yas pa na/ /rin chen bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang ba bzang po sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng na bzhugs/ /g.yon pa ne'u= bum pa bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/

/ nor bu bzang po sku mdog dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul rta= g.yon pa= nor bu bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ku be ra ni sku mdog nag/rdzu 'phrul rta= g.yon pa= ral gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag shes ni sku mdog ser/ /rdzu 'phrul rta= g.yon pa= gser gri bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'brog gnas sku mdog nag po la/ /rdzu 'phrul= g.yon pa= mdung dmar bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lnga rtsen sku mdog ser skya la/ /rdzu 'phrul= g.yon pa= khang brtsegs bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni dkar/ /rdzu 'phrul= g.yon pa= gri phub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /klu chen brgyad ni sku mdog ser/ /rin chen sbrul gyi gdengs kas brjid/ /phyag gnyis 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs pa'i/ /nor bu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shar du ring po mig bzang dang*/ / gang po ser skya sa pa gnas/ /seng ge nye seng dung can dang*/ /dga' ba shin du sa pa lho/ /seng ge seng ge'i ral pa dang*/ /bla ma ser skya nag po nub/ /'dzin pa 'dzin dga' brtson skyong dang*/ khyab 'jug nye nag byang du'o/ /lnga spyod nyi ma byang shar na/ /me ru tshigs lnga ser po bzla/ /ri mnyam me ni lho nub tu'o/ /ser can rlung ni nub byang na/ /gnod sbyin sde dpon nyi shu brgyad/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /smug nag rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /gri phub 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbang po zla ba chu zla dang*/ /skye bdag gdos pa'i rgyal mtshan dang*/ /dbang ldan tsan dan 'dod pa'i gtso/ /mgrin ngan mgul nges pa ṭi dang*/ /nor bu nor spyod dgra rab dang*/ /nyer lnga dang ni ri mnyam dang*/ /gser can gang po seng ldeng dang*/ /g.yon phyogs lha dang ba glang skyong*/ /'brog gnas mi yi rgyal po dang*/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog tshig lnga ser/ / bzhin bzang dang ni ring po dang*/ /dri za sna tshogs 'bras bu gsum/ /mgul gsum lcags mdung ring po dang*/ /lha las byung ba'i ma ldan te/

/sa ga'i rigs las byung ba yi/ /stobs chen sum cu rtsa gnyis yin/ /steng 'og phyogs mtshams bsrung zhing skyong*/ /ljang nag gri mdung 'dzin la bstod/ /lha rgyal dkar po rdo rje 'dzin/ /klu rgyal dkar po sbrul zhags bsnams/ /gnod sbyin ser po ne'u le bsnams/ /dri za dmar po rgyud mangs can/ /lha min sngon po go mtshon 'dzin/ /mkha' lding gser mdog gshog pa rgyas/ /mi ci'i rgyal po rta mgo can/ /ltos 'phye sngon po sbrul mgo can/ /lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams/ /kun kyang rang mdog rgyan gyis brgyan/ /phyag g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs dang*/ /g.yon pa ne'u le 'dzin la bstod/ /de ltar bstod cing rab bsngags pas/ /bdag cag 'khor bcas bsrung ba dang*/ /'dod pa'i don rnams 'grub pa dang*/ /bgegs rnams ma lus med par mdzod/ /tshe dang bsod nams 'phel ba dang*/ /'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa dang*/ khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba dang*/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa rgyas par mdzod/ / spro na/ byang phyogs skyong ba nas/ myur du 'grub par mdzod/ kyi bar kyang brjod/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ bai ring po brjod pas pad 'dab kyi bai rnams gshegs/ 'od kyi lcags kyu bkrol bar bsam/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can sogs dang*/ badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa byang phyogs su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs par brjod do/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad mu khyud dang bcas pa bri/ de'i steng du rten gtor khang bzang gsum brtsegs 'khor sa rim pa gsum sogs sgom don dang mthun pa 'god pa rgyas pa'i lugs dang*/ zlum gtor gtso 'khor dgu pa 'god pa 'bring po'i lugs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal mi 'bri bar gtor ma kho na byed pa bsdus pa'i lugs gsum po gang gis kyang chog mod/ deng sang lag len rgyas pa la mdzad cing*/ de yang gtor ma byed pa rgya gar pa'i lugs dang*/

khang bzang byed pa rgya nag gi lugs yin gsung*/ de'i mdun nam g.yas phyogs su yi dam dang chos skyong gi 'bur gtor bsham/ mchod pa dang spyan gzigs gzhan rnams kyang ci bde bar bkod nas/ bgegs gtor btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ gos sngon can gyi bdag bskyed dang*/ gtor 'bul sngon du 'gro bas/ gong du bstan pa ltar mdun bskyed chos skyong chen po rnam thos sras 'khor bcas bskyed cing mchod gtor 'bul ba dang*/ bzlas pa sogs rjes chog ma gtogs gong du bstan pa rnams tshang bar byas/ slob ma rnams khrus byas/ gos gsar pa gyon/ phyag dang me tog bkye bsdu sngon du 'gro bas/ bgegs gtor btang la bgegs bskrad/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ chos bshad dang 'di'i lo rgyus ci rigs par bshad/ maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcugakhro phu ba'i lag len ltar na/ rdo rje 'dzin pa sogs kyi gsol btab byed/ dkyus kyi lag len ltar na/ gnod sbyin gter skyong rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /che mchog bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan rdzogs/ /sgrub mchog bdag la mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub ma lus dus 'dir stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum/ khro phu ba'i lag len la rgyun bshags mi mdzad do/ /dngos gzhi ni/ thog mar slob ma phyag rdor gyi mngon rtogs rigs bdag gi bar rdzogs par phogamadun gyi gtor ma la dmigs su bcug ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa nas/ thugs kar hūṃ gi bar gong bzhin bsgom pa las/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe rol mo drag la yun ring bar byed/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ mi 'jigs seng ge'i khri steng nas/ phyag kyang 'tshal gyi bar gyis bstod/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ / bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros mdun bskyed rgyal po'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas sngags 'phreng rin chen 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba lta bu gyur/ de las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul 'phongs bsal/ 'jig rten khams kyi dngos grub thams cad bsdus te sngags 'phreng la thim/ de nyid slob ma'i kha sgo nas zhugs te snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ de nas sngags 'phreng 'khor lo ltar 'khor ba la sems gtad du bcug ste/ gzungs tshar gsum/ gtso bo'i snying po brgya rtsa brgyad/ rta bdag brgyad kyi snying po tshar bdun bdun rjes bzlos byed pa'am/ bsdu na thams cad lan gsum res chogaslob mas slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum/ slob dpon gyi bgrang 'phreng slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gong bzhin mdun bskyed la mchod bstod bya/ slob ma gsang bdag gi nga rgyal brtan po bskyed du bcug la/ gtor ma lag tu gtad de/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing*/ gtor ma'i bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ de rjes kho phu ba'i phyag len ltar na bar chad zhi bar bya ba'i phyir drag po'i rjes gnang mdzad de/ 'di ltar na gong spyan 'dren gyi skabs phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad mi dgos/ 'on kyang slob ma yi dam gyi bsnyen song yin na ma gtogs/ drag po'i rjes gnang bka' gnyan pas ci thod thod du mi bya'o/ /thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas slob ma 'di'i rjes bzlos byed du bcug ste/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ mi'i 'jig rten du bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la chos dang*/ longs spyod dang*/ rin po che'i phung po la sogs pa shin tu rgyas par gyur cig/ ces lan gsum dang*/ spro na/ 'dod pa'i khams na longs spyod pa'i/ /dngos grub bdag gis kun thob nas/ /bla ma yi dam dkon mchog mchod/ /'phrin las rnam bzhi rdzogs par shog/rin chen sna bdun longs spyad nas/ /gter gyi dngos grub phyugs rnams dang*/

/gzi brjid dang ldan chos skyong gis/ /rtag tu bdag la srung gyur cig/ bar mdzod 'bru dang 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /rgyal mtshan 'khor los bsgyur ba dang*/ / thogs med rdzu 'phrul grub nas ni/ /las mchog bde la gnas par shog/ ces pa'am/ bsdu na tshigs bcad tha ma lan gsum brjod/ khro phu ba'i lugs la smon lam 'di mi mdzad/ rjes khas blangs/ maṇ+ḍal/ yon 'bul ba rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ mdun bskyed kyi rjes chog gong du bstan pa bzhin bya/ dga' ston yang rgya cher spel lo/ /rnam sras sgrub thabs kuna~X dga~X'i phul/ /spal ti'i bzhed pa gzhung bsrang nas/ /lugs gzhan khyad par gsal bkod pa/ /snyinga~X po~X'i yi ge ngo mtshar rmad/ /rgyal po chen po rnam sras ser chen gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dbang gi las la cher bsngags shing*/ /pha rol g.yul rnams 'joms la dpa'/ /ngal gsos rgyal po'i sgrub thabs ni/ /mdor bsdus tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /rgyal po mer chen gyi sgrub thabs shes nas 'di la 'jug par bya ste/ mchod gtor bshams/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ e yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor bh+ruṃ las gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa/ rdo rje sa gzhi la gnas shing rdo rje rwa bas bskor ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can du gnas pa'i dbus su/ 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa'i lte ba la sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i rta sngo nag lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/ gser gyi sga dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du bai dmar po/ de las 'od 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khams gsum dbang du bsdus/ slar thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan gnyis dmar la zlum pa/ smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag g.yas mdung dmar dar chen bcas 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas sgrub pa po la dngos grub kyi char 'bebs pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' lhab lhub dang*/ bse khrab gsol ba/ gser gyi ske rags can/ dbu la rmog zhu dang*/ zhabs la bse'i lo khram gsol ba/ khams gsum ma lus dbang du bsdu ba'i 'od zer 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du sha yig las sras gza' mchog chen po rā hu la sku mdog dud kha sku stong srin po'i lus la sku smad sbrul 'jug tu 'khyil ba/ dbu dgu'i steng na bya rog gi mgo yod pa/ mgo lus thams cad mig gis gang ba/ phyag g.yas chu srin gyi rgyal mtshan dang*/ g.yon sbrul zhugs 'dzin pa'o/ /lho ru ra las gnod sbyin dha na/ nub tu ma las gnod sbyin ka la/ byang du na las gnod sbyin ku be ra/ de'i phyi rol lha snam gyi phyogs bzhir/ shar du sha las gnod sbyin bum sna/ lho ru sa las gnod sbyin dung sna/ nub tu ha las gnod sbyin sna gsum/ byang du aṃ las gnod sbyin sna bo che/ de ltar bdun ka'ang thung zhing gsus po che ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /shar sgor dzaḥlas lcags kyu ma dkar mo/ lho sgor hūṃ las zhags pa ma ser mo/ nub sgor baṃ las lcags sgrog ma dmar mo/ byang sgor hoḥlas dril bu ma ljang khu/ thams cad 'dzum khro g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /

rgyas pa la spro na/ bstod pa ltar bskyed chog kyang rgyas pa bzhin bya'o/ /de nas spyan 'dren nas dbu brgyan pa'i bar gser chen dang 'dra/ mchod pa'ang spro na gser chen ltar rgyas par phul ba'i rjes la/ 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i thugs dam bskang ba rnams bya/ bsdu na ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ bstod pa ni/ bai/ rin chen mgon po bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun bas sngar sangs rgyas/ /'gro ba'i bsam pa rdzogs mdzad pa/ /ngal gsos po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'og min gnas mchog bla med nas/ /byang chub sems dpa' rin chen mang*/ /'gro ba'i re 'dod skong mdzod pa/ /thugs rje can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /drang srong rnam mang thos pa dang*/ /btsun mo dpal tshul bzang mo yi/ /sras su smon lam rdzogs mdzad pa/ /rnam thos sras la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog na/ /bzang po'i khri la bzhugs nas ni/ /gter chen bzhi la mnga' mdzad pa/ /dzam+bha la la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha chen khyod ni khros pa'i tshe/ /spyan rtsa dmar po bzlog pa yis/ /dgra la mi nad phyugs nad gtong/ /lus ngan po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gshin rje ya mān+ta ka yis/ / gdong dmar 'dul bar dbang bskur ba/ /gshin rje dmar po srog gi bdag/ ma ru rtse la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du/ /rgyal ba shākya thub pa yis/ /chos 'khor bsrung mar dbang bskur ba/ /sgo ba che la phyag 'tshal lo/ / gru gu'i yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /gru gu rta dmag rgyal po yis/ /srung ma chen por dbang bskur ba/ /ku be ra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgya nag yul du gshegs pa'i tshe/ /rgya rje dar btsan dmar po yis/ /te de'i srung mar mnga' gsol ba/ / mdung dmar can la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bod yul dbus kyi bsam yas su/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /srung ma chen por dbang bskur ba/ /chos kyi rgyal por phyag 'tshal lo/ /chos skyong rgyal po rdzu 'phrul can/ khyod kyi mthu stobs bsam mi khyab/

/sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /da lta bdag gi mgon mdzod cig/sras mchog dam pa rā hu la/ /mgo dgu srin po'i cha lugs can/ / chu srin rgyal mtshan sbrul zhags 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ / gnod sbyin dha na sku mdog ser/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs gnyis pa/ /rtse gsum thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad khyod la bstod/ / tshig rkang gnyis pa dang bzhi pa de kho na bzhin du sbyar ba/ gnod sbyin ka la 'jigs gzugs smug/zhal gcig phyag gnyis= be con thod khrag 'bar ba 'dzin/ /gdug pa= ku be ra ni sku mdog ljang*/ /zhal gcig= dbyug tho 'bar ba thod khrag 'dzin/ /gdug pa= dregs pa bum sna dmar ljang la/ /zhal gcig= rgyal mtshan dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa= dregs pa dung sna ser ljang la/ / zhal gcig= mdung dmar dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /gdug pa= dregs pa sna gsum ljang nag la/ /zhal gcig= mdung dmar rtse gsum ne'u le 'dzin/ / gdug pa= dregs pa sna chen dkar ljang la/ /zhal gcig= dbyung tho 'bar ba ne'u le 'dzin/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ shar phyogs sgo srung chen mo ni/ /dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ khro bzhad brkyang bskum gar gyis rol/ /lcags kyu 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ / de bzhin du tshigs rkang gsum la 'don pa spos la/ lho phyogs sgo srung= ser mo zhal= khro bzhad= zhags pa 'dzin la= nub phyogs= dmar mo= khro bzhad= lcags sgrog= byang phyogs= ljang nag= khro bzhad= dril bu= phyi rol khor yug la gnas pa'i/ /gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs rnams kun/ /lcags kyu dang ni ne'u le 'dzin/ /las kun sgrub mdzad khyod la bstod/ / de nas bzlas dmigs gsal btab la/ oṃ mahā rā dza yak+ṣa sa ma ye bai shra ma ṇa ye sarba tsit+ta rat+na hri hri dza dzaḥ zhes ci nus bzla/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung raṃ las me/ a las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum/

oṃ las thod pa'i nang du bh+ruṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ rnams las sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod byed gdug pa can thams cad bkug ste bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi phung po chen po dang gtor ma gcig tu 'dres nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ sogs ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra/ a mṛ ta 'i mthar/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ rin chen mdzes pa'i pho brang na/ khams gsum dbang du byed pa'i lha/ /rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ /mdung dmar 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bai byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /sras dang blon po sgo ma dang*/ /gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas/ /'khor bcas ma lus thams cad kun/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams/ /bu sdug bzhin du bskyang ba dang*/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par mdzod/ /gzhan yang bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ / log par zhugs pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /de yi phru ma gzhom pa dang*/ /gtan nas brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /de ltar bcol ba'i las 'di dag/dam tshig ldan pa khyed rnams kyis/ /sngon gyi dam tshig rjes dgongs la/ /ma g.yel da lta 'grub par mdzod/ ces 'phrin las gzhol/ bskang ba rgyas par byed na skabs 'dir bya/ rjes chog ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /de'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na legs par 'grub na sgom don dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor/ rdul mtshon nam/ ras bris dgram/ bsdu na pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad kyi steng du/ gtor ma gru gsum la mdung dmar sngags can btsugs/ bris sku dang mchod gtor bsham/ dung chos dri bzang gis gang ba dang*/ rdo dril rol mo sogs tshang bar byas la/ gsang bdag gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas gong bzhin 'dod don gsol btab kyi bar du mdun bskyed kyi cho ga grub pa na rjes gnang bya ste/

gsol gdab ni/ thugs rje chen po'i gter mnga' ba/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ / bdag sogs dbul phongs bskyab pa'i phyir/ /gter chen grub pa bdag la stsol/ / zhes so/ /de nas/ rgyal chen rnam mang thos pa ni/ khyod kyis brtson par mchod nus sam/ /'phrin las bcol dang dam tshig rnams/ /rjes su mthun par byed nus sam/ / zhes slob dpon gyis dris pa la/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs rjes bzlos kyi lan gdab/ rgyun bshags nas/ mchod bstod kyi bar ser chen nyid kyis rigs 'gre/ lcags kyi rdo rje slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag 'di ni ye shes rdo rje ste/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kun gyi bdag/dregs pa spyi'i gnyen po mchogakhyod la bdag gis deng 'dir bskur/ / oṃ mahā a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ dregs pa spyi 'dul ba'i rjes gnang gtor ma chen po snying gar gtad la/ mdun bskyed las rgyal po mdung dmar can gnyis pa chad nas/ slob ma'i snying gar thim lus dang grib ma'i tshul du bzhugs par mos/ oṃ bai rā dza sa mā ya sid+dhi dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ 'di ni rgyal po chen po ste/ khams gsum dbang du sdud pa'i lha/ /dngos grub gnyen po chen po 'dis/ khyod la dbang bskur thob gyur cig/kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ /wāka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūṃ/ zhes sku dngos kyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdung dmar lag tu gtad la/ 'di ni dbang gi mdung dmar te/ /tshe dang bsod nams rgyas par byed/ /'gro ba thams cad dbang du sdud/ /dbang gi las kyis dbang bskur sbyin/ /oṃ bai rā dza ma ma dung dung phaṭa/ dbang gi las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /dung phor nas dri bzang lce la bzhagagator ma nas cung zad bcad de dngos grub tu sbyin/ bdud rtsi'i ro mchog dam pa yis/ /zas nor longs spyod char ltar 'bebs/ / 'jig rten gsum gyi bcud thams cad/ /bdud rtsir bsgyur nas gtad cing bskur/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta sid+dhi hūṃ hūṃ/

dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /mthar gtor dbang bskur ba'i lugs kyang 'dug mod kyi/ 'di nyid kyi gtor dbang ni sku dngos kyi rjes gnang nyid yin pas/ logs su mi dgos par mngon no/ /smon lam gdab pa man chad kyang ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ / rgyal chen sgrub thabs ngo mtshar rmad/ /gter ma kuna~X gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rab dga~X'i snyinga~X po~X mdor bsdus tsam/ / rjes gnang bcas pa gsal bar bris/ /mdung dmar can bya rgod gshongs kyi gter mar grags pa phyi sgrub rta sngon can gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rgyal po ngal gsos po/ /de la btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ / nor sgrub shin tu rmad byung ba/ /gsang sgrub ljang khu'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /'di'i cho ga spyi rnams ser chen gzhir bzhag pa la mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ tri las rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bai yig ljang khu las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i be con thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas dngos grub ster ba'i ne'u le brla g.yon pa la brten te bsnams pa/ zhi 'dzum sgeg la yan lag rags shing gsus khyim che ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ zhal nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon nas nyi zla 'char ba/ sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gter gyi bum pa'i steng na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i g.yon du phuḥyig las yum pad+ma gtsug phud ma sku mdog dmar mo/ g.yas nor bu dang g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ smad sbrul mjug tu 'khyil zhing sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /nor bdag gter la mnga' brnyes pa/ /klu rgyal tshogs la dbang yang bsgyur/

/rgyal chen yab yum 'khor bcas la/ /gus pas bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ yab kyi sngags ni ser chen dang 'dra/ oṃ nā ga ni ba su te ku ru ye swāhā/ yum gyi sngags so/ /gtor 'bul gyis sngags ser chen gyi gtor sngags bsdus pa des mdzad/ rjes gnang gi gsol btab dang*/ dri ba dri lan mdung dmar can gyi skabs bzhin byed/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ser chen dang 'dra/ srog 'khor ga'u bla rdor bcas pa yod na/ sgrub pa'i skabs maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su de 'jog cing*/ slob ma'i snying gar gtugs nas/ rgyal chen 'di la stsal nas ni/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes pa thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar mdzad/ de ma 'byor na bgrang 'phreng snying gar gtugs nas/ rgyal chen sogs brjod/ rten gyi gtor ma nor bu'i gzugs can kho na mdzad pa rnams khyad par ro/ /zangs dkar lots+tsha'i man ngag ni/ /kuna~X gyi mthar thug yin par bsngags/ /rgyas pa'i las sgrub ches dga~X' ba/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X'i yi ge'o/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras ljang ser be con ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ oṃ swā sti/ sangs rgyas rin chen mang po ni/ /res 'ga' byang chub sems dpa'i tshul/ /gzhan du gnod sbyin bdag por sprul/ /de la phyag 'tshal sgrub thabs bshad/ /'dir mdung dmar can gsang sgrub gar mkhan mchog gi sgrub thabs ni/ mdung dmar rta sngon can gyi skabs su bshad pa dang sgrub thabs rjes gnang ni spyi 'dra ba las/ rtain gtor dmar po zlum po nor bu 'bar ba'i dbyibs can gyis rtse mo mtshan pa zhig bshom/ gtor ma byin rlabs ser chen dang 'dra/ bya ba thams cad dmar ser gnyis kyi rigs 'gre ba las/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar g.yu 'brug sngon mo me'i ze ba can mgo g.yas su bstan pa/

de'i steng du bai yig dmar smug las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras gar mkhan mchog sku mdog dmar smug zhal gsum sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ phyag bco brgyad kyi dang po gnyis nor bus gang ba'i gzhong pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma bcu drug rim pa bzhin du/ rgyal mtshan dbyug to ral gri mda'/ /rtse gsum tho ba bi dza pur/ /mdung dmar rnams ni g.yas su'o/ /ne'u le pad+ma sgrags pa dang*/ /sbrul zhags 'khor lo rdo rje'i zhags/ /gzhu dang bum pa ri rab dang*/ /yongs 'du'i shing sdong g.yon na 'dzin/ /dar gyi na bza' dang*/ gser gyi go khrab mu tig gi rgyan can dang*/ sbrul dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa khro 'dzum ral pa'i thor tshugs can no/ /mdun du yum pad+ma gtsug phud ma dmar mo bum pa dang rin po che bsnams pa/ 'dab ma drug la mdun nas brtsam te g.yas bskor gyis/ sras nyi ma la dga' ba dkar po rin po che 'dzin pa lha'i cha lugs can/ nor bu bzang po dkar po lug gi mgo can rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ gang ba bzang po ser po rta'i mgo can bum pa 'dzin pa/ yang dag shes sngon po sha ba'i mgo can nor bu 'dzin pa/ sred spong dmar ser ra'i mgo can gre ba 'dzin pa/ blon po rgyal ba khyu mchog ljang khu glang po che'i mgo can gzhong pa 'dzin pa/ khyams su gnod sbyin dang klu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa'o/ / sngags ni/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ye/ na da ku be ra mahā bha ga bh+ya krit+ta bhi na dh+ya ma na sid+dhi swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /bstod pa'i skabs su/ dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /gar mkhan mchog gi gzugs 'dzin pa/ /btsun mo sras dang blon po dang*/ /rgyal phran 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / ces dang*/ gtor sngags kyi skabs/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa na da ku be ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes brjod/ rjes gnang mdung dmar can dang 'dra ba las/ mdung dmar lag tu gtor ba'i tshab tu/

zangs gzhong 'bru sna sman sna nor sna zas snas gang ba gtad la/ 'di ni rgyas pa'i gtor gzhong ste/ khyad par rigs brgyud phun sum tshogs/ /'phel zhing rgyas par byed pa yi/ /rgyas pa'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ bai rā dza puṣ+tiṃ ku ru a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ / zhes brjod pa khyad par ro/ /kuna~X nas gar mkhan mchog go zhes/ /dga~X' bar bsngags pa'i rnam thos bu/ /'khor bcas sgrub thabs rmad byung gi /yi ge snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig spel/ /rnam sras gsang sgrub dmar po gar mkhan mchog gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ shin tu zab pa'i man ngag ni/ /shog ril drug pa las byung ba'i/ /snyan grags rgya cher sgrub pa'i thabs/ /dmar po chos dung can de yin/ /sgrub thabs kyi yan lag ser chen ji lta ba bzhin las/ rten gtor zlum po dmar por byed/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ rin po che'i ri bo'i steng du rin po che'i khang bzang de'i nang du seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la/ bai yig dmar po las dung dkar bais mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dmar po 'od zer 'phro ba zhi zhing 'dzum la sgeg cing sha nyams rgyas pa/ phyag gnyis kyi dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba 'bud cing*/ sgrub pa po la snyan pa'i grags pas stong gsum khyab par mdzad pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin brgyad dang*/ gnod sbyin mo brgyad po thams cad kyang khams gsum dbang du bsdu ba'i cha lugs can dung dkar 'bud pa'o/ /

bstod pa ni/ rdo rje 'jigs byed lus ngan po/ /dpal dang grags pa rab 'phel ba/ /gsung mchog rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / ces bstod/ sngags ni/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ma ma kīrti puṣ+tiṃ ku ru swāhā/ lhag ma gtor chog dang*/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo thams cad ser chen nyid 'don pa spos pas chog/kuna~X la ma grags ches dkon yang/ khungs ma'i man ngag rab dga~X' ba/ /yig rnying don gyi snyinga~X po~X tsam/ /gsal bar bris pa e ma ho/ /rgyal chen rnam thos sras gsung mchog lus ngan po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel// ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsang bdag thugs las sprul pa ni/ /mngon spyod las kyi bdag por bsngags/ /rdo rje dra ga byed la btud nas/ /de yi sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /cho ga spyi phal cher ser chen dang 'dra ba las/ rten gtor nag po gru gsum snying gi gzugs lta bu bsham/ 'bul gtor mdung dmar can bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las gzhal yas khang drag po 'bar ba'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i dbus su/ gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i lte bar paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bai yig nag po las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar rab tu gnag la 'jigs pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas ka shi'i ras kyi ba dan dpyangs pa'i rdo rje'i dbyug tho nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon mchod rten nag po thugs kar 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum dmar la zlum zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ khro gnyer bsdus shing sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang dar gyi stod g.yogs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan can/ phrag gong g.yas g.yon nas nyi zla 'char ba/

sku stod nas bya gcan gdug pa'i tshogs dang*/ sku sked nas gnod sbyin srin po'i tshogs dang*/ sku smad nas seng ge sogs gcan zan gdug pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spro ba/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dam ma brgyad la phuḥyig nag po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ klu chen brgyad po thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag khro zhing mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag thugs kar thal mo sbyar bas nor bu 'dzin pa/ sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun bdun dang ldan zhing*/ smad sbrul 'jug tu 'khyil ba/ gtsug gi nor bu las 'od 'phro zhing zhal nas phugs kyi sgra sgrog pa/ phyi rol du gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang*/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ / sngags ni/ oṃ ni laṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi mahā yak+ṣa rā dza ku be ra/ bai ru dha ka sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga mdung dmar can dang 'dra/ bstod pa ni/ stobs chen mi sdug 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /gtum po ma rung tshar gcod pa/ /rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas rnams la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes brjod/ rjes gnang gi skabs/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo ser chen nyid 'don pa spos pas chog pa la/ gzhug gi smon lam gdab mi dgos/ slob ma yi dam gyi bsnyen song yin na gnad la dbab pa'i drag po'i rjes gnang de yang nges par mdzad/ dregs byed 'di la seng ge'i gdan byed pa dang*/ shing rta la bzhugs pa dang*/ na bza' 'jol ber gsol ba dang*/ go khrab sogs gsol ba byed pa'i lugs kyang yod pa gang mos su bya'o/ /kuna~X nas rab dga~X' rgyud gzhung dang*/ /'brel ba'i sgrub thabs yid ches can/ /yig sna shin tu mang po yi/ /nyer mkho snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam mo/ /rnam thos sras drag byed kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no//

//dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i srung ma mchog/rnam sras sgrub thabs 'brog gnas kyi/ /sngags rgyud las dang rjes mthun pa'i/ /drag po'i sgrub thabs bshad par bya/ /'di'i sgrub thabs dang*/ gtor ma'i bshom dang*/ byin rlabs sogs spyi rnams mdung dmar can dang mthun pa las/ rten gtor kha dog nag po dang*/ dam rdzas rnams kyang mgon po nag po bzhin byed/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkhar gnam lcags 'bar ba'i tsha tsha 'khrug pa'i sa gzhi la rwa gur gyi dbus su/ sprin nag 'khrug pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi gzhi la thod ril brtsigs pa'i gzhal yas khang zlum po sgo gcig pa/ phyi rol du dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor ba/ de'i dbus su bh+ruṃ las 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa lte ba mu khyud dang bcas pa/ ral gri'i phreng bas bskor ba'i dbus su/ chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi lte bar/ ru ṭa pho mo bsgral ba'i gdan/ phyogs kyi rtsibs bzhi la/ shar du zhe sdang 'o ma'i mtsho/ /lhor nga rgyal mar khu'i mtsho/ /nub tu 'dod chags khrag gi mtsho/ /byang du phrag tog gser gyi mtsho/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ hūṃ mthing nag las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can thams cad tshar bcad/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gnyis dgra bgegs la sdang mig tu lta ba/ mche ba gtsigs shing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri me 'bar ba 'phyar ba/ g.yon mda' dar leb rgan gyi mdog can khrag pa la bkal ba/ sku la dar nag gi ber chen bse khrab smug po dang bcas pa gsol ba/ dbu la lcags kyi rmog zhu gser gyi thig le can bsnams pa/ sma ra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba/ zhabs la sag lham g.yu ris can gsol ba/ baiḍūr+ya'i mdog can gyi rta mchog lus nyams rtsal dang ldan pa/

gser gyi sga dang phra men gyi yob can chibs pa/ shin tu 'jigs su rung ba srin po'i cha lugs can/ me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i bai yig mthing nag phyogs kyi mtsho bzhi'i dbus su/ shar du drag las bdud mo gshin rje mgo dgu ma nag mo phyag g.yas dung gi spu gri dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rin po ches brgyan pa/ ber dkar gsol zhing ba men ru yon la chibs pa/ lho ru raka las bdud mo gshin rje lag brgya ma ser mo g.yas lnga bcu ral gri dang*/ g.yon lnga bcu bdud zhags 'phyar ba/ sku stod la mi lpags dang*/ sku smad la stag lpags gsol ba/ ma he la chibs pa/ nub tu sha las bdud mo phung khrol ma dmar nag g.yas lcags kyu dang g.yon dgra snying 'dzin pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can zhal nas khrag gi zor 'phen pa/ g.yag rgod nag po la chibs pa/ byang du bh+yoḥlas bdud mo gsod byed ma ljang nag g.yas lnga na khram shing*/ g.yon lnga na bdud zhags glo snying dang bcas pa 'dzin pa/ sku stod la mi lpags dang sku smad la dred lpags gsol ba/ rkyang bu kha dkar la chibs pa/ thams cad kyang mi mgo'i do shal dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i bud med 'bum 'bum gyis bskor ba/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs chen bzhi la/ shar lhor ḍhṛ las yul 'khor srung dkar po pi wang 'dzin pa glang po che la zhon pa/ lho nub tu be las 'phags skyes po sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa ma he la zhon pa/ nub byang du bi las mig mi bzang dmar po sbrul zhags dang mchod rten 'dzin pa chu srin la zhon pa/ byang shar du be las ngal gsos po ljang nag dbyug tho dang ne'u le 'dzin pa seng ge la zhon pa/ thams cad kyang go cha gsol zhing ches khros pa'o/ / sngags ni drag sngags mang du yod kyang snying po/ oṃ be tra ka rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ zhes pa yin la/ bstod pa bsdus pa ni/

lha tshogs dbugs 'byin lha min 'joms la dpa'/ /mi bzad bdud kyi cha lugs bstan pa skyong*/ /byang phyogs rgyal po bdud rgyal rnam thos sras/ /'khor bcas sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la bstod/ / gtor chog kyang snying pos mgo drangs nas 'bul ba'i khyad ma gtogs mdung dmar can gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ pad+ma sngon po 'dab brgyad kyi khyad ma gtogs bshom dang bdag mdun mdung dmar can dang 'dra/ gsol btab nas dbu brgyan pa'i bar ser chen bzhin mdung dmar can bzhin dregs pa spyi'i dbang bskur/ sku dngos kyi rjes gnang yang mdung dmar can dang phal cher 'dra ba las/ 'di ni rgyal po chen po ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*/ /dgra bgegs 'dul zhing brlag mdzad pa/ /las kun sgrub pa'i dbang bskur sbyin/ /kā ya sid+dhi sogs 'don pa spo/ tsa ka li'am gtor ma lag tu gtad la bka' bsgo drag tu bya ba/ ral gri lag tu gtad la/ chos skyong rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /gdul dka' sna tshogs 'dul mdzad pa/ /shin tu gtum pa'i khro tshul gyis/ /ma rungs dgra bgegs tshar gcod cig/oṃ mahā a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ oṃ āḥhūṃ swāhā/ rdo rje dang ral gri lhan cig 'phyar du bcug ste/ yi dam spro ba lnga'am drugachos skyong gi spro ba gsum gyis dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i mos pa byed du bcugabagrang 'phreng slob ma'i snying gar gtugs la bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ rjes smon lam gdab pa man chad ser chen gyi skabs dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X tu drag shul che ba 'di/ /snubs kyi man ngag yin par grags/ /sgrub skor rgyas shing rab dga~X' ba'i/ /snyinga~X po~X nyer mkho tsam zhig bris/ /rnam sras nag po rta sngon gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ bla ma dang ni gsang ba'i bdag/rgyal chen 'khor bcas la btud nas/ /dkar po tshe 'dzin sgrub pa'i thabs/

/mdo tsam bdag gis bshad par bya/ /rten gtor zlum gtor dkar po gtso 'khor dgu pa'am khang bzang ma gang rung bya/ cho ga'i spyi rnams ser chen gyi rigs 'gre ba las/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang la bh+rūṃ las gzhal med khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa steng thog rim pa gsum du phub pa/ 'khor sa rim pa gsum dang bcas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar a las zla ba dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la saṃ las seng ge dkar po rin po ches brgyan pa/ de'i steng du bai dkar po las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ khams gsum snod bcud kyi bcud dang bkrag mdangs thams cad 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rnam par tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas dngos grub dgug pa'i lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon 'chi med ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i chu shel gyi bum pa gser gyi rdo rjes kha brgyan pa 'dzin pa/ zhi zhing sgeg la brjid pa'i nyams can/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la k+ṣa yig dkar po brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du dzaṃ bha la/ lho ru gang ba bzang po/ nub tu nor bu bzang po/ byang du ku be ra/ shar lhor yang dag shes/ lho nub tu 'brog gnas/ nub byang du lnga rtsen/ byang shar du pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li rnams thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po g.yas na lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar po dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ rta dkar po la chibs pa'o/ /'khor sa dang po la klu brgyad/ bar pa la gnod sbyin bye ba/ tha ma la sde dpon nyer brgyad dang*/ stobs chen so gnyis thams cad kyang dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi rnam pa can no/ / zhes dang*/ sngags ni/ oṃ bh+ruṃ ṇi ā yu ṣe hūṃ dzaḥ bstod pa ni/

gdong lnga nyi zla'i gdan steng na/ /bai las byung ba'i mgon po ni/ /kai la sha ltar sku mdog dkar/ /g.yas pa tshe 'gugs lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yon pa tshe yi shel bum bsnams/ /sku la rin chen sna tshogs spras/ /lha yi nor ster khyod la 'dud/ /tshe dang nor gyi dngos grub stsol/ / zhes pa'o/ /gtor chog kyang ser chen kho na dang 'dra ba las gtor sngags bsdus pas chog/rjes gnang gi cho ga ni/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab brgyad tshom bu dgu dang bcas pa la/ bum pa spyi dang mthun par bshams/ rten gtor 'cha' ba dang*/ mi 'cha' ba'i lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'cha' ba'i tshe bum pa'i g.yas su bshams/ mdun bskyed sgrub tshul ser chen dang 'dra ba las/ thog mar bum pa sgrub pa dang ste/ bum pa'i nang du lha dgu bskyed/ /sgrub tshul spyi dang 'dra/ de nas rten gtor ram bris sku yod na de la dmigs/ med na mdun bskyed kyi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin/ bum pa la dmigs nas/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye/ ā yu ṣe/ ā yur+dz+nyā na sid+dhi a pa ra mi ta tshe bh+rūṃ/ zhes pa brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ rjes gnang la yang cho ga'i gzhi ser chen dang 'dra ba las/ gsol btab/ sgrub mchog bdag la tshe dang ye shes kyi/ / zhes 'don pa spo/ sku'i rjes gnang la slob ma nyid lha tshogs su bskyed cing*/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i skabs/ snying po'i mthar a be sha ya a btags pa mang du bzlas/ de rjes slob dpon gsang bdag dang*/ mdun bskyed rgyal chen 'khor bcas kyi dbang bskur bar mos su bcug la/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ / sogs kyi mthar/ bum bzlas kyi sngags brjod cing*/ bum pa spyi bor bzhagabum chu 'thung du bcug pas 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub thob par bsam/ de rjes rin po che'i dbu rgyan bcing ba sogs byed cing*/ rten gtor med na/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi skabs/ bris sku'am bum pa mgo thog tu bzhag nas bka' bsgo byed/

yod na rten gtor spyi bor bzhag la gtor dbang bka' bsgo byed pa yin te/ ser chen dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad par de rnams so/ /'di la 'khor sa mi byed pa dang*/ 'khor sa gsum la/ nang rim gyi sde dpon nyer brgyad/ stobs chen so gnyis/ gnod sbyin bye ba rnams 'god pa'i lugs kyang yod pa gang bder bya'o/ /kuna~X du zab cing dga~X' bar grags/ /yid la ngo mtshar cher bskyed pa'i/ /sgrub yig snga phyi mang po las/ /snyinga~X po~X bsdus pa de tsam lags/ /rnam sras dkar po tshe 'dzin gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ oṃ swā sti/ nam mkha' mdzod la gus btud nas/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol phyin rdzogs pa/ /nor gyi dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs/ /nor bu lta bu bshad par bya/ /dpal he ru ka'am gsang bdag gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ gtor ma ri rab gling bzhi'i rnam pa can maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du nor sna sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod du bzhag/mchod gtor sna tshogs kyis kyang bskor la/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ suṃ las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor bh+ruṃ las gzhal yas khang*/ de'i dbus su seng ge la gnas pa'i zla ba'i steng du bai yig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rgyal po rnam thos sras sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig spyan gsum pa/ mche ba cung zad gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas rin chen phreng bas mtshan pa'i dbyug tho dang*/ g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le dku la brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang gser gyi go cha gsol ba/ rin po che'i rgyan kyis brgyan zhing*/ sems dpa'i phyed skyil gyis seng ge'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gzi brjid nyi ma stong dang 'dra ba'o/ /gtso bo nyid grub pa na/ lus dang grib ma'i tshul gyis dzam+bha la la sogs pa rta bdag chen po brgyad sku mdog phyag mtshan spyi dang mthun/ thams cad kyang rta sngon po la chibs pa gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs kyis bskor ba'o/

/phyi rol du klu chen brgyad kar sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i bar na rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ oṃ rat+na a bhi ṣiñca muṃ/ zhes dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/

mchod bstod gzhan dang mthun/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa rnams man ngag bzhin shes par byas la/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa hūṃ swāhā/ bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa rat+na gu h+ye sid+dhi a be sha ya dzaḥ sgrub pa'i sngags so/ / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa rat+na gu h+ye a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ a pa ya/ rat+na sid+dhi hūṃ hūṃ/ las sbyor gyi sngags so/ / oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye hūṃ/ srog sa mā ya hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ spogs chog gi sngags so/ /gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ las byung ba'i gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtshor gyur/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs / snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pas gtso bo la 'bul/ 'khor gyi gnod sbyin spyi la/ oṃ pū dza bā liṃ gṛh+ṇa kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa dang*/ 'byung po spyi la kha 'bar ma'i sngags kyis sbyin/ yig brgya bzod gsol/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bstim pa rnams bya'o/ /'di nyid kyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum dang*/ gtor ma'i man ngag che chung*/ gces pa'i gdams ngag bcu bzhi la sogs pa ni yig rnying du shes par bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ maṇ+ḍal/ gsol btab/ rgyun bshags rnams spyi dang 'dra/ slob dpon yi dam du gsal ba gnas gyur te/ rgyal po rnam thos sras su gyur par mos la/ slob ma'ang mngon rtogs bzhin rnam thos sras su bskyed cing ye shes pa spyan drangs te bstim/ rigs bdag gis rgyas gdab pa'i bar bya/ rin po che'i go cha dang gzugs brnyan slob ma la gtad/ thang ka spyi bor bzhag la/ mdun bskyed las sku gnyis pa chad de thim par bsam/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa las 'phreng ba lag tu gtad/ gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*/ /snying gar sa bon sngags 'phreng 'od 'bar bar bsgom/ sems can thams cad dbul ba'i sdug bsngal las bsal bar bya'o snyam du bzhugs pa ni/

thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /rin po che dang ne'u le gzugs brnyan gtad la/ las sbyor gyi sngags brjod/ yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /gtor ma'i bka' bsgo byas la mtheb kyu nas cung zad cig sbyin/ 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra'o/ /shin tu zab par rab grags pa/ /rtags las kuna~X du yid ches shing*/ /bla ma las thob dga~X' ba skyes/ /snyinga~X po~X nyer mkho tsam zhig bris/ /rnam sras ljang gu seng zhog dz+nyā na lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ nor sbyin dbang po la btud nas/ /gsang sgrub shin du rnyed dka' ba/ /yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa yi/ khyad par cung zad bshad pa bya/ /gong du bshad pa ltar rgyal chen dmar po rta sngon can gyi sgrub thabs spyi dang mtshungs pa las/ gzhal yas khang ser chen bzhin bskyed/ dbus su seng ge'i gdan bskyed pa'i sa bon tsa yig la byed pa dang*/ gtso bo'i sa bon bai'am traṃ gang rung dang*/ rgyal po chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas stag gi rgyal mtshan dang mdung dmar/ g.yon gyis ne'u le dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar la mche ba gtsigs pa/ dar dmar po'i cod pan can rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ cha lugs gzhan rnams rta sngon can dang 'dra/ phyogs bzhir trag dmar po bzhi las/ shar du nor rgyun ma/ lho ru dbyangs can ma/ nub tu nor skyong ma/ byang du bha ra li rnams dmar mo zhi ma khro/ rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon rnga yab bsnams pa/ phyi'i khang bzang brgyad du/ skad cig gis rta bdag brgyad ni/ ser chen bzhin las/ g.yas na rang rang gi phyag mtshan dang mdung dmar/ g.yon na lcags kyu dang ne'u le 'dzin pa'o/ / rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ rta sngon can dang 'dra ba las gsang rten gri snying yod na/ de nyid spyi bor bzhag ste/

'phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo bzhin bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ de med na sngags kyi 'khor lo gtor ma'i nang du bcug pa zhig byas la bka' bsgo drag tu mdzad pa phyag len yin/ sngags kyi bzla tshul sogs sham bu mi 'dra ba mang du yod na'ang*/ rjes gnang tsam la mi dgos la/ phyi sgrub rta sngon can nyid kyi rjes gnang thob pas nang sgrub gsang sgrub yang gsang thams cad kyi nyams len byas pas chog par mngon yang*/ so so'i rjes gnang mdzad pa'i phyag len kyang 'dug cing*/ khyad par yang gsang 'di la gal po cher mdzad do/ /shin tu zab par kuna~X nas grags/ /sna tshogs spyod rnams yid dga~X'i gnas/ /las tshogs sgrub skor ches mang yang*/ /rjes gnang snyinga~X po~X tsam 'dis chog/yang gsang phyag mtshan bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba thugs rje'i mnga' bdag ni/ /gter gyi bdag por sku sprul pa/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /cha tsam gsal bar bshad par bya/ / skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ rang sems dzaṃ yig ser po yongs su gyur pa las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar byas/ 'dod dgu'i char phab/ slar 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa dzam+bha la gser btso ma ltar 'bar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na shing thog bi dza pu ra ka bsnams pa/ g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pas yid bzhin nor bu rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ zhi zhing sgeg pa sha nyams rgyas pa'i hur bag chags pa/ rab tu dgyes pa'i spyan gdangs shing dbu skra nag po'i thor cog can/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang bcas pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i rol pa'i stabs kyis dung gi mgo dang*/

pad+ma'i mgo zhes bya ba la sogs pa gter chen po rnams la zhabs brten pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi lhab lhub dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i do shal can/ 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i sku can du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dgachu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ oṃ ār+ya dzam+bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ puṣ+pe nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*/ /gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje/ /byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon bo dzam+bha la/ /dngos grub mchog stsol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus bzla/ mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs te mnyam par bzhagaslar yang lha skur langs te dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su ji skad bshad pa'i chu sbyin la sogs pa la nan tan du bya zhing*/ mchod gtor la yang nan tan du bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal pad+ma 'dab brgyad tshom bu can nam/ ma 'grub na rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par bya/ dkar gtor mchod pa dzaṃ bshos zangs gzhong zangs bum chus gang ba sogs yo byad rnams tshang bar bya/ mchod pa byin brlabs spyi dang mthun/ gong bzhin bdag bskyed byas la/ mdun bskyed kyang bdag bskyed 'don pa spos pas chog cing*/ bzlas pa'i mthar gtor ma la a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung pa'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ zhu ba las gtor ma 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

oṃ āḥhūṃ/ snying po mthar i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa lan gsum mam lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gong bzhin bstod la/ ser sna'i las kyi me yis gdungs pa dag/ skye ba skye bar khyod la skyabs su mchi/ /rin chen gter gyi bdud rtsi'i char rgyun gyis/ /sems can dbul ba'i sdug bsngal zhi bar mdzod/ / ces gsol btab/ skabs 'dir yang chu sbyin spro na bya/ rjes gnang gi ngo bo sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar/ slob mas phul bar mos te/ chu sbyin 'bul ba ni/ zangs gzhong gi dbus su/ stong pa'i ngang las 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la gong bzhin bskyed/ ye shes pa bstim/ gnas gsum byin rlabs dang*/ dbang bskur byed mi dgos/ rang gi lag pa g.yas kyi mthil du zla ba la gnas pa'i oṃ hūṃ trāṃ hrī a/ de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rnams bdud rtsi'i rnam par bkug ste thim/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes chu byin gyis brlabs te/ snying po'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu khyor ba brgya rtsa brgyad dam/ bum pa'i chu rgyun mi 'chad par dbul bar bya'o/ /mthar dzaṃ bshos chu nang du bcug la/ gong gtor ma 'bul ba'i sngags kyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod gsol btab lan gsum bya/ de nas 'phags pa dzam+bha la dgyes te/ slob ma la yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang*/ bdud rtsi'i dngos grub byin par mos la/ dzaṃ bshos nas cung zad bcad cing ster ba dang*/ chu ci dgar 'thung du gzhug go /rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /kuna~X nas grags che ches zab pa/ /nor gyi sgrub thabs rab dga~X' ni/ /snga phyi'i yig tshogs dpag med las/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig nyer mkhor bkod/ /'phags pa dzam+bha la ser po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyud rgyal kun gyi rtser son pa/ /dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus las

byung*/ /ye shes zhabs kyi man ngag ste/ /gnod gnas sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'di'o/ /'di la rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa zhu ba glus bskul yan chad gsang 'dus 'jam pa'i rdo rje lhan skyes gyi skabs bzhin nyams su blangs nas/ glus bskul ba/ dzaṃ las bi dza pu ra dzaṃ gyis mtshan pa dang*/ baṃ las snye ma baṃ gyis mtshan pa'i 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ rang nyid dzaṃ bha la ser nag dkar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rang 'dra'i yum nor rgyun ma la 'khyud pa/ lhag ma g.yas gnyis bi dza pu ra dang ral gri/ g.yon gnyis gter gyi ne'u le dang pad+ma 'dzin pa/ cha lugs rnams dzam+bha la spyi dang mthun pa'o/ /skye mched byin rlabs/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ sems dpa' gsum brtsegs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams kyang 'jam rdor dang 'dra ba las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ spyi bor oṃ/ snying gar hūṃ/ gsang bar āḥ brla gnyis la swā/ byin pa gnyis la hā rnams kyis rgyas btab/ bdag bskyed la mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba rnams byas te/ rang gi snying ga nas dzaṃ spros mdun du rang dang 'dra bar bskyed/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin rlabs/ rang gi snying ga'i 'od zer gyis sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba mkha' nang du dzaṃ bha lar gyur/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros/ mchod pa phul te mdun bskyed la thim/ dbang bskur rgyas btab bya/ rang gi lag mthil du pad zla la hūṃ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ de'i lte bar mi bskyod pa lha bcu dgu'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par mos te/ lha rnams rjes chags kyi snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du gyur pa/ mdun bskyed dzaṃ bha la'i ljags la dza yig gis mtshan pa'i steng du bab pas gsol bar bsams la/ chu sbyin brgya rtsa brgyad 'bul/ gtor 'bul mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab rnams spyi dang mthun par byas la/

rang gi snying gar bsdu/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis/ oṃ āḥdza hūṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ yi ge bcu pa ci 'grub tu bzlas/ bang mdzod thams cad du yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i char 'bebs par bsam/ 'jug tu dge ba bsngo zhing*/ thun mtshams su lha'i nga rgyal la gnas par bya/ 'di la yang sgom lung gis chog go /gnod gnas sgrub thabs rnam gsum las/ /'bring po'i lugs su kuna~X nas grags/ /sngags shes dga~X' zhing yid ches gnas/ /rgyun bshad las byung snyinga~X po~Xr dril/ /gsang 'dus las byung ba chu sbyin dbang po 'bring po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ nor bu'i rigs kyi sngags gtso bo/ /chos ldan kun gyi nor sgrub pa/ / 'phags pa dzaṃ bha lar btud nas/ /dpa' bo grub pa'i man ngag bshad/ /'di nyid kyi rten nam 'khor lo mdun du bzhag la/ mchod gtor bzang pos mtha' skor/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūṃ yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi dbus su/ paṃ las gser gyi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa/ de'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la dzaṃ dgu dang baṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la nor rgyun mas yang dag par 'khyud pa/ shar du nor bu bzang po dang zla shel ma/ lho ru gang ba bzang po dang sbyin ma/ nub tu nor sbyin dang sbyin bzang ma/ byang du rnam thos kyi bu dang 'phags ma/ shar lhor ki li mi li dang rab bzang ma/ lho nub tu 'jam po 'khyil pa dang rab sbas ma/ nub byang du zhal gyi dbang po dang lha'i bud med/ byang shar du spyod pa'i dbang po dang dbyangs can ma/ thams cad kyang sku mdog gser btso ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ yab rnams rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil na bi dza pu ra dang*/

g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ yum rnams g.yas mchog sbyin dang g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma bsnams pa'o/ / gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang mthun/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ 'gro la dmigs med thugs rje yi/ /thabs mkhas rang bzhin sku sprul pa/ /gnod sbyin pho mo'i tshogs rnams la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / spro na/ dzaṃ bha la'i mtshan brgya dang*/ bstod pa rgyas pa dang*/ nor rgyun ma'i bstod pa rnams kyis kyang bstod do/ /oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lan+d+re ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas shing*/ oṃ ma ṇi bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ pu r+ṇa bha dra ya swāhā/ oṃ bhan da ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra wa ṇa ya swāhā/ oṃ kī li mā li ni ye swāhā/ oṃ pi tsi kuṇ+ḍa li ni swāhā/ oṃ mu khen+d+rā ya swāhā/ oṃ tsa ren+d+ra ya swāhā/ oṃ ba su dha ra ṇi swāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra kan+d+yai swāhā/ oṃ dat+ta ye swāhā/ oṃ su dat+ta ye swāhā/ oṃ ār+ya ye swāhā/ oṃ su bha dra ye swāhā/ oṃ su gup+ta ye swāhā/ oṃ di byai swāhā/ oṃ swa ra swa s+t+yai swāhā/

zhes pa rnams kyang ci rigs su bzlas la/ mthar chu sbyin spyi dang mthun par phul/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas spel/ gtso 'khor so so'i sngags kyis mthar/ a kā ro btags pas 'bul te/ gtso bo la lan bdun dang*/ gzhan rnams la gsum gsum mo/ /mchod bstod/ 'dod don gsol btab sogs spyi dang 'dra bar bya/ 'di'i rjes gnang sbyin par 'dod na/ mdun bskyed kyi rten pho rkyang mo rkyang pho mo sbrags pa ste gsum mam/ 'khor lo gsum 'god/ ma 'grub na/ maṇ+ḍal gsum la de'i rim pas tshom bu bkod/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ dbus su gong bzhin bskyed/ g.yas su gnod sbyin pho dgu'i dkyil 'khor bskyed/ g.yon du mo dgu'i bskyed/ gnas gsum byin rlabs man chad chabs gcig tu bya/ slob ma rnams kyis gsol btab yan lag bdun pa sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang 'dra bar byas/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal 'dzin du bcugamadun bskyed rnams blo yul du nges par bskyed nas/ chu sbyin gtor 'bul mchod bstod rnams bya/ de nas sngags kyi bzlas lung sbyin te/ de nyid kyis slob ma'i bya ba 'grub pa yin no/ /'khor lo kuna~X la grags mod kyang*/ /rab dga~X'i bka' gtad shin du dkon/ /snyinga~X nas tshul 'dir 'jug 'dod na/ /dang po~Xr rig gtad zhu ba gces/ /dzaṃ bha la lha mang gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ mi bskyod rdo rjes byin rlabs pa/ khro bo 'chol ba'i cha lugs can/ /smug 'dzin de la btud byas nas/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ /skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ bsrung 'khor gang 'os shig bsgoms nas/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du/ hūṃ las rdo rje rwa dgu pa/ phyi ser la nang nag pa/ de'i lte ba la hūṃ gis mtshan par gyur/ oṃ a zhes pa'i sgra dang bcas 'od zer 'phros/

sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la nag po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ na ma u tsuṣ+ma ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ zhes phyag bya/ ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun/ zla ba rdo rje hūṃ dang bcas pa las 'od 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang nyid la thim/ mdun gyi 'phags pa dzam+bha la'i tshogs kyang oṃ a zhes pas spyan drangs nas hūṃ la thim/ rang lus kyang zla ba rdo rje dang bcas pa la thim/ de nyid kyang snang stong sgyu ma lta bu'o/ / zhes brjod la cung zad mnyam par bzhag zla ba rdo rje hūṃ yig dang bcas pa las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la sku mdog bung ba ltar gnag pa/ gcer bu rigs ngan gyi cha lugs rna ba ma phug pa mi'i thung gi rnam pa can/ mtshan ma gyen du bsgreng ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril la khro gnyer bsdus pa/ phyag g.yas pas ka pā la khrag gis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ g.yon pas nor bu sna tshogs skyug pa'i ne'u le brla g.yon pa la brten pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa zhabs g.yas bskum/ g.yon brkyang bas pad+ma dang*/ zla ba'i gdan la nor bdag rnam thos bu'i gzugs can nor bu skyug pa mnan pa/ byis pa'i gzugs can skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan zhing*/ spyi bor rgyal ba mi bskyod pa bzhugs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na 'gying ba'i thugs kar zla ba la rdo rje rwa dgu pa hūṃ yig dang bcas pa/ phyogs kyi rwa rnams rab tu gdengs shing*/ dbus kyi rwa rnam par dkar ba nor bu'i tog gis brgyan pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba la hūṃ/ dpral bar oṃ/ lce la dzaṃ/ dpung pa g.yas la bha/ g.yon la la/ thugs kar dza/

lte bar len/ ngar gdong g.yas la dra/ g.yon la ye/ bol gong g.yas la swā/ g.yon la hā rnams zla gdan la gnas pa/ yi ge thams cad kyang mdog nag po 'od zer ser po 'phro ba'o/ /de thams cad las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas dzaṃ bha lar gyur nas rang gi snying ga'i hūṃ la thim/ yang 'od 'phros phyogs bcu'i rin po che'i thams cad bsdus/ rlung nang du brngubs pa'i tshe/ klu chen brgyad dang nor bdag rnams kyi kha nang du song*/ rlung phyir rgyu ba'i tshe bskyugs pas rin po che'i phung por gyur/ rang gi lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du baṃ las byung ba'i bum pa bzang po/ lag pa'i 'khrig ma la oṃ/ bum nang du dzaṃ/ mdzub mo la bha/ gung mo la la/ srin lag la dza/ mthe'u chung la len/ mthe bong la dra/ lag mthil gyi rtsa ba'i dbus su ye/ g.yon du swā/ g.yas su hā rnams zla ba la gnas par gyur/ dzaṃ yig las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas bum pa gang*/ mdun du zangs gzhong gi nang du sku gzugs sam ling ga bzhugs su gsol/ de nyid skad cig gis gong bzhin bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka nas dzaṃ bha la gcig spros nas de la bstim/ oṃ in+d+ra ya ṇi mu khaṃ bh+ra ma ri swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rang gi khyor bas chu blug ste bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur pa rang gi kha sgo nas zhugs/ dzaṃ gyi 'od kyis ser por gyur/ hūṃ la sogs pa'i 'od zer gyis nus mthu chen por byas te/ thugs ka nas gyen du logazhal nas thon/ lag mthil du byung ba phul bar mos pa'am/ rdo rje'i lam nas khyor bar phul bar bsam pa gang rung gi dmigs pa dang bcas/ oṃ swāhā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin lag len bzhin 'bul lo/ /de nas gtor sngags lan bdun gyis chu khyor ba bdun phul/ gtor ma dzaṃ bshos 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ma ṇi bha drā ya/ mahā yak+ṣa se na pa ta ye/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ dzam+bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ zhes lan bdun gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal gyi dbang phyug dpal chen bcu gnas rin chen rnam pa mang ldan pa/ /thabs mang stobs chen dri med thugs rje drang srong lha mo'i sras gyur de'i/ /sras cig mtshungs med ma lus srid dang zhi ba'i nor bdag gter chen ni/ /mi'u thung cha byad thod khrag ne'u le 'dzin mdzad khyod la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /mgon po nam mkha'i mdzod can nor gyi char 'bebs pa/ /ma skyes rang bzhin dag pas sku mdog sngon por bzhugs/ khyod ni rdo rje sems dpa' nyid du bdag mchod na/ /rtag tu yid la re ba'i 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ / ces bstod cing gsol ba btab/ rten chu nang du dbyung ngo*/ /rten med na rang gi snying gar bsdu ba'am/ gshegs pa gang rung bya/ gtor ma gtsang sar btang ngo*/ / oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas par bya'o/ /mthar lha sku mi dmigs par sbyangs te dge ba bsngo/ thun mtshams su yang lha'i nga rgyal dang ma bral ba byed/ 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal tshom bu mchod gtor rnams spyi dang mthun par bsham/ bgegs gtor btang*/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun par byed/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams bzlas pa'i bar gong bzhin byas la/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad nyi la hūṃ las nas/ bskyed cing yi ge 'god pa bzhin bya/ ye shes pa spyan drangs nas bstim/ gtor 'bul mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams bdag bskyed bzhin byas la/ slob ma'i bya ba ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra ba las/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags kyi dod/ 'gro rnams bsgral 'dod bsam pa yi sogs kyi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byed/ sku'i rjes gnang gi mthar yi ge rnams 'god/ snod bcud lhar bsgyur nas bstim/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi mthar lag pa byin rlabs nas mchod bstod kyi bar/

slob ma nyid chu sbyin rgyas par 'bul du 'jug pa'am/ mi lcog na/ slob ma'i don du dmigs nas slob dpon gyis bya/ de'i mthar mdun bskyed kyi klu brgyad sogs kyis rin po che zos shing bskyugs pas slob ma la dngos grub stsol ba'i dmigs pa gong bzhin phog la dzaṃ bshos dang chu nas cung zad sbyin/ rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang 'dra/ 'di thun mong ma yin pa paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag gi lugs yin/ thun mong tsam sbyin par 'dod na sgrub thabs brgya rtsa dang*/ rgya mtsho'i nang nas 'byung ba kho nas chog go /kuna~X nas ngo mtshar mchog gyur pa'i/ /man ngag bzhi zhes dga~X' bar bsngags/ /gzhung dang man ngag mtha' yas las/ /nyer mkho snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdus/ /'phags pa dzaṃ bha la nag po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon po la btud nas/ /de yi rnam 'phrul nor lha'i gtso/ /gnod gnas lha lnga la btud nas/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang bcas pa bshad/ /mdun du bris sku'am maṇ+ḍal tshom bu dang bcas pa'i rten bshams la/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed gang yang rung ba sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa'i dbus su/ dzaṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ spyan gsum dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ khro bo'i cha lugs can/ phyag g.yas pas mdung rtse gsum pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas nor bus mtshan pa'i be con bsnams pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yu 'brug sngon mo la chibs pa/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing sangs rgyas dpa' bo'i ngo bor gyur/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon rten 'brel gyi rdzas sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/

lhor rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo g.yas rin po che spungs pa dang g.yon lcags kyu bsnams pa/ nub tu pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon nor bus mtshan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ byang du las kyi mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu g.yas rdo rje rgya gram dang g.yon gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang skyil krung phyed pas bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ po ṭa la nas dzaṃ bha la 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ zhes gsungs shing dbang gi lha rnams kyis dbang bskur/ gtso bo la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang*/ 'khor rnams la gtso bos dbu brgyan/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la hri da ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ces ci nus su bzlas/ thun 'jog khar/ zangs gzhong gi snod du ldugs sku bzhag pa'am/ sku gzugs med kyang rung*/ rang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba'i lag mthil g.yas su bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i bum pa bzang po'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūṃ las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ mdun gyi dzaṃ bha la 'khor bcas zangs gzhong gi nang du byon par bsams la/ snying po brgya rtsa brgyad kyis chu sbyin 'bul/ mthar thig pa gcig lce thog tu bzhag la/ lhag ma phyogs bzhir gtor/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pad+ma kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la hri da ya bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan lngas phul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ spyan ras gzigs dbang sku las mngon sprul pa/ /rigs lngas byin rlabs bdud rtsi char ltar 'bebs/ / pad+ma khro bo ār+ya dzaṃ bha la/ /rigs bzhi mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas la 'dud/ / ces 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol sogs byas la/ gong du bshad pa bzhin rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/
