tshom bu la yang bsnyen pa ma thon gyi bar du brtan bzhugs byed/ rgyun gyi bzlas pa'i skabs lta bu rten dang tshom bu gnyis ka med na/ badz+ra muḥ gshegs su gsol/ mkha' 'gro rigs bzhis sngags kyang sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi skabs ma gtogs mi dgos so/ /de ltar na sngags 'bru 'bum du bzlas pas bsnyen pa sgrub pa yin pas ga'u'i sgrub pa las sbyor dang bcas pa sogs 'di nyid kyi las tshogs rnams sgrub pas rtags 'phral du thon par 'gyur ba yin no/ /'di'i rjes gnang bya bar 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba dkar po zhig bri/ lte ba dang phyogs bzhi'i 'dab ma la 'bru'i tshom bu bkod/ bum pa bcud dang ldan pa kha rgyan can dang*/ gtor ma dkar gtor gtso 'khor lnga pa zhig dang*/ gzhan yang 'bul gtor mchod pa tsā ru'i bza' ba rnams ci bder bshams/ rtse gsum be con rdo rje rdzas gzhong nor bu lcags kyu pad+ma rgyal mtshan/ sna tshogs rdo rje ne'u le'i rkyal pa rnams dngos sam tsa ka li tshang bar bsham/ dbu rgyan dang rin po che'i 'phreng ba zhig kyang bzhaga'aphags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed 'dod don gsol btab yan chad gong dang 'dra ba las/ maṇ+ḍal gtor ma bum pa gsum gyi gnas su rin po che'i gzhal med khang pa zhes sogs brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /de gsum la so sor dmigs nas bzlas pa brgya phrag re re bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams khrus byas/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas 'dug pa la/ bgegs gtor spyi dang mthun par btang*/ yid ches pa'i lo rgyus bshad/ slar yang maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs su gsol/ / sogs gsol ba btab/ rtog pa thams cad legs par bsdus nas ni/ /shin tu bsam pa bzang dang ldan pas nyon/ /brjes ngas blo la rdo rje sems dpa' sogs/ /bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyis byin mi rlob/ / ces nyan par gdams/ sangs rgyas chos dang

ma lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung*/ sku'i rjes gnang la spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i rjes su/ ji ltar bltams pa nas/ shrī ye hūṃ/ slob dpon 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs su gsal ba dang*/ mdun bskyed dzaṃ bha la rigs lngas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad gang*/ sdig pa dag par mos/ dbu brgyan zhing*/ oṃ rat+na mu ka ṭa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ rgyal ba rigs lngas dbu brgyan par bsam/ rin po che'i 'phreng ba mgo la bskon/ oṃ rat+na mā la a bhi ṣiñca traṃ traṃ traṃ traṃ traṃ/ gsung gi rjes gnang dang thugs phyag mtshan bstim pa spyi dang 'dra/ mdun bskyed kyi gnas gsum nas/ dzaṃ bha la dkar dmar mthing gsum spros nas/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du bstim pa yon tan gyi rjes gnang ngo*/ / gtso bo'i phyag mtshan lag tu gtad/ rje btsun 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dang*/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams/ /bu yis myur du thob par shog/oṃ pad+ma kro dha sogs/ bcom ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sku gsung thugs kyi sogs gong ltar brjod bzhin du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/

oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī pi shi ni steng lha'i snang srid thams cad slob ma 'dis dbang du gyur ciga'og klu'i snang srid thams cad= bar mi'i snang srid thams cad= swāhā/ de bzhin du/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i sogs dang*/ oṃ rat+na ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ 'jig rten khams kyi nor rdzas bang mdzod thams cad slob ma 'dis dbang du bsdus shig swāhā/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan pad+ma sogs dang*/ oṃ pad+ma ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ rgyal po dang blon po dang yul mi dbang chen po dang nor bu'i bdag po klu chen po rnams slob ma 'dis dbang du bsdus shig swāhā/ las kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i phyag mtshan gtad la/ bcom ldan las kyi sogs dang*/ oṃ karma ḍā ki nī pi shi ni/ yul mi phyug po dang*/ rkang 'gros dang*/ zas nor sna tshogs pa slob ma 'dis dbang du bsdus shig swāhā/ zhes pa ni 'phrin las kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /de nas gtor ma'i bka' bsgo spyi dang mthun par byas la/ gtor ma'i lha lnga slob ma la bstim/ su pra tiṣ+ṭhas brtan bzhugs bya/ gtor ma nas bag tsam dngos grub kyi don du slob ma la sbyin/ rjes rnams spyi dang 'dra zhing*/ tsā ru'i bza' ba longs spyad par bya'o/ /'di'i sgrub thabs bdag bskyed du byed pa'i lugs kyang yod mod kyi/ gong du bshad pa nyid legs so/ /nor sgrub kuna~X las khyad 'phags pa/ /rin chen phung por spungs pa dang*/ /mtshungs shing dga~X' bar rjes bsngags pa'i/ /snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam bkod pa yin/ /dzaṃ bha la dkar po jo bo lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan sdom pa he ru ka'i/ /rnam 'phrul las byung dzaṃ bha la/ /dmar po srog sgrub ces bya ba'i/ /sgrub thabs mdo tsam bri bar bya/ /'di'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi bya ba yig rnying las shes par bya'o/

/'dir mdo tsam smos na/ bde mchog lhan skyes sam/ bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgrub thabs kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang bde mchog gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor bzang du bshams/ nang mchod dang phyi mchod bdag bskyed ltar byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du bh+ruṃ las gter gyi bum pa gnyis zhabs sprad cing kha g.yas g.yon du bstan pa las rin po che'i char 'bebs pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du dzaṃ dang baṃ las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum nor bu 'bar ba'i thor tshugs can/ phyag g.yas rin po che dbang gi rgyal po thugs ka'i thad tsam du 'dzin zhing*/ g.yon pa gter gyi ne'u le rin po che skyug bzhin pa yum gyi sta zur g.yon gyi thad tsam du 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs can dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ brjid bag chags la bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can yid tsam khro ba'i ngang tshul can no/ /yum bde ba rgyas byed ma yab dang rnam pa mtshungs pa las/ phyag g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin pa/ skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang bas yab la 'khyud pa/ lha mo'i cha byad rdzogs pa'o/ /yab yum gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ ye shes sems dpa' dang lhan cig byon pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par gyur/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar dang*/

bzlas sngags la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod 'bul/ rjes chags dpa' bo mchog tu bde ba'i rang bzhin can/ /zag pa dang bral mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug dpa' bo che/ /gnyis med rnam rol dgos 'dod kun 'byung mchog gi lha/ /mgon po khyod la mngon par 'dud do mngon phyag 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs kar yi dam gyi sngags 'phreng gi dbus su/ dzam+bha la yab yum/ de'i thugs kar de nyid kyi sngags 'phreng dang sa bon bsgom/ de'i 'od zer gyis mdun bskyed bskul ba sogs dmigs pa gsal btab la/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza lan+d+re ye dha na me dhi hrīḥḍā ki nī dza la sam+bha raṃ swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzla'o/ /mthar gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ yi dam gyi mngon rtogs ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ sngags kyi mthar a kā ro btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ yig brgya bzod gsol brtan bzhugs rnams spyi dang mthun zhing/ rten med na gshegs gsol bya'o/ /'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na/ skar ma rgyal gyi nyin mo/ stegs bu gru bzhi pa btsag gis byugs pa zhig la bcad dmar skyas pad+ma 'dab brgyad 'bri/ dbus su tshom bu dmar po bkod/ der mañji bkod pa'i steng du nang mchod dang*/ de'i steng du maṇ+ḍal la sin+dhu ras byugs/ de la chos 'byung gi dbung su dzaṃ dang baṃ/ mtha' ma sngags kyis bskor ba bri/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang mchod pa byin rlabs rnams sngon du 'gro bas/ 'dod don gsol btab yan chad bdag mdun gong bzhin byas nas/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum bya/ sku'i rjes gnang spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i rjes su/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra

zhes brjod/ maṇ+ḍal gyi sin+dhu ra mtheb srin gyis blangs la/ slob ma'i dpral bar lan gsum du byugasnying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa lan gsum brjod/ de nas rjes su bzlas pa'i lung*/ dam bca' ba'i lung*/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin pa las/ slob ma'i snying gar dzaṃ dang baṃ gnyis kar bkod cing*/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas yi dam gyi sngags kyis 'go drangs nas/ sngags 'phreng spro ba ni/ khyad par ro/ /mthar nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis sbyin/ lus thams cad bdud rtsis gang*/ bde bas pas khyab par mos su gzhugarjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra zhing tsā ru'i ston mo rgya cher bya'o/ /'di slob dpon bir+wa pas man ngag tu 'dod pa dang*/ khyad par 'brog mi nas brgyud par 'dod pa ni brgyud yig shin tu 'khrul ba yin pa sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi chings sogs la brtags pas kyang shes par yod cing*/ yi ge 'ga' zhig las 'byung ba ltar/ bla ma sa skya pa che pos ba ri lo tsā ba la gsan par byas pa nyid 'thad pas/ brgyud pa'ang de yan chad bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs dang 'dra bar shes par bya'o/ /gnod gnas dmar po'i sgru ba thabs ni/ /kuna~X las khyad par 'phags pa yi/ /dga~X' chen he ru ka mtshungs pa/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam bris/ /dzaṃ bha la dmar po sa lugs kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ pad+ma gar dbang rnam 'phrul las/ /nor lha'i rgyal por sku sprul pa/ /de la btud nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /mdo tsam bdag gis brjod par bya/ /dzaṃ bha la dmar po grwa ba mngon shes lugs kyi sgrub thabs dang*/ rjes gnang gi rim pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal la ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad dmar po bris pa'i lte bar bdud rtsi ril bu dang ldan pa'i myos byed bzang po ka pā la gang ba bu ram sbyar ba dang*/ de'i mdun du gtor ma rin po che 'bar ba'i dbyibs can 'bri mog pas dmar por bsgyur ba la bu ram dang sha la sogs pas brgyan pa dang*/

'bul gtor gcig gam/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gcig ste gnyis kyang bsham/ g.yas su bum pa dmar po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa kha rgyan dang*/ mgul chings kyis mdzes pa'i nang du chu gtsang ma dang*/ lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas tshang bar blug pa bkod/ g.yon du mchod sbyin gyi snod zangs gzhong du sku bzhugs su gsol/ mtha' mchod pas bskor te/ yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dmigs rten rnams a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du paṃ las pad+ma/ ma las nyi ma/ a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ dzaṃ yig dmar po las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can dbul 'phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ār+ya dzaṃ bha la dmar po zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi pa/ sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i phung po ltar dmar zhing 'od 'bar ba/ chags pa dang sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan zhing cung zad khro la 'dzum pa/ rtsa zhal dmar la bzhad pa/ g.yas dkar g.yon sngo ba/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po na rin po che dang*/ bar pa na lcags kyu/ g.yon gyi dang po na thod pa rin po ches gang ba/ bar pa na zhags pa/ tha ma gnyis na gter gyi ne'u le bsnams nas btsir bas nor bu rin po che sna tshogs skyug pa/ zhabs g.yas pa gnyis cung zad bskum zhing g.yon pa gnyis cung zad brkyang ba'i 'dor stabs kyis gnod sbyin nor bu skyug pa gnyis mnan pa/ klu chen po brgyad dang rin po che sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing*/ me tog phreng ba dang dar gyi cod pan gyis mdzes pa/ de'i thugs kar hrīḥyig dmar po las gsang ba'i lha mo ku ru kul+le sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma/ dang po gnyis kyis ut+pa la'i mda' gzhu rna ba'i drung du 'gengs shing*/ 'og ma gnyis kyis ut+pa las mtshan pa'i lcags kyu dang zhags pa bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum pa'i brang ba g.yon pa'i brla la bstad pa'i skyil krung phyed pas bzhengs pa/

mi rus kyi 'phreng ba'i phyag rgya lnga dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas brgyan pa/ khro zhing 'dzum la sgeg pa'i nyams ldan gsal bar bsgoms te/ yab yum gnyis ka'i gnas gsum du yi ge 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ thugs ka'i dbus su rang gi sa bon bkod pa las 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya dzaṃ bha la shrī ku ru kul+le sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mahā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ ho gnyis su med par bsam/ yang 'od 'phros dbang lha spyan drangs mchod de/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis sku gang dri ma dgachu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgyas rin po che 'dzin pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ dzaṃ bha la dza len+d+ra ye dha na mi dhi hrīḥswāhā/ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus su bgrangs bas mnyes nas nor gyi dngos grub sbyin par bsam mo/ /gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hī/ btags pa dang*/ gtor ma phyi ma a kā ro sa 'bul/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya āḥhūṃ dang*/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai we t+ya/ shap+ta zhes sogs rgyas bsdus ci rigs pas mchod/ bde gshegs kun gyi gsung las legs sprul zhing*/ /thugs rjes chags pa'i sku mdog dmar por bzhugs/ /dbang gi 'phrin las rdzogs mdzad dzaṃ bha la/ /ma lus 'gro ba'i re skong khyod phyag 'tshal/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs brjod/ de nas bum pa bsangs sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las zla ba'i gdan la bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa/ dmar po mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i nang du sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang phyogs bzhir zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las byung ba'i rigs lnga thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas rin po che dang*/ g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dpag tu med pas brgyan pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs te/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dgug gzhug bcings mnyes byas/ dbang lha spyan drangs pa la mchod de dbang bskur bas/ rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa la mchod cing bstod de/ rang gi thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril ba rigs lngas thugs kar thim pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ sku'i cha thams cad nas babs pa'i bdud rtsis bum pa gang bar bsams nas/ oṃ hūṃ traṃ hrīḥ.a/ zhes pa ci nus su bzlas te/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang*/ rigs lnga 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i dzaṃ bha la dmar po sngar bzhin yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed de/ mchod bstod dang bzlas pa sogs sngar bzhin byas/ lhag chad kha bskang*/ 'dod don gsol ba btab/ lha zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur par bsam/ thun mtshams su chu sbyin dang gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod pas zangs gzhong du sngar ltar bskyed nas/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de'i thugs kar raṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin can gcig bsams nas/ raṃ zhes brjod pas rjes su chags pa'i me 'bar te/ zhal nas me lce cung zad byung bas shin tu skom pa'i gdung ba la mchod pa 'bul bar bsam/ rang gi lag mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūṃ aṃ dz+riṃ khaṃ hūṃ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi babs zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gang ba sor mo'i rtse las 'dzags/

sngags kyis phul bas skom pa'i gdung ba zhi ste mnyes nas zhal dang ne'u le dang nor bdag rnams kyi kha nas rin po che sna tshogs byung bas rang gi dgos 'dod thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bsams la/ chu sbyin zhing sngags nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzlas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūṃ gis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs nas/ sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ti kha kha khā hi khā hi btags pa gsum mam lnga la sogs pas phul bas ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu can gyis gsol bas/ mnyes nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub thams cad stsol bar bsam/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ rgyal ba rin chen mang gi thugs rje las/ /mngon par sprul pa nor bdag kun gyi rje/ /gsung gi dbang phyug ār+ya dzaṃ bha la/ / 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes pas bstod/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ dzaṃ bha la'i zhal dang/ nor skyug pa dang*/ ne'u le la reg par bsams nas/ chu sbyin phul pa'i chu las thigs pa gcig mtheb srin gyis blangs te/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun lce la bzhag par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūṃ zhes brjod cing dngos grub blangs/ gtor chu dang bcas pa rang gi longs spyod pa'am/ chu bo chen por gnas pa rnams la sbyin par bya'o/ /de nas slob ma rnams rjes su bzung bar bya ste/ de la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ slob ma rnams khrus phyag maṇ+ḍal sngon du 'gro bas gral du 'khod pa la gsol ba btab pa'i rjes zlos gyis zhes brda sbyar nas/

kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can nas/ blo mchog bdag la gnang bar mdzod/ / kyi bar lan gsum brjod du gzhugagur nas 'byung pa'i rgyun bshags sam gang yang rung ba'i sgo nas/ sems bskyed pa'i sdom pa phog ste/ mdun bskyed kyi dmigs pa sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar phog bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi mos 'dun byed du bcug la/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ mdun bskyed kyi sku las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma la phogaslob ma'i nad gdon sdig sgrib sbyangs/ lus 'od dmar po'i gong bur gyur par bsam du gzhug go / gnyis pa ni/ slob ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun bskyed kyi skabs su brjod pa de nyid 'don pa spos te/ slob ma dzaṃ dmar du bsgoms pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ bla ma dang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon kyi 'od kyis phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas mkha' 'gro chos skyong nor lha gter bdag dang bcas pa thams cad dzaṃ bha la dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma la thim pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa gnyis su med par bsam du gzhug sngags kyi gsham la a be sha ya aḥ zhes btags pa brjod cing/ gu gul gyis bdugarol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas ye shes pa dbab bo/ /rdo rje spyi bor bzhag ste/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra gyis brtan par bya'o/ /slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros pas dbang lha spyan drangs pa la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs su bcugaslob dpon gyis 'di la zhes 'don pa spos la brjod/ lhas rang rang gis dbang bskur ba'i bya ba rnams mdzad par bsam du bcug nas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyis zhes sogs dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyi mthar/ a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis smin mtshams yan chad gang*/

lus kyi sgrib pa dgabum dbang thob/ mgri pa yan= ngag gi= gsang dbang = snying ga yan= yid kyi= shes rab ye shes kyi= lus thams cad= sgo gsum gyi= dbang bzhi pa thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med mnyam bzhag gi phyag na rin po che bsnams pas dbu brgyan par bsam du bcugaslar yang slob mas bla ma la me tog gi 'phreng ba re phul bar bsams te/ bsnyim pa me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum brjod du bcugaslob dpon gyis 'di gsan pas khyab rjes zlos bya mi 'tshal zhes brda' sbyar/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum dang/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'phrin las rdzogs par mdzad du gsol/ /dzaṃ la dmar po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bde chen gnas su rung du gsol/ / zhes brjod cing*/ spyi bor me tog bzhag par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar dbang bskur ba de dag brtan par bya ba'i phyir rjes su gnang ba sbyin par bya ste/ thod chang lag tu bzhag la/ khams gsum snying khrag bsdus pa'i bcud/ /byang chub sems ni dmar la dwangs/ /srid gsum dbang du byed pa'i rdzas/ /bu yis blangs pas dngos grub thob/ / ces brjod/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag cing*/ sngags kyi mthar a bhi ṣiñca aḥ zhes brjod/ gtor ma rin chen 'bar ba lag par bzhag la/ yid bzhin rin chen 'bar ba yis/ khams gsum kun gyi nor bsdus pas/ /'dod dgu char 'bebs dbang gi rgyal/ /bu la sbyin pas dngos grub thob/ / ces dang*/ gtor zan byin zhing sngags sngar bzhin brjod/ de nas chu sbyin pa'i rjes su gnang pa yang bya ste/ chu sbyin gyi dmigs pa sngags gtor bsngo/ bstod pa 'dod don gsol ba'i bar lag len ltar byed cing*/ slob ma yang byed du bcug / de ltar sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi sgo nas/

dzaṃ bha la dmar po'i rjes su gnang ba legs par thob pa yin pas/ dzaṃ bha la dmar po nor lhar bsten mchod gtor dang bsnyen sgrub ci nus su bya snyam pa'i rjes zlos kyis bya/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs gsum brjod/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul du bcug nas/ deng nas brtsams te sogs gsum brjod/ bsngo ba smon lam rgyas bsdus ci rigs pa byas nas/ rjes kyi cho ga rnams kyang cha tshang la ma nor bar bya'o/ /kuna~X la zab par grags pa yi/ /sgrub thabs yi ge ches dga~X' ba/ /rgyas bsdus gnyis ka'i skyon spangs nas/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdus pa yin/ /dzaṃ bha la dmar po gter ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ chu dbang snying rje chen po la/ /btud nas ngo mtshar sgrub thabs ni/ /nor sgrub bcud len bsrung sogs la/ /lhag par bsngags pa 'dir brjod bya/ /rgyud 'grel las ji skad bshad pa'i rten tshang ba'am/ min na'ang shing las byas pa'am/ ri mor bris pas kyang rung ste/ chu sbyin gyi chas dang*/ mchod gtor mdun du bshams/ yi dam gyi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mchod pa dus 'khor gyi lugs bzhin nam/ spyi dang mthun par byin gyis rlabs kyang rung*/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ki nī/ badz+ra dhā tī shwa ri ga ga na swa bhā wa sarba da ra bya bi shwa dha ni/ sarba dra bya ṇi/ bi shwa dha ya hūṃ pheṃ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po'i rtse mor pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ 'dab ma rnams phyogs kyi mdog can/ lte bar haṃ las 'phags pa dzaṃ bha la ljang khu'am ljang ser phyag mtshan sogs dzaṃ bha la ser po spyi dang mthun par bskyed/ de'i brla g.yon pa'i steng du hāḥlas lha mo nor rgyun ma sngon mo phyag g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang lhan cig yab la 'khyud pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la shar du hiṃ las zla shel ma/

mer hīḥlas rab bzang ma gnyis nag mo/ lho ru hṛṃ las sbyin ma/ bden bral du hṝḥlas rab sbas ma gnyis dmar mo/ byang du huṃ las 'phags ma/ byang shar du hūḥlas dbyangs can ma gnyis dkar mo/ nub tu hl̥ṃ las sbyin bzang ma/ nub byang du hl̥̄ḥlas lha mo dpal gnyis ser mo/ de ltar gnod sbyin mo dgu char yang g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas 'dod dgu'i char 'bebs shing*/ g.yon pas rang mdog dang mtshungs pa'i pad+ma'i sdong bu 'dzin pa/ rol pa'i stabs su bzhugs pa rnams su gyur/ ye shes pa spyan drangs te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥhiḥzhes bsre/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ lte bar hoḥ gtsug gtor du haṃ/ gsang bar k+ṣaḥrnams kyis rgyas btab/ lha dbang bskur ba ni mi mdzad/ gal te byed par spro na chu dbang bskur te/ rigs drug gis so sor rgyas btab/ lag mthil du a i ṛ u l̥'i 'od kyis 'khor 'das snod bcud kyi bdud rtsi thams cad bsdus/ zhal du phul bar bsams la/ chu sbyin spyi dang mthun par phul/ gtor ma yang gsol bar mos la/ oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥ.ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ i daṃ bā liṃ gan+dhaṃ puṣ+paṃ sogs lan gsum gyis phul/ dpal ldan rdo rje dbyings dbang phyug/ sgrol ma reg bya rdo rje ma/ /gos dkar ro ma mā ma kī /gzugs ma spyan ma dri rdo rje/ /gnod sbyin mo dgu'i tshul bstan pas/ /rab bskor 'phags pa rmug 'dzin ni/ /dpal ldan mi bskyod rdo rje ste/ /thabs mkhas tshul gyis longs spyod ster/ /de dag rnams la gus pas 'dud/ / ces sogs dang phyogs mthun gyis bstod pa ci shes kyis bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyis gsol btab/ yi ge bcu pa'i bzlas pa ci 'grub bya/ gnod sbyin mo dgu'i mtshan sngags kyang ci rigs par bzlas la/ de nas oṃ āḥhūṃ hoḥhaṃ k+ṣaḥ.ār+ya dzaṃ bha la sid+dhi me pra yats+tshan+tu/ ma ma dha naṃ/

da da tu/ badz+ra dha ra ā dz+nyā pa ya te swāhā/ zhes las sgrub pa'i sngags kyang cung zad bzla'o/ /mthar dngos grub blang ba dang*/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ rten la brtan bzhugs sogs byas la/ thun mtshams la 'jug go /'di'i rjes gnang ni/ rten dngos sam tshom bu la brten kyang rung ste/ bzlas pa yan chad gong bzhin song ba na/ rdo rje shugs kyi skabs bzhin gsol btab yan lag bdun pa/ rigs drug gi sdom bzung rnams bya/ mdun bskyed gsal 'debs su bcugaslob ma dzaṃ bha lar bsgom pa la ye shes pa bstim/ sngags kyi bzlas lung bya/ slob ma chu sbyin 'bul du gzhugade tsam gyis chog go /kuna~X tu khungs che rab zab kyang*/ /rgyud 'dir yid dga~X' can kun gyis/ /ma thos dbul zhing 'phongs ba la/ /brtse bas snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bris/ /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo las byung ba dzam+bha la ljang khu'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan gsang ba'i bdag po la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal ci nus mchod/ /gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po yi/ /sgrub thabs bzlas lung mdo tsam bri/ /mdun du rin po che'i snod du gtor ma zhig bsham/ de la nor bu bzang po'i tsa ka li 'dzugs/ mtha' mchod pas bskor/ phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed dang*/ rang gi mdun du rnam thos sras skad cig gis bskyed/ tsa ka li bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis gnod sbyin nor bu bzang po sku mdog ser po rta sngon la chibs shing rgyug pa/ phyag g.yas nor bu 'bar ba dang g.yon pas gter gyi ne'u le 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ snying gar zla ba la maṃ/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ri a bhi ṣiñca hūṃ/ zhes rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan pas dam la bzhag cing dbang bskur/ haṃ sa maṃ sa baṃ sa/ zhes pa ni brda'i dbang ste/ mi bskyod pa dang*/

'jam pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje lcags kyu'i sa bon no/ /gtor ma rnam sras ljang khu seng zhon ltar byin gyis brlabs/ snying po la a kā ro btags te 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ nor bu'i rigs kyi gsang sngags ni/ kun gyi bdag por dbang bskur ba/ /lha rnams kun gyi'ang nor gyi bdag/nor bu bzang po khyod la bstod*/ 'dod don gsol btab spyi dang mthun/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ rdo rje 'dzin pa zhes sogs gsol btab dang*/ gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma nyid rnam thos sras su skad cig gis bskyed/ slob dpon phyag rdor du gsal bas/ gtor ma slob ma'i lag tu sprad la bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ mtha' bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin te/ rjes kyi bya ba thams cad spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bram ze mig ser las brgyud cing*/ /bha ro tsa ku ni zhes dang*/ /dzā ma pā las kuna~X grub pa/ /rab dga~X'i rigs gtad snyinga~X po~X tsam/ /'di'i bsnyen grub ni yig rnying las shes par bya'o/ /nor sbyin nor bu bzang po'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rab zab sgrub thabs rnyed dka' ba/ /gang gi rtog pa las bsdus nas/ /bla ma'i zhal gyi man ngag bzhin/ /rjes gnang bcas pa cung zad brjod/ /mchod gtor gtsang sbra can bshams la/ phyag na rdo rje gos sngon can gyi bdag bskyed dang*/ rnam thos sras ser chen lta bu rnam thos sras gang rigs kyi mdun bskyed sngon du song nas/ de'i mdun du bka' nyan gyi tshul du bskyed par bya ba yin te/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma'i gdan la k+ṣa yig gur gum gzhon nu'i mdog can las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ sras gar mkhan mchog sku mdog dmar ser sngo dkar ba'i zhal gsum khro zhing bzhad la skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen pad+ma ral gri zhags pa mda' bo che dgra sta rnams dang*/

g.yon pa brgyad kyis dril bu rtse gsum ne'u le me tog gi phur ma ba dan thod pa gzhu rnga yab rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing*/ stag lpags dang*/ dar gyi na bza' dang*/ sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ 'od zer rab tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrug pa/ de'i g.yas su tshangs pa dang khyab 'jugagayon du dbang phyug dang lus ngan/ phyogs bzhir gnod sbyin gter bdag pho bzhi/ mtshams bzhir mo bzhi dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las/ spyan 'dren gyi tshe/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya bca' ste/ gung mo zlum por bkug pa la mdzub mo dkris/ sor mo lhag ma rnams so sor gshibs te rtse sbyar ba las mthe bong dang mthe'u chung steng 'og tu bskyod pa'o/ /de nyid g.yab cing*/ oṃ ṭāk+ki ku pa ra swāhā/ zhes spyan drangs/ sor mo gzhan rnams bsnol/ gung mo bsgreng ba spyi bor bzhag ste/ oṃ tsi ti tsi ti bi tsi ti mud+ga ra hūṃ hūṃ zhes dam la bzhag ste las la bskul/ rigs bdag ni mi bskyod pa'o/ /sngags ni rnam sras gar mkhan mchog dang 'dra ba zhig lag len la mdzad na/ de yang bya mod kyi/ na mo rat+na dra yā ya/ na mo bai shra ma ṇa ya/ na ṭa ku pa ra s+yai/ gu h+ya kā/ narta pa ti/ ma bha ra ta yi ṣ+yaṃ/ a nu dū pa su rū pa na ṭa ku pa ra/ tsan+d+ra khaṃ/ na tsa kaṃ/ he mahā skaṃ/ na ḍa ku pa ra/ he ma kaṃ ku ha kaṃ tsa la tsa la/ pa tsa pa tsa/ phu lu phu lu ku pa ra/ zhes rgyud las 'byung ba'ang bzla'o/ /gtor chog kyang rnam sras dang 'dra ba las/ na mo na ḍa ku pa ra/ bi dza ya/ pra bhā ra/ ku pa ra ya/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta sogs sbyar bas phul/ gshegs gsol gyi sngags ni/ na mo bai shra wa ṇa su ta ya/ na ḍa ku pa ra ya/ oṃ pa ra pa ra/ naṭ+ṭa naṭ+ṭa/ gats+tshe swa bhā wan/ ya thā su/ a twaṃ yak+ṣen+t+ra swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o/

/ngal gsos po yi sras kuna~X gyi/ /mchog gyur yin zhes dga~X' bar bsngags/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs ches dkon pa'i/ /yi ge'i snyinga~X po~X spel 'di mtshar/ /sras gar mkhan mchog gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos bu/ /de sras bcas la btud byas nas/ /gzungs las 'byung ba'i sgrub thabs zhig/shin tu rnyed par dka' phyir bshad/ /rgyal po ser chen gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs sam/ gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs bzhin nyams su blangs nas/ gtso bo'i mdun du pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la k+ṣa yig ser po las gnod sbyin rgyal ba khyu mchog sku mdog gser btso ma ltar rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis nor bus gang ba'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis yid bzhin gyi nor bus mtshan pa'i be con dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ gzhon nu'i lus can dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba khyu mchog gnod sbyin bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ na mo bai shra ba ṇa ya/ mahā dha na dā ya/ tsaṇ+ḍe shwa rā ya/ ā kar+ṣa ya/ a pa ra bi ta tsaṇ+ḍe shwa ra/ pa ra ma kā ru ṇi kā sarba satwa/ hi ta tsin+ta/ ma ma dha na wa ra do pa t+ye sha swa ya ma ā kar+ṣa ya swāhā/

zhes spyan drangs/ bgegs bskrad/ dbang bskur dbu brgyan/ mchod pa rnams rnam sras dang 'dra/ rgyal po'i sras ni 'phrul che ba/ /nor gyi bdag po mthu bo che/ /rgyal ba khyu mchog 'khor bcas la/ /mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal/ / zhes bstod/ na mo bai shra wa ṇa ya/ tad+ya thā/ si mi si mi/ su mu su mu/ tsaṇ+ḍa tsaṇ+ḍa/ tsa ra tsa ra/ sa ra sa ra/ ka ra ka ra/ ki ri ki ri/ ki li ki li/ ku ru ku ru/ mu ru mu ru/ tsu ru tsu ru/ san+da ya/ at+ma naṃ nir+yan+ta/ an+dar dhā ru swāhā/ na mo bai shra wa ṇa ya swāhā/ dha na da ya swāhā/ mo no ra tha pa ri pu ra ya swāhā/ zhes bzlas/ gtor ma ni rnam thos sras la phul ba'i rjes su/ oṃ dzi narga bha sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ sogs kyis 'bul/ bsnyen pa song nas sbyin bsreg la 'bad na dngos grub stsol bar bshad/ 'di la rjes gnang med bzlas lung tsam mdzad do/ /rgya nag lugs kyi rnam sras su/ /grags pa'ang 'di dang rjes su mthun/ /kuna~X tu btsal yang rnyed dka' ste/ /dga~X' bas snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig bsdus/ /gser 'od las byung ba rgyal ba khyu mchog gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge legs 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ rgyal ba ston pa la btud nas/ /rnam thos sras kyi btsun mor grags/ /lha mo dpal gyi sgrub thabs ni/ /shin tu rnyed par dka' phyir bshad/ /gtsang sbra can gyi mchod gtor rgya cher bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gter gyi bum pa dgu'i steng du pad zla la seng ge'i gdan/ de'i steng tu shriṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ lha mo dpal chen mo ljang khu/ sgeg cing bzhad la spyan gdangs pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas nor bus mtshan pa'i pad+ma dang*/ g.yon skyabs sbyin mdzad pa/ 'khor gnod sbyin ma mo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba'o/ / gnas gsum byin brlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang mthun pa las/ rigs bdag ni gshin rje gshed do/

/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ shes rab pha rol phyin pa mo/ / nam mkha' mdzod kyi ting 'dzin las/ /sgrub la dngos grub stsol ba'i tshul/ / dpal gyi lha mo de la bstod/ /oṃ ka ma la wa si ni/ ka ma le/ mahā lak+ṣi ma ra dz+ya me/ de hi de hi ba ra de swāhā/ zhes ci 'grub tu bzlas/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ shrī de wī sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ la a kā ro btags pas 'bul/ mchod bstod/ 'don don gsol btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol rnams spyi dang 'dra'o/ / 'di la bsgom lung 'bogs pa las gzhan pa'i rjes gnang mi dgos/ dpa' bo chig sgrub kyi rgyud la brten par mngon zhing*/ jo bo'i man ngag bka' gdams pa rnams las brgyud pa'i gdams pa ngo mtshar can yin no/ /kuna~X la ma grags rnyed dka' ba/ /thos pa nyung ba'i skyon yin te/ /sngags rgyud shes rnams yid dga~X'i gnas/ /snyinga~X nas yid ches gsal po~Xr bkod/ /lha mo dpal chen mo'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dpal mo dbyig gi char 'bebs ma/ /nor sgrub kun gyi rig sngags rgyal/ /de la btud de phyag 'tshal nas/ /sgrub thabs gsal bar brjod par bya/ /skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sngon du 'gro bas/ swa bhā wa sa stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gter chen po'i sa gzhi la rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i khang bzang gi dbus su/ gser gyi bum pa nor bus gang ba'i khri la paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i steng du/ baṃ las rang nyid lha mo nor rgyun ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas mchog sbyin gyi mthil nas nor bu'i char 'bebs pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma rab tu rgyas pa dang rin po che'i 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing*/ sgeg cing lang tsho la bab pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ /mtha' skor du nor dpal mo la sogs pa gter gyi bdag mo'i tshogs thams cad dang*/

steng gi cha la sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas btab rnams spyi dang 'dra ba las rigs bdag ni rin chen 'byung ldan no/ / ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas/ /tshe dang nor dang mthu'i dpal brnyes shing*/ /sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i/ / dpal mo nor rgyun ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ / ces bstod/ oṃ bā su dha ri ni swāhā/ zhes snying po ci nus dang*/ ji ltar rigs par nor rgyun ma'i gzungs 'don pa'am/ klog par bya'o/ mdun bskyed ni/ ba'i lci ba'i maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa byas la/ der me tog gi tshom bu bkod/ mchod gtor gtsang ma spyi dang mthun pa dang*/ khyad par me tog sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod bzhagamachod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun/ bdag bskyed bzhin bskyed la/ mchod bstod bzlas pa rnams tshar ba'i rjes la/ snying po'i mthar/ puṣ+pe tīts+tsha na maḥ btags pas lan brgya rtsa brgyad me tog phul la/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab/ yig brgya/ bzod gsol/ gshegs gsol/ smon lam/ bkra shis rnams bya/ rjes gnang gi bya ba ni sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i skabs dang 'dra ba las/ gsung gi rjes gnang song ba'i skabs su/ nor rgyun ma'i mdo bklags te/ gzungs dngos gzhi la rjes zlos lan gcig byar gzhug go /sangs rgyas pa yi sngags rgyud la/ /nor sgrub kuna~X gyi rtsa bar grags/ /zur bka'i sgrub thabs rab dga~X' ba/ /snyinga~X rje'i sems kyis gsal po~Xr bris/ /lha mo nor rgyun ma'i rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gang la longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /dka' ba med par thob 'gyur pa/ /gnod sbyin mo'i rigs sngags mchog/shin du zab gyur mdo tsam bri/

/maṇ+ḍal khru gang ba la tsan+dan gyi chus phyir gru bzhir byugs/ dbus su zlum skor la thug par byugs/ me tog gi tshom bu bzhi bkod/ me tog dkar po'i phung po dang*/ shing pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu dgos par bshad kyang*/ ma rnyed na bil ba'i dod byas bdag bskyed khro bo gang rung zhig sngon du 'gro bas/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su nor rgyun ma gser btso ma lta bu/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lang tsho phun sum tshogs pa/ phyag g.yas pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu sngo dmar bsnams pa/ g.yon 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i bum pa zhabs sprad cing*/ kha gnyis nas rin po che'i rgyun 'bab bzhin pa'i steng na mnyam par bzhengs pa/ sngags re re brjod cing*/ me tog re 'bul ba lan nyi shu rtsa gcig byas pas/ gdugs dkar po re re dbu thog tu byung bar bsam/ bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes lan bdun gsol ba btab/ sngags ni/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ gha taṃ dzhi bha saṃ rak+ṣa ṇi/ pha la haṣ+ti bā su bha ri te/ shi waṃ ka ri shan+tiṃ ku ru/ puṣ+tiṃ ku ru/ bha ya nā sa ni/ sarba duṣ+taṃ/ bhañca/ bhañca/ dzaṃ bha dzaṃ bha/ staṃ bha staṃ bha/ a mṛ te/ ut+bha we/ ku ru ku ru/ ma ma ka dz+ye swāhā/ zhes pa'o/ /gshegs gsol mi dgos/ dge ba bsngo/ 'di rgyun gyi nyams len yin la/ bsnyen pa'i tshe/ sngags dang bcas te me tog ci nus su 'bul ba yin la/ 'bum phrag bzhi'am/ zla ba gsum gyi bsnyen pa rdzogs par bzhed do/ /'di'i rig gtad ni/ rgyun gyi nyams len de nyid slob dpon gyis tshang bar byas pa'i rjes la/ slob mas yon dang maṇ+ḍal phul/ me tog dkar po bzhi bcu zhe gnyis las mi nyung ba slob dpon gyi phyag tu gtad/ slob dpon gyi me tog de/ mdun bskyed la phul/ me tog re slob ma'i spyi bor spungs/ slob ma 'di la dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ de ltar lan nyer gcig byas la/

sgrub thabs bshad pa nyid kyis don 'grub pa yin no/ /mdun bskyed mi dmigs par bzhag pa nyid kyis chog/rjes chog mi dgos so/ /nor rgyun sgrub thabs ches zab pa/ /kuna~X la ma grags rab dga~X'i tog/'dzim lo'i man ngag snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /gsal bar bkod pa'ang rmad du byung*/ /dza ma ri'i lugs nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ oṃ swā sti/ gnod sbyin bdag po ngal gsos po'i/ /slas kyi gtso mor rab grags pa'i/ /gnyis las ba lang rdzi yi ni/ /sgrub thabs snying po bri bar bya/ / rang yi dam du gsal ba'i smin mtshams nas 'od 'phros/ lcang lo can nas nor rgyun ma badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ mdun du 'khod pa ni/ sku mdog ser mo sgeg cing mdzes pa/ phyag g.yas pa pi tsu ra'i 'bras bu dang*/ g.yon pas rin po che'i snye ma 'dzin pa/ gter gyi bum pa zhabs sprad pa/ rin po che'i char 'bebs pa'i steng na mnyam par bzhengs pa/ byang chub kyi shing la rgyab bsten pa/ 'dod 'jo'i ba mo'i khyus bskor ba/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ / mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams nor rgyun ma rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs bzhin byas/ oṃ dzaṃ dhi ka tha ma no ha ra sarba bha na paṭ+ṭa rat+no hūṃ dz+ruṃ hūṃ hūṃ swāhā/ zhes bzla/ mthar gshegs su gsol/ 'di la maṇ+ḍal gyi tshom bu bshams nas/ slob dpon nyid kyis gong bzhin nyams su blangs nas/ slob ma la bsgom lung 'bogs pa ni/ slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi bya ba'o/ /glo bur dgos pa'i las kuna~X la/ /rab tu dga~X' bar bsngags pa yi/ /nor rgyun bran mo'i sgrub thabs kyi/ /snyinga~X po~X 'di yang ngo mtshar che/ /ba lang rdzi'i nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ dbang byed pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma/ /pho nya'i las byed gnod sbyin mo/ /de la brten nas de'i sgrub thabs/ /cung zad tsam zhig bri bar bya/

/skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid nor rgyun ma dmar mo dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ 'od dang bkrag mdangs 'bar ba/ lcags kyu dang ne'u le bsnams pa/ rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ oṃ ma no ha ra ha ra/ oṃ aṅku sha aṅku sha hri hri hri/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mdun bskyed dang*/ mchod bstod byed tshul dang*/ slob ma la lung 'bogs tshul rnams ba lang rdzi'i nor rgyun ma'i skabs dang 'dra'o/ /'di yang kuna~X du zab po zhes/ /bsngags shing rab dga~X' las tshogs can/ /snyinga~X nas sgrub par 'dod na ni/ /yig rnying rnams la te po~Xr gzigs/ /yid 'phrog nor rgyun ma'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dge'o/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ thugs kyi rdo rje gsang ba'i bdag/phyag na rdo rje la btud nas/ /gnod sbyin chen po zhang 'on gyi/ /phyi nang gsang gsum sgrub thabs bshad/ /bris sku'i mdun du mchod gtor bshams la/ phyag na rdo rje'i khang bu brtsegs pa'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bsrung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa'i nang du/ 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa de'i lte bar pad+ma nyi ma srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la/ hūṃ mthing nag las gnod sbyin chen po rdo rje bdud 'dul phyag g.yas nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon gser gyi bum pa rin po ches gang ba 'dzin pa/ sku mdog nag po khro zhing brjid pa/ spyan gsum/ mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'gril ba/ sma ra smin ma dbu skra kham nag gyen du brdzes pa/ dar nag gi 'jol ber gsol zhing*/ sag ti'i lham gyon pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan dang*/ gser gyi ske rags bcings pa/ mi mgo'i do shal dang bcas shing*/ rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing*/ me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /g.yon du bh+yoḥlas yum rdo rje kun 'grub ma sku mdog sngon mo phyag g.yas pas zhal zas gtso la stobs cing*/

g.yon pas nad rkyal 'dzin pa/ dar dkar gyi na bza' dang*/ mgo bo'i do shal can/ skra dmar ser thur du 'phyang ba'o/ / rtsibs bzhi la shar du nor lha dkar po dar dkar gyi na bza' dang*/ rin po che'i rgyan can/ g.yas nor bu dang*/ g.yon rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ brkyang bskum gyi stabs kyis dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ zhi ba'i nyams can no/ /lho ru mgon po nag po shin tu khros shing dar nag mtha' ljang can gsol ba/ sbrul dang mi mgos brgyan pa/ g.yas tsan+dan gyi bing chen dang*/ g.yon lcags par 'dzin par brkyang bskum gyi stabs kyis gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ nub tu 'brog gnas dmar po zhal lnga ste/ dbus seng ge g.yas rta dang lugagayon ra dang spre'u/ phyag drug dang po gnyis kyis rin po che'i sgrom bu 'dzin pa/ bar pa gnyis kyis gser gyi 'khor lo dang shing 'bras 'dzin pa/ tha ma gnyis kyis 'bras dang sman sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ brkyang bskum stabs kyis klu pho mo bsnol pa'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ byang du rnam sras ljang khu sku sbom zhing brjid pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan dang bse'i khrab dang rmog zhu gsol ba/ gser gyi rta lcags dang*/ sman sna nor bus gang ba'i gzhong ba bsnams pa/ rta ngang ser la chibs shing*/ gnod sbyin pho mo brdzis pa'o/ / gal te de dag sa bon las bskyed na/ dzaṃḥhūṃ k+ṣaṃ beṃ zhes pa rnams las bskyed do/ /gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dbang bskur rgyas btab/ gtso bo la phyag na rdo rje dang*/ 'khor rnams la rdo rje rtse lnga pa res dbu brgyan/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ dpal chen rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ /gdug pa 'dul zhing bar chad sel/ khyod kyis 'phrin las kun sgrub pa/ /gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas la bstod/ / de nas bzlas pa ni/ yi dam gyi sngags kyis cung zad thogs drangs nas/

oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta ra ga ra ge hūṃ phaṭa/ gtso bo'i sngags so/ / oṃ badz+ra rat+na tsit+ta ban+dha bdud ma ting skyol ting ting dza dzaḥ yum gyi'o/ / oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya dzaṃ bha la hri da ya swāhā/ oṃ mahā kā la ha na ha na badz+re na swāhā/ oṃ mahā yak+ṣa pañca de ba rā dza ya swāhā/ oṃ bai shra ma ṇa ye swāhā/ zhes bzlas zhing*/ gtor chog ni spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs la/ snying po'i mthar i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mahā pañca a mṛ ta khā hi/ mahā rak+ta khā hi/ sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes btags shing*/ 'khor rnams la i daṃ bā ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ gcig pu btags pas 'bul/ mchod bstod/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs kyi 'dod don zhu/ rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ 'di dkyus kyi nyams len ltar yin/ phyi sgrub kho na ltar na/ yum mi bskyed par gtso 'khor lngas chog go /gtso bo'i phyag g.yas kyi phyag mtshan nor bus mtshan pa'i be con byed pa'ang yod do/ /nang sgrub ni gzhan 'dra ba las/

'khor bzhi mi bskyed par rdo rje bdud 'dul sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gang bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas srin po pho mo mnan pa/ cha lugs gong dang 'dra/ yum yang snga ma bzhin bskyed de lcam dral gnyis su sgrub pa yin no/ /gsang sgrub ltar na/ sku mdog mthing nag/nag dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum mche ba gtsigs shing dbu skra gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag drug g.yas gsum na rtse gsum/ dbyug pa ral gri/ g.yon gsum na thod pa zhags pa lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis dgra bgegs thams cad mnan pa/ rgyan cha lugs gong dang 'dra/ phyogs bzhir/ k+ṣa las gnod sbyin bzhi ste/ g.yas su rnon po nag po dgra sta ral gri nad rkyal zhags pa rnams 'dzin pa/ g.yon du kun gyis 'jigs byed dmar ser dar nag ral gri nad rkyal zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rgyab tu nyi ma mig dmar nag gri gug zhags pa nad rkyal thod khrag 'dzin pa/ mdun du yum rdo rje kun 'grub ma/ gong bzhin/ de rnams me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan rnams bsgyel ba'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ gnod sbyin pho gsum char yang phyag bzhi pa/ thams cad kyang zhi ma khro sbrul dang rin po ches brgyan pa'o/ / gnod sbyin de gsum gyi rigs sngags ni rim pas / oṃ badz+ra mahā yak+ṣa ya a ka tri skyol dza dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa tsakra dun dun dza dzaḥ oṃ mahā dz+nyā na nā ga rā dza ha ha rbad rbad sa ma ya dza dzaḥ zhes so/ /rjes gnang gi bya ba ni/ yi ge rnying ma rnams na/ rnying ma'i lugs kyi byin rlabs dbang gi tshul can 'dra min sna tshogs zhig 'dug na'ang*/ deng sang lag len gyi rgyun med la/ da ltar gsar ma dang mthun pa'i rjes gnang la phyag len mdzad de/ sgom don dang mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor ram/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad tsam/ bsdu na tshom bus kyang rung ste/ steng du gtor ma rdo rje phyed pa'i rnam pa can bkod/

mtha' mchod gtod gyis bskor/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed gtor chog yan song mtshams/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /dpal chen rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi/ / sku gsung thugs kyi rjes gnang dang*/ /byin gyis brlab pa stsal du gsol/ / zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab/ slob dpon phyag rdor dang*/ mdun bskyed gnod sbyin 'khor bcas gsal btab nas rgyun bshags bya/ slob ma gnod sbyin 'khor bcas su bskyed la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs/ lcang lo can nas 'khor bcas spyan drangs la bstim/ rol mo bya/ sku'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /bzlas lung byin rlabs kyi lung dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ gsung gi rjes gnang ste/ de gnyis la phyi'i rjes gnang zhes bya/ phyag mtshan bstim pa thugs kyi rjes gnang zhes bya/ gtor ma mgo thog tu bzhag la/ bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ mthar/ hūṃ mgon po rdo rje bdud 'dul ni/ /thugs rje'i stobs kyis gdug pa 'dul/ /gzhon nu dpa' bo khros pa'i sku/ khro bo'i rgyal pos dbang bskur ro/ /lha thams cad kyi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros/ slob ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ lus thams cad 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyis gang bas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs par bsam/ gsang ba'i rjes gnang ngo*/ /snying ga'i 'od zer gyis snod bcud bsdu ba'i dmigs pa phog ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rjes gnang ngo*/ /rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ phyi sgrub nang sgrub gsang sgrub gsum so sor don du gnyer ba la de dang de sbyin zhing thams cad don du gnyer na/ mdun bskyed kyi skabs phyi nang gsang gsum gyi gtso bo rnams gsum sgrigs su bskyed/ phyi sgrub kyi 'khor bzhi dkyus ltar dang*/ gsang sgrub kyi 'khor bzhi de'i phyi rim la 'god/ thun mong du mchod gtor sogs phul nas/

slob ma'i bya ba'i skabs/ slob ma yang mdun bskyed bzhin du bskyed/ bzlas lung gi skabs phyi sgrub lha lnga'i sngags song ba'i rjes la/ gsang sgrub kyi 'khor bzhi'i sngags sbrel nas bzlas lung byed/ maṇ+ḍal la tshom bu so sor 'god/ gtor ma gcig gis chog pas gtor dbang yang gcig gis chog go /gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi/ /sgrub thabs kuna~X du dga' ba 'di/ /snyinga~X po~X len pa la mos shing*/ /tshig tshogs gtsor mi byed la 'os/ /gnod sbyin rdo rje bdud 'dul gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gnod sbyin nor gyi dbang phyug gi /thugs kyi rnam 'phrul las mkhan mchog/gzhan gyis mi thub sgrub thabs ni/ /rjes gnang dang 'brel mdo tsam bri/ /mdun du maṇ+ḍal dkar po pad+ma 'dab brgyad la tshom bu gcig bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gtsang mas bskor/ phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang sgo gcig pa/ de'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma a las zla ba la hrīḥyig 'od kyi 'phro 'du las/ gnod sbyin chen po gangs ri'i mdog can/ gzhon nu'i lus la sdang mig dmar ba/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon gter gyi bum pa 'dzin pa/ dar dkar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rin po che'i phyag rgya bcas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ ri rab kyi byang shar nas/ gnod sbyin gzhan gyi mi thub pa 'khor bcas badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dbang bskur spyi dang mthun pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ hriṃ dza a pa ra dzi ta dza dzaḥ zhes ci nus bzlas/ mchod pa byin rlabs spyi dang mthun pa las/ 'bru gsum mang du brjod/ gtor ma byin rlabs rnam sras ljang khu seng zhon gyi skabs bzhin bya/ snying po la bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi swāhā/ zhes btags pa lan bdun gyis 'bul/

ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ dpal ldan rgyal po rnam thos sras/ /de'i bang mdzod lde mig 'dzin/ /nor bdag chen po rin chen sbyin/ /'byor pa spel byed khyod la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la sogs spyi dang 'dra/ /slob ma khrus byas maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du btang*/ bla ma rje btsun bdag la dgongs su gsol bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la/ gnod sbyin gzhan gyis mi thub pa'i dngos grub kyi rjes su gnang ba mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma la dar dkar gyis gos bskon/ stong par sbyangs pa nas rigs bdag gi bar sgrub pa'i thabs ltar dmigs pa phogaslob ma'i lag tu rin po che'i 'phreng ba gtad de/ bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ gtor ma spyi bor bzhag ste/ bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ slob ma de 'di'i bsnyen sgrub byed nges yin na/ dam tshig bsre zhing bro dgag pa'i phyag len kyang yod/ rjes kyi bya ba rnams spyi dang 'dra ba la/ slob mas dar dkar po'am ser po'i yon dbul bar bya'o/ /'di'i sgrub tshul ni/ rgyud dang man ngag rgyas pa rnams su shes par bya'o/ /rab zab stag lung thang pa yi/ /thugs dam lha drug nang na'ang bzhugs/ /kuna~X du rgyas pa'i yig cha las/ /rab dga~X'i snyinga~X po~X mdo tsam bsdus/ /gnod sbyin a pa ra dzi ta'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon dang he ru ka /ra hu la dang mar me mdzad/ /bla ma yi dam la btud nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i sgrub thabs bshad/ /tshogs bdag chags pa rdo rje sgrub par 'dod pas/ mdun du maṇ+ḍal dkar po zlum po/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyis mtshan pa/ stegs bu gru bzhi la tsan+dan dkar po dang*/ gi haṃ bsres pas byugs/ maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su bum pa dkar po nang rdzas can bsham/ mthar mchod gtor gyis bskor/ tsa ka li dang la du la phug sogs kyang bsham/

bdag bskyed spyan ras gzigs sam/ dgyes rdor gang rung bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi mdun du gaṃ dkar po las tshogs kyi bdag po rtsa zhal glang po che'i gdong pa can/ g.yas byi la'i gdong*/ g.yon spre'u'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gsum la phug nor bu ral gri/ g.yon la du chang snod dgra sta 'dzin pa/ zhabs mdun ma gnyis bsnol zhing*/ rgyab ma gnyis g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs can/ gcer bu rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ pad+ma'i tshangs skud can/ 'og tu yum dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gcer bu rin po ches brgyan pa/ spre'u'i gdong can ut+pal sngon po'i tshangs skud can/ phyag gnyis kyis gtso bo'i zhabs gnyis brten zhing*/ zhal gyis gsang ba'i rdo rje 'jib pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad pa/ pho nya dang phyag brnyen mo spre'u'i lus can gyis brten pa/ sku'i 'og dang g.yas g.yon du gter gyi bum pa can/ mtha' bskor du bkra shis rtags brgyad dang*/ rdzas brgyad dang*/ rgyal srid rin po che'i sna bdun gyis bskor ba/ thugs kar sngags 'phreng sa bon dang bcas pa/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ lte bar hūṃ/ thugs ka'i sngags 'phreng sa bon las yid bzhin gyi nor bu'i rgyun babs/ gsang ba nas brgyud/ yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud gsang ba nas babs/ bum pa gang*/ de las lud de gnas khang gang bar gyur/ mchod pa rnams spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs te spyi dang mthun par 'bul/ shel gyi ri bo lta bu'i sku/ /'phongs sel 'byor ba kun gyi bdag/tshogs rje tshogs bdag bgegs kyi gtso/ 'khor bcas rnams la bstod pa 'bul/ /oṃ ga ga na pa ti ma ma rat+na sid+dhi ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga/ga na pa ti swāhā/ zhes bzla/ gtor ma a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las gtor snod du gtor ma bdud rtsir bskyed/ oṃ āḥhūṃ gis byin gyis brlabs/

oṃ ga na pa ti bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /sogs 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i bya ba ni/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun pa rnams byas la/ slob ma tshogs bdag tu bskyed/ sngags kyi bzlas lung spyi dang mthun par sbyin/ la phug lag pa g.yas pa dang*/ la du lag pa g.yon du gtad/ maṇ+ḍal spyi bor bzhag la bka' bsgo drag tu bya/ rjes kyi bya ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /rgyun gtor tsam dang nyer 'brel ba'i/ /sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas 'di/ /kuna~X nas mkho ba'i yid dga~X'i gnas/ /yi ge byas pa'i snyinga~X po~X yin/ /'jur 'gegs sel ba'i tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten dbang la gus btud nas/ /tshogs bdag dkar po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /jo bo rje yi man ngag bzhin/ /mdo tsam bdag gis bri bar bya/ /bag phye la mar dang spos dang sbrang rtsi btab pa la/ la du'i tshul gyi ril bu mang du bsham/ snod gtsang ma gzhan zhig chu gtsang gi gsum gnyis tsam bkang*/ me tog la sogs pa mchod pa spyi mthun du bsham zhing*/ rten yod na bgram/ yi dam kyi mngon rtogs sngon du song bas/ rang gi mdun du pad zla'i gdan la tshogs bdag dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ phyag g.yas gnyis na la phug dang 'phreng ba can/ g.yon gnyis na ne'u le dang dgra sta 'dzin pa/ gsus pa 'phyang ba rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ stag lpags kyi stod g.yogs smad g.yogs gsol ba/ ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ sna shal dmar ba g.yas brkyang gi rol pas bzhugs pa/ byi ba la gnas pa'am/ rgyab brten pa'o/ / ril bu rnams 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes mtheb srin g.yas pas ril bu rnams rim pas chu nang du bskyur bas rna shal gyis blangs shing gsol bar bsams la/ nyer gcig sogs gang nus su phul/

de nas bzlas pa ni/ oṃ bh+rūṃ ga ṇa pa ti swāhā/ zhes dang*/ oṃ bha ra ka ta ye swāhā/ zhes pa dang*/ oṃ wa ka te daṃṣ+taṃ bhin da hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes pa rnams gang rung ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ bh+ruṃ ga ṇa pa ti rat+na sid+dhi swāhā/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzla'o/ /mthar ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ lha yi rgyal po lha min 'joms/ /mtha' dag bgegs la dbang bsgyur ba/ / gangs ri'i mdog ltar rab tu dkar/ /tshogs rje gzi brjid 'bar la bstod/ / bdag gi mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i yon bdag mdzod cig/ ces drag tu gsol ba btab/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na mi dmigs par sbyangs/ lung 'bogs tshul ni/ rjes gnang spyi dang 'dra bar byed pa'ang yod la/ yang slob ma'i mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bshams/ gsol btab yan chad tshar ba'i rjes la/ slob ma la bsgom lung phog nas/ sngags la rjes zlos byed pa nyid yin no/ khyung po rnal 'byor gyi zhal nas/ mi yi yon bdag ngo bsrung dka'/ /lha yi yon bdag bsgrub par bya'o/ /zhes dge bshes dkon mchog mkhar la gnang*/ de nas phag gru las brgyud pa'i gsung bsgros las 'byung ngo*/ /dka' tshegs chung zhing kuna~X nas zab/ /gong ma'i phyag lan brgyud bcas 'di/ /dga~X' bar mthong nas 'bad de zhus/ /snyinga~X po~X tsam zhig yi ge byas/ /tshogs bdag jo bo lugs bsdus pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// // ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ gsang bdag la sogs ye shes kyi/ khro bo kun la btud byas nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po sgrub thabs ni/ /mdo tsam rab tu bshad par bya/ /bde mchog gam phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du song nas/ bris sku'i mdun du dam rdzas rnams tshogs par bya/ mdun bskyed bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+ruṃ las gzhal med khang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa'i gdan dang bcas pa/ lte bar gaṃ las tshogs bdag dmar po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas la phug dang dgra sta/ g.yon la du dang 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/

byi ba sngon po la chibs shing*/ gter gyi bum pa la zhabs brten pa/ thugs kar gaṃ /rtsibs brgyad la rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa re re/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ ri rab kyi rtse mo nas tshogs bdag badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ ga na pa ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhaga.a mṛ ta sa phyi 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ rat+na rat+na rat+no rat+no/ ga ṇa pa ti/ ga ga ga ga ga ga ga ga/ga na pa ti/ tsu ru tsu ru/ ma nu pa tra/ ru ru ru ru/ ga ga ta ya/ ga ṇa pa ti ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas/ gtor ma dang mchod pa spyi dang mthun par byin gyis brlabs/ snying po'i mthar a kā ro btags pas gtor ma phul/ mchod bstod 'dod don gsol btab sogs tshogs bdag gzhan dang mthun no/ /'di ni dpal chen rga lo nas brgyud pa ste/ sku mdog dkar po byas kyang rung*/ gtso bor dbang gi las kyi kha dog tu bya'o/ /'di bsgom lung kho nas 'grub bo/ /nam mkha' mnyam pa'i rgyud chung las/ /kuna~X du gsal bar bstan pa yi/ /rab dga~X' sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X 'di/ /phag gru'i gsung dang mthun par 'dod/ /tshogs bdag dmar po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ /

༄༅/ /sog ma med kyi sgrub thabs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon po sangs rgyas dang*/ /phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs pad la/ /btud nas sog ma med ces pa/ /sngags bdag sgrub thabs bri bar bya/ /phyag na rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ dkar gtor dang mchod pa bsham/ rang gi mdun du pad zla la phuḥyig las/ klu rgyal sog ma med gser mdog sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis gser gyi bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing lte ba man chad sbrul 'jug tu 'khyil ba/ bu dang chung ma la sogs pa'i gnyen 'dun dang 'khor g.yog drug khri dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ byang phyogs nas klu rgyal sog ma med 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ nā ga rā dza sa pā ri wā ra dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ oṃ nā ga rā dza sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag par mos/ klu dga' bar byed pa'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ hi li hi li mahā hi li phruṃ phu swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ oṃ phuḥphuḥphu ta phu ta mahā kro dha hūṃ/ sid+dhi sid+dhi s+pho ṭa ya hūṃ phaṭa swāhā zhes ci nus su bzlas/ mthar klu dbang rgyal po'i sgrub thabs su bshad pa ltar gtor ma byin gyis brlabs nas sngags kyi mthar/ i daṃ bā liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes gtso bo dang*/ oṃ bhak+ṣa ya/ bhak+ṣa ya/ sa mā ya tiṣ+ṭha/ dz+ruṃ phruṃ phu hūṃ swāhā/ zhes pas 'khor la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ klu yi rgyal po sog ma med/ /sangs rgyas stong gi 'phrin las pa/ /gzhon nu gtum po sbrul mgo can/ /sngags bdag sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / 'dod don gsol ba btab la/ oṃ muḥ zhes spyan drangs pa rang gnas su gshegs/ bskyed gzhi mi dmigs par sbyangs/ bris sku yod na rab gnas bya'o/ /'di la rig gtad byed pa'i lag len yod par gda' na'ang*/ sgom lung thob pa tsam gyis chog go

/kuna~X la sog ma med ces grags/ /'ga' zhig tu ni sngags bdag ces/ /rab tu dga~X' bas mtshan gsol ba'i/ /sgrub thabs snyinga~X po~X tsam 'di yin/ /jo bo rje las brgyud pa/ bka' gdams pa'i man ngag klu rgyal sog ma med kyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ /dbyug gu ma spun gsum gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swā sti/ 'jig rten mgon la rab btud nas/ kha na ma tho dang bral ba'i/ /longs spyod phun tshogs sgrub pa'i thabs/ /cung zad tsam zhig bri bar bya/ /snod gtsang mar dkar gtor gsum dang*/ chang bu gsum bsham/ rang sems skad cig gis mdun du gnod sbyin mo kun+da li sku mdog mthing kha/ spyan rtsa dmar ba/ phyag gnyis kyi bar na rin po che bsnams pa'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod du oṃ āḥhūṃ zhu ba las gtor mar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ lan gsum/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar me tog mañju sha ka kha bye ba'i ster du/ dbus su nor ster ma sngon mo/ g.yas su gos ster ma dkar mo/ g.yon du zas ster ma dmar mo/ gsum ka'ang phyag g.yas nor bu dang*/ g.yon pas bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa dar dkar gyi stod g.yogs dang*/ sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' can/ rin po che'i brgyan pa/ rol pas bzhugs shing 'dzum pas bdag la gzigs pa/ spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ de las 'od 'phros/ dbyug gu ma spun gsum badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ bzlas pa ni/ oṃ a na le kuṇ+ḍa le mahā pi sha tsi ni ye swāhā/ oṃ gṛh+ṇa mahā bhan+ḍa pi sha tsi ni ye swāhā/ oṃ shu dra mu khe mahā pi sha tsi ni ye swāhā/ zhes ci nus su bzlas la/ dkar gtor gsum po rang gi snying po lan gsum gyis phul/ hūṃ mkha' 'gro chen mo khyed gsum la/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di phul bas/ /bdag la nor gos zas gsum gyis/

/mi 'phongs 'byor ba de nyid kyang*/ /chos kyi grogs su 'gro bar mdzod/ /bdag la skal pa med mod kyang*/ /log 'tsho med pa'i 'tsho ba stsol/ / zhais brjod la gtsang sar dor/ chang bu thog mtha' gnyis la rang sngags dang*/ bar pa la/ oṃ mi li gi pi li gi swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun bdun gyis sngags grub pa'i tshe 'bul lo/ /zhes brda' gtor du bya/ de ltar rab zhag gsum 'bring brgyad/ tha ma nyer gcig gis 'grub bo/ /de nas yig rnying las bshad pa ltar gyi/ byi ba kha sprad kyi rten bcas/ gzhan rnams sngar dang 'dra ba la/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ tsa me u me ni du kha*/ na swāhā/ zhes bzhi brgya tsam du bzla bar bshad do/ /dam tshig tshul khrims dang*/ gtsang sbra la gnas shing*/ byi ba la mi sdang bar bya'o/ /'di lung tsam gyis 'grub cing*/ 'di'i brgyud yig 'ga' zhig na/ rdo rje gdan pa brgyud par byas pa'ang 'dug mod kyi/ jo bo rje nas/ bka' gdams pa las brgyud pa kho na yin par shes par bya'o/ /deng sang kuna~X la ma grags pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rab tu dga~X' ba 'di/ /tshul ldan rnams kyi snyinga~X nor yin/ /rgyun gyi lag len gsal po~Xr bkod/ /dbyug gu ma spun gsum gyi sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ / ༄༅/ khol po kun+dha li sgrub thabs so/ / oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang la/ /dngos po kun gyis phyag 'tshal nas/ /tshogs kyi bdag po'i khol po ni/ /kun+dha li yi sgrub thabs bshad/ /ras la glang po che dkar po rin po che'i rgyan dang*/ sna thag can rin po che'i snod bkal ba zhig bris la mdun du dgram/ 'bras dang dkar gsum sogs bza' ba gtsang ma'i spungs gtor bsham/ bdag bskyed khro bo gang rigs dang*/ mdun du tshogs bdag dkar po skad cig gis bskyed nas/ de'i mdun du thad ka skad cig gis gnod sbyin kun+dha li dkar po g.yas lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon glang po che'i sna nas 'khrid pa/

thun mtshams re la stong gsum bskor bar nus pa mdun du bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ pi sha tsi kun+dha li i daṃ bā liṃng ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod cing*/ gtor ma nas phud gtor bya/ spos dkar dang tsan+dan la sogs pa'i bdug pas bdugabadag dang tshogs bdag la nor bu dang 'bru'i mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ stong gsum bskor bar bsam/ oṃ pi sha tsi kun+dha li mahā bud+dha shwa ra/ dhi ri dhi ri/ phob phob/ sid+dhi hūṃ swāhā/ zhes nyer gcig las mi nyung bar bzla'o/ /lha yon bdag tu sgrub pa zhes bya ste/ 'tsho ba tshegs med par 'grub bo/ / 'di la lung ma gtogs rjes gnang mi dgos/ 'di las gzhan pa'i man ngag kyang med do/ /'di yang jo bo rje nas brgyud pa bka' gdams pa'i gdams pa'o/ /kuna~X la grags pa mi che yang*/ /tshul khrims ldan pa rab tu dga~X'/ /mi rnams snyinga~X ni mgu dka' bas/ /lha sgrub pa la brtson po~Xr bya/ khol po kun+dha li'i sgrub thabs kyi le tshan no// //dar rgyas 'phel/ sgrub thabs rin chen 'byung gnas las/ nor lha'i sgrub thabs bshad pa'i skabs te/ bco brgyad pa'o// //zhu dag/'dir 'bad rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba yis/ /bla ma yi dam lha tshogs dbyer ma mchis/ /rtag tu zhal mthong gsung gi bdud rtsi la/ /brten nas mchog gi go 'phang myur thob shog/shu bhaṃ/ maṅga laṃ// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/yi dam rgya mtsho'i sgrubs thabs rin chen 'byung gnas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ - PAGE 276 -- PAGE 1 - EMBED CorelDRAW.Graphic.9
